The Bad: The rest of the food was a massive letdown. I was genuinely surprised by how off-balance and awful the flavors were.
The Drinks: The mocktails were overwhelmingly sweet, tasting more like pure sugar syrup than a crafted beverage.

Service & Execution
The Ugly: The service was painfully slow. We had to wait a full hour just for a simple serving of fried rice.

Ambience & Maintenance
The venue is showing serious signs of neglect. There was noticeable dust everywhere, and the seating has not been maintained well. The chairs were highly uncomfortable, making it hard to actually sit back and enjoy the evening.

I never expected this level of service and food quality from BYG. It’s disheartening to see a favorite spot slide this far down. They urgently need to look into their kitchen efficiency, recipe consistency, and basic housekeeping.

The Ultimate Bengaluru Brewery Experience 🍻

Byg Brewsky (Hennur) definitely lives up to the hype as the most popular outlet in the city. If you’re looking for the quintessential "Bengaluru vibe," this is exactly where you’ll find it.

The atmosphere here is incredible—spacious, lively, and yet soothing with the right balance of light music. It’s easily one of the most happening spots in town, perfect for both a high-energy night out or a chill evening.

The Brews: Their in-house brewery is top-notch with a wide variety of craft beers and a full bar.

The Food: We explored a bit of everything—chicken, fish, pork, and roasted corn. Every dish was outstanding, featuring very rich, distinct flavors.

A Small Quibble: While the quality is high, the starters come with a lot of onions and boiled corn on the side, which feels a bit like "filler" given the premium pricing.

Booking is Essential: Don’t just show up! Prior booking is a must to ensure you get a table, especially since the weekend crowd is massive.

Price Point: It is on the higher side, but the ambiance and food quality make it worth the spend.

Verdict: A must-visit destination for anyone in Bengaluru. This review is based entirely on my personal experience.

Absolutely fantastic experience at Big Brewsky, Hennur! The ambience here is unmatched, making it the perfect spot to unwind. Both the food and drinks were top-notch, packed with great flavor. Service was quick and attentive too. Everything about the vibe and the culinary experience was excellent. Will definitely be coming back

name: Byg Brewski Brewing Company
review_texts:
This is a top tier hangout spot. The ambience is just really good for candle light dinners . The pondside seating with ducks going around is simply relaxing.

Sitting right next to the water body just elevates the whole vibe of the place.

The craft beers easily hold their own, and the pricing is surprisingly fair—you're looking at about ₹300 to ₹350 for a full 500ml glass. We tasted the Smoked Amber Ale, the IPA, the Wit beer, and the Hefe. Every single one hit the spot and tasted super fresh.

For food, we ordered the egg noodles. Honestly, it was amazing. Perfectly cooked, huge portion, and had that great wok-tossed, savory flavor that just pairs perfectly with a cold beer. Everything we ate was great, and the service was super fast and friendly .

They had some really good music playing in the background too.

The service was prompt and to the point , no fuss service .

The decor of this bar is quite nice, with a large pond in the center that surprisingly even has two ducks in it.

However, the music here is way too loud, making it impossible to hear my friends talking. The BGM selection isn't great either—it’s mostly just cheesy, outdated pop songs. I’m definitely not a fan of the playlist.

The snacks we ordered were just mediocre. Plus, since they have an open kitchen, we could still smell the cooking fumes even while sitting out in the courtyard.

Overall, I wouldn't really recommend it. If you're looking for a good atmosphere, there are better bars out there to go to.

Byg Brewski on Sarjapur Road is not just a brewery, it’s an experience.
One of the biggest brewpubs in Bengaluru, this place feels like a mini holiday spot with massive open spaces, greenery all around, and that stunning waterfront seating that instantly sets the mood.
What made our visit extra fun was their “Spin to Win” activity – running daily from 12 PM to 8 PM.
Every table gets a spin, everyone wins something – no awkward rules, no pressure to finish food fast. Just spin mid-meal and enjoy the surprise. Such a cool concept!
Coming to the food – every dish we tried was on point.
The peanut fried wontons were super crunchy and addictive,
avocado tacos were fresh and flavourful,
pickle mushroom balls had a nice tangy kick,
and the paneer puffs were soft inside with a crispy outside.
For main course, the mushroom stroganoff was rich, creamy and super comforting.
Desserts were heavenly – the chocolate cake was pure indulgence and the raspberry chocolate mousse was light, balanced and delicious.
Drinks were equally good – refreshing watermelon mocktail, their in-house brewed beer, and a fun Byg shot to end it on a high.
Service was amazing – quick, friendly, and very attentive.
Overall, Byg Brewski Sarjapur Road is perfect for date nights, celebrations, or just a chill evening with great food, drinks, vibes and fun experiences.
Definitely a must-visit if you love breweries with a view.

I recently visited Byg Brewski Brewing Company on Sarjapur Road and overall had a really enjoyable time! The ambience is one of the biggest highlights — the vast, vibrant space with both indoor and outdoor seating creates a great vibe for a casual night out, dinner with friends, or even a relaxed date night. The poolside and garden-like seating areas made the evening feel extra special.

The craft beers and beverages are definitely worth trying, with several refreshing options on tap that pairs well with the food. The staff were attentive and friendly, and we felt well-looked after — they even suggested some good brews and dishes.
In terms of food, we had a mix — a few dishes were delicious and well-presented, while some felt more average in taste. But overall it paired nicely with the drinks and complemented the experience. The pricing is on the higher side, so it’s worth keeping that in mind if you’re planning a meal with drinks.
The only minor hiccups were that it can get busy on weekends, so reservations are a good idea, and a couple of items took a little longer to arrive during peak times — but nothing that dampened the night.

Great spot overall for craft beer lovers and anyone wanting a fun, social evening on Sarjapur Road. Would definitely recommend stopping by if you’re in the area!

Visited Byg Brewski Brewing Company recently and tried their newly launched Mango Menu — such a refreshing and unique concept with mango-infused cocktails, mocktails, appetizers, and desserts! 🥭

We tried the Sushi Cone, Summer Mango Salad, Coconut Crusted Chicken, Mango Brulee, and Crisp & Creme.

But the real stars of the evening were definitely the desserts — Mango Brulee and Crisp & Creme. Both were absolutely outstanding and easily the best dishes we had. The Mango Brulee was rich, creamy, and perfectly caramelized, while the Crisp & Creme had an amazing texture and flavour combination that made us want more.

Loved the overall ambience and creativity of the menu. A must-try for mango lovers this season!

name: Empire Restaurant- HSR LAYOUT
review_texts: We had our lunch here after coming from a long trip ! Well the food was great and the signature red kebab is back 😍😍😍 which is mouth watering . I will always prefer Empire for non veg food then any other restaurant if I am travelling . Cost wise it is good 👍! Will definitely visit for sure 👍
Food was good and ambience is also fine but I suggest one thing put some songs that's very satisfying but biriyani i don't liked

The chicken in the shawarma felt very bland. Could have been improved. it was just a lot of mayo
It's not the same as I had before. The masala's very perfect before. Kinda disappointed..

A decent restaurant to visit in HSR Layout. We tried both shawarma and their signature chicken fry. The shawarma was not that great, but the chicken fry is definitely a must-try.
Overall, a decent place, especially for their signature items.

Great food and an even better dining experience! A special thanks to rehan for his excellent service. He was polite, friendly, and incredibly quick, making sure we were comfortable throughout our meal. His positive attitude and genuine care really stood out. He truly deserves appreciation for his hard work. Thank you, Rehan !

name: Central Tiffin Room
review_texts:
If you're looking for the best dosa in Bangalore, your search ends here.
CTR serves authentic South Indian food, and almost every item on the menu is excellent. The quality and taste of the food are top-notch, which is why this place has remained a favorite among food lovers for generations.
Located in the heart of Malleswaram 7th Cross, the restaurant is easy to reach and attracts visitors from all parts of the city.
Timings: 7:00 AM to 12:30 PM and 4:00 PM to 9:30 PM. The restaurant is open every day.
I had the famous Butter Masala Dosa, and it was outstanding. The dosa was perfectly crispy, generously coated with butter, and served with delicious coconut chutney. Every bite was flavorful and worth the wait.
A must-visit place for anyone who wants to experience one of Bangalore's most iconic dosas

Visited CTR Tiffin Room, Bengaluru and had an amazing experience. We arrived a little late, so the Idli and Vada were no longer available as service closes around 12:30 PM. However, we tried their famous dosa, and it was absolutely worth it.

The dosa was incredibly crispy, flavorful, and unlike any dosa I have ever had before. The taste was truly unique and memorable. The staff were also very polite, friendly, and welcoming, which made the experience even better.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Bengaluru. Definitely one of the best dosa experiences I’ve had! 😊🙏

The ambience of the place feels very nostalgic and reflects the charm of the 70s era. It has a two-storeyed seating arrangement along with a separate AC hall. Although there was seating available in the non-AC area, we chose to sit in the AC section.
We ordered one Set Dosa, which was served with sago, and two Butter Masala Dosas that came with two types of chutney but no sambar. One of the chutneys had a mint flavour but was unfortunately too salty, making it difficult to eat. Overall, the taste of the food felt quite ordinary.
We also ordered filter coffee, but it was very light and the milk didn’t seem to be properly boiled.
Perhaps we were just unfortunate on that particular day, but the overall experience was not good enough for us. Unfortunately, we did not enjoy the food, so I would not recommend this place based on our visit.

Growing up in Bengaluru, I've visited CTR Malleshwaram many times. I recently went back after almost a decade, and I'm happy to say the taste hasn't changed at all. The hype is absolutely justified—the food is still delicious.

The masala dosa is outstanding, the goli bajjis are a must-try, and if you're a coffee lover, their filter coffee is among the best.

Personally, I felt the dosa had a bit too much butter/oil for my liking, but that's just my preference.

The service, however, could be better. The waiters are always in a rush, which can sometimes lead to confusion with orders, and they aren't always very polite while handling it.

Parking is another challenge, but that's something you'd expect in Malleshwaram.

Overall, despite a few minor drawbacks, CTR continues to be one of Bengaluru's iconic food destinations and is definitely worth a visit.

Visited this beautiful old-style place in Malleswaram and it turned out to be such a lovely experience! If you’re someone who enjoys authentic Bangalore-style breakfast with that nostalgic charm, this place is a must-visit.
We started with Bonda Soup , it was my first time trying it and I absolutely loved it. The bonda was soft, and the hot, flavorful dal poured over it made it incredibly comforting.
Next, we had the Benne Masala Dosa, and it was top notch! Perfectly crisp on the outside, soft inside, generously smeared with butter, and paired with delicious chutney and sambar. Every bite felt indulgent.
We ended the meal with a classic filter coffee, and wow… it was the perfect finish. Strong, aromatic, and served just the way it should be.
The whole place has such an old Bangalore vibe ,simple, authentic, and full of character. Definitely going back again!

name: Taaza Thindi
review_texts:
Absolutely loved this place! The food was fresh, tasty, and full of flavor. Every item we tried felt properly homemade and satisfying. The atmosphere was really nice too — simple, clean, and super comfortable for a quick breakfast or casual hangout. Service was also friendly and pretty fast even during the rush.

If you’re looking for a good spot for South Indian breakfast/snacks, this place is definitely worth visiting. Great taste, good vibe, and overall a really pleasant experience. Will definitely come back again! ⭐️

Taaza Tindi - One of the best breakfast spots in bengaluru. The food quality they offer at such a low price is impressive and delicious too.

Service is quick and fast moving. You would find the dosa counter bit crowded but the other counters are fast moving.

We tried masala dosa (Crispy and perfect), Idli vada (make sure to try this for the coconut chutney) , kharabath and kesari bath (minimal in quantity and it tasted good)

You would find it difficult to find a place to eat. Overall this is a must try place for breakfast if you’re nearby Jayanagar!!

Portions here are on the smaller side at a very pocket-friendly price. The service is impressively quick with extremely good crowd management. Best past is that the hygiene standards are top-notch.
Expect heavy crowds especially on weekends. While their dosa is definitely worth trying, you should definitely also try their   idli-vada with chutney, along with their excellent chow-chow bath. All of this comes

Food is very good, you only get Cocunut chutney for idly, vada, Dosa. No sambar or other chutney varieties. But the taste is very good, prepare your mind to stand in queue to get Masala dosa. Coffee is awesome, kesari bath is too good. Their price point is unmatchable❤️

I had such a lovely time at Taaza Thindi! Standard practice is to pay and get your food tokens first.

Here's a trick: Get both your masala dosa and idli vada tokens, then grab the idli vada and enjoy them while you're waiting in the queue for the dosa. Saves you time!

The masala dosa was delicious, flavorful, and best of all, it didn't break the bank. Definitely a great spot for a tasty and budget friendly meal.

Highly recommend!

name: Empire Restaurant | Kammanahalli
review_texts:
The Empire is quite the family destination for lunch and dinner in Kammanahalli, Bangalore. Although over the years the place has become increasingly crowded and difficult in terms of parking space, they have also ensured customer service and hospitality by arranging for smart valet parking services.
We had the most delicious and scrumptious mutton and chicken biryani along with the mint lime juice.
The service was a bit slow we felt given that we had ordered biryani. The staff were smartly dressed and the food is served hygienically by the waiters in gloves. There is warm or hot water for drinking, a big deal during the winter.

Quite disappointed with the quality standards of the renowed Empire group of restaurants.
Ordered some kerala parottas and butter chicken masala. The parottas were not fresh and undercooked. The butter chicken masala tasted like it came from a pre cooked meal packet which can be seen in the quality of the chicken pieces.
The service was good, being the only plus point.
Confused as if these are measures taken due to “LPG shortage”.
Hope Empire can maintain their original quality.

Always a memorable food experience at The mighty Empire. Food is of same the taste for the last 20 years, hygiene has improved like a pro, and new menu items al have been added to stay in the groove. Excellent 👌 job guys! Rupak is a great server with a happy smile always.
Food: 5/5  |  Service: 5/5  |  Atmosphere: 4/5

The food here is very nice
Especially the chilli chicken must and should try

Had lunch at Empire Restaurant today and really enjoyed the experience. We tried the Grill Chicken, BBQ Prawns, Mutton Curry, Jeera Rice, Rumali Roti, and Mango Shake. Everything tasted fresh and flavorful, especially the Grill Chicken and Mutton Curry. The Mango Shake was thick and refreshing, making it a perfect way to end the meal.

A special mention to Madhab, who served us. He was friendly, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the meal. Great food and excellent service

name: The Pump House
review_texts:
One of the nicest places for beer lovers in JP Nagar! The Pump House is a perfect hangout spot if you enjoy great brews, good food, and a lively crowd. The ambience is energetic yet comfortable, making it ideal for catching up with friends or enjoying a relaxed evening out.

They have a wide variety of beers and drinks to choose from, and every option feels thoughtfully crafted. The food selection is equally impressive – from starters to main course, there’s something for everyone. Each and every dish is absolutely worth the money, both in terms of quality and quantity. The flavors are spot on, and the presentation adds to the overall experience.

Being located on the main road is a big advantage, and there is plenty of parking available, which makes it very convenient. The washrooms are neat, clean, and well maintained – something that truly enhances the comfort of the visit. The staff are friendly, attentive, and professional, ensuring smooth service even during busy hours.

Overall, The Pump House stands out as a fantastic place for beer lovers and food enthusiasts alike. Definitely a must-visit spot in JP Nagar!

Ambience (5/5)-
Situated in the heart of JP Nagar, Pump house has made a very big name for itself throughout the years. A huge nearly open environment with lots of plants, coolers and quirky spots for dining, this place offers a great tropical vibe at day and an entirely different vibe at sunset. My only feedback- the music can get a little too loud at times.

Food and drinks (5/5):
This being my second time, I have ordered a handful of vegetarian dishes and they're made and presented with utmost care. Paneer ghee roast was a delectable starter. Thai green curry was made with authentic sticky rice and is a must have. Their Kahlua soaked Tiramisu is a stand out in the dessert section. It's creamy, perfectly layered and not sweet enough to allow you to order it again.

Their beers have always been great. I've had the pleasure of trying their stout on a winter noon and their belgian wit on a hot summer noon and these are some of the best craft beers in the city, right there with the creme de la creme. Their mocktails, especially the ones that have a concoction of fruits are ideal picks for the sober folks.

Service (5/5)-
The staff greets you with a Namaste right from the entrance, the floor managers and bartender visited our table to make sure we're enjoying our food and drinks. Service was polite, timely, accommodating and quick, even on a fully packed holiday afternoon. Special mention to Dipak for very good service and for suggesting dishes we liked.

The only point of concern here are the prices but the experience very well makes up for it. This is a great place to plan your dates, casual outings with friends and family. I'd always recommend The Pump House to anyone who loves appetizing food and beer crafted to perfection.

🍻 Had a wonderful experience at The Pump House, JP Nagar! It’s a great place to relax, enjoy good food, and spend quality time with friends.

🥘 I tried the platter, tiramisu, and a few mocktails, and everything was absolutely delicious. The platter offered a nice variety of flavors, the tiramisu was rich and satisfying, and the mocktails were refreshing and well-crafted.

✨ The ambience is one of the best parts of the place. The lively atmosphere, comfortable seating, and overall vibe make it perfect for both casual outings and weekend get-togethers.

👏 The service was excellent as well. The staff were friendly, attentive, and ensured everything was served on time.

🚗 The location is very convenient, right on the main road, and parking is easily available.

⏰ A small tip: weekends tend to get quite busy, so it’s a good idea to book a table in advance or arrive early to grab the best seats and enjoy the ambience without the rush.

⭐ Overall, a fantastic spot for great food, refreshing drinks, and a fun atmosphere. Definitely worth a visit and highly recommended!

My recent visit to the Pump House was extremely disappointing. Firstly this was on my bucket list from long time & decided to visit on a friday.
The ambience is electric & extremely good. Firstly, they alloted side tables where there is no space to keep our plates & seating is uncomfortable. The service was super slow, perhaps because of RCB match & it was friday.
Surprising the food was very disappointing with a average taste.
Most of the non-Veg starters are in the Range of  ₹400-₹500 & veg starters are ₹300 onwards.
Lemon Soya chicken Lollypop ₹395
Malay spiced butter chicken ₹395
Lemon Chilli cauliflower ₹295
All the starters were below average.
They do add 7.5% Staff contribution by default to the bill, which can be removed.
My suggestion would be to avoid visiting on Friday & absolutely do not waste your time if you get side tables.
service & Food quality must be improved.

Good vibes and a good place to hangout and have a peaceful chat with friends. They have really created and outdoor experience indoors and the vibes here are immaculate. Perfect location too. Super fun place loved every bit of it.

name: Communiti
review_texts:
Nice fun and busy brewery with a good atmosphere. We went there as a group of 10 on a Saturday early evening and it took some time to get a place to sit together.

Drinks wise, we primarily drank beer. There was a decent variety of beers, hefe, wheat, IPA, Honey ale etc. Not amazing, but good.

Food was okay. We focussed primarily on starters and ordered a bunch of veg and non-veg. They were all good quality and decent taste, but nothing stood out particularly.

The service experience was mixed. While the staff was friendly, it sometimes took them a long time to get us the beer that we had ordered.

The place does get a bit loud and it became harder to have a conversation later in the evening. The ambience is nice though, and the seating is comfortable.

Overall, a good experience and a nice busy place to visit in the centre of Bangalore.

We initially decided to check out Communiti because it boasts close to 29,000 reviews online, and after our evening here, I completely understand why it has earned every single one of them! The hype is incredibly real. If you are looking for exceptional food and drinks on Residency Road, this place is an absolute must-visit.

We ended up ordering quite a feast for our table of three, and every single item exceeded our expectations. First off, they have an incredible craft beer deal: ₹1499 for 2 liters of beer plus a starter. We originally wanted the IPA, but since it was out, we went with the Wheat beer and were pleasantly surprised by how smooth and refreshing it was.

The cocktail menu is top-tier. My friend ordered a Bloody Mary and a Margarita and absolutely loved both. I tried a 'Mango Madness' mocktail, which was a complete yorker, absolutely delicious. We also gave the Tequila Sunrise a try, and it instantly became one of our table favorites!

For food, the portions are incredibly generous. We got the Home Made Nachos with Chicken Chunks, which was a massive serving, and the Butter Garlic Spicy Chicken was simply superb. We also ordered the Veg Club Sandwich (nice and juicy, though leaves a tiny bit of room for improvement) and the Bruschetta Chicken Penne, which my friend declared was some of the best pasta she’s ever had.

Yes, we ordered a lot, but when the food and drinks are this spectacular, who cares? My friend even said she hasn’t experienced food and drinks this good in a long time.
Highly recommend coming here with an empty stomach and good company!
The food was delicious and the service truly stood out. Sujoy and Vashi were amazing servers friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit.

Communiti is exactly the type of place to be on a Friday night out.

Went here with group of 5 and couldn't have picked a better spot. The long shared seating is perfect for big groups, the music is lively enough to keep the energy up without killing the conversation, and two pitchers in (Belgian Wheat and Ragi Gold Lager, both excellent) the night just took care of itself.

Food highlights: the Butter and Cheesy Fish was genuinely outstanding. The BBQ Chicken Pizza on thin crust was decent, and everything else - hummus and lavash, nachos, fries, nutty veggie stickers were great bar bites, exactly what you want when you're sharing plates and catching up.

For the location and the overall experience, the prices are surprisingly affordable. Vibe, food, cost all solid. Definitely coming back.

Visited Community for the first time on a Saturday night, and I honestly expected a much better vibe. The venue is split into two sections-the ground floor is Community, while the upper floors are a different restaurant that’s not even listed on Google Maps, which made the whole setup a bit confusing.

For a Saturday, the crowd was surprisingly sparse. I was expecting a lively young crowd, but it felt more like a family restaurant than a nightlife destination.

The food was just average, and the drinks didn’t stand out in any way. There’s nothing on the menu that would make me want to come back over the many other options in the city.

One thing that really spoiled the ambience was the odd disco light setup. It looked like a cheap black-box disco light constantly flashing, which felt completely out of place and took away from the overall atmosphere.

Overall, it wasn’t a bad experience, but it definitely didn’t live up to the hype. There are far better places in Bangalore if you’re looking for good food, creative drinks, and a lively weekend vibe.

name: Just BLR
review_texts:
Visited this place and had a great time. It’s a perfect place to chill and unwind, whether with friends or after a long day.
The ambience is lively yet comfortable, with good music that really sets the mood without being too overwhelming. The seating and overall setup make it easy to relax and enjoy your time.
Service was smooth, and the overall vibe of the place makes you want to stay longer.
A great spot to hang out and enjoy a relaxed evening - definitely worth a visit!

Came here for the first time, I was at the restro bar for half an hour, I had come for a stand-up comedy show and was waiting at the bar, until it was time. I found the menu to limited and a tad bit expensive compared to a few places of the same level. I did enjoy my drinks though. I also found the music to be loud, but since it's on a bustling street of Brigade road, I guess it's fine, but they can still look into it. It's a very good place for a large group of people to come and chill for sure. I'll also be back soon!

I was here when a friend who is quite a regular to this place  ended up bringing me. The food was decent, considering that it was reasonably priced and for the price it was definitely a banger. The ladies that accommodate you are really nice and welcoming and was always ready to serve us. There was karaoke music too when I was here. Enjoyed the vibe and the time that I had spent in here.

I and my wife were strolling on brigade road, half dozen guys were inviting customers so we decided to try it out. The place has more furniture than guests, more waiters too. Some packing walkies like we were in some heavy security zone. Full of men and constantly staring at few ladies who were there. Very lousy ambience. Menu looks like a phone directory. Exorbitantly priced drinks, a pint of bud beer around 550/-, whereas in a brewery you get 500ml for 350/-. Service on the other hand is good, polite waiters. We had chilli pork which was surprisingly tasty. The cocktails were stiff and refreshing. They some robot wheeling around to take orders. Not a family place as smoking is allowed all around. This place suits group of men.

We love visiting Just BLR whenever we are on Brigade Road. We went back today after a long time and were surprised to see many changes to the interiors and the food menu. They have even introduced a robot server, which is a great added attraction. We love how they welcome and cater to every customer, and the music is always great. The food was as good as ever—we’ll definitely be back soon with friends!"

name: Koramangala SOCIAL
review_texts:
Very unique experience as compared to the other Social Outlets. They have everything present in the washroom starting from mouthwash to earhuds to sanitary stuffs really impressive.

Obviously the food the ambience the vibe is very chill and nice.
We ordered crispy corn ; Jalapeño cheese balls ; masala peanuts ; chicken ghee roast ; couple of cocktails and mocktails. Every thing was tasty. No complaints about the food at all.

Food is very average. It takes ages to get the food. Starter came after the Main after asking several times. Waiters are not really attentive. But they can Host big Groups atleast. Also after group arrival they made the music so loud that talking to person next to you was almost not possible anymore. Ambience is modern and if they open the roop top sections it can be refreshing as well. A Social is alwys a good to go but dont expect the Ordinary here. There is a lot of room for improvement. And wth do you roll the menue like a news paper? Thats the most annoying thing i have ever seen in my life. Asked for a QR Code for the menue but they didnt have.

Food was average overall. The crispy corn was not up to the mark, but the mocktails and KitKat shake were really good. Service was excellent. I personally liked the loaded nachos. A good dance floor is available for anyone interested 😜. The theme was nice, and it was good to see the smoking zone kept separate.

The place has a good ambiance with a pleasant vibe, if you’re looking for a spot with good energy and music that isn’t too loud. I enjoyed their Banarasi Patiala with gin. The food was decent, we tried the veg grilled platter, noodle soup, and salad bowls, which were average in taste. Overall, it was a nice experience and a good place to unwind.

Koramangala Social never disappoints. The greenery inside creates such a refreshing atmosphere, making it one of my favorite hangouts in Bangalore. We had the chicken platter and some shrimps, and both were top-notch. It’s got that perfect eclectic vibe whether you're there to work or just catch up with friends. Great service and always a good crowd!

name: Hallimane Restaurant
review_texts: We went to Hallimane Restaurant for their Mango Meals during the mango season in May. It’s an unlimited banana leaf meal with more than 20 dishes made using mango. They serve everything from mango holige and mango rasam to mango rice, mango pickle, mango rasmalai, and mango ice cream. The variety is really impressive and it’s a fun experience if you enjoy mangoes. That said, after a point it can feel a little too sweet. The meal costs around ₹450 for adults and ₹350 for kids, which feels worth it for the experience. Weekends are super crowded, so it’s better to reach by around 12 PM for lunch if you want to avoid a long wait.

Just had the amazing food here. The desserts like mango holige and mango rasamali are top notch. The Mango pulihora was good. The best item i had was white rice with mango palak dal and papad and also rasam. And loved the ice cream in the end. Few items didn't impress me like sambar and sweet mango dal . The food was on the pricier side but negotiable for one time visit. Let's meet next year for mango festival try to add a mango mojiti it will definitely add the value when we complete the meal

Tried Halli Mane for the first time and absolutely loved the authentic Bengaluru-style experience. The Mango Mela meals were something completely unique — I’ve never seen so many mango-based dishes in one meal before! From mango rasam and mango holige to mango rasmalai and raw mango chutney, every item had its own flavor and identity. The traditional Karnataka-style serving, homely atmosphere, and balanced taste made the experience memorable. It felt less like eating at a restaurant and more like enjoying a festive homemade meal. A must-try place in Bengaluru for anyone who wants authentic local food and a unique seasonal experience.

Halli Mane located in the prime location of Malleswaram serves authentic South Indian dishes. It is a must visit place during their special mango and Jackfruit Mela.
We visited @ Mango mela when they served different mango items, Mango Festival Meal, served at ₹450, little expensive but dishes served were top notch.
As we entered, the most notable part was the service style, neither it was a buffet nor a normal setup of any standard Restaurant, the  service was like a Wedding feast - Dining in a row or Eating together in a traditional line at a function पंगतीत जेवणे. On the banana leaf the dishes were served in quick succession, repeatedly one after the other.
The food truly gives that authentic marriage food vibe, with a rich flavorful taste. Dosa, and the delicious mango themed meal served was awesome.
This restaurant is located in a very crowded area, somewhat difficult to find a parking place as only roadside parking is possible. When we reached we had to wait for half an hour as the restaurant was crowded and after we completed our meals the queue was much longer.
On the front of cleanliness they need to look into the basics and keep overall hygiene in place, provide better washroom
On the whole we had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend this place to others for a traditional meal on banana leaf experience.
Visited 09.05.26

We visited Hallimane for their mango 🥭 Special Lunch, and it was a truly festive experience.

The traditional meal was served on a banana leaf, bringing out the authentic touch like the festival. The spread had a variety of homely dishes, mango curries, mango Palya , mango kosambari, mango obbattu, mango Alubai , mango milk shake , mango Rasmali , mango lemon rice , mango sambar , mango rasam , mango gojju and crunchy papad, each prepared in a simple yet flavorful style.

Finally finished lunch with mango Ice cream.

The ambiance was warm and welcoming, and despite the festival crowd, the service was quick and courteous. Overall, it was a wholesome, satisfying meal that celebrated the spirit of mango 🥭  meals in the best way possible.

Meals Adults : 450
Children : 300

name: Meghana Foods - Marathahalli
review_texts:
Visited the best biryani spot in Bangalore – and it truly lives up to the hype!

• Even on normal weekdays, there is a heavy rush, which clearly shows the popularity.
• Heavy rush means one thing here – super hot and freshly prepared food every time 🔥
• The aroma itself makes you hungry!

Items I tried:
• Mutton Roast
• Chicken Biryani
• Paneer Biryani
• Gobi Manchurian
• Manchurian
• Tandoori Butter Roti
• Soft Drinks

Taste Review:
• The biryani taste is excellent – one of the best in Bangalore.
• Perfect spice level and well-cooked meat.
• Mutton roast was flavorful and rich.
• Overall food quality is very good.

Ambience:
• Average – can be improved.

Service:
• Service is average.
• Order processing and response time could be better.

Final Verdict:
If you are craving biryani in Bangalore, this is the place to visit. In my opinion, Meghana serves one of the best biryanis in the city. 🍛🔥

Good nonveg options are available
Meghana special biryani is good.
You can order chicken , Mutton, prawns and fish here. Though the biryani changes the rice would remain same for most of the biryani types. They can accomodate for groups of 10-18 people to sit together.  Above average ranting as per the taste and can say we can try it. Well maintained and clean sitting arrangements.

Seat and table height are not proper. Eating is difficult.

Food tastes great and service is fast.

Too much loud noise.

Had food at Meghana Foods and it was an amazing experience. The taste was absolutely delicious and full of rich flavors. The quality of the food was excellent, especially the biryani, which was perfectly cooked and aromatic. The service was quick and the staff were polite and attentive. The ambience was clean and comfortable, making the dining experience even better. Overall, a must-visit place for anyone who loves authentic and flavorful food. Highly recommended! 😋🍽️

Tried the boneless biryani at Meghana Foods.The taste was just average. Expected a bit more flavor and richness considering their usual standard. Not bad, but not as impressive as their regular biryani.Need improvement in gravy and curd.

name: URU - JP Nagar
review_texts:
Place is humungous, they have vallet parking. We visited this place on Sunday afternoon for lunch with prior reservation

Ordered 5 starters, 2 prawn items which was good. Malai chicken was tasty, egg pakoda which was crispy and had spicy kick, paneer item. All the starters were nice and tasted good

For main course we had ghee rice, egg fried rice. Nothing stood out in main course. We asked for chilli oil and oyster sauce for fried rice which came after we finished the dish

For desserts we had tiramisu, chocolate cheese cake, something with gulab jamoon. All the deserts were good

Service was damn slow, i asked for the staff to remove the service charges and share the bill. They can really work on improving their service speed

Overall a nice place for a family, friends meet up. Will visit again and recommend it to everyonen looking for a place to chill and have good food

The restaurant is huge, with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating, making it a great place for large groups or a relaxed meal. The food was honestly just average, but the new dessert menu was the highlight of the visit! There were so many unique and delicious options to choose from, and every dessert we tried was worth it. They also have a fun photobooth, which is a nice touch if you're visiting with friends or family. Overall, I'd recommend coming for the ambience and desserts rather than the main course.

Don’t be deceived by the entrance as it is humongous (1.5 acres). Firstly parking is Valet and      they park is somewhere close is what they said. With place being huge they have not constructed across the whole place but lets lot of greens(trees and plants)across. They have lot of activities for kids so they are set.
Coming to food, we tried multiple things here started with their onion rings and it was so freaking crispy and crunchy it was nice. Other things we tried were potato wedges, chicken malai kabab, chicken lollipop, Tangra style chilli chicken, French fries, chicken tikka overloaded pizza, chicken spaghetti bolognese, biscoff bliss cheesecake. While most of them were good those I felt kind of okay was chilli chicken. It’s pet friendly too

Had the tandoori broccoli for starters - midly sweet with nice green chutney. Spaghetti pesto pasta had a subtle basil and nutty flavour. Fried rice was decent and had good quantity. Tropical punch mocktail was delicious.

The service was quick. They have both indoor and outdoor seating - very nice vibe overall. They have a separate space for pets as well. They are some stalls for games and shopping. Uru is a huge space where there is something for everyone visiting!

Always a nice experience visiting URU. Good food & pleasant service. Outdoor seating is beautifully designed, can host events & gatherings as well. Chicken Beresta, Spaghetti Bolognese were both fantastic. Fish fry wasnt upto the mark, was missing the kasundi flavour. Bang bang Brownie cheesecake was bang on though!!

name: Nagarjuna Restaurant Since 1984 - Marathahalli
review_texts:
Visited Nagarjuna after hearing a lot about it, and overall it lived up to the hype.

It’s located on the main road in a prime area, on the 1st floor, with a huge seating capacity. Even though it was quite crowded, we didn’t have to wait much for a table. The place is well-maintained, clean, and the staff were polite, well-mannered, and quick with service.

We tried their famous Andhra thali (₹350), which is unlimited. It included rice, dal, a dry sabzi (changes daily), chutneys (I think cucumber and coconut), sambar, rasam, curd, chaas, and a sweet (dalia). You can keep getting refills.

Taste-wise, everything was genuinely very good and flavorful. The only item I didn’t enjoy much was the rasam—it was extremely spicy and had a strong garam masala punch.

One thing I really liked was that the food didn’t feel overly oily or heavy, which is rare for thali places.

We also ordered Mushroom Sholay (₹330), which was quite tasty, and a Thums Up (₹70).

If not tried would recommend, especially for the thali experience.

Food is always great at Nagarjuna. Their unlimited meals are a must-try — comes with pappu dal, rice, chutney, sabzi, rasam, sambar, curd, buttermilk, and kheer. The taste has been consistently good every single time we’ve visited. Simple, comforting, and delicious food.

The place is neat, clean, and hygiene is well maintained. They also have sufficient parking, which makes the experience much more convenient.

Staff are courteous, attentive, and always welcoming.

This time we also tried the podi chicken, which was really good. Chicken chilli and chicken 65 are worth trying too. Biryani is decent as well.

I’m not from South India, but this place has become my go-to spot whenever I visit Bengaluru. The food is always delicious and never disappoints. we ordered the Veg Andhra Meal, Chicken Sixer, and Chicken Biryani, and everything was amazing. The Chicken Sixer is an absolute must-try and is definitely my favorite dish here. Highly recommended!

P.S. My main goal is always to finish everything on the banana leaf because there’s just so much food 😭

Nagarjuna Restaurant in Marathahalli remains a top-tier destination for anyone craving authentic Andhra flavors. The star of the show is undoubtedly their legendary Andhra Meals—the combination of the aromatic ghee, spicy gunpowder (podi), and signature pappu is simply unbeatable and offers a true taste of tradition.

​The Chicken Nagarjuna and Sholay Kababs are consistently tender, well-marinated, and packed with a spicy punch that keeps you coming back for more. Despite the heavy crowds, the service is remarkably efficient and the staff manages the rush with a professional attitude. The restaurant maintains a clean, vibrant atmosphere that is perfect for a hearty family lunch or a quick office breakout. If you are in Marathahalli and looking for a high-quality, flavorful, and satisfying dining experience, Nagarjuna is a must-visit!

Nagarjuna Restaurant in Marathahalli is a legendary hotspot for anyone craving authentic, fiery Andhra cuisine in Bengaluru. Famous for its iconic Andhra meals served on traditional banana leaves, the restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience where unlimited rice is paired with flavor-packed pappu, ghee, and a variety of spicy chutneys. Beyond the meals, it’s a paradise for non-vegetarians, drawing massive crowds for its signature, perfectly spiced Chilli Chicken, mutton biryani, and deeply flavorful chicken fry. While the ambiance is simple, comfortable, and family-friendly, the quick service and consistently bold, rich flavors make it a must-visit destination that frequently sees bustling queues during peak lunch and dinner hours.

name: Al Amanah cafe and Restaurant
review_texts:
The Ultimate Spot for Roll Lovers! ⭐⭐⭐⭐★
​The Food: If you are a roll lover, this place is an absolute must-try! They serve a massive variety of flavors that cater to all kinds of taste buds.
​The Quantity: The portions here are incredible. The rolls are so heavy and filling that they can easily replace a full lunch or dinner.
​The Vibe & Wait Time: It does get a little crowded, so expect a brief waiting period before you get your food. However, the wait is completely worth it for the quality and quantity you get.
​Final Verdict: Highly recommended for heavy, flavorful rolls that hit the spot every single time! 🌯🔥

Quality seems to have dropped—or maybe competition’s just better now. This used to be a favorite, but my third visit after a long gap was disappointing. The 40 min long queue in heated conditions was not worth the hassle at all.

Al-Amanah Special Jumbo Roll:
This felt like a complete letdown for the price. The “special” tag was misleading—you only get a few bitter, burnt mushrooms, slices of boiled egg, and very average chicken. I expected a proper mix of toppings, but there was nothing of that sort.

Chicken Roast Jumbo Roll:
Tasted almost the same as the special roll. No distinct flavour minus the mushrooms & egg.

Crispy Chicken Roll:
The only good one—crispy, spicy, and actually flavourful.

Main Issue:
There’s a clear lack of flavour across the menu, often masked by excessive mayo and sauces which aren’t particularly flavourful to begin with. I love the fact they dont serve dry rolls which are an absolute pain but there is something missing big time here. Its not dry but where's the flavour. They really need better toppings, balanced seasoning, and elements like veggies, masala, or pickled additions to elevate the taste. Overall, it no longer hits the spot and isn’t worth the wait or hype. The chilled soft drinks was the best part about this visit.

Sad that one of my fav spots has come to this.

I recently visited Al Amanah Restaurant, and it’s definitely famous for its jumbo roll. At just ₹160, the quantity is amazing—honestly, it’s more than enough for one hungry person and feels totally worth the price.

The taste is really good and satisfying, which is why the place is always crowded. There’s almost always a queue, and it gets quite jammed, especially during peak hours.

The restaurant has seating on two floors, which is decent but just okay overall. The staff manages well despite the rush, but they could improve a bit on hygiene and the billing process to make the experience smoother.

Overall, a great spot for budget-friendly, filling food—especially if you’re craving their famous jumbo roll!

This is good place for rolls. I tried Veg roll i.e. Falafel roll. Felt a bit dry, they could've added more sauces to make it more juicy.  My friends had chicken roll and that was sufficiently juicy enough to not feel dry.

The prices are very good. Not so expensive and the portion is very fulfilling .

The ambience of the place is okayish. We went there at 4pm, so the place was not that much crowded. But when we were coming out of the place, it was very crowded. During peak hours, it will get very crowded and it will be a hassle to just place the order, leave along sitting and eating.

Absolute Crunch Heaven!If you are looking for the perfect bite, this Chicken Crispy Roll is a must-try. The outer wrap is beautifully toasted, but the real star is the golden, golden-fried chicken inside that delivers an incredible crunch with every single bite. It is packed with creamy mayo and a hint of spice that keeps it juicy without getting soggy. Unbelievably satisfying and highly recommended. If you ordered jumbo special roll then you can't finish easily full of loaded. Once upon a time you can try  ✨️ 😉 . There is no light board there is no light inside also there is no maintenance but full rush people are getting mad for roll. Roll lover need to try once.

name: Karama Restaurant
review_texts:
A Random Visit That Turned Into a Great Experience” ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My wife and I randomly decided to visit Karama without planning much, and honestly, it turned out to be a surprisingly great experience. From the moment we entered, the ambience felt warm and welcoming. The seating setup and overall vibe made the place feel premium yet comfortable.

The food was definitely the highlight of our visit. We tried a mix of dishes, and most of them were genuinely impressive. The mutton dishes especially stood out — soft, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. You can tell the kitchen knows how to handle non-veg items really well. Even the starters had good balance in seasoning and taste.

Service was another strong point. The staff was attentive, polite, and quick without being intrusive. It made the whole dining experience smooth and relaxed.

What I liked most is that despite hearing mixed reviews before visiting, our personal experience was actually very positive. Every restaurant can have off days, but on our visit, Karama delivered good food, nice ambience, and quality service.

If you enjoy flavorful non-veg food and want a good dine-in experience in Bengaluru, this place is definitely worth trying at least once with family or friends.

Was here with family on bakrid. We sat on the first floor.
Ambiance is good, they have lamps hanging from the ceiling, the walls are ceramic cut outs of paintings, they had a dedicated space for people wanting to sit on the sofa on ground level.
For Appetizers, we had their Mutton Peshawari Sheekh, Chicken Pakiza Tikka and Alfaham Chicken.
For Mains, we had their Mutton Biryani and Chicken Biryani.
The food was cooked middle Eastern style, mild flavors, smokiness on the sheekh and tanginess on the Pakiza chicken.
We felt the portions could be better.
The service was incredibly slow even though there were few guests.
Overall, you can visit if you like to try middle Easter food like Sheekh and Mandi

Very beautifully designed restaurant with ample seating space. Dim lighted and good spot for family or friends dine-in. All the dishes were delicious and my favorite was Rogan Josh. The gravy and mutton was well prepared and flavourful. Service was also fine and they suggest proper quantity to order as per group size. Butter chicken was very creamy and worth trying. In drinks, Arabian pulpy grape is my all time favorite and one can order a jug itself for group of 4 or more.

Rating:0.5/5
Incredibly overrated. I came here because of all the hype, but it was a massive disappointment. The service was painfully slow, and when the food finally arrived, it was easily some of the worst-tasting food I’ve had in a long time. Definitely not worth the price or the wait. Avoid it and try something worthy.

Visited this place recently and the overall experience was pretty average; not bad, but nothing that really stood out or gave that wow factor either.

That said, the Dahi Kebab absolutely deserves a special mention. Easily a 10/10 dish! I’ve honestly never had anything like it before. Super flavourful, perfectly balanced, and definitely the highlight of the meal. Would probably come back just for that alone!

name: Sagar
review_texts:
I recently visited Sagar Restaurant and tried their special mango milkshake, which cost ₹170 including GST. The milkshake itself tasted good—fresh and enjoyable—but honestly, it didn’t feel special enough to justify the price.

For ₹170, I expected something more unique or premium in terms of taste or portion. While they did add a few mango pieces on top, it didn’t really make a big difference. I’ve had similar mango milkshakes at other places for much lower prices. In fact, just the other day I had a comparable drink elsewhere for around ₹60 (half portion), and it felt like much better value. With that comparison, this one feels clearly overpriced.

The place itself is decent. It’s fairly clean, and you can see they are making an effort to maintain hygiene, which is definitely a positive. The overall environment is okay, nothing particularly standout but comfortable enough.

That said, I personally feel the place is a bit overhyped, mainly because of the pricing not matching the experience. If the cost was more reasonable, it would have been a much better overall impression.

In short, good taste and clean setup, but pricing needs a reality check.

We visited on a Sunday afternoon, we got a table quickly. The service was prompt, and the food was good overall.

A special mention goes to the jalebi—it was served hot, perfectly crisp, and very well made. The pav bhaji was decent, though the bhaji could have had more depth of flavor, and the pav could have been crispier. We also tried the mango shake, which was quite good. The samosa was average and nothing particularly noteworthy.

Overall, we found it as a good spot for snacks.

Sagar Restaurant is not just a place — it’s an emotion.
Man, I genuinely can’t have enough of this spot.
Let’s consider the facts.
It’s past midnight.
You’re hit with late-night cravings.
You’re dreaming of pav bhaji or jalebi fafda.
Entire Bangalore knows where you need to be.
Sagar in Rajajinagar is the answer.
I literally travel 20–25 km just to come here — and every single time, it’s worth it. The pav bhaji is buttery, comforting, and exactly what a midnight craving demands. The jalebi fafda combo? Pure joy on a plate.
And don’t even get me started on their mango pulp juice — available 365 days a year and always a must-try. Thick, sweet, nostalgic, and ridiculously satisfying.
Vada pav? Solid.
Dabeli? On point.
Chaat? They’ve got it all.
But here’s one honest tip — skip the pani puri. That’s a strict no-no for me.
Everything else? Absolute treat.
If you’re in Bangalore and craving proper street-style comfort food, especially late at night, Sagar Restaurant in Rajajinagar is the pilgrimage spot.

The mango and strawberry milkshakes were refreshing, but honestly, the mango milkshake felt overpriced at ₹280—it didn’t quite match the richness or taste expected for that price. Masala puri was flavorful and well-balanced, while the jalebi fafda combo was crispy and enjoyable. One time is okay to visit. Overall, a nice place for snacks, but pricing vs taste could be better for some items.

Had an amazing experience at Sagar! The fafda and jalebi were absolutely top-notch perfectly crispy, fresh, and full of authentic flavor. The dabeli was equally delicious, packed with the right balance of spices and taste.

But the real highlight was the mango shake it was incredibly rich, thick, and made with real mangoes. Easily one of the best I’ve ever had!

If you’re a fan of Gujarati snacks and refreshing drinks, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

name: The Rameshwaram Cafe @ JP Nagar
review_texts:
Some places earn their popularity through clever marketing, while others earn it one plate at a time. This café undoubtedly belongs to the latter. It is perhaps the most talked-about café in Bengaluru, but the hype is entirely justified. From the very first bite, it becomes evident that this place is committed to authenticity rather than imitation.

The use of pure ghee elevates every dish, lending it an unmistakable richness and aroma that is difficult to find elsewhere. Unlike many cafés in Bengaluru that often imitate trends, presentation styles, or flavours, this establishment has created an identity of its own. The food is honest, traditional, and exceptionally satisfying.

The dose was outstanding, with the perfect balance of crispness and softness. Every bite reflected careful preparation and high-quality ingredients. Equally impressive was the idli sambar. The idlis were neither overly soft nor dense; they had the ideal texture to absorb the flavourful sambar beautifully, making every mouthful incredibly comforting and delicious.

A special mention goes to the filter coffee, which was nothing short of perfection. Rich, aromatic, and expertly brewed, it complemented the meal flawlessly and left a lasting impression. It is easily one of the finest cups of traditional filter coffee I have enjoyed in Bengaluru.

The consistency in taste, the authenticity of the preparation, and the evident focus on quality make this café stand apart from the rest. If you are a dosa enthusiast or simply appreciate genuine South Indian cuisine prepared with care, this place deserves to be at the very top of your list. It is a culinary experience that truly lives up to its remarkable reputation.

Visited the famous Rameshwaram Cafe and had a wonderful experience! I tried the Ghee Podi Idli, Butter Podi Masala Dosa, and Paniyaram, and every dish was delicious. The idli was soft and generously coated with aromatic podi and ghee, the Butter Podi Masala Dosa was perfectly crisp with a flavorful potato filling and rich butter, and the paniyaram was crispy outside and soft inside.
The coconut chutney, red chutney, and sambar were fresh and complemented the dishes perfectly. The food was served hot, and the presentation on banana leaves added to the authentic South Indian experience. Despite the crowd, the service was quick and well-managed. Definitely worth the visit, and I'll be back to try more dishes. Highly recommended! 🌿✨🍽️

I recently visited The Rameshwaram Cafe, a bustling and highly popular spot known for its authentic South Indian flavors. The café is usually crowded, which clearly reflects its reputation for serving delicious dosas and idlis.
I ordered the Butter Benne Plain Dosa (₹120) along with a Masala Chai (₹40), with all prices inclusive of GST. The dosa was well-prepared with a rich buttery taste, and the chai had a pleasant, satisfying flavor that complemented the meal perfectly.
Due to the high demand, the waiting time for dosas can be slightly longer. However, the café has an organized system in place. There is a self-order token counter outside, which makes the ordering process easier. Once you get your token, you need to collect your food from designated counters—separate counters are assigned for dosas, idlis, juices, tea, and more. It is a fully self-service setup, but it is managed efficiently despite the crowd.
They also offer a variety of juices and desserts, adding more options for visitors.
Overall, a great place to enjoy authentic South Indian food with excellent taste. Be prepared for some waiting time, but the food makes it worth it. Highly recommended for dosa lovers.!

Visited The Rameshwaram Cafe @ JP Nagar and the food was really tasty, especially the dosa and filter coffee. The place has a great South Indian vibe and quick service even though it’s usually crowded. The ghee flavor in the dishes makes the taste rich and satisfying. Seating can feel a bit busy during peak hours, but overall it’s a nice spot for breakfast and snacks with friends and family.

The Rameshwaram Cafe @ JP Nagar is a popular restaurant known for its delicious South Indian food, quick service, and clean, vibrant atmosphere. Visitors especially love the crispy dosas, flavorful chutneys, and high-quality ingredients. However, the cafe is often crowded, especially during peak hours, which can lead to long waiting times and limited seating. Overall, it’s a great place to enjoy authentic South Indian cuisine and is worth a visit for food lovers.

The Rameshwaram Cafe

name: Brahmins' Coffee Bar
review_texts:
One of the best places in Bengaluru for a classic old-school breakfast! The place was packed on a Saturday morning, which speaks for its popularity. I ordered the Idly-Vada combo, Kharabath and filter coffee. The Kharabath was easily one of the best I've had in Bengaluru - flavourful, perfect spice and comforting. The idly was soft and fluffy, while the vada was crispy. Special mention to their coconut chutney (They don’t serve sambhar)

The only letdown was the filter coffee, which tasted a bit too watery and could have been much better. Other than that, I thoroughly enjoyed my breakfast experience!

Good old place. Reminds me of old Bangalore. Can take your old ones to the place and relish them of their memories. The chutney is actually good, and even though idli dipped in chutney sounds new, the taste was good. Quick tip: take slip for 2 idlis, but seperately, so the first time you get  idli and butter, finsish that and go get another idli in a different plate, so that you end up getting more butter. As thata what enhances the taste of the chutney and the idli.

If you're looking for an authentic Bengaluru breakfast experience, Brahmins' Coffee Bar near Shankar Mutt Road is an absolute must-visit. This iconic eatery has earned its legendary reputation by serving a simple yet unforgettable menu that focuses on quality rather than variety. The soft, melt-in-your-mouth idlis paired with their signature coconut chutney are outstanding, while the crispy vadas are perfectly golden and packed with flavor. Their Khara Bath and Kesari Bath are equally delicious, and no visit is complete without enjoying a strong, frothy filter coffee that perfectly rounds off the meal.

The place has a charming old-world vibe and reflects the true essence of Bengaluru's traditional breakfast culture. Even though there is limited seating and parking, the constant crowd speaks volumes about its popularity and the consistency of its food. The service is incredibly quick, the prices are very reasonable, and everything is served fresh and hot.

What makes this place truly special is its commitment to maintaining the same authentic taste for decades. Whether you're a local or visiting Bengaluru for the first time, Brahmins' Coffee Bar offers a nostalgic culinary experience that you won't forget. Simple food, exceptional quality, and unmatched flavor make this one of the finest breakfast destinations in the city. Highly recommended!

Heads up — early mornings get crowded here, so be ready to wait a few minutes for a table. But trust me, it's worth it.
The idlys are wonderfully soft and pillowy, easily some of the best in the city. The chutney deserves a special mention too — it strikes a perfect balance between coconut and a subtle spiciness that keeps you coming back for more. The vada crispy,soft and smoking hot as it should be...
To wash it all down, the filter coffee is strong and aromatic, exactly how South Indian coffee should be.
Despite the morning rush, the surroundings are calm and peaceful, making it a pleasant spot to enjoy your meal.
If you're an idly lover in Bangalore, this place needs to be on your list!

Brahmin's Coffee Bar is a legendary breakfast spot in Shankarapura, Bengaluru, and it's easy to see why it's so popular. They keep the menu simple with just a handful of dishes, but every item is packed with flavor.

I tried their idli, kesari bath,Khara bath and the iconic filter coffee,each one was absolutely delicious. I left with both my stomach and my soul full of happiness. If you're in Bengaluru, this place is a must visit for an authentic South Indian breakfast experience.

name: Taaza Thindi
review_texts:
Taaza tindi is good one to choose  with their limited menu option and the price is also less. The food here is of good taste and the quantity seems less but for the price they have mentioned is more enough. Also its crowed at the peak hours but you have a plenty of space.
I highly recommend you to visit and have food here.

Taaza Thindi is an amazing, cost-effective Darshini and easily one of the best breakfast spots in this area. It’s a self-service outlet with open seating and a very systematic counter setup, each dish has a separate counter, making the process smooth and organized.
The menu is limited, but the taste is outstanding. We had Masala Dosa, Idly-Vada, and Kesari Bath, all were fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. Because of the unbeatable price and quality, the place is always crowded, yet the service is impressively fast and efficient.
Parking can be a bit challenging during peak hours, but it’s manageable. Overall, a must-try place for authentic, budget-friendly South Indian breakfast in Banashankari.
Best spot for a crispy masala dose! The taste is amazing and authentic. It gets very crowded during weekend peak hours, so timing your visit is key, but the food never disappoints.!

One of the best places to have Dose in Bangalore. Tastes great. It's very affordable and at the same time very hygienic. They serve the food hot and fresh. The ambience is great for all age groups and service is quick. Definitely worth visiting. 10/10

One of popular spot of bengaluru famous for their pocket friendly offerings. Everything here is a must try and I would suggest to try everything off the menu If you are a large group. Personally, when I come here I never want to miss their idly, vade, khara Baath and ofcourse coffee. These are my go to.

name: Hoot Craftworks 2.0
review_texts:
Hoot Brewworks 2.0 – Amazing Food, Drinks & Atmosphere

Hoot Brewworks 2.0 is truly an incredible place to hang out with friends and enjoy great food and drinks. The overall ambiance is lively and energetic, making it a perfect destination for evening outings, celebrations, or even watching live sports. The staff here are superb—very polite, attentive, and always ready to help, which makes the entire experience even better.

One of the highlights of this place is the excellent selection of food and drinks. The menu offers a wide variety of dishes and beverages, and everything is prepared with top-notch quality and taste. Every item we tried was delicious and well presented. It’s definitely a paradise for food lovers who enjoy exploring different flavors along with refreshing drinks.

I happened to visit during the India vs New Zealand match, and the atmosphere was absolutely electric. The arrangements for the live match screening were fantastic, creating a stadium-like vibe inside the place. It even seemed like the owner of the place was personally present during the match, making sure everything was running smoothly, which really shows their dedication to hospitality.

Hats off to the team for maintaining such great standards. Another big advantage is the plenty of parking space available, making it very convenient for visitors. Overall, Hoot Brewworks 2.0 is a must-visit place for a memorable dining and entertainment experience.

Hoot is on the main Sarjapur Main road. The entry is nice and well decorated. The staff are polite and helpful. The food is fresh and delicious. They have their own brewery, try the Mango beer which seasonal. The prices are reasonable and the service is quick. The food quality is awesome. Please try.

Visited Hoot for the first time post covid, I guess they had also closed for a while. I liked their ambience, it must be even better during the evening. We went in around 12:30 on a Sunday afternoon, there were very few people. Warm welcome and also the service was pretty quick. We ordered few chicken starters and a chilli potato. Starters were really nice. I also liked the beer. Highlight was the japanese cheese cake, it was really nice. This place hasn't lost its charm, planning to come here for a evening drink.

Hoot 2.0 an amazing place to unwind on weekday/weekend. The open air large space is beautiful and the overall vibe is just spot on, that too in the middle of Sarjapur. The DJ keeps the energy up with great music — definitely a big plus!

The stunning ambience, DJ, Music, Courteous staff/Service is the highlight here.

Highly appreciate the service by Paras.

Only disappointing part was food, which was absolutely below average & prices are definitely at the premium. The management must make menu competitive as there are loads of option in sarjapur in the same vicinity.
Good food but service is little late even in mid day having less crowd

name: Empire Restaurant Mosque Road
review_texts: The staff were friendly, polite, and provided good hospitality throughout the visit. While the chicken biryani was decent, it didn't quite stand out. Felt like it was normal rice. However, the chicken kebab, alfaham, butter naan, and chicken korma were much better and were the highlights of the meal. The atmosphere of the hotel was average and fairly comfortable, though nothing particularly remarkable. The only downside was that the prices felt a bit high compared to the overall experience. Overall, it was a pleasant visit with good food and service, especially if you're looking to try their grilled and curry dishes. Overall, it was an okay stay, but better value for money would make it more appealing.

I was trying to order online and wanted clarity on dinner dishes, this guy Ashfaque picks the call and has no information or idea about the food, why is he picking up the calls in the first place. He promised to get someone to call me back but no-one did so I ended up ordering from different restaurant... Disappointed I remember the service used to be more professional earlier....

Taste is good but one staff seems like manager looks so arrogant to our group.
First I wanna return the menu back and that guy walked to that way and stopped walking then he told the waiter to get it back by pointing his finger to me and he didn’t say anything to me.
Just feel like Oh wow how rude you are!
If you can’t take it then you should tell me “please wait a moment the waiter will come to get it” or something else, shouldn’t walk pass like this and I saw he isn’t busy at that time.
Maybe he is Egotistical person and thought like he is manager can’t touch the menu.
In other restaurants manager will take menu back and send to waiter or another staff because customer already gave it in front of him.

Waiting for food for a very long time, another group came after us but they got food before us.

And we found hair in coin parotta so we called the waiter to change it but that manager suddenly came and tried to stop the waiter and asked. He didn’t asked customer first for what happened. We really felt racism from him because we’re from Southeast Asia maybe he thought we’re from Tibet who live here that’s why he discriminated with us.
But they changed the new plate for us

One thing that I like is the real time screen on TV to show about inside the kitchen. That’s so good to make sure your food is clean. I really appreciated and so impressed about it and would like to take a picture for the review but they told me to delete it.

I’m not sure he’s a manager or not but he acted like that. The thin guy with suit jacket.
But I would like to tell you… Even Bastian restaurant we already spent a lot of money there so “don’t look down to the customer!”
Amazing services and food really excellent compare to last time this time i really felt satisfied you guys made good service

Food here is just awesome and I am a regular customer of this outlet. I stay close by and buy food almost 3 to 4 times a week from this place.
Yesterday, I went to buy few things and the person in the cash counter (photo uploaded) was very abusive. I asked for ghee rice and it's red gravy with an extra cost. I understand the lpg crisis, however he was like " take what is given and don't ask questions "
I asked him to talk politely and say its not available, then he comes away from the counter, towards me with a violent behavior.

I complained to another senior staff there abt this incident,  Even after that, the man challenges me, "Go complaint to whom so ever, I don't care ".
This matter was just left there.

I again went in the evening as my grandson loves kebabs from here. The same person again questions me, " What could I do, How have you come here again ?". And throws the bill at me.

Shocked, how can he have so much of revenge. Empire is known for best of its hospitality. The waiters are more kind and always serve with a smile.
I request the management to place some good mannered  staff at the counters.

name: The Fisherman's Wharf
review_texts:
Had a wonderful experience at The Fisherman’s Wharf! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The seafood dishes were especially impressive, cooked perfectly and packed with taste. The ambiance was relaxing, with a pleasant waterfront vibe that made the dining experience even more enjoyable.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and ensured we had everything we needed throughout our visit. Service was prompt, and the overall atmosphere was welcoming and family-friendly.

A great place for seafood lovers and anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.
Highly recommended, and I look forward to visiting again!

Visited Fisherman's Wharf in HSR after having been to their Goa outlet multiple times. To be honest, the Goa experience is still on a different level. The food here was decent and the ambience was good, but somehow it did not have the same freshness, taste and overall vibe that makes the Goa location special.

We ordered a few seafood dishes and while they were okay, some items felt a bit overcooked and the seasoning was not very consistent. Service was polite but a little slow during peak hours. The restaurant itself is spacious and good for family outings, but I was expecting a bit more considering the brand reputation.

Its not a bad place by any means, just that if you have experienced Fisherman's Wharf in Goa, you may find this outlet falling a little short in comparison. Overall a decent dining experience, but there is definitely room for improvement in food quality and consistency.

Great atmosphere and amazing ambience for a Saturday night quite goan vibe. Food was ok not something great. We are lovers of cafreal gravy and the one we have tasted in Goa was just amazing comparatively it was on for cafreal as well as goan gravy.

Had been here for dinner. Every dish we ordered was good. In starter we had honey chilli chicken where the chicken wad soft and juicy with spicy sauce and right amout of sweetess added through honey. Then we had butter garlic prawns which was coated in a white sauce. The prawns were fresh, had the garlic flavour and perfectly cooked due to which it was just melting in mouth. For mains we had the chicken tikka kulcha which was crispy from outside and tasty chicken filling. Perfectly paired with coriander chutney. For dessert we had the basque cheescake and you must definitely try this if you like cheesecake. Not overly sweet just perfect. Soft and melt in mouth dessert. Had a good dinner time.

I had a very disappointing experience at Fisherman’s Wharf. The food quality was extremely poor across the board.

The ghee roast was a complete letdown and lacked any authentic taste. The neer dosa was rubbery and inedible. The naan was half-cooked, chewy, and poorly prepared. Even the buffet offerings were below basic standards, with no freshness or flavor.

Overall, this was one of the worst dining experiences I’ve had. Based on food quality alone, I would rate this place 0/10 and strongly recommend avoiding it.

name: Cool Joint
review_texts: Used to roam in Jayanagar alot but never felt to try sandwiches as I am not fan of sandwich much. But after shopping for late till 10pm we had no other options other than Cool Joint though we just wanted to have idli in some Darshini eateries. So, we went for Veg Cheese Grill and Corn Cheese Grill and then like a dessert Chocolate Grill. All of them were at Rs.80 each. Veg was okay, corn was somewhat good and we liked Chocolate Grill. This seems to be hyped one and the oldest one in Jayanagar that's the reason for the crowd otherwise sandwiches were just decent but it's still a huge crowd puller. May be sandwich lovers can give a visit and share their opinion. For us it was just okay. Have tried Hari Sandwich for Rs.50 and a bit smaller in size and it's in 3rd Block that seems to be a bit good.

Hidden Gem: Old-School Sandwiches & Badam Milkshake Magic
Tucked away in a bustling corner that’s been slinging treats for decades, this no-frills joint is a time capsule of flavor. The faded signboard and worn wooden counters scream “vintage,” but don’t let the age fool you—the quality here shines brighter than ever. We’ve been coming back for years, and it never disappoints.
First bite: the sandwich. They grill it right in front of your eyes on a sizzling tawa, no shortcuts. Freshly sliced veggies—crisp onions, juicy tomatoes, shredded carrots—pile high with molten cheese and a secret green chutney that packs a tangy punch. The bread? Soft yet crusty, buttered to perfection. It’s messy, hearty, and hits that street-food sweet spot without feeling greasy. At under ₹80, it’s a steal for the portion size.
Then, the star: badam milkshake. Thick, frothy goodness blended live with real almonds, cardamom, and a generous scoop of vanilla ice cream. You watch the magic happen—nuts ground fresh, milk frothing up—no powders or shortcuts. It’s creamy, not overly sweet, with that nutty aroma lingering. Pairs perfectly with the sandwich for a quick, satisfying fix.
Spotless counters, friendly uncles who remember regulars, and zero fuss. In a world of flashy cafes, this old spot keeps it real: clean, transparent, top-notch quality. Perfect pitstop after a ride or work crunch. 5/5—worth the nostalgia trip!

Always one of the best place to go for sandwiches , ice creams . I am going this place more than 27 years and I ll always live to go here . Fruit salad I creams are always my favourite . You can also find juices too here . They use to give tomato soup at 5 rs 15 years back and that use to be better than best of the best place . It’s defiantly an iconic Bengaluru shop which I ll keep on going .

They have very good range of icecreams and  sandwiches
We had cheese corn sandwich, vegetable sandwich, gudbud, nargis, triple sundae, falooda, lovers special, honeymoon special

They had amazing names to their menu with amazing flavours
Mind blowing, Try this ..you will feel something good in your heart. You will feel sweet inside. Love your partner. If you have girl , go with her. She will be happy. Try Hot choco fudge.

name: Truffles - Sanjaynagar
review_texts: Had a very pleasant experience at Truffles, BEL Road. The food was nice and tasted good, with plenty of options on the menu. The ambience was really good—comfortable, lively, and a great place to hang out with friends or family. The restaurant was clean and well maintained, which added to the overall experience. The staff were friendly, courteous, and attentive throughout our visit. The only small thing I would mention is that there was a little too much capsicum on the pizza for my personal preference. Apart from that, everything was enjoyable, and I had a good time. Would definitely visit again!

Truffle Restaurant is definitely a must-visit place for food lovers! They offer a huge variety of food at a very affordable price, and everything we tried tasted fresh and absolutely delicious. The quality of the food was excellent, and every dish was full of flavor.
The atmosphere of the restaurant is lively, comfortable, and perfect for hanging out with friends or family. The staff and service were also amazing — very friendly, quick, and welcoming.
Overall, the food taste gets a solid 10/10 from me. Great food, great pricing, great service, and a great vibe. Highly recommended!

Stopped by for some desserts, but the place was completely packed—all tables were booked, so we couldn't get a seat.

We tried the Blueberry Cheesecake Jar and a Chocolate Cupcake to go.
Both were tasty and high quality, but definitely on the very sweet side.

They were a bit too sugary for us to finish.
No parking available.
