Great experience at Truffles, Sanjaynagar. We arrived about 30 minutes before opening time and the staff were kind enough to let us in. Had pizza, a chocolate milkshake, and the chicken Boston bao.  Everything tasted excellent. Very affordable prices for the quality and quantity. Definitely a must-visit place.

I would give the food a precise 3.7/5
Not everything is good here.
Few are amazing ( korean chicken burger, any shakes , dutch truffle)

Few were okish ( cheescake fish and chips(oily ) )

Few were bad ( american lamb burger -- A bland cutlet)
But the variety of options make the visit worthwhile

name: Windmills Craftworks [Whitefield]
review_texts:
The most good thing I liked here was the ambience and the service. They have a limited Continental and modern Indian menu, especially not many options for vegetarians.

I really liked the Parmesan Chilli Kulcha—it was too good. The Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli was just okay; I actually left it because I felt something was missing. The Honey Chilli Potato was too sweet for our taste, so we didn't even feel like ordering dessert later.

The portion size isn't worth the price. Overall, my experience was okayish, that's all..

We went there as a family on a weekday evening. We could get a table right away. The ambience is excellent. The service is very friendly and attentive. The beers are good, four of them, each with its own taste. The food was good as well. We tried several items, chicken wings, lamb seekh, fish fingers etc. and most of them were extremely tasty and of high quality. We had pork belly for the main. It tasted was fine but the crunchy side was a little too hard.

The kids also has good fun. They enjoyed the food, the ambience and were comfortable on the sofa. Didn't ask for a high chair and don't think one was available.

They have valet parking available.

Overall, a great place to visit for good quality food and beer is a nice atmosphere.

A wonderful place to catch up with friends and colleagues. The beers are great and the food is delicious.

Friendly and polite staff, cater for all your needs.

We will definitely visit again.

I have been visiting this place from last 12 years and this is the best microbrewery in Bangalore—it always has been.
The craft beers are consistently top-notch, with the Hefewizen and stout being crisp and brewed to perfeftion.

The ambiance is relaxed and the service has always been great.
The food menu complements the beers.
The staff is knowledgeable and very courteous.

This place never disappoints and continues to set the standard for microbreweries in the city.

Ever since I moved to Bengaluru, I've made it a weekend ritual to check out a different brewery every chance I get. After trying quite a few, Windmills is still the one I keep comparing everything else to.

If you're into craft beer, you'll notice the little things - the balance, the freshness, and how clean each brew tastes. That's what really stood out here. Every beer I tried felt well thought out rather than just another house brew.

The place itself is just as memorable. The live jazz in the background, relaxed ambience, and attentive service make it easy to spend an entire evening here. I didn't explore much of the food menu, but the fish dish I ordered was excellent and paired really well with the beer.

Definitely one of my favourite breweries in the city, and a place I'll keep coming back to.

name: Veena Stores
review_texts:
Visited Veena Stores in Malleshwaram — a proper old Bangalore classic that almost everyone recommends. The place definitely has that nostalgic charm and is almost always packed, which says a lot about its popularity.
That said, I personally found it a bit overhyped. The chutney, which they’re especially famous for, didn’t quite live up to the buzz for me. It was good, but not something extraordinary.
The kharabath, however, was genuinely tasty and well-made.
Overall, it’s a solid, iconic breakfast spot with strong local love — but in my opinion, slightly more hype than wow.

Veena Stores never disappoints! The idlis are super soft, the khara bath is packed with flavor, and the vada is perfectly crispy. Highly recommended!

One of Bengaluru’s finest breakfast spots. ❤️

I stopped at Veena stores for tea.

The place is one of the must visit places at Bangalore. Known for ita delicious breakfast options.

The store has integrated technology quite well with a self order machine and payment collection. The service is very quick.

I tried the vada and tea. Vada was served with chutney. It was quite crunchy and delicious.

Tea was excellent with the perfect amount of tea powder and sweetness.

I recently visited Veena Stores and had an excellent breakfast experience. This place truly lives up to its reputation for serving authentic South Indian food.

The idly was incredibly soft and fluffy, almost melting in the mouth, and paired perfectly with their chutney. The vada was crispy on the outside and soft inside, making it absolutely delicious. I also tried the kesari, which was rich, slightly sweet, and very satisfying.

The bisibillebath was full of flavor, warm, and comforting, while the chow chow bath (a combination of khara bath and kesari) was perfectly balanced and tasty. Every dish felt fresh and well-prepared, maintaining consistent quality.

To complete the meal, I had their filter coffee, which was strong, aromatic, and refreshing—the perfect end to a classic Bangalore breakfast.

Located on Margosa Road, the place has a simple, no-frills setup but is always bustling with people, which shows its popularity. Service is quick despite the crowd.

Overall, Veena Stores is a must-visit for authentic South Indian breakfast lovers.

Only idly and vada I liked along with one sweet. Puliyogre and other rice item is avg. Not enough space to even stand and eat. Over-all 3.5 stars.  Don't visit with much expectation go with avg expectations.

name: Chulha Chauki da Dhaba | Jayanagar
review_texts:
Visited Chula Chauki Dhaba for a Sunday lunch. Glad that we made it early around 12 pm. By the time we finished the restaurant was jam packed with crowds waiting. I had previously visited the Indira Nagar branch. The ambience is starkingly similar for a second made me confused if I visited this branch earlier too. It's a authentic dhaba setup can be a little uncomfortable to sit for long time.
Coming to the food we tried tandoori chicken to start. It was good but slightly dry and not as juicy . For mains went went with chicken tikka masala and chicken keema along with jerra rice and phulka. The chicken keema is a must try. I would say sikp the chicken tikka masala and go for the butter chicken as it's not that good. Overall the taste was okay but can be improved a bit.
The dishes took time to arrive, but the staff was courteous and well reciving our feedbacks.

Tried visiting Chulha Chauki da Dhaba, Jayanagar after hearing so much hype everywhere, but honestly it felt like just another normal restaurant with fancy presentation and social media hype 😅. The ambience is definitely nice and the rooftop setup with lights gives a good vibe for photos and hanging out with friends 🌃✨, but when it comes to the actual food, it was pretty average and nowhere close to the level people describe online. The papad topping starter looked colorful and tempting, but taste-wise it was very basic. Paneer items were okay-ish, not bad but nothing memorable either 🫠. Rotis and naan were decent, but again for the amount they charge, you expect something much better. Most dishes felt heavily priced just because of the “dhaba theme” and crowd popularity.

The biggest issue is that this place is seriously overrated and overpriced for what it offers 💸. You end up paying premium prices for food that tastes very ordinary. The quantity also doesn’t justify the cost at all. Even the chutneys and sides felt average, and some dishes looked better than they actually tasted. Service was fine but the waiting time and crowd make it feel overhyped. It’s not a bad place, but definitely not worth all the craze people create around it. You can easily find many places in Bangalore serving tastier North Indian food at much better prices 😅. Overall, it’s good for one-time visit and ambience photos 📸, but if you’re going mainly for amazing food, this place may disappoint you. Food was just okay, not something worth spending so much money on 🙃🍽️

One of the best ever North Indian dishes I've ever had!!! ❤️

We had Masala Papad, Paneer Biriyani, Mushroom Masala, Jeera Rice, Dal Tadka, Tandoori Roti, Sweet Lassi, Salt Lassi, Lemon Soda... Each and every dish was top notch! 🔥

Quality and quantity were so good that is 4 could barely finish all the dishes. ❤️

Service was amazing, staff assisted from order to billing. Ambiance is also very good.

I'm definitely visiting here again 💯

Chulha Chauki Da Dhaba in Jayanagar is a nice option when you're craving North Indian comfort food without the typical fine-dining setup. The restaurant is located on the 5th floor, but there's a lift available, so reaching it isn't an issue.

I visited for lunch, and the place was relatively quiet when we arrived. However, as the afternoon progressed, more tables started filling up, which is usually a good sign. The interiors are designed around a traditional dhaba theme, with rustic décor and seating that tries to recreate the roadside Punjabi dhaba experience.

The menu is quite extensive and covers both vegetarian and non-vegetarian Punjabi dishes. From paneer gravies, dal makhani, and stuffed parathas to butter chicken, kebabs, and other North Indian classics, there's enough variety for mixed groups. Portions are generous and pair well with their assortment of breads.

One thing worth noting is that they do not serve alcohol, so it's more of a family restaurant than a pub-style North Indian place.

Service was pleasantly quick. Despite the restaurant gradually getting busier, our food arrived within 15–20 minutes, and the staff were attentive throughout the meal.

Overall, Chulha Chauki Da Dhaba delivers a good combination of Punjabi food, dhaba-style ambience, and efficient service. It's a solid choice in Jayanagar when you're looking for hearty North Indian food in a relaxed, family-friendly setting.

First time tasting Punjabi dishes, everything was good and awesome too. From the moment I walked in, the aromatic spices and vibrant decor transported me straight to the heart of Punjab 🇮🇳. The menu offered an authentic selection of traditional dishes, each prepared with evident passion and care. I particularly enjoyed the rich and creamy Butter Chicken, a classic that did not disappoint. The Tandoori Roti was perfectly cooked, fluffy and slightly charred, making it an ideal accompaniment. Overall, it was a memorable culinary journey filled with authentic flavors and warm hospitality. #PunjabiCuisine

name: House of Commons
review_texts: I read the reviews of this place on Google and expected a pleasant experience. Initial impressions like the ambience are good. However, on the arrival of the first dish, which was the soup, there was an unsettling disappointment that set within me. The food was so much worse than expected, despite the high rates. The sizzler arrived lukewarm and not in its usual form. The soup is probably the worst I've ever tasted in Bengaluru. I am a non-alcoholic so I won't completely judge this place plainly based on the food, but there is definitely a LOT of room for improvement here. The cutlery is worn out too (as attached in images). Service is decent and the place itself is decently clean. Staff is quite quiet and reserved but brisk. So, I would definitely avoid this place as a non-alcoholic.

I had an absolutely delightful experience at House of Commons! 🤩 The food was incredibly delicious, exceeding all my expectations. 🤤 The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff. ✨ The atmosphere was simply perfect, making it a truly memorable visit.

House of Commons is a great spot if you’re looking for good food without spending too much. As the name suggests, the pricing is quite reasonable, making it a solid choice for casual dining. The food was genuinely tasty and satisfying, with flavors that didn’t disappoint.

What really stood out, though, was the ambiance. The place has a nice, relaxed vibe that makes it comfortable to sit back and enjoy your meal. Overall, it’s a well-balanced experience—good food, fair pricing, and a pleasant atmosphere. Definitely worth a visit.

The food was quite average overall with very limited vegetarian options. We ordered the Arrabbiata pasta, which was just okay. The starters and main course were also underwhelming. The paneer curry and mix veg curry had too much gravy and very little paneer or vegetables.

I also tried their Mango Tango mocktail, which was overly sweet and tasted very similar to Maaza — lacking both creativity and flavor.

The service was disappointing as well. Despite the restaurant not being crowded, it took a long time to get the attention of the waiters.

Overall, not a place I would recommend.

House Commons HSR is one of the best places to hang out in HSR Layout. As a vegetarian and someone who doesn’t drive, I really appreciate how convenient and comfortable this place is.

The location is excellent — easily accessible by auto and cab, and situated in a lively yet safe part of HSR. Even without a vehicle, reaching here is never a problem. The area around the restaurant is well-lit and active, which makes late evening visits feel comfortable.

What impressed me the most is their vegetarian options. Unlike many bars where veg choices feel limited, House Commons has a good variety of flavorful and well-prepared vegetarian dishes. The starters were fresh and perfectly seasoned, and the presentation was great. It’s a place where even vegetarians can enjoy a full dining experience without feeling restricted.

The ambience is vibrant and classy at the same time. The lighting, music, and seating arrangement create a relaxed yet energetic vibe — perfect for catching up with friends or even a casual team outing. The staff is polite, attentive, and quick with service, which makes the overall experience even better.

The bar section is well-managed, and the mocktail options are equally good for those who prefer non-alcoholic drinks. Everything feels organized and professionally handled.

Overall, House Commons HSR offers a great combination of tasty food, lively atmosphere, and easy accessibility. Whether you’re a vegetarian, a non-driver, or just someone looking for a good place to unwind in HSR, this spot is definitely worth visiting.

name: KAAPI KATTE
review_texts:
I’ve been a big fan of this place since 2015 and have been visiting ever since. It has always maintained its quality and charm over the years.

The menu is simple and budget-friendly, which makes it even more appealing for visits.

I especially love the tiffin items and coffee — both are consistently good.

The place is well-maintained, but parking can be a bit difficult. Two-wheelers are manageable, though.

Prices are too minimum 🤗
Must try Garlic roast Masala Dosa 😋🤤 🔥

Idly with chutney is perfect without sambar.
They have a standing fan at the corner which blows the mist with air😉🌪️
COFFEE is also good 👍😊

We visited Kaapi Katte for the first time. It was good, but not up to the hype. I felt the coffee was average. There are many other restaurants that serve much softer rava idli compared to this place. The vada was good though. If we’re passing by or nearby, it’s okay to visit once.

1. Kaapi Katte offers an authentic South Indian filter coffee experience in Bangalore.

2. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee creates a warm and nostalgic vibe.

3. It is a small, cozy place perfect for quick chats and casual meetups.

4. The traditional steel tumbler service adds to its charm.

5. Overall, it gives a simple yet memorable taste of Bangalore’s coffee culture.

Great place to have coffee and other south Indian foods at reasonable rates.  Coffee is great.  Also try sabakki idli which is unique to this place and its awesome. Vada also is good along with other regular food items like kharabath and others.

Parking for two wheelers is not an issue but for cars it can be depending on the day and time of the week.

name: U D ROTIGHAR (BHARJARI OOTA & PARTY HALL)
review_texts:
We celebrated our niece naming ceremony here. The food was great. No doubt about it. Lift is available, Air conditioning is available in the party hall . Party hall can accommodate around 80-100 people . Parking is little different. Restaurant doesn’t have parking facilities. So will have to park the vehicle elsewhere . It’s an old restaurant and has still lived upto its name . We asked the restaurant owner for the stage decorations. We got it for a pretty decent price and worth the money. Try to negotiate with them.
Over all good restaurant

Located right on the famous fruits and flower street alongside legends like Vidyarthi Bhavan and Namma SLN, Roti Ghar definitely managed to impress. Despite the heavy crowds, the experience was seamless.

The Food Breakdown:

* Starters: The Spanish Manchurian (3.7/5) was a unique highlight—creamy spinach base with fried veg balls, mushrooms, and paneer. A very different and tasty twist!

The Manchow Soup (2.5/5) was unfortunately a bit too watery for my liking.

* Chaats: The Palak Chaat (4/5) was the absolute winner! A perfect medley of sweet, tangy, and spicy with a satisfying crunch from the kaju and palak.

The Masala Puri (3.5/5) was solid and traditional, though the Bhel Puri (2/5) lacked the "wow" factor and proper masala balance.

* Main Course: We had Roti, Pudina Roti, and Paneer Laziz (3.9/5). The paneer was incredibly soft (Nandini paneer) and paired perfectly with the spicy, kaju-filled gravy. Everything felt very fresh.

Vibe & Service:
The service was lovely—quick and amicable despite the place being jam-packed. They have a standing self-service area on the ground floor and a more relaxed AC seating area on the first floor. Also I loved the fact that they mentioned their main source like for paneer they use fresh nandini one after the fake paneer rampant in India and rotis are clearly distinguished between maida and whole wheat. Also super reasonable price for the quality and taste!

Total Verdict: A great spot for a variety of flavors if you are in the area. Don't miss that Palak Chaat!
It's a really nice place, food was amazing. If you wanna try real South Indian taste, please do come.

Delicious, pure vegetarian meal and local. Waiting times for getting the table can vary. We had to wait for a few minutes but waiting times can be much longer. The experience was delightful. I can recommend it for anyone who wants to eat local vegetarian.
The food is great  and love the service ,,it is just too overcrowded during lunch time but th food served is amazing..

name: Indraprastha Vegetarian
review_texts:
Quick Service, tasty good, affordable price and totally worth it experience.

Good for casual family dining.
Tried Kaju masala, Butter Garlic Naan and Sczhewan Noodles.
Absolutely loved all of them
The waiters are responsive and quick.

Quite and nice ambience.
Good seating spaces and cleanliness
Ideal location.
Overall very satisfied.

Visited Indraprastha Hotel and tried their Idly Vada Sambar and Masala Dosa.

The masala dosa was the highlight of the meal—crispy, well-roasted, and packed with a tasty potato filling. The idly and vada were soft and fresh, but the sambar was just okay and could have been more flavorful. The coconut chutney paired well with the dosa.
Good restaurant and has only one branch in Vijayanagar. Food was good ambience also good. Must visit once. Mouth watering food

I would rate this place around 3.5 stars overall. The food is average — not bad, but not something you would really enjoy or remember. The taste could definitely be improved.

The washrooms also need better maintenance. The hygiene and setup gave more of a roadside dhaba/small hotel vibe, which doesn’t match the expectation for this category of place.

Overall, it’s an average place with average food and ok ambiance — not disappointing, but also not impressive. Could be much better with improvements in food quality and washroom standards.

Ambience is good.
Meals taste❌
Meals quantity ❌
Waiters and servers attitude ❌❌❌

Masala dosa✅
Rest all is crap.
Bad parking.
Bad recommendation by the server.

Don't waste ur money by going to AC seating or seating also.

name: Vijayanagar Food Street
review_texts:
Hell Yeah🔥

Here, You can get all sorts of South Indian, North Indian and Street foods.

I've tried:

Gobi Manchurian, which was crispy on the outside and softer inside. A PERFECT GOBI. But i felt it wasn't spicy enough. Kids will love it for sure. They charged me 70 for full plate.
I would give a 4.5/5.

Egg Rice, Must try!!! They didnt dump hell lot of sauces. Just masalas, rice and egg. It had enough spice, rice was well boiled. ₹50 for a full plate.
A Solid 5/5🔥

Waiting time depends on the crowd. In an average it would be around 5-10 mins.

Visited Vijayanagar Food Street recently.

It’s an okay place for a quick street food stop, but the options are quite limited compared to other food streets in the city.

The area is also small, so it can feel crowded during peak evening hours. You can try a few basic snacks if you’re nearby, but overall it’s a normal experience and not something very special.

Parking ♿🅿️ Limited
Accessibility ♿ Yes

Vijaynagar food Street offers a variety of food items like Ginnu, Dosas, Paddu, Soda, Bhel, Gobi. A lot of stalls to choose from.
Best part is no Non Veg in any cart.

A drawback is the parking space and active traffic on the street.
Whenever a car passes by, it causes inconvenience to all the people on the street.

They can either make pukka stalls and make amenities like drinking water, seating spaces and all. That would be super helpful thing to do.
Not very much food options. Mostly 99 varities dosa centers. Marshmallow choco must try. But all food was good. There are so many vehicles passing by not able to move freely.

Overall good experience if you go by bike you will get parking easily if it’s a car it’s hard to find a parking please so please avoid going on car, weekends will be huge crowd. Food is like depends on you choose the cart and taste. Overall good experience if you choose good cart it’s worth for money. Peni and Ginnu are my favourites.

name: Vapour Brewpub and Diner
review_texts:
Google review for vapour brewpub and diner restaurant..
We have ordered many starters mocktails and drinks, and overall food was good. We have to order the items by scanning the qr code, which helped us in avoiding the asking for hard copy whenever we want to order. Everytime when we add any items to the order list, any staff member was asking us for the confirmation that was one good. Being a rooftop we were getting good wind, but only problem was smoking smell as there were no specific tables like no smoking zone. Overall theme was good and on that day we watched complete india vs west indies match felt really well in craud. Dance floor was ausome, dj was playing good music and we requested for kannada songs and was played. Overall experience was very good.

Here’s a polished Google review you can post:

We recently visited Vapour Brewpub and Diner and had a great overall experience. We ordered several starters, mocktails, and drinks, and the food quality was good.

The ordering system was convenient — we had to scan a QR code to place orders, which made it easy without repeatedly asking for a hard copy menu. Every time we added items to our order, the staff promptly came for confirmation, which was really appreciated.

Being a rooftop place, we enjoyed the pleasant breeze and ambiance. The only downside was the smoking smell, as there wasn’t a clearly designated non-smoking zone.

The theme and vibe were excellent. We even watched the full India vs West Indies match there, and the crowd energy made it even more enjoyable. The dance floor was awesome, the DJ played great music, and they even played Kannada songs on our request.

Valet parking was available, which was very convenient. The restrooms were well maintained, with two separate facilities each for men and women.

Overall, it was a very good experience, and we had a wonderful time!

Vapour Brewpub and Diner – Sarjapur Road is a perfect hangout spot for those who love great food, refreshing drinks, and a lively party vibe. Located on one of the busiest stretches of the city, this place surprisingly feels like a peaceful escape once you step inside, making it ideal for party lovers and weekend chill scenes.

The rooftop seating is one of the biggest highlights of this brewpub. Especially if you grab a corner-side table, the views are absolutely amazing. The open-air setup, combined with ambient lighting and a vibrant crowd, creates a fantastic atmosphere for both casual evenings and energetic nights. Whether you’re catching up with friends or planning a celebration, the rooftop adds a premium touch to the entire experience.

When it comes to food, Vapour doesn’t disappoint. The menu offers a good variety of options catering to different tastes, and the quality is consistently impressive. Alongside that, the selection of beverages, including a wide range of alcoholic drinks, is well-curated. From classic choices to signature brews, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

Despite being located on a crowded and busy road, the vibe inside feels completely different—almost like stepping into a party zone away from the chaos outside. The music, crowd energy, and overall ambiance make it a favorite spot for party enthusiasts.

Service is decent, and the staff handles the rush efficiently, especially during peak hours. Overall, Vapour Brewpub and Diner offers a complete package of great views, tasty food, good drinks, and a lively atmosphere, making it a must-visit place on Sarjapur Road.

I recently visited Vapour Brewpub and Diner on Sarjapur Road and absolutely loved the experience — especially the view and overall vibe. Situated on the 7th floor, the rooftop seating offers a stunning elevated view of the city and surrounding greenery, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a sunset with friends or for an evening out. The ambience is lively and relaxed, blending open-air seating with cool breezes and great music that keeps the vibe energetic yet comfortable. The house-brewed beers are excellent, and the crowd here adds to a social, upbeat atmosphere. Whether you’re going for chilled drinks, good food, or the sunset skyline view, this place delivers on all fronts. It’s a great choice for casual hangouts, date nights, or weekend celebrations with a pretty memorable backdrop.

We went here for our anniversary dinner. Roads leading to vapour have too much traffic. Basement has car parking available. Lifts are in not good condition. Outdoor seatings are good if the weather is pleasant but we could not get it as it was already booked by a group. We ordered nachos, panner tandoori pizza, Hakka noodles, tandoori chicken. Everything was decent. Ordered a cocktail but it was very average. Music is loud if you are sitting inside. After 10 pm they open the dance floor. Ambience is quite average. Washrooms are quite old and in need of maintenance. Heavy police checking in the area for drink and drive cases so beware!

Had an absolutely amazing and beautiful Valentine’s night with my husband at Vapour, Sarjapur! ❤️

Even though it was Valentine’s week and the place was extremely crowded, Sujata was incredibly sweet and kind. We waited around 15–20 minutes, but she made sure we got a seat amidst all the rush. She also informed us in advance that the service might be a little delayed due to the crowd, which we truly appreciated.

We waited almost an hour for everything, but honestly, it didn’t matter — we were happy to be seated and enjoy our special time together.

A special mention to Raja, who was fantastic! He was constantly moving around, serving everyone with a smile and making sure all guests were comfortable.

Overall, we had a wonderful experience at Vapour, Sarjapur. Thank you for making our Valentine’s celebration memorable! ❤️✨

name: Hakuna Matata
review_texts:
Updated review:

Went for dinner and had the following:
Gabhi manchurian: ver very good
Spring roles: filling seemed stale so asked ro cancel which the restaurant obliged.
Paneer lababdar: good
Malai kofta: the gravy was excessively thick and made with maida like a pasta sauce. Also the kofta was very hard and dry.

Ambiance is good, staff is decent and service is quick.

Visited for a quick dinner. Staff was courteous and service was quick. Had ordered Paneer lababdar butter garlic naan and butter roti.

The paneer lababdar was a little bland. It could be either a little sweet or a little spicy. Either way would have been better.

The naan and roti were great. Very nicely done

It has a really good vibe! The food tastes great, they serve beer, and the ambience is open and chill. They have a lovely open garden with hut-style seating, which I loved. The only downside was that I noticed a lot of flies around. They definitely need to maintain a bit more hygiene around the tables and near the green windows.

On the bright side, the service is quick and the staff are super attentive. I even got to watch a live IPL match while dining. Overall, it’s a fun, go-to place!

I'm giving 1 star just because they are charging more than MRP. Food is amazing here, service could be better, they have limited people to take order. Staff doing there best, 10/10 for efforts. I'd like to come back here.  Must try their Thai Pocked and choco Brownie with vanilla.

Note: First ask the price then place the order and  there is no AC as it's open space kind of setup evenings are best to enjoy the spot

We visited this restaurant for our office team lunch and had a wonderful experience. The food was delicious, with a good variety of dishes that were enjoyed by everyone. The service was prompt, courteous, and attentive throughout our visit. The restaurant was clean, well-maintained, and had a pleasant ambiance, making it a great place for team gatherings. Overall, we had a memorable dining experience and would be happy to visit again.

Refreshingly different experience than the usual. Nice blend of covered and open seating with a bit of green view all around.

Food tasted really good. We tried crab soup, mushroom ghee roast, chicken tikka masala, roti and naan.

Taste, service and ambience outmatches the price. Must try!

name: 46 Ounces Brewgarden
review_texts: Had a wonderful experience at 46 Ounce Brew! The ambience is beautiful, peaceful, and perfect for spending quality time with friends or family. The place has a very relaxing vibe and is well maintained. We tried the Golden Fox craft beer, and it was smooth, refreshing, and really good. The food was equally impressive—especially the Chilli Cheese Toast and Kodogu Pork, both of which were delicious . The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. The service was quick, and the overall experience was excellent. This place is suitable for families, couples, friends, and even larger groups. Definitely a place I'd love to visit again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

"We recently celebrated our daughter’s birthday at 46 Ounces in Electronic City, and it was an absolutely flawless experience. The venue feels like a magical place in the middle of the city. Its enchanting landscaping, sweeping lawns, and magnificent, giant trees perfectly complemented our party's theme.
The hospitality we received was truly exemplary. A special note of thanks must go to the managers, Chingnu and Dev. From our very first planning meeting, they guided us with incredible patience, assisting with every minute detail and going above and beyond to secure a beautiful, private corner for our celebration.
We are also incredibly grateful to Roshan and Sachin, who attended to our guests throughout the entire event. Their expert menu recommendations were highly appreciated and well-received by everyone. Even though our chosen seating area was located quite far from the kitchen, they managed the service seamlessly, maintaining a high standard of attentiveness despite it being an exceptionally busy day. The diverse menu, breathtaking ambiance, and stellar team made this a truly perfect and memorable celebration."

We visited 46 Ounces for dinner after seeing many hyped reels online.

The restaurant is huge, with a spacious open lawn, a pet-friendly atmosphere, great music, and a giant screen to enjoy live sports while dining. The ambience is lovely and makes it a nice place to spend an evening.

However, the main disappointment was the food. Unfortunately, we didn't enjoy it, and it didn't live up to the expectations created by the online hype.

Overall, it was an okay-ish experience. We loved the ambience, but the food quality could definitely be improved.

The service and atmosphere are top notch. The outdoor seating area offers a great view of live sports being telecasted, creating an open and lively atmosphere. The attentive service staff even asked for feedback after each dish was tasted. We tried their in-house crafted beers, particularly the 46 Golden Fox beer, which was very pleasant. The mango-flavoured mocktail was also a good choice. For starters, we enjoyed the veg platter, which was nothing special but satisfying. The veg Alfredo noodles and some titbits with beer were also good. Overall, the food and beverage experience was enjoyable.

The ambience was calm and relaxing, especially in the evening. we ordered paneer, a burger, and two mocktails. The total bill was around ₹2,300–₹2,800 for two people.

The food was good, the atmosphere was pleasant, and the overall experience felt worth the price for a special occasion.

Recommended for birthdays, family gatherings, and anyone looking for a peaceful place with a nice ambience.

name: Hard Rock Cafe Bengaluru
review_texts:
Had a wonderful experience at Hard Rock Cafe Bangalore! The ambience was lively with great music, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy a meal. We ordered the BBQ Burger, NY Steak, Hurricane, Fish & Chips, and Cobbler, and every dish was delicious and well-presented. The steak was cooked well, the burger was juicy, and the fish & chips were crispy and flavorful. The dessert was a perfect way to end the meal.

The staff were courteous, attentive, and provided excellent service throughout. Overall, a great dining experience with good food, vibrant atmosphere, and friendly hospitality. Would definitely visit again and recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable meal in Bangalore!

Amazing place First time experience was good as my friend birthday. The live band was playing and requested for happy birthday song with the waiter crew and cheesecake. Amazing times. Truly special experience from here. And the manager He made the visit especially fun and memorable.If you stop by, give Ahmad and Ajith a shoutout and tell them they’re “Almost Famous.”
Food: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Atmosphere: 5/5
Noise level
Loud, and but you can still talk
❤️1

It's Hard Rock Cafe so you know what to expect. What's noticeable is that while many major chains... McDonalds, KFC, Taco Bell etc  struggle here to deliver consistency.... This is consistently good. The Beef and Chicken Fajitas exactly as you'd expect. Great music, cold beer, good food and the standard themed decoration. Narendra the bar manager was an excellent host and all the staff were pleasant and efficient. When you feel the need for International standards this is a good choice. Watch out for the bands on Saturday nights, they get some higher quality acts visiting from out of town.

​Hard Rock Cafe is so much more than just a place for food and drinks—it’s a vibrant cultural experience center. If you love rock music and great vibes, this is your ultimate regular hangout.
​The staff here are incredibly attentive and go above and beyond. I asked for a walkthrough of the property, and Mr. Narendra was absolutely fantastic. He personally gave us a wonderful tour, sharing the fascinating history and rich culture behind the Hard Rock brand.
​Now, let's talk about the food and drinks! If you love a tangy, citrusy kick, you absolutely have to try the Strawberry Basil Lemonade mocktail—it's incredibly refreshing. For food, their Legendary Nachos are an absolute must-try, made with premium, super-quality ingredients.
​We also tried the Pork Back Ribs, and honestly, words fall short. They were top-class! The meat was cooked to absolute perfection, and the rich BBQ sauce infused it with incredible flavor. Meat lovers, this is your paradise—do not miss out on this.
​Amazing music, stellar service and mouth-watering food. We will definitely be back for more!

5 stars

This was my 100th Hard Rock Cafe visit, and Hard Rock Cafe Bengaluru made it feel special. From the moment I walked in, I felt genuinely welcomed, and that made the whole experience even better.

The Hurricane was perfect, bartender Ajith (Samir) was outstanding, and the food was good. Even better, the pricing did not feel crazy inflated like at so many other cafes around Asia and the world.

John the manager was very nice, but Ahmad from the Rock Shop was the shining star for me. He has the personality, organization, and presence of someone who could run the whole place. He made the visit especially fun and memorable.

If you stop by, give Ahmad and Ajith a shoutout and tell them they’re “Almost Famous.”

name: The Rameshwaram Cafe
review_texts:
I recently visited Rameshwaram Cafe and had the dosa, lemon rice, and filter coffee. Overall, it was a very good experience, and the food quality lived up to the reputation.

The dosa was crispy, fresh, and served hot with flavorful chutneys and sambar. The lemon rice was well-seasoned, aromatic, and had the right balance of tanginess and spices. The filter coffee was rich, authentic, and a perfect way to end the meal.

The cafe was clean, well-maintained, and the service was efficient despite the crowd. The food quality and consistency were impressive.

The only downside is the pricing. A few items, especially the beverages and some popular dishes, feel slightly on the higher side compared to other South Indian restaurants. That said, the portions are decent, and the quality of ingredients and preparation helps justify the cost for most items. The cafe is also usually crowded, which can make it difficult to find seating during peak hours.

Overall, I’d rate it 4/5. Great food and good service, with pricing that is a little premium in places but still fair for the overall experience.

The Rameshwaram Cafe is great breakfast spot in the city. The food is always good and reasonably priced. My favourite is the ghee podi idli which is doused in ghee! I also love the garlic masala dosa, the vada and the idli. Everything is always fresh. And ofcourse a filter coffee to wash all the food down is a must. Perfect way to start the weekend.

If you're looking for an authentic South Indian café in Bengaluru, your search ends here.
This place is always bustling with food lovers. From washing your hands to collecting your order, you may have to wait in line. However, the moment you take your first bite, you realize that the wait is completely worth it. The quality and taste of the food are consistently top-notch.
They have two automated coupon-generation machines with QR code payment options, making the ordering process smooth and efficient despite the crowd.
They don't just serve food—they serve memories too.

We had breakfast from here and food really tasted good. We reached around 8 am on a friday and place was moderately crowded. Got food after 10mins waiting time. We tried ghee podi masala dosa, ghee podi idly and filter coffee. All were tasty but ghee podi idly really stood out. Rates were a bit higher. Will be good if some token system is maintained. Place is kept very neat and clean.

Had a fantastic breakfast experience at Rameshwaram Cafe! The food was fresh, flavorful, and served with the authentic South Indian taste that the cafe is known for.

We tried a variety of dishes, including the Ghee Pudi Dosa, Pudina Roasted Dosa, Lemon Rice, Pulihora (Tamarind Rice), and Gongura Rice, along with their signature coffee. Every dish had its own unique flavor and was prepared perfectly.

The Ghee Pudi Dosa was the standout item crispy, aromatic, generously coated with ghee and podi, and absolutely delicious. The Pudina Roasted Dosa had a refreshing mint flavor and a wonderful crunch. The Lemon Rice was light, tangy, and comforting, while the Pulihora delivered the perfect balance of tamarind and spices. The Gongura Rice was packed with authentic Andhra flavors and was a treat for anyone who enjoys a slightly tangy and spicy rice dish.

The chutneys complemented every dish beautifully, and the portions were satisfying. To finish, we had their famous filter coffee, which was rich, aromatic, and the perfect end to the meal.

Highlights of the visit:

- Ghee Pudi Dosa – an absolute must-try
- Authentic South Indian flavors
- Freshly prepared food with quality ingredients
- Excellent variety of rice dishes
- Delicious filter coffee
- Quick service and energetic atmosphere
- Great presentation served on banana leaves

If you're a fan of South Indian cuisine, Rameshwaram Cafe is definitely worth visiting. The combination of flavorful dosas, delicious rice varieties, and excellent coffee makes it a place you'll want to come back to again and again!

name: The Biere Club
review_texts:
Ambience (4/5):
At the crossroads between Vittal Mallaya Road and Lavelle road, The Biere Club offers a very classy place to enjoy pint or two. It offers a rusty old Irish pub vibe with comfortable seating and games like snooker (on the first floor). The sound of the music is quite bearable.

Food and Drinks (3/5):
The 3 dishes I tried (2 veg starters and a dessert). Thai corn fritters and the Hummus dish were decent light accompaniments with beer although you'd expect much more in terms of taste and complexity for the prices you're paying. The Biere Club special sundae was nothing more than a basic ice cream you get on the street for about Rs 150 although they charge 3X of that.

Their beer quality, body and mouthfeel is definitely above average but their seasonal Mango Ale was worth a try. What disappointed is the lack of cocktails available here. There's a lot of hard liquor menu items but not a lot of cocktails. On the off chance someone like me is in the mood for an espresso martini, I had to give them the recipe to make it although it was done as per instructions.

Service (5/5):
Swain was great at suggesting, making conversation and even taking feedback positively too. The service in general was agile and courteous.

My only gripe with this place is being situated in one of the most expensive areas in Bangalore, the prices you'll pay will be exorbitantly high. I dined alone but the amount in the bill is usually what I see when I go out with a +1. So if price is a very decisive factor for picking the place, you might want to reconsider.

It was quite good experience we had here, where foods section is all good with above average. And would have happy if there was more collections in regards of beer menu. Ambience and atmosphere wise it's a good place to dine.

Went there for lunch on a weekday. It was quite empty. The aesthetics of the place are nice. We got three beers pilsner, mango ale and rye-wizen bock. They were all fine. The mango ale a bit more bitter than what I expected. For food, we ordered mushroom fritters which were a bit spicy, cauliflower kebab (which wasn't great), grilled chicken skewers (which was good) and spaghetti (which was great). The service was quite good. Overall, a good experience, but coming hear after many years, I somehow expected an even  better experience, especially with the beer.

I was attracted to the place for the vibe. The ambience is a throwback like a British pub. They had 3 beers in tap. I tried the ale which was smooth. The chicken sando was good. Service was prompt. It is a good venue to watch a sporting event.

They have some good beers and food is ok, not that great. The prices are a bit over the top given its location. Every time I'm here there is one or the other beer which I really wanted that day is not available. Rest all the experience is good, quick service and nice vibes overall.

name: The Pallet Club.
review_texts: Very beautiful place. The place has some asthetic locations. The food and the options of the food was very good. The staff was friendly and even accepted the feedback that was given on the food. Gentle light music was played which was apt for the time.Overall a good place for everyone to hangout. There craft beers were also good. Would suggest to try samplers before ethe main onces.

Upon researching a couple of reviews online, I ended up visiting this place for the new year eve and liked it a lot. Excellent hospitality, tasty food, wonderful service, and a fair pricing. The buffet was fantastic; since we tried it upon tempting for the huge spread they had.

It's a lovely restaurant located at perfect location in Whitefield. Good ambient music quickly lightens the mood. Did try a few drinks and they were enjoyable, like Don Angel tequila, and Jagerbomb shots.

I would recommend this place!!

Service is pretty bad. The attendant was quite unprofessional. We had to ask multiple times for food to be served. Quite delayed service.
Food quality is also sub-par. Although beer taste is really good & authentic.
The ambience is pretty good. Perfect for enjoying ipl along with your food & beverages.

Nice place to hang out with friends during weekends…. Valet parking is available which make you feel relax and tension free…
Good parking space available for bikes as well … You can dine in and enjoy. Best service with best music around the place.
Delicious food… Loved it 😍😍 Even chicken wings are tasty. They have brewery which adds to good experience as they have good tasty beer 🍻
Main course food items are not that good I would rate it as average.
This restaurant goes above and beyond to provide a perfect ambiance, exceptional service, and delicious food that will leave you wanting more.
Great service.. keep up the good work 🙌🏻
Definitely I would recommend this place!

Overall the place is nice. The service was good. We ordered few drinks and some starters. To be honest chicken nachos was absolutely delicious with perfect quality and quantity. Overall the food was good not that great.

The place is pretty awesome to chill out with friends and family.

name: The Big Barbeque - Buffet - Bengaluru - Marathahalli
review_texts:
Visited The Big Barbeque for an office team lunch. The food variety was quite impressive, with 40+ items across starters, main course, and desserts for both veg and non-veg.
For veg, we had paneer tikka, grilled pineapple & watermelon, malai broccoli, crispy corn, cheese potato, and veg kebab—all were good and nicely prepared. For non-veg, there were options like fish, prawns, chicken, wings, and mutton kebab on the grill. They also had live counters for pizza, pasta, garlic bread, and pani puri, along with a decent spread of desserts.
The ambiance was lively and suitable for group outings, which added to the experience.
However, the service was very disappointing. We had to ask multiple times for grill items, but no one was attentive enough to serve them on time. It felt like the staff were more focused on other tables, and our requests were mostly ignored, which impacted the overall experience.
Overall, great food variety and atmosphere, but service needs significant improvement, especially for large groups.

recently visited AB's - Absolute Barbecues (Big Barbeque) in Marathahalli and had a good dining experience 😊. The ambience was really nice — lively, comfortable, and perfect for family outings 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 as well as team lunches 🏢.
The live grill on the table was the highlight 🔥. The starters kept coming non-stop and were full of flavor 😋. The fish fry was excellent 🐟, and the barbecue fish was especially yummy — perfectly marinated and grilled just right 👌.
However, for vegetarians, the barbecue options were limited. There were mainly barbecue mushroom 🍄, paneer, and one fruit option on the grill, so the variety felt a bit less compared to non-vegetarian starters.
The buffet spread had impressive variety 🍽️. There were different types of biryani including Chettinad biryani and Hyderabadi dum biryani 🍛. They also had a good range of salads 🥗 and a live pizza counter 🍕 with both veg and non-veg options.
The dessert section was a real highlight 🍨. They had live ice cream rolls, waffles 🧇, sponge cake 🍰, gulab jamun, carrot 🥕 halwa, kheer, chaat items, pani puri, and many more options — a paradise for dessert lovers 😍.
The staff was attentive and ensured quick service throughout 👏. Overall, it’s a great place for celebrations 🎉 and casual get-togethers. Nice ambience, tasty seafood 🐟, wide buffet spread, and an amazing dessert selection make it worth visiting. ⭐⭐⭐⭐✨

I had an incredible experience at The Big Barbeque! The food was absolutely delicious 😋, with a fantastic variety that satisfied everyone. The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff. The ambiance was cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot for a meal. Highly recommend! ✨🍖

Soo much in variety. 🫠 You will forget what to try.

Recently visited Big Barbeque and had a wonderful experience. The Big Barbeque buffet had an impressive spread with a wide variety of dishes, and everything we tried was delicious. The ambience was pleasant, and the service was prompt and courteous throughout. It truly felt worth the price we paid. Definitely a great place to enjoy a hearty buffet meal!

We visited on Ugadi day for lunch. Arrived at 1 PM. Saw all live counters not yet started and empty. Condiments looked like the night before. Starters for 5 people were served too slow minute quantities. Like 2 spoons of potato. 3 cutlets were being brought out. Waited for 30 mins and asked my lady waiter. She was smirking at me. It was a veg all buffet. Complained to the manager who brought out actual quantities after 30 mins and we were already done. Pasta pizza counter were empty without chefs. Just 1 pizza laid out the entire time. At 2 pm the chef asked me to wait 10 mins for pasta. I asked my server about pasta. She was like everything is available just go and search at live counter. Desserts were stale and tough. For sure this was from last night 😭. Never asked for feedback. Were worried about the bill. Came out quietly to post this.

name: Zaatar Multicuisine Restaurant
review_texts:
Google review points for maps , simple human like unique 6 points: zaatar multi cuisine, nirvana international spa,credit bee,

Zaatar Multi Cuisine
Loved the taste and freshness of the food, especially the starters.

The ambience feels cozy and perfect for family dinners.

Staff were polite and service was quicker than expected.

Good variety in the menu with decent pricing.

Clean seating area and well-maintained interiors.

A nice place to relax and enjoy multi-cuisine dishes with friends.

Nirvana International Spa
Very calm and relaxing atmosphere from the moment you enter.

Therapists were professional and made the session comfortable.

Clean rooms and good hygiene standards maintained throughout.

The massage experience felt refreshing and stress-relieving.

Staff handled appointments smoothly and were courteous.

Great place to unwind after a busy work week.

CreditBee
The app interface is simple and easy to understand.

Loan application process was quick and mostly hassle-free.

Customer support responded politely to queries.

Useful option for short-term financial needs.

Verification and approval updates were clearly communicated.

Overall experience was smooth compared to many similar apps.

Remove numbers , but bulleted

Zaatar Multi Cuisine
Loved the taste and freshness of the food, especially the starters.

The ambience feels cozy and perfect for family dinners.

Staff were polite and service was quicker than expected.

Good variety in the menu with decent pricing.

Clean seating area and well-maintained interiors.

A nice place to relax and enjoy multi-cuisine dishes with friends.

Visiting Zaatar Multicuisine Restaurant on Old Madras Road in Bangalore offers a mixed dining experience. On the positive side, the service stands out as attentive, courteous, and prompt, ensuring that diners feel well-attended to throughout their meal. However, the core aspects of the visit leave a rather ordinary impression. The taste of the multicuisine dishes is strictly average, lacking the distinct flavors or memorable punch you might expect from their Arabian and North Indian specialties. Additionally, the ambience is quite basic and mediocre, offering a standard, casual setup that doesn't particularly elevate the dining mood. It functions decently for a quick, hassle-free meal if you prioritize good service over standout culinary flavors or an immersive atmosphere.

Great ambience, excellent service, and tasty food. I tried the Egg Biryani, and it was quite delicious. It's not the traditional Hyderabadi dum biryani style, but it has its own unique flavor and is definitely worth trying. Overall, a pleasant dining experience!

1. Food was average ….. Dajaj Faa (Chicken) was tasty although very bland…. They should provide more additions to add to the taste. We tried the Rubiyan Magli ( Prawn ) was deep fried and extremely oily.
2. Service was good
3. Ambience was good

It is always great to have food here !! Biriyani and Tandoori chicken are the highlights! Arabian cuisine is also good and must try ! Overall great place to have lunch or Dinner 🍛! They have ample amount of space for parking as well as for seating . Will visit for sure !!

name: SLV CORNER VEG RESTAURANT
review_texts:
SLV Corner is one of those classic spots that truly lives up to its reputation. Located very close to Ramakrishna Ashrama, it’s easy to find and a go-to for anyone craving authentic vegetarian food. Parking is fairly convenient for two-wheelers right in front, while four-wheeler parking can be a bit tricky with mostly street-side options.

The restaurant operates in two formats—a self-service section and a separate service restaurant just opposite. The self-service area mainly focuses on South Indian staples and chaats, while the service section offers a more extensive menu including North Indian and Chinese dishes. The ambience is simple and old-school, but clean and well-maintained, which adds to its charm.

Coming to the food, the self-service section delivers consistently great flavors. The masala puri, sev puri, idli with sambar dip, and masala dosa were all excellent and packed with authentic taste. The rava idli was soft and enjoyable, though the Bombay sagu could have been better. Their filter coffee was a solid finish—strong and satisfying. The garlic bread and pizzas may not be the focus here, but their traditional items truly shine.

The place is moderately priced, accepts both cash and UPI, and the service is quick with friendly staff, even during busy hours. It does get crowded, especially during peak times, but the fast turnaround keeps things moving.

Overall, it’s an iconic vegetarian spot in Basavanagudi, perfect for a quick bite or a wholesome meal. With hygienic food, generous thalis, and consistent quality, it’s definitely a place you’ll want to revisit and recommend.

Another favorite haunt of mine in Basavanagudi. I have been coming here since my school days and nothing much has changed from how all their dishes taste. I prefer this to other iconic legends in the area since you have faint chance of finding parking. Food wise must try is kharabath & vade drowned in lip smacking liquid chutney. This is to die for. Everything else also is awesome. It recently got a face lift (2026) and I realised haven't written about them. So do your taste buds a favor & enjoy the chutney with everything, even coffee 😉 also they have a seating restaurant just opposite, but I prefer the good old corner in used to.

If you are planning to go on a walk through Malleswaram, Tipu Sultan’s Summer Palace or Bangalore Fort, this is the place to get brunch at with all your fellow walkers.
A masala dosa and coffee costs Rs.100 but it’s the conversations and experience that will be worth a lot more!

Definitely OVERHYPED. Absolutely WORTHLESS. ANY Udupi hotel will have much much much better quality than this.

Basically these hotels have reached a stage where it doesn't matter. They are too famous and people will come anyway for trying.

I took masala dosa, poori, shavige, khara bath and idly.

Masala dosa -- it was roasted well but it was tooo thick. It was as if I was biting a blanket. Attached photo.

Sambar -- orange colored water. It was soooo thin.
Poori , khara bath, idly -- avg.

Actually opposite this is the fast food SLV corner, the Google lip shows only the seating restaurant of SLV. I visited the fast food corner and the food is good. We had kara bath, idly dip, masala dosa, shavige and filter coffee.
It’s crowded but the service is very quick.

name: Thom’s Bakery
review_texts:
Tried out this classic Bangalore spot and it definitely lives up to the hype!
The atmosphere is simple, old-school, and gives that nostalgic bakery vibe.
Prices are super affordable, which makes it even better for quick bites.
The highlight for me was the puffs – absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor 🤤
Overall, a great place if you’re craving tasty snacks without spending much. Definitely worth a visit!

I had egg puff delivered to me to Bristol.

This was an excellent treat for my taste buds.

The pastry was light, the egg was perfect and the spices immaculate.

For a snack this is the best addition to your day.

If you are passing through or know someone who can bring it to the UK for you, I would highly recommend.

Recently, we visited Thom’s Bakery after hearing Virat Kohli mention it in an interview—he specifically recommended their egg puffs, so we had to try it!

We reached around 6:30 PM, but unfortunately, there were no puffs left—no egg puffs, no veg puffs. Only pastries were available at that time. So we ordered a Almond Croissant (absolutely loved it—must try!) and a Chocolate Muffin (really good too).

They also have a variety of snacks and biscuits—we picked up some butter biscuits, plain tea cake, and cornflakes mixture.

The price is a little on the higher side, but the taste definitely makes up for it. Next time, we’re planning to go earlier and finally grab those egg puffs 😌😂

Thoms Bakery is a great spot for fresh pastries, cakes, and snacks. The quality is consistently good and prices are reasonable. A reliable place to grab a quick bite or pick up baked treats in Bangalore.

It's my personal review, the OG puffs were only fresh and same as ayyangar bekary. Can try one time

If you stay far from place and for a puffs u should not come but taste was good

Cup care i tried was not good and not  worth for the money

I recommend you to try veg roll bur it's looks like subway burgers was so good if it's heated totally worth to try ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Service is very bad and billing for few items takes more time.

Not a non vegetarian so can't comment on those

name: The Reservoire Koramangala
review_texts:
- Visited for a team lunch; 1st and 3rd floors open, 2nd floor closed during our visit.

- Best ambience: 1st floor, followed by 2nd (from what we could see).

- 3rd floor (rooftop) felt average — furniture and vibe don’t match the charm of the lower floors.

- Tried a variety of dishes; overall food quality is good.

- Chicken in coconut was the only miss — expected something unique, but it was just okay.

- Staff is friendly, attentive, and quick.

- If you’re a foodie, this place is definitely worth visiting.

Met an old friend here for drinks and dinner, and while the place had a few positives, the overall experience was fairly average.

Pros:

1. The staff were courteous, polite, and helpful throughout our visit.
2. The ambience had a rustic charm with an old-school sports pub vibe. The place was also clean and well maintained.
3. The restaurant is spread across three floors with ample seating space suitable for groups of all sizes.
4. We didn’t have to wait for a table, which was a plus.

Cons:

1. The elevator was extremely slow and quite small — it could barely accommodate three adults comfortably.
2. Service was disappointingly slow. We waited nearly 30 minutes for the beer tasters, only to find that many of the craft beers were unavailable. Also, they don’t brew their own beers and instead source them from Toit.
3. The food was average overall and slightly too spicy for our liking.

Visited The Reservoir for the first time after loving the Indiranagar branch for a long time, and this branch also impressed us with the food, ambience, and service.

The peri-peri french fries were really good — crispy, well-seasoned, and served in a good quantity.

We also tried the veg Thai baos. The flavors were excellent with a nice balance of tanginess and crunch, but the stuffing was a little too oily. Apart from that, the taste was really good and I would definitely order it again, probably requesting less oil next time.

The Thai green curry with jasmine rice was easily the highlight for me, just like in the Indiranagar branch. The curry had a rich coconut flavor, the vegetables were cooked perfectly, and the portion size was very satisfying.

The ambience was cosy and pleasant, though the music felt slightly loud. Service was quick and friendly, and the pricing is actually very reasonable for the quality and ambience they offer.

Overall, a really good experience and definitely a place we would visit again.

Love the ambience of this bar and price of foods. My friends group came just to eat and foods are affordable and tasty.
Here you will get different variety of foods as one of my friend wants to eat rice and butter chicken and other want to eat sushi and here we got everything we want to eat.

Had a great time at The Reservoire with my friends. We started with the Buffalo Wings, which were packed with flavor and perfectly cooked. For drinks, we tried the Jameson Irish Whisky and the Dalmore 12 Years — both were smooth and went really well with the food.
For the main course, we had the Chicken Tikka Pizza, and honestly, it stood out. The pizza had that old-school style and taste, which made it even better. Fresh, flavorful, and properly done without trying too hard to be fancy.
The service was outstanding throughout the evening. The staff were attentive, quick, and friendly without being annoying. The open rooftop ambience with the dim golden lights created a really relaxed vibe, perfect for hanging out with friends. Great food, great drinks, and a really good atmosphere overall. Definitely worth visiting again.

name: Neemsi Restaurant | JP Nagar
review_texts:
Lunch here was a great experience. The servers, especially Mr. Venkatesh and Ms. Sambun, were super patient and helped us pick dishes based on what we like. They even made sure we were comfy with extra cushions on our seats. Food arrived in under 10 minutes and every dish was plated really well. Place is bit crowded so suggest you to pre-book your seats to reduce delay in getting seated.
Service + food + comfort all nailed.
Definitely coming back to try more!

The ambience is warm and welcoming, with friendly staff and quick service. Flavors lean toward the spicier side, and the mocktails are refreshing. The Mysore Pak cheesecake is the highlight — definitely worth trying.
It’s a pleasant spot for dinner with friends and family, but the restaurant feels a bit hyped. Despite its promise of redefining vegetarian food, the experience didn’t meet my expectations. Some dishes lacked seasoning: the watermelon feta salad and spinach cream soup were bland, while the lotus stem crisp was overly spicy

We visited for the lunch.
Nice ambience, great food with a warm welcome and behaviour from the staff.
The best thing is the presentation of the food. I want to mention the names who had served our table. Phyrnai was very polite and with patient behaviour to all the customers. Indra and other staff members were also very attentive. Valet service was very helpful when it rained heavily suddenly. The sweet gesture concludes with the magnetic sticker as a souvenir of the restaurant.
All the best 🙏🏼

Came here for a spontaneous quick dinner and it turned out to be one of the best dinner experiences. The service here is impeccable, Mr. Vekatesh and Ms.Firnayi were so prompt and kind. Every little thing about this place makes you feel satisfied, from the "Green Apple" welcome drink to the very last "Pan Tart" as a mouth freshener. The food is pretty good too. It was our second visit and hopefully we keep coming back again and again! Cheers! 🙌🏻

Neemsi stood out for the experimental veg cuisine, its service quality and taste of each item. We had a great time with family and enjoyed some of the highly recommended items on the menu like Avocado papdi chaat, crispy lotus stem, special paneer tikka, air bread with paneer and chilli caviar etc. However the potion size was less, best suited for less than 4 people. I really liked the Mysore pak cheese cake - a must try. Weekends could get really crowded and pre-booking is not allowed so try to visit early or waiting time can be upto 30 -40 min.

name: Long Boat Brewing Co.
review_texts: An evening well spent with the family. The staff were very polite and received us well. Had a table just next to the waterfall which made the experience even better. Sohel and kiran took care of us very well, gave great suggestions on the food options. We had ordered almost every vegetarian starter on the menu. And believe me nothing went wrong. Every thing tasted great. The rayalaseema paneer biriyani on the other side is next level. Desserts as well tasted great and the portions were huge.

Excellent day out on the occasion of Mother's Day. I visited with my family for lunch and thoroughly enjoyed the food, brews and efficient service.

They had closed off the prime waterfall adjacent seats on the ground floor as they arranged the buffet in that section. This felt like a downer initally but we checked out the first floor and luckily could sit at booth section which was great for my 10 month old daughter as she had sufficient space to play. The waterfall view from here is good as well and water sound is soothing. We also felt that this section was better temperature controlled than the first floor indoor seating which felt quite congested in comparison.

All the food items were standard pub fare but were great in quality and flavour. They had Mango Hefeweizen as a seasonal brew which was quite refreshing and 100% recommended when available. They do have high chairs for babies although we did not take as my daughter was more comfortable on the booth seating. Valet parking is available.

Special word to the staff, they were quite efficient and even took special requests readily. Overall no fuss, that's what you want from a relaxed family lunch. Would highly recommend this place, they get all things right.

The place is a little loud. The place has an overall nice scenery with a waterfall view in middle. The place is pet friendly. The food definitely requires improvement. Certain dishes did not taste nice. Staff and service provided is good. Seating area is optimum. Overall, a good place to go, but will not recommend if particularly going for food tasting.

We visited this place on a weekend for lunch, ambiance is good it's more beautiful with pleasant wheather we went on a sunny day. Seating with waterfall side was good for evenings.. pre-booking is required on weekends. Service was super fast.. After placing the order we got everything real quick except the pizza which we ordered last...
Food was good, didnot like the paneer starter.

⭐⭐⭐⭐Great Ambience, Craft Beers & Perfect Instagram-Worthy Vibes!

Recently visited Long Boat Brewery, Marathahalli, and honestly, I didn’t expect it to turn out this good. The ambience was absolutely fantastic with a vibrant yet comfortable atmosphere that instantly sets the mood for a great evening.

One pleasant surprise was the presence of a dedicated dance floor, which added a lively touch to the overall experience. I visited with my parents, and even they thoroughly enjoyed the ambience, music, and overall vibe of the place — which says a lot!

The brewery offers an impressive variety of craft beers with plenty of options to explore. Their beverage menu is equally extensive, featuring a good mix of cocktails and mocktails. The starters menu also had a wide range of choices, making it easy to find something for everyone.

Another major plus was the ample parking space available, which is always a bonus in Bengaluru.

Special mention to Mr. Pooran, our steward for the evening. He was incredibly courteous, attentive, and always had a warm smile on his face. His hospitality genuinely enhanced our experience. A big shout-out to him for his excellent service!

One area that needs improvement: While the starters and drinks were enjoyable, the main course was quite disappointing. The dishes lacked flavour and felt very bland compared to the otherwise excellent experience.

Overall, despite the main course not living up to expectations, everything else was wonderful. If you’re someone who loves beautiful ambience, good drinks, great service, and Instagram-worthy spots, Long Boat Brewery is definitely worth a visit.

name: Anand Sweets - Sarjapur
review_texts:
If you’re craving authentic Delhi-style chaats, Anand Sweets is a great place to check out. They have a wide variety of sweets and desserts on display, but this time I decided to focus only on their chaat section.
I’ve visited this place twice now, and based on my experience, I’d rate it 4/5 ⭐
I’ve tried their Pani Puri, Masala Puri, Dahi Puri, Papdi Chaat, and Kachori Chaat – and overall, the food is really good. The flavors are well-balanced, fresh, and satisfying. Perfect spot when you’re in the mood for some proper North Indian chaat.
It’s a self-service setup, so you need to place your order and collect it yourself, which is pretty smooth and organized.
A big plus is that they provide valet parking, which makes it convenient, especially during busy hours.
Definitely worth visiting if you love chaat and don’t mind self-service!

Here sweets honestly don’t need any review. They are made with very pure ingredients and the taste is always top notch. Absolutely amazing. I personally like Kaju Mysore Pak the most.

The outlet is clean, hygienic, and well maintained.

Snacks are also really good. When I visited, Sonu, Mithilesh, and Rakesh made me feel genuinely welcomed. They served everything with a lot of warmth and made sure I tried everything properly. Really nice people.

Ghanshyam at the sweets counter is also a very nice guy.

Overall, a great place for quality sweets and snacks.

We recently decided to try sweets in Bengaluru and chose Anand Sweets, Sarjapur for our first experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be quite disappointing.

Before purchasing, I wanted to taste a Gulab Jamun, which is a fairly common practice in many sweet shops. I politely requested the counter staff if I could try one piece before buying. Even after clearly stating that I was willing to pay for the sample, the request was repeatedly declined without any explanation. It wasn't about getting something for free—it was about understanding the quality before making a purchase.

The interaction itself left a poor impression. Customer service is not just about selling products; it's about helping customers make informed choices. The way the request was handled felt dismissive and unwelcoming.

Because of this experience, I decided to reduce my purchase and bought only half a kilogram instead of the larger quantity I had originally planned. Unfortunately, after reaching home and trying the Gulab Jamun, the product did not meet expectations either. The texture, taste, and overall quality were far below what I would expect from a premium sweet brand. In fact, it was among the least enjoyable Gulab Jamuns I have had in recent years.

One thing Anand Sweets does exceptionally well is presentation. The packaging is attractive, premium-looking, and well-designed. However, good packaging can only create a first impression; ultimately, it is the quality of the sweets that customers remember.

My honest takeaway from this visit is that the brand appears to invest heavily in presentation and packaging, but the product quality and customer experience did not justify the reputation or premium pricing.

For people who genuinely love traditional Indian sweets and prioritize taste, this outlet may not meet expectations. And for those considering gifting sweets, while the packaging looks impressive, the quality of the sweets inside should be the deciding factor.

Had sweets here and experience was really good.
Ordered mango based sweets which were really flavourful.
A must try dishes guys.

My experience at Anand Sweets was nothing short of amazing. Mr Mishra, store manager was very helpful. He was very helpful and nice to give us options for gift options for a family gathering.

We loved the boxes suggested by him and he was open to feedback. Their new menu items which include the ones in the image are a must try. I personally loved the Chilli paneer sub, chatpata paneer multigrain roll. It was both healthy, and flavourful at the same time. Thanks, Anand sweets and team!!

name: The Filter Coffee - Kalyan Nagar
review_texts:
This place was never on my wish list, and I randomly dined in for dinner and I must say, it’s worth a visit to this eatery for the Tamil Nadu cuisine and the quality of the food.

The plain dosai combo with an idli along with a mini filter coffee was an excellent choice. The dosai was crispy, thin and the oil used was very minimal. The white chutney wasn’t my thing at first but became an acquired taste eventually. The filter coffee is smooth and was a perfect way to end the meal.

One of the best breakfast places in Kalyan Nagar. Their breakfast menu is available till 12:15pm. TFC has great mini idlis and their medu vadas are too crispy. Great variety of coffees too. Definitely recommend trying TFC

Had an awesome experience at The filter coffee! 🤩
The dosa was perfectly crispy on the outside and soft inside, with delicious chutneys and flavorful sambar. Every bite was fresh and satisfying. The cafe has a nice, cozy atmosphere and the staff were very friendly and quick with the service.
If you love South Indian food, this place is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended for tasty dosa and great service! 🥞✨

I had high hopes for Filter Coffee, but the food fell short. The kurma served with the idiyappam lacked any real taste, and the Gobi Uraval was completely bland. On a positive note, the dosa and chutney were decent, but the rest of the meal was very disappointing.

Worst food seriously worst. Is other reviews are really genuine because 1000 reviews cost 2000 rupees from the review companies 😄.
For this 1 idly , 1 poori 1 hour waiting.
No one taking order ,no one gives menu . We need rise hand for menu , food that we ordered. 1 items one idli comes first after 15 minutes 1 puri next get out 😀

name: Bengaluru Cafe
review_texts:
If you like your dosa the right amount of crispy and buttery, Bengaluru Cafe is the place to be. At just 80/- you’ll get the best best Butter Masala Dosa served with a chutney that is nostalgia in it’s core.

As a Bengali girl, who has only eaten dosa outside the South, Bengaluru Dosa is officially one of the dosa places I will be coming back to.

Note: This is an open canteen/cafe with no proper seating benches except one on the side (maximum capacity 5). However, they have standing areas to eat and a long long line, so make sure you’re here for the wait as much as you are for the great food and hype :)

If you’re looking for authentic Bengaluru-style South Indian food, Bengaluru Cafe is a must-visit! The ambience is clean, modern, and welcoming, with quick self-service and a lively atmosphere. The food was fresh, flavorful, and served hot. The ghee-soaked dish paired with the rich chutney and the delicious khara bath made for an unforgettable meal. Every bite tasted authentic and comforting. The staff was efficient, the place was well-maintained, and despite being busy, the service was fast. A perfect spot for breakfast or an evening snack. Highly recommended for anyone who loves traditional Karnataka flavors. Looking forward to visiting again!

It is a good place for a quick breakfast. There is no seating, so it is mainly an eat-and-go place. We tried the Masala Dose and Masala Vada, and both were very tasty and authentic. It is a great place for South Indian breakfast. Idli is served without sambar, but the chutney is delicious. Worth a visit for tasty South Indian food.

Overall the taste of the food is good. The dosas are crisp and nice, but nothing unique or different about their dosas, they are good in terms of bangalore standards. Waiting time is a lot, and ordering is also a menace. Too many people on weekends. But overall a nice experience and the food was good. No place to sit though, so not for old people.

went there for breakfast after cycling. i had benne dose and idli with filter coffee. the dose was so crunchy and juicy. idli was soft. it was delicious. i still have the essence of that place with me. must try if in bangalore

name: To Be Continued Sky Lounge TBC
review_texts: This place has a fantastic atmosphere and delicious food. The staff is incredibly friendly, and the service is quick. We visited with a group of friends during the IPL matches, which was a lot of fun because they have a huge projector screen. It was awesome being able to watch the live match while enjoying our food and drinks. It’s the perfect spot for sports fans to hang out!

I recently visited To Be Continued (TBC) Sky Lounge in HSR Layout and it was an amazing experience. The rooftop ambience and overall vibe of the place are fantastic, making it one of the best spots in the area to relax with friends. The open terrace seating gives a great city view, especially in the evening when the lights and music create a lively atmosphere. The DJ music keeps the energy high and the crowd here is always fun and vibrant. The food and drinks menu has a good variety, and everything we tried tasted really good. The staff were friendly and the service was smooth despite the place being busy. It’s the perfect place for weekend hangouts, parties, or even a casual evening with friends. If you’re in HSR Layout and looking for great music, rooftop vibes, and a fun nightlife experience, TBC is definitely a must-visit.

Amazing Food and Great Vibes at TBC Sky Lounge! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
​If you are looking for a place with great food 🍔🍹 and a fantastic ambiance ✨ in HSR Layout, TBC Sky Lounge is the place to be! The food taste and quality here are absolutely top-notch 💯. The overall vibe and atmosphere of the place are very, very nice—perfect for hanging out with friends or family 🌆🎶.
