​An amazing highlight is their offer: if you book a room at the hotel (Astra) 🏨, you get a massive 30% discount on your food and overall bill 💰✨, which is a really great deal! Even if you choose to dine in your room, their room service is excellent and delivers everything hot and fresh 🛏️🛎️. Highly recommended! 👌🔥

I recently visited this place in HSR and overall it was a really good experience. The ambience is very nice, peaceful, and well maintained. It feels comfortable the moment you walk in and does not feel too loud or rushed, which I personally liked.

The people working here are genuinely good and polite. I was served by Krishna and Reema, and they did a wonderful job. They were attentive, respectful, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our time there. Their service definitely made the experience better.

There was one incident where I was served chicken even though I am a pure vegetarian. I noticed it immediately and did not eat it. Yes, it was a mistake, but I am not reviewing them negatively for that. As humans, we all make mistakes sometimes. We never know what someone might be dealing with on a given day, and these things can happen. What matters is how the rest of the experience is, and that was mostly positive.

Coming to the food, they actually have very good vegetarian options. The vegetarian food we tried was tasty and well prepared. One honest feedback would be about the paneer ghee roast. I personally did not like it much as it felt very plain and the only thing noticeable was excess ghee without much flavour. Apart from that, the other vegetarian dishes were enjoyable.

They also have a separate smoking zone, which is thoughtfully planned and does not disturb others. We visited with a small kid, and the place felt quite kid friendly. It was not overly crowded, which made it comfortable for families as well.

Parking is also not a problem since you can find space nearby on the road, which is convenient.

Overall, it is a nice place with good ambience, kind people, and decent food options. I would definitely consider visiting again. That is why I am giving it 4 out of 5 stars.
The atmosphere is really nice, went for office team dinner, reasonable and tasty food no doubt. The service is really good, recommended

name: Gilly’s 104 Bar
review_texts: Dance floor and pubs are there.  Food is just mediocre. Varieties of alcohols, liquor, wines, breezers and soft drinks are available. Smoking is also allowed. Nice party vibe, especially on weekend days. Happy hours are also there. Entry fees will be charged. The only disadvantage was, they have a very very stupid and irritating set of music with very foolish and unnecessary remixes.  Everything else seems fine.

Taking about the vibe and music is just not that vibey. Useless remixes and ruined the songs. It was severely overcrowded.

Don'ts:
Do not order alcohol they charge 10 times more.
For starters creamy cheese mushroom highly recommended and red thai curry in mains.
Had ordered pineapple cherry cheese stick it was so horrible and stale. Inedible. So overall food is pricey not worth the vibe.

Ps: It took them 40 minutes just to bring the bill.
Never going to visit this crap. Drunken Daddy is way way better.

Great atmosphere. Food is good. Service can (and should) be way better. We went on a Monday and the music was good (albeit too many repeats and rain interrupted the performance but resumed quickly). No power backup is a huge L.

One of the best hangout place in Koramangala.This place has a  good ambience, the food served is amazing and special mention is Jalapeno poppers.I would say it was decent crowd. But the place is over crowded during peak hours. There is almost no place in the dance floor and once you get up from your table, we need to wait to get a new table if you we want to return back from dance floor. If the bar can have some restriction in the total number of people entering during peak hours might improve the experience.

This bar has good ambience, the food served is yum, a decent crowd. But the place is over crowded during peak hours. There is almost no place in the dance floor and once you get up from your table, we need to wait to get a new table if you we want to return back from dance floor. If the bar can have some restriction in the total number of people entering during peak hours might improve the experience.

name: Hotel Nalapaka
review_texts:
I have known this place for years, and the menu has not changed at all - which is a good thing. It’s one of the best spots for North Karnataka cuisine. Breakfast is served from 7:30 am to 12 pm. In the afternoon they only serve the meals.

Wait times are usually 30-60 minutes, and they don’t take reservations. You just give your name and wait until they call you. The food quality is excellent and I love the hot jola rotis. Service can be a bit slow when it is crowded, but it’s worth the wait. Weekends get very busy.

Had an amazing experience at Hotel Nalapaka!
The Jolada Roti Oota was absolutely authentic and full of flavor. Every item on the banana leaf felt homemade and perfectly balanced — from the spicy curries to the chutneys and sides. The jolada roti was soft, fresh, and tasted incredible with the ennegai.

Simple food, rich taste, and true North Karnataka vibes. A must-visit place for anyone craving traditional oota!
One of the finest places to have joladh Rotti Meals in bengaluru. Been coming to this place for more than 10 years now and the taste remains the same. Paddu and Girmit here is also good.

I used to love nalapaka before but when I recently visited noticed a decline in food quality. The jolad rotis were too big and thick. The chutney was a bit gone by dinner time and though the place was empty, the wait for roti serve was a bit longer. Also a makeover with more clean sofas would be great.
Good option for North Karnataka food especially jolada rotti oota.

name: Desi Masala
review_texts:
When called restaurant they said reservation is not required, however we got the table in 5-10 mins.

Ambience is just average, there rest room was not clean. When asked that said maintenance going on.

There are varieties of items available and all veg items. But when it comes to taste, it’s completely bad. We all felt taste and quality both are worst except harabara kabab.

About service, one of the worst service we ever had. First the table we sat was full shaking, so asked them to fix it but no proper response to it. I have added that video as well.
Next refilling was very very slow, when asked the manager he bluntly said I’m the only one who is managing and you should understand. Come on, if he can not manage then what else can he do!!?
We also asked then for Masala Dosa as per there menu, even after 5 follow ups and wasted 40 mins they did not turn up with item we asked.

I strongly recommend not to go here and waste your time and have bad experiences

We visited this restaurant for lunch on a weekday expecting a relaxed dining experience, but unfortunately the service turned out to be quite disappointing. Although we were informed over the phone that reservations were not required, we still had to wait around 5–10 minutes to get a table after arriving. That part was manageable.

The biggest issue during our visit was the extremely slow service. Several food items at the buffet counters were left empty for long periods and were only refilled after repeatedly informing the staff. We even had to wait over 15 minutes just to get rotis, which became frustrating after a point. The serving staff did not appear very attentive, and the coordination overall seemed lacking.

That said, one person who truly stood out was the manager, an elderly gentleman who handled the situation with sincerity and professionalism. He personally monitored the counters, checked on guests, and genuinely tried his best to ensure food was refilled quickly. His attitude and effort were definitely appreciated and probably the most positive part of the experience.

The ambience of the restaurant was average overall. While the dining area was decent, the restrooms were not maintained properly during our visit. When this was brought up, the staff mentioned that maintenance work was ongoing.

The restaurant offers a large variety of vegetarian dishes, which initially creates a good impression. However, when it comes to taste, most of the food felt quite mediocre and did not really justify the pricing. Nothing tasted particularly bad, but very few dishes stood out enough to be memorable.

Overall, the place has potential because of its wide menu and courteous manager, but the slow service, average food quality, and lack of proper management made the experience underwhelming.

We visited for lunch on a weekday, and the service was extremely slow. The food items were refilled only after repeatedly informing the staff. We had to wait more than 15 minutes just for rotis, which was quite frustrating. The serving staff seemed careless and not very attentive.

However, the manager (an elderly gentleman) was very kind and responsible. He personally checked on the food counters and genuinely tried his best to refill the items as quickly as possible. We really appreciated his effort.

The food quality was average for the price we paid it was just okay. There is no proper table reservation system. You have to make the payment at the entrance and then find a table on your own, which was inconvenient.

Overall, the experience could have been much better with improved service and better table management.

Exceptional Main Course: The Paneer Tikka, Paneer Gravy, and Gobi Manchurian were standout dishes, alongside a well-prepared Veg Fried Rice.

​Dynamic Open Kitchen: The open kitchen concept added a great visual element, allowing guests to watch the fresh preparation of dishes as they were being replenished.

​Attentive Service: The staff was proactive, particularly the server ensuring a constant supply of hot, fresh Naan at the table.
​Generous Add-ons: The menu included great "extras" like unlimited vanilla ice cream, Jaljeera, and a hearty, thick soup.
​Student-Friendly Pricing: A significant perk was the 15% student discount, making it a budget-friendly option for those with a valid ID.

​Dessert Inconsistencies: The experience was slightly let down by the sweets; the Gulab Jamun was served cold and the Halwa lacked sufficient sweetness.

​Crowded Atmosphere: Visiting around 7:00 PM resulted in a heavy rush, highlighting a lack of adequate seating and a cramped environment.

​Ventilation Issues: The layout is somewhat flawed, as most seats do not receive direct AC airflow, which can get uncomfortable during peak hours.

This is a place that punches beyond its limits for the price provided per person. The variety is pretty big and the taste rest assured, is also surprisingly very good. Overall, the ambience is pretty good given that it caters to a large number of visitors at once. The manager, Mr Prashanth was also quite courteous, accommodating and a friendly person who helped us get hot batch of food. I would definitely visit once more.

name: House of Commons
review_texts:
House of Commons is a lively resto-bar known for its affordable drinks, diverse food menu, and vibrant nightlife. Located on Jyothi Nivas Road, it offers North Indian, Chinese, Italian, and Continental dishes.

Popular for DJ nights and group hangouts, it provides a casual ambiance with music, making it a favorite spot for parties and social gatherings.

A very nice place with good food and surprisingly fast service. The taste is really good, and overall the experience was pleasant. It does get a little crowded, but the service team still manages things well.

Beer is reasonably priced and tastes good, which is a big plus. Definitely worth visiting if you’re looking for a spot with good vibes, tasty food, and quick service.

Absolutely disappointing experience. The pizza was a major letdown—the base felt like a roadside-style one and was clearly undercooked (as shown in the image). The texture was doughy and unpleasant, making it hard to enjoy even a few bites.

The onion rings were equally bad—extremely hard, almost like biting into coconut. Definitely not fresh or properly cooked.

Overall, the quality did not justify the price at all. Would not recommend this place.

Worst customer service experience ever. We arrived at House of Commons, Koramangala at 8:50 PM and placed our order. It took an unacceptable 35 minutes just for the KF Ultra Max / Premium to arrive at our table. To make matters worse, when I requested a replacement for the Hoegaarden, the staff flatly refused and said they couldn’t replace it. Extremely slow service, rigid staff, and zero care for the customer. Absolutely ruined our night. Avoid this place if you value good service. (Attaching screenshots of our order #FF39 and table setup).

Dropped down here for dinner. Firstly loved the hospitality shown by the manager Mr. Hrushikesh & the waiter was equally courteous.

The ambience is rustic, cool & relaxing yet crowded with people. An exquisite bar and restaurant with good food, drinks & exemplary service.

Vegetarians can get some good options here. Quantity and quality of food is high. Worth a visit.

Absolutely a cool hangout place.....Definitely going back here. So pull up your socks & head over to this place to hang out with a bunch of friends.

name: Red Rhino - Craft Brewery and Inspired Kitchen
review_texts:
We celebrated my son’s birthday with a lunch at Red Rhino on Hoskote Road, and it turned out to be such a wonderful experience from start to finish.

The location is easy to get to and has a really nice vibe—spacious, clean, and thoughtfully designed. The ambience strikes a great balance between lively and relaxed, which made it perfect for a family celebration. It felt special without being overwhelming.

Coming to the food—everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. There was something for everyone, and each dish lived up to expectations. You can tell they put effort into both taste and quality.

What truly stood out was the service. The staff were warm, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout. They were especially kind and accommodating considering it was a birthday celebration, which made the experience even more memorable.

Overall, Red Rhino is a fantastic choice for a family outing or special occasion. Great food, inviting ambience, convenient location, and excellent service—we couldn’t have asked for more. Highly recommended!

Visited Red Rhino recently. This place has a good vibe and ambience, especially for an evening outing with friends or family. Tried a few non-veg dishes like Chicken Malai Kebab, Mutton Seekh Kebab and Peri Peri Chicken — they were decent and nicely presented, though taste-wise nothing really stood out much. Overall food was okay.

The highlight of the meal was definitely the Tiramisu dessert — very well balanced, soft and flavorful. Probably the best thing we tried there. Service was fine and the overall experience was average to good.

This place turned out to be a cracking find for a relaxed lunch with a bit of flair. We chose an outside table, which made the whole experience feel breezy and laid-back, with just the right amount of buzz around. It’s the kind of spot where you can enjoy a long conversation, catch a match on the screens, or simply soak in the lively atmosphere.

The food and drinks were a real highlight. We tried hummus with pita, alio olio, tiramisu, and a couple of mocktails - guava mary and passion fruit - and everything arrived beautifully presented and packed with flavour. Nothing felt rushed or careless; there’s real attention to what comes out of the kitchen.

What truly lifted the experience was the staff - warm, attentive, and genuinely keen to make sure we were having a good time. The menu covers a wide mix of cuisines, so there’s something for everyone.

One smart tip: pre-book through apps like Zomato - you can get discounts up to 40%, which makes the experience even sweeter.

Yes, it’s slightly premium on portions, but the quality, ambience, and service make it well worth it. A top spot in Whitefield for a relaxed meal or a casual celebration. 🍹🍝
Everything we ordered was great. Chicken curry leaf tikka was awesome. The staff is super sweet and their recommendations were on point!

This place has ambience in 90s theme. It looks very great. We went there in an afternoon. It was fairly crowded and lively even at almost closing time. I have had some of the best jhol momos here. We also tried their Nalli Nihari, prawns and red sauce pasta. All of them were delicious. We also tried their beers and we loved it. I would come here again and again to have their jhol momos and try other foods. Highly recommended. Must visit.

name: Savoury Family Restaurant
review_texts:
Absolute Perfection!

Visited Savoury Restaurant in Frazer Town yesterday and the food was absolute top-notch! Everything from the rich flavors to the quality of the meat was spot on. Easily one of the best dining experiences I've had in the area recently. If you are looking for authentic, delicious food that never disappoints, this is the place to be. Highly recommended!

Visited Savoury Family Restaurant with my family and had a wonderful experience. We ordered the Chicken Mandi Family Pack and Haleem, and both were delicious. The mandi rice was flavorful, aromatic, and served with generous portions of well-grilled chicken. The chicken was juicy, perfectly cooked, and complemented the rice beautifully.
The Haleem was rich, smooth, and packed with flavor. Portion sizes were generous and ideal for sharing with family. The restaurant was clean, family-friendly, and the service was quick and attentive.
The overall quality of food, quantity, and taste made the meal worth the price. A great place for family gatherings and anyone looking for authentic Arabic-style mandi in Bangalore

Had dinner here on Sunday and the experience was excellent. I ordered Chicken butter masala with Naan, along with Grilled Chicken. The food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The butter chicken had a rich, creamy texture, the naan was soft and served hot, and the grilled chicken was juicy and well-marinated. Service was prompt, staff were courteous, and the overall ambience made the dining experience very enjoyable. Definitely worth visiting again. Highly recommended...

We revisited Savory Restaurant in Fraser Town (Mosque Road) with a lot of old memories because the food used to be amazing. We ordered porotta, Al Faham, and biryani—and the food is still very good and full of flavour.

That said, the place itself feels quite run down now. The dining hall, chairs, and overall ambience could really use an upgrade. The lack of crowd also makes it feel less inviting, and visually, it’s not a place you’d be excited to dine in anymore.

However, if you’re ordering in, this is still a great option—the food quality definitely holds up. Hoping they spruce up the space to match how good the food still is.

I visited during Ramadan, and the atmosphere felt completely different in the best way. There were more people outside than inside, creating a lively and vibrant ambiance. The energy in the air, combined with the pleasant aroma of delicious food, made it a truly happening spot—especially after Iftar.

The food tasted great, and the service was equally impressive. While it may seem a bit on the pricier side, the overall experience makes it worth it.

name: Chulha Chauki da Dhaba | Kalyan Nagar
review_texts:
Recently, we visited a dhaba-style restaurant in Kalyan Nagar, near Manyata Tech Park, and the place was amazing! The ambience is great, and the food is absolutely delicious. You get to sit in a traditional Punjabi dhaba-style setup and enjoy your meal, which makes the experience even more special.

Oh my God, the crowd on weekends is huge! But despite being so busy, the service is super fast. The food quality is excellent, and the staff manages everything really well.

I absolutely loved the authentic dhaba vibe, and I’m definitely going to visit again soon! ❤️🍽️✨

One of the oldest restaurants in tye neighborhood, a true dhaba ambience and the dishes are fantastic. The service is quick. Be prepared for a long waiting time during weekends. Overall if you want to eat Authentic dhaba style north Indian cuisine in and around Kalyan nagar this is the best option.

Been there with my colleague for lunch. We reached the location at around 1300hrs (1PM). This is our first visit to this place. Earlier we also went to Jayanagar branch, considering the taste we went to check this restaurant as well. However taste & service wise it was same. The franchise Maintained it here as well. There restaurant is on the 3rd Floor. Lift is available. Space is little smaller when compared to Jayanagar but same Ambience is maintained. It was also has outer seating for 10-15 people.

Pros:
Food is really tasty
Staff is very cooperative & courteous
Parking is available
Ambience is nice
Neatly maintained
Yellow Gang- support staff are really good
Hygiene is maintained

Cons:
Nil as of now

Recommendation/Suggestion:
The turning at the toilet is bit risky since its ledge may lead to nearmiss if anyone miss to see through mirror. One can make a smooth slope to cover the issue.

Overall its a must visit restaurant.

Had an incredible experience here today! The food was fresh and flavorful—you can tell they use high-quality ingredients. I highly recommend the [Insert Dish Name], it was the highlight of the meal. Beyond the food, the service was top-notch; our server was attentive without being overbearing and made us feel right at home. 10/10 would recommend!"

Absolutely loved my experience at Chulha Chauki Da Dhaba! The food tasted authentic, fresh, and full of rich desi flavors. From the warm hospitality to the cozy dhaba-style vibe, everything felt perfect. The portions were generous, service was quick, and every dish had that true homemade North Indian touch. A must-visit spot for anyone craving delicious comfort food!

name: By 2 Coffee-Bhojana Shale
review_texts:
Excellent homely festival food, Jain friendly. They serve amazing full meals on banana leaf and it feels light on stomach and pocket friendly too. One meal is priced 180/- Only.

PS- I would prefer early visit at 12:30 or 1PM rather 3:30PM since the food served might be lil cold..

Their food is very appetizing ! High quality food. But the wait time is too long, it is crowded everytime. Especially their idly is soft, chutney mildly spicy and vada is crunchy. The only drawback is the eating space, scaling it up would surely be amazing.

Worst by 2 coffee branch i have visited no proper hygiene serving sugar near coffee with single spoon with previously left over coffee in the same spoon used to stir coffee which is unhygienic standard ntg provision is there to stir the coffee , well comes to food vada previously serving best size with proper price now mini vada which they prepare in home serving for 30rs which is fully cold ,no crisp NTG , asking manager what kind of vada is this ,his irresponsible answer and attitude was it comes like that we can't do anything go go careless behaviour, also careless owner who is looking after the branch .this careless because buisness is growing well over there so no worries on customer.there wealth should be only fulfilled as shows there gunda Manager  .

Posted pic .
Unhygienic manner.
One of the best places to have masala dosa and cofee. Always busy but the line moves fast.

Disappointing Dining Experience

This place doesn't feel like a proper restaurant—it’s more of a temporary setup, like a small function hall. The rooftop has been converted into a dining space, but it lacks ambiance and feels makeshift.

The service was rushed and impersonal, resembling a typical wedding food line. Staff hurriedly placed the banana leaf and began serving, without courtesy or attention. A meal priced at ₹180 doesn’t even include a water bottle—when requested, they insisted on payment first, in a rude manner.

There were no tissue papers to wipe the leaf, and the variety of dishes was minimal. Worse, not all listed items were served unless you kept track and reminded the staff.

The dining setup is a long table with chairs, more like a marriage hall than a restaurant. The staircase leading to the rooftop was narrow and unclean, adding to the discomfort.

Though the food tasted good, the limited variety and poor service do not justify the cost. There are better places in the city offering banana leaf meals with far superior service and value.

name: AYODHYA UPACHAR
review_texts: Ayodhya Upachar Hotel is a self-service restaurant with a ground-plus-two-story construction. Both South Indian cuisine and some North Indian gravies are delicious. There is no designated parking space; only two-wheeler parking is at the owner's risk. I had the Rava Dosa and Masala Dosa, both of which were delicious but really greasy. Due to its proximity to Ring Road, the hotel's interior is always covered in dust. On the first level, they offer a good party hall that can hold up to 150 people.

Pure veg. Lot of options for vegetarians. Taste was good. Lot of parking space.
But I felt bit expensive. One plate idly & vada costed 105₹. Elsewhere it costs 85₹.  Some hotels charge around 100₹, but that will be justified by size of idlies and vada. But here it was not the case here. Sizes were not great.

I have been to Ayodhya Upachaar three to four times. The food quality is very good. All types of food are available there.  South Indian dishes are excellent. The ice creams are also very nice. Compared to other places, the prices are affordable. It’s always crowded with people at all times. If anyone wants to visit this place, they should definitely try it once.
Veg food available, good and quality maintain. Coffee is very good.

Order 219898884370110 dated 20/10/2025.Bill 32.Ordered 2 numbers of two idli one vada combination and four extra vadas additional. But received only four idlis and four vadas.It should be six vadas and four idlis.
I am 83 and my wife is 78. We wanted to celebrate the auspicious deepavali at home with children for breakfast.So we ordered food through Swiggy on Ayodhya Upchar.Paid Rs.50 as gift to the delivery agent on Deepavali day.
Matter reported to Swiggy, chatted with a customer support agent. Solution offered (1).Shall give a coupon to adjust on future orders with in 7 days. (2) Shall credit Rs.120.00 to my account with in 7 to 10 working days. I refused both. Thank you Swiggy and Ayodhya Upchar spoiling my 83rd Deepavali. Blocked Swiggy and Ayodhya Upchar from my family accounts. Keep cheating customers. You will end up where you belong.Goodbye

name: Adyar Ananda Bhavan - A2B
review_texts:
Visited this A2B today (27 May 2026) at 9:00 AM for breakfast. The food quality is honestly very good, and our mushroom dosa, ghee roast, and plain dosa were all delicious
However, the dining experience needs a lot of work. The top floor service area was closed at 09:00 am (only self service was available), and the air conditioning on the ground floor was not working at all.
Worst of all, there were so many flies buzzing around while we ate, so they really need better pest control. While the food is tasty, the restaurant hygiene has a big scope for improvement.

We really hope the management fixes these comfort and cleanliness issues soon.

Adyar Ananda Bhavan (also known as  A2B) is an Indian chain of vegetarian restaurants and confectioners.
It has branches and outlets in United Nations, Singapore, Malaysia.
This Hotel has more than 10000 employees  making a turnover of over Rs. 800 crores.
The food is tasty and the price is little bit higher.
Very good customer service across the table.
Seating arrangement is good and high chairs are available for the kids.
The restroom is maintained neatly.
To celebrate Deepali, many Sweet items in colourful packings, are available.

⭐☆☆☆☆ (1 Star)

I had a very disappointing experience at A2B Adyar Ananda Bhavan.

I ordered a Masala Dosa costing ₹120. Unfortunately, the potato filling (palya) served inside the dosa was in very poor condition. It had a strong unpleasant smell and seemed stale, making it impossible to eat. The odor was so bad that we immediately stopped eating and informed the cashier about the issue.

Instead of addressing the complaint professionally, the cashier showed no concern for customer satisfaction and refused to provide a refund or any reasonable solution. When food quality is clearly compromised, customers should not be expected to pay for something that is unfit to eat.

Food establishments have a responsibility to serve fresh and hygienic food. Serving stale-smelling palya and then refusing to take responsibility when a customer raises a genuine concern is unacceptable.

I hope the management seriously reviews its food quality standards, kitchen hygiene, and customer complaint handling process. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this outlet and will think twice before visiting again.

Food Quality: 1/5
Customer Service: 1/5
Value for Money: 1/5

Very disappointing experience.

Absolutely terrible experience. The food was horrible, bland, poorly prepared, and nowhere near worth the ridiculous prices they charge. They market themselves like a high-end restaurant, but the quality is worse than a cheap roadside place.

Customer service was non-existent. The staff were rude, inattentive, and acted like helping customers was a burden. On top of that, the plates and utensils were visibly dirty, which is completely unacceptable for any restaurant, let alone one charging premium prices.

Overpriced, unhygienic, and badly managed. I genuinely regret wasting my money here and would never recommend this place to anyone.

Service was very poor. Cash counter boy was full of attitude I didn't understand that is giving us free food or what. Behaving rudely.
This is masala dosa there is no masala or it's not even crispy i Paid 130 for this .

name: Richie Rich Ice Creams
review_texts:
If you are looking for a spot that hits the trifecta of fantastic craft beer, delicious food, and top-tier hospitality—all without making your wallet cry—this is the place to be.

Here is why this brewery has officially become my go-to spot:

* The Brews: Smooth, distinct, and perfectly crafted. Whether you are into a crisp, refreshing wheat beer or a bold, flavorful stout, they’ve got something on tap for every palate.

* The Grub: Usually, brewery food is an afterthought, but the kitchen here deserves its own award. Every dish we ordered was fresh, bursting with flavor, and perfectly portioned.

* The Vibe & Service: This is what truly sets them apart. The staff treats you like family from the moment you walk in. The hospitality is warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming without feeling intrusive.

* The Price Point: Honestly, given the premium quality of the food and drinks, the bill was a incredibly pleasant surprise. It’s rare to find high-end execution at such a reasonable, pocket-friendly price.

The Verdict: 10/10. Incredible value for money, an amazing atmosphere, and an all-around stellar experience. I’ll definitely be back (probably next weekend)!
Special mention of Shubham, Shailesh and Santosh for delivering fantastic hospitality.

Best ice cream in Bangalore. This is proven by the always busy shop. Chaats are okay and pulav and other rice items are good.
I am going to this place for over 40 years and the ice cream taste had not changed.

Absolutely not worth the hype and definitely not worth the money. The only good thing is the icre cream. Any other food is absolutely not worth it. Especially the pizza, they're using a pre-made crust that tastes and looks like bread and serve it on a use and throw plate (find pics attached). I don't mind either but they're charging 400+ for the pizza and for the drinks too, they're serving in use and throw paper glasses, which is fine, but then stop charging 100+ for a damn lime soda. Never going back again. If you're going back again and again thinking this place is nice or the food is tasty, you don't know real taste.

Sharing the pic for reference of the sheer size and texture - the ice cream here especially softy is great. Chocolate ice cream waffle cone with chocolate dip is absolutely delicious - it may sound too over the top but it is actually very tasty. Same with khulfi, hot chocolate fudge and other sundae items. Generally known for vanilla flavour but all flavours are good.

Look out for parking coz it is difficult. However, the staff help and guide for parking.
Loved their Elvis Presley Ice Cream, it's simply delicious and a must try! The Tawa pulav was tasty as well. The best part is they provide drive-in service.

name: Kabab Magic
review_texts: In the proper old Bangalore, Basavanagudi. Good vibes. I have had here at least 200 times since my childhood, trusted one and tastes good

As of June 2026,

This remains one of my favourite restaurants.

The Chicken Roll, Shawarma Plate and Grape Juice are the standout items on the menu and are definitely worth trying. Their mayonnaise is unique and has a distinct flavour that sets it apart from what most other restaurants serve.

The restaurant has recently expanded its dining area, offering a more spacious seating arrangement with proper tables and comfortable chairs, making the overall dining experience even better.

The average cost per person is around ₹200–₹300, making it a great value-for-money option.

The only downside is the starters. They often seem either overly oily or excessively dry, which takes away from an otherwise enjoyable meal.

Dined here on a friend’s recommendation. The place was a bit crowded in the afternoon. It’s a self-service restaurant — you place your order on the ground floor and eat on the first floor. The food was served in about 10 minutes. Ordered Tandoori Chicken, Biryani Rice, Rumali Roti, Shawarma Plate, and Special Grape Juice. Everything tasted good — the meat was tender, the rumali roti was soft, and the pulpy grape juice was nicely tangy. The highlight, though, was the Tandoori Chicken — it was really good. Prices were moderate. Overall, my tummy was satisfied!

I tried the crispy burger here, and for around ₹110 it was actually pretty good — crispy, tasty, and worth the price. The place is usually very crowded, which shows that it’s popular, but it can make the experience a bit rushed , the waiting time was about 10-15 mins .One concern was that the shawarma didn’t look very hygienic, so I avoided it. Overall, the burger was great for the price, but the hygiene and crowd management could be improved.

If you are a fan of authentic grilled flavors and non-vegetarian delicacies in Bengaluru, Kabab Magic is a place you simply cannot ignore. I recently visited this outlet, and the experience was quite memorable. The restaurant is famous for its legendary grilled chicken and shawarma, and after tasting them, I can understand why. The meat was perfectly marinated, tender on the inside, and had that signature smoky char on the outside that defines a great kabab.
The menu is quite diverse, offering everything from classic Tandoori items to Chinese starters and flavorful Biryanis. Their Shawarma is definitely one of the highlights—well-stuffed and seasoned perfectly. The service was fairly quick despite the heavy evening rush, which shows they are well-managed. The seating area is decent, though it can get quite crowded during peak hours, especially on weekends.
However, there is one thing to keep in mind: the pricing. Compared to other local joints serving similar food, Kabab Magic is a little expensive. While the quality and hygiene are definitely better than most roadside stalls, you do pay a premium for the brand and the taste. A meal for two can easily add up, making it more of a "treat yourself" spot rather than a budget daily eatery.
Overall, if you don't mind spending a few extra rupees for high-quality, delicious grilled food, this place is a 4-star experience. The taste is consistent, and the food is consistently fresh. It is a great spot to visit with friends or family when you are craving some solid non-veg starters in the city!

name: Whitefield SOCIAL
review_texts:
I went to Whitefield SOCIAL for dinner with a friend, and the first thing that surprised me was the sheer size of the place. From the outside, you really wouldn't expect it to be so massive, but it opens up into a huge, beautifully designed space. I also loved the attention to detail they've put into the little things—the way the menu is designed, the quirky cutlery holder, and even the tissue papers have their own unique character.

Right from the start, the service was fantastic. The staff was incredibly attentive to our needs, and the manager was super friendly, stepping in to help us out whenever required.

They have a massive selection of cocktails on the menu. We tried a couple of them, and they were really good—absolutely no complaints there. For food, we ordered a non-veg platter and some fish and chips. Both were decent, but I definitely liked the platter a lot more than the fish and chips. Overall, it was a great evening with a wonderful vibe, and the excellent service really made the experience stand out.

The food and drinks were good. The environment was fine. The cost per person was approximately 1000 rs. The ambiance was good. Advance booking is recommended during peak hours. The staff were very polite. The dance floor was a bit short, but overall it was good. You can also watch matches there.
Renovated interiors with new vibes but seating designs can be better . A bit crowded one for family . Food taste is good ; there is scope for more variety. Option to be indoor or in patio

As always any social outlet in Bangalore that I have been too never dissapounts
Grear ambience
Lots of comfy seating
Service by Abhishek very good and helpful and courteous

The nachos with cheese sauce and chicken so 😋
The LiiT was so so good
Music good too
DONT COME HERE if you do not have India phone number. After using app to order you MUST register but they only take India WhatsApp number.  Total crazy and foreign person unfriendly. DO NOT RECOMMEND

name: 1522 - The Pub New Bel Road
review_texts:
Had a really good experience at 1522. The place has a vibrant and energetic ambiance, making it perfect for hanging out with friends or even for a casual evening outing. One of the biggest highlights is how affordable the food and drinks are compared to many similar pubs in the city, which makes it a great value for money spot.Should have been  more food options

The menu has a decent variety, and the presentation and quality of the food are quite good. However, I felt that the taste could be slightly enhanced , a bit more seasoning or richness in flavor would really elevate the dishes and match the overall vibe of the place. Service was smooth and the staff were friendly and attentive.

Overall, it’s a great place that ticks most boxes , ambiance, pricing, and comfort. With a slight improvement in taste, it could easily be a perfect experience…
The food was really good, the atmosphere is lively and enjoyable, and the overall vibe of the place is great. Definitely a nice spot to hang out and have a good time.

I went to 1522 with my friends and had a really nice experience. The ambience was good and the place has a chill vibe, making it perfect for hanging out. We ordered pizza along with a few other dishes, and the food was good overall. The outdoor seating especially made the experience better, with a pleasant atmosphere and comfortable setup.

It’s a nice spot to relax, talk, and spend time with friends, especially in the evening. The service was decent, the place was well-maintained, and the overall vibe made it worth visiting. I’d definitely recommend it for casual hangouts.

The service here is really great compared to other 1522's, the moment we walked in, the waiter made sure we did not lift our hand to call them. Location is good.

Top Floor has family dining, and the below floor has karaoke, good that they have separate zone for smokers.

Would definitely recommend for friends.

The highlight of 1522 is definitely its open-air rooftop, which creates a relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere, especially in the evenings. The music is upbeat without being overwhelming, allowing you to enjoy conversations while still feeling the party energy.
The food menu offers a wide variety of options, from classic pub snacks to hearty main courses. Their starters pair really well with drinks, and the portion sizes are generous. The bar is well-stocked, serving everything from refreshing cocktails to a good selection of beers.
Service is generally quick and friendly, even during peak hours, which adds to the overall experience. Prices are reasonable considering the location and ambiance, making it a value-for-money spot.
Overall, 1522 Pub on BEL Road is a go-to destination if you want a mix of good food, great drinks, and a buzzing atmosphere with friends.

name: Taj Hotel
review_texts:
Visited Taj Hotel in Chikpet to try their famous chicken biryani after hearing a lot about it. Honestly, it was just average and didn’t quite live up to the hype. The biryani was decent but lacked the rich flavor I was expecting.

I also tried their kebab, and it was average as well. While nothing was particularly bad, neither dish stood out or felt memorable.

Overall, it was an okay experience. If you’re nearby, you can give it a try, but based on my visit, the food didn’t quite match its reputation.

One of the old Bangalore charms.
Walkable from commercial Street. However no parking nearby.
Food is the reason people come by... Finger licking biriyani, mutton kalimirch, sheekh kebab, and of course glass bottles thumbs up. Loved it.
It's clean and hygiene based on its statue, however don't expect anything fancy or modern.

I visited Taj Hotel in Shivajinagar after watching Instagram reels and seeing all the hype around their famous mutton biryani. Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing.
The building feels very old and the overall cleanliness was not up to the mark. The dining area did not look well-maintained, which affected the overall experience.
I ordered the mutton biryani expecting a rich and flavorful dish, but what I received was more like plain kushka with only two very small pieces of mutton. For a price of ₹380, the quantity and quality were far below expectations. The taste was just average and nothing special compared to many other biryani places in Bangalore.
The restaurant is well known and has a long history in Shivajinagar, which is one reason many people visit it.  However, based on my visit, the food did not justify the price. I felt that I paid a premium amount but did not receive a premium dining experience.Got Mutton biriyani in normal steel plate I don't think it's a MB.
Overall, I found the place overrated. Poor cleanliness, average taste, very little mutton in the biryani, and high pricing made this a disappointing visit. I would not recommend it to anyone looking for value for money

Your counter people behaviour is not well, after doing 1000rs bill also, they don't have fenegreek to serve customers, behaviour also very rude, they are telling ask in first floor, first floor people telling ask to ground floor people, they both behaving rudely to the customer, please take action, don't have manners, how to behave with customer, if zero star was there, i would have give that also.. shameless people

I didn't like the taste much or bad choice of order. The only item I liked and prefer for must try dish is Kalmi kebab. It was top notch.
The rest items I was not satisfied much. I had big expectation on this place.
We went in auto, the roads are always crowded and difficult to drive by car. I would prefer not to go their with your own vehicles.

name: Sarjapur Social
review_texts:
Hello Google users,

I visited this place for lunch. The place has a good vibe and ambience.

We ordered starters, main dishes and mocktails. For starters we ordered K Krispy Lotus Stems and Cajun Fries. The Cajun Fries was excellent but the Lotus Stem quality can be improved. For the main dishes were ordered the Peanut Butter and Smoke Chilli Ramen and Paneer Makhani Biryani. The Biriyani was yummy with well marinated and cooked Paneer. The taste of peanut butter was too overpowering. We had Virjin Mojito for drinks. It was refreshing. We ended the meal with Sizzling Brownie. It was an excellent way to complete the meal.

The prices are a bit high but the experience was good and if you are in and around Bangalore Sarjapur area then this place is a must visit.

Regards,
Deepak.

The atmosphere is really good, and the food is also nice. However, the service is very slow — it took almost an hour for the food to arrive. At the entrance, they charged us an entry fee even though we had already pre-booked through Dineout . Also, when we arrived, the staff didn’t give us a seat. We had to wait around 20 minutes, and only after we raised our voice did they arrange a table for us.

We had a team party ... We loved the ambience and the DJ (after10) were great...
Starters were hit a miss Chicken Kebab, Chilli paneer and corn were yummy... Rest others were a miss...
Drinks were awesome 👍😎 especially Banarsi Patiala.. 🍹

We attended a corporate office party for 28 people here and the experience was amazing from start to finish. We opted for a package, and everything was very well organized. The food was great, the music set the perfect vibe, and the service was attentive and smooth throughout the event. Even the cocktails were impressive and well crafted. Overall, it was a fantastic experience and a great place to host corporate gatherings. Highly recommended!

Its a good restaurant that costs more than moderate price. The staffs are polite and professional. Dance floor is limited and it feels like more crowded. DJ night available but only after 9.30 pm. I had a great time with friends over here.

name: Sattvam Restaurant
review_texts:
I've been to this restaurant before a few times and as of late 2025, I feel the experience has fallen down from being pretty good to absolutely average.

First things first, I feel the ambience is below par. The chairs we got cannot be said to be particularly clean. The music included two songs, and that's about it! Given that they charge upwards of 700 per person, these are inexcusable flaws.

Now coming to the food. They served soup and a few starters after seating. They were decent and okay. Then we went for the main course. The spread was wide. There were chaats, Indian, Continental, and Italian dishes. Some of the items were delicious to be honest. Finally, the desserts were okay. Again, nothing out of the ordinary.

In sum, the food was decent. But for the price they have charged, the overall experience could have been substantially better. One could try the place once, but I would not recommend multiple visits if they maintain this standard.

We recently tried the new à la carte menu at Sattvam and it was truly an elevated vegetarian dining experience. The ambience is beautiful with Bhagavad Gita wall art, ISKCON-inspired decor, and soothing Hare Krishna music that creates a calm and spiritual vibe.

What makes this place unique is their satvik cuisine — completely vegetarian with no onion and no garlic, yet every dish is packed with flavour and creativity.

Some highlights from our meal were the Peacock (crispy kattaifi nest with spicy potato mash), Smoked Sweet Corn Essence soup, Thai Mango Guava Mélange, Cheriya mini appam with coconut relish, Betel Leaf Tartare, Fried Dumplings, Golden Paneer Symphony, Signature Naanza, and the Butterfly Rice Bowl with sweet chilli basil stir fry. Every dish was beautifully presented and tasted excellent.

We ended with Basant, their take on kunafa with kataifi crisps and pista — a perfect dessert to finish the meal. The service was amazing throughout the experience.

They’re also known for their 70+ dish satvik buffet, making it a great place for anyone looking for a wholesome and premium vegetarian dining experience. Highly recommended.

Before i say anything about this place !  I want to tell you this was by far the best experience I’ve had !!! The staff was soo good soo perfect !! Coming to food everything was sooo beautifully presented!!! Extra points for the presentation!!! I had gone here to enjoy the ala a carte .

I had a wonderful buffet dinner experience at Sattvam with my family members, and I must say it was truly exceptional.
From the moment we entered the restaurant, we were welcomed with warmth and great hospitality.
The ambience is peaceful, elegant, and gives a very positive vibe.
The restaurant is beautifully maintained, very clean, and perfect for a family dinner.
The buffet spread was excellent with a wide variety of delicious vegetarian dishes.
Every item was fresh, tasty, and prepared with high quality ingredients.
The starters were amazing and full of flavor.
The main course had many wonderful options, and every dish was rich in taste.
The desserts were outstanding and beautifully presented.
The sweets, ice creams, and traditional desserts were especially enjoyable.
The service was quick, professional, and very well managed.
A special thanks to Mr. Krishnamurthy, the manager, who took care of us very promptly and personally ensured everything was perfect.
His attention, polite nature, and customer care made our dining experience even more memorable.
He was very humble, professional, and made us feel truly valued as guests.It is rare to find such excellent hospitality these days.
The entire staff was courteous, attentive, and always ready to help with a smile.
The dining experience was smooth and very comfortable.
The presentation of food was also impressive and attractive.
The quality of service matched the quality of food perfectly.
My family members were all very happy and satisfied with the experience.
Everyone appreciated the taste, cleanliness, and hospitality.
It was truly a memorable family dinner for us.
The peaceful atmosphere makes it a perfect place for celebrations and special occasions.
The restaurant gives a premium fine dining experience.
The buffet pricing is worth it for the quality and service provided.
I highly recommend Sattvam to anyone looking for an excellent vegetarian fine dining restaurant in Bangalore.
If you want great food, beautiful ambience, and outstanding service, this is the perfect place.
Special appreciation once again to Mr. Krishnamurthy for his prompt care and excellent hospitality.
Thank you for making our family dinner so special and memorable.
We will definitely visit again soon.
Highly recommended

Sattvam was once celebrated for its opulent, wide‑ranging buffet and live cooking stations, where every dish seemed to surprise you in the best way. These days, though, it has settled into being simply adequate: a vegetarian spread that’s decent enough but lacks any real wow factor, and the bill feels noticeably steep for what you get.

The flaws in the items were
Pizza - cold
Momo- very old batch kept on heater
Curd rice- had turned sour
Lemon rice and pouliyogre- dried cookedrice with no moisture in it
Tomato shorba/soup- too watery

name: Glen's Bakehouse Whitefield
review_texts:
As the name suggests, this place is well known for its baked goods, and it certainly lives up to the reputation. The cakes and brownies are delicious, and they offer a great selection of puffs, croissants, and other bakery items. The cakes are especially fresh and flavorful.

The coffee is also very good and pairs perfectly with the baked treats. The ambiance is pleasant and inviting, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a snack or coffee break.

The service is friendly and efficient, adding to the overall positive experience. Overall, it's an excellent bakery and café that is definitely worth visiting for its quality baked goods, coffee, and comfortable atmosphere.

Had a lovely breakfast experience at Glen’s Bakehouse. The café has a peaceful ambience with both indoor and outdoor seating, surrounded by plenty of greenery and tree canopies. Watching the pizzas being freshly baked in the large live oven added a nice touch to the experience. The English breakfast was well-prepared and delicious, and the overall atmosphere made for a relaxing start to the day. Definitely a great spot for a leisurely breakfast or coffee break.

Visited this place today. We arrived around 4.45 so got a table quickly.
Foods was decent , I will not say very good but okayish. We ordered hot chocolate,  coffee, almond crusted chicken strips and chicken res pesto pizza.
Atmosphere also very averagea and casual.
Service was quick and prompt.
Overall good experience.

I really wanted to love Glen’s Bakehouse in Whitefield because the ambience is absolutely amazing—it’s easily one of the prettiest spots in the area. But unfortunately, the experience was a letdown.

The Good:
The food itself is decent. Their mini cupcakes are actually quite good—dense, flavorful, and exactly what you’d expect from a high-end bakery. The Red Velvet and Belgian Chocolate minis were tasty, but that’s where the positives end.

The Service (or lack thereof):
The service was horrible. We sat there for ages and no one bothered to check on us. Even when you go up to the counter, there’s hardly anyone there to assist you. You literally have to force yourself on the staff just to get an order in. For a place that charges a bomb price, you’d expect at least a basic level of hospitality, but the staff seemed completely indifferent and "least bothered."

The Biggest Issue:
My biggest complaint is the shocking lack of eggless or veg options. In a city like Bangalore, not having a solid range of eggless cupcakes (like a simple Eggless Red Velvet or Truffle) is a huge oversight. When I asked about it, the staff couldn't have cared less.

Verdict:
You’re paying a premium for the setting, but the service and the menu variety (especially for vegetarians/eggless eaters) just don't justify the cost. Unless you’re just there for a photo op, it’s hard to recommend.
Would you like me to add a specific mention about the lack of healthy or sugar-free alternatives as well, or does this cover the main points of your visit?

Honestly, Glen’s Bakehouse is one of those places that just feels good to visit. The moment you walk in, the vibe is warm and cozy — perfect whether you’re meeting friends, going on a casual date, or just enjoying some quiet “me time” with coffee.

The food has been consistently great every time I’ve visited. Their baked items are soft, rich, and balanced — not overly sweet — and everything tastes fresh. Portions are filling, presentation is lovely, and the coffee complements the desserts really well.

What I also appreciate is the service — polite, friendly, and attentive even when the place gets busy. It never feels rushed.

Overall, it’s a comfort spot for me now. Good food, calm ambience, and a pleasant experience every single time. Definitely recommend if you’re in Whitefield!

name: District 6 - Best German Microbrewery in Bangalore | Pub Rajajinagar
review_texts:
District 6, Rajajinagar is not just a brewery—it carries a legacy of crafting some of the finest brews in the city, paired with an ambience that perfectly blends industrial charm with a lively, premium vibe. Easily one of the best German-style microbreweries around.

This mango season, their special menu truly stands out. We tried the mango paneer chilli—unique and flavourful—and paired it with their seasonal mango-based beer, which was refreshing and well-balanced. The mango and watermelon mocktails were equally impressive.

For starters, the cheese dumplings and mushroom chilli were delicious. The main course with Thai curry & jasmine rice, along with phulka, veg curry, and paneer curry, was wholesome and satisfying. We ended on a perfect note with the chocolate fondant cake served with ice cream—rich, warm, and indulgent.

Overall, a must-visit for great brews, seasonal specials, and a complete dining experience.

This place is worth the hype. Great staff, good snacks and brew. Seating is comfortable and interiors are cosy. The starters are quite exhaustive and were very well presented. The starters were prepared the way we requested. The stewards served with a smile which makes a lot of difference. The manager was very helpful in clarifying our queries.

Since we were here on a weekday, there very few customers making the experience peaceful. The prices are on par with similar breweries. Parking is not an issue.

Food and service was nice. I was about to rate 5star but removed one star because while enjoying a random person comes and ask to take photo and says i will give you hard copy.

I thought it is restaurant sponsored person and later he is like this is chargeable and he is also not fine to click in your phone.

Food was amazing we ordered sushi, pesto pasta, papad paneer and couple of drinks.

We visited District 6 during their Oktoberfest celebrations and had a really good time. The German Lager and Märzen beer were excellent – smooth, fresh, and enjoyable. That said, it was a bit disappointing that, despite the Oktoberfest theme, there weren’t more German beers available on tap to try.

The food was tasty and paired well with the drinks, and the service was attentive and friendly throughout our visit. What really elevated the afternoon was the live music. The band Acoustic Saga set the perfect vibe – Naveen, the lead singer, was simply outstanding with his versatile voice and wide repertoire of songs. Praveen on the sax and flute was equally brilliant, adding a fantastic dimension to the performance.

Overall, a great spot for good food, quality drinks, and amazing live music. Would definitely recommend catching Acoustic Saga here if you get the chance!

District 6, and I must say it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment you step inside, the ambiance immediately stands out. The lighting, music, and overall vibe create the perfect balance between energetic and relaxed. It’s the kind of place where you can comfortably enjoy a chill evening or celebrate with friends. The interiors are stylish and thoughtfully designed, giving the brewery a premium and welcoming feel.
The food at District 6 is equally impressive. Every dish is beautifully presented and packed with flavor. You can truly taste the quality of ingredients and the attention to detail in preparation. Whether it’s starters or main course, everything complements the drinks perfectly. It’s not just bar food — it’s a complete dining experience.
And of course, the beer is the real highlight. Fresh, smooth, and expertly brewed, each sip reflects craftsmanship and passion. The variety caters to different tastes, and every brew has its own unique character. District 6 isn’t just a brewery; it’s an experience that combines great food, amazing ambiance, and outstanding beer. Highly recommended for anyone looking to have a memorable time! 🍻🔥

name: The Pump House, Whitefield
review_texts:
Exceptional experience at The Pump House! A special thanks to Rakesh Saurav for his outstanding hospitality and impeccable service, and to Chef Keshab for taking such great care of us with a delicious light dinner. Their professionalism, attentiveness, and genuine care made our visit truly memorable. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout.

The Pump House offers great food, a vibrant ambiance, and service that truly sets it apart. Rakesh Souv and Chef Keshab are a true asset to the team. Thank you both for making our evening so special. Highly recommended, and I look forward to visiting again soon!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Had a wonderful lunch experience at The Pump House Whitefield today. The ambience was vibrant, comfortable, and perfect for a team lunch. The food was excellent, with a great variety of dishes that were fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared.
A special thanks to Rakesh Kumar and ananta ji for their outstanding hospitality and seamless arrangements. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and dedication ensured that everything was perfectly organized and that our team had a comfortable and enjoyable experience.
The service was prompt, and the staff were courteous and attentive throughout. The combination of great food, excellent service, and a welcoming atmosphere made this a memorable outing for our team.
Highly recommend The Pump House Whitefield for team lunches, corporate gatherings, and special occasions. Thank you, Rakesh Kumar and Owis, for making our lunch experience truly enjoyable.

Worshingla did a great job serving us. She was good 👍

We were 5 people..

We had
Cajun Potato wedges 😋 305
Corn Salt and pepper 295
Drums of hell 🔥449
Chicken Roulade with Khameeri Roti 😍438
Jalapeno Cheese Croquettes 😋 295
Grilled Salmon 1099
Hot chocolate Souffle 💝 369
Mango Tres leches 💝369

All food was amazing 😍.

Had a fantastic experience at The Pump House, Whitefield. The ambience is one of the biggest highlights—beautifully designed with plenty of greenery, spacious seating, and a vibrant atmosphere that makes it perfect for both casual outings and celebrations. The food was delicious, well-presented, and packed with flavor, while the craft beers were fresh and refreshing.
A special thanks to Rakesh and Team Sundra for their outstanding hospitality. They were incredibly friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit. Their excellent service truly elevated the entire experience and made us feel very welcome.
The combination of great food, refreshing drinks, lively vibes, and exceptional service makes The Pump House a must-visit in Whitefield. Highly recommended, and I look forward to coming back soon!

Had an amazing time at the Pump House garden party for lunch! 🌿✨ The whole setup had such a beautiful birthday vibe—perfect mix of relaxed and lively. The ambiance was refreshing, with greenery all around making it feel like a little escape from the city.
A special shoutout to Manager Rakesh and his team for their warm hospitality and seamless service. They truly made the experience even more memorable with their attention to detail and friendly approach.
Great food, great vibes, and great company—definitely a place I’d love to visit again for celebrations! 🎉

name: BLR Brewing Co - Kanakapura Road
review_texts: Had a wonderful experience at BLR Restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. Every dish was well-prepared and beautifully presented. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and had a great atmosphere. Overall, it was an excellent dining experience, and I highly recommend BLR Restaurant to anyone looking for tasty food and great service. Looking forward to visiting again!

Visited BLR Brewing Co. today. The ambience was really good, and the staff were extremely polite, cooperative, and welcoming throughout the visit. It’s also a pet-friendly place, which is a big plus.

However, the food was quite overpriced and lacked taste. Even the beer prices felt expensive compared to other breweries. I tried the Mango NEIPA, and unfortunately, it had a very bitter and unpleasant taste. On the brighter side, the mocktails were actually good. Overall, great ambience and service, but the food and beer experience could definitely improve.

I visited BLR Brewing Co. yesterday and had a generally pleasant experience. The ambience is definitely the highlight it has a fantastic, open-air feel with lush greenery and a great 'old Bangalore' vibe that makes it perfect for a relaxed evening.
Food & Drinks:
Pizza: We tried their pizza (which they also offer for delivery). While the crust and toppings were decent, the food overall felt just 'ok.' It was satisfying but lacked that 'wow' factor; there is definitely room for improvement in the flavor profile.
Nagpura Mocktail: This was a refreshing choice! It paired well with the meal, though like the food, it was good but not extraordinary.
Verdict:
The vibe here is excellent and easily the best part of the visit. While the food is decent, I think the kitchen could do a bit better to match the high standard set by the beautiful decor and atmosphere. It’s a great spot to hang out for the environment alone!

What an aesthetically beautiful place! The tasty food, quick service, and polite staff make the dining experience even more enjoyable.

They offer both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food options and parking is conveniently available. There’s even a paan shop right at the entrance — a perfect way to complete your meal the traditional Indian way.

Absolutely loved the overall experience! Highly recommended for everyone — whether you’re visiting as a couple, with family, for a party or solo.

I went to Blr Brewing for my Sunday Brunch and I just loved it.
The best part is that the place is pet friendly so I could go there with my dog and enjoy the January weatger which is little cold than usual in Bangalore this year.

We ordered Onion Rings(yummmm), Dahi kababs(yummm again),
Rajma patty on mini paratha (okayish for us as it was very very spicy that we had return it, the staff was kind enough to ask for a replacement dish but we did not ask for anything), roasted veggies with feta pizza (yummm). Drinks I ordered Shimla (very sweet for my taste but was suiting well with our food).

The only disappointing thing was the price for 3 boiled eggs, I wanted to get on boiled egg for my dog but since they dont have that option we had to order 3 eggs which costed us Rs. 300/- (disappointed)

Overall a great place to enjoy a chilling sinday brunch with your furr babies.

name: Lakeview Milk Bar
review_texts:
We went to Lakeview Milk Bar on a Saturday afternoon. It was fairly empty. They have a ground floor where one can do take out or stand and eat and a dine-in area on the first floor with 9-10 tables.

We tried three scoops of ice cream, vanilla, alphonso mango and chocolate noir. Vanilla and Mango were okay but the chocolate ice cream was disappointing. It was a bit too icy. In general, I expected the ice cream to be creamier and smoother.

The service was fine when we were there, there wasn't much crowd.

Overall, there are better options around I feel.

I found this place while shopping and tried the chocolate croissant and peach danish. The chocolate croissant was a bit of a letdown; the croissant was not crispy and the filling was strange. However, the peach danish was fresh and delicious, especially the centre-filling of vanilla custard.

The staff were very friendly and helpful, making good recommendations when asked.

It’s a good place for a quick bite or dessert, but don’t expect anything extraordinary.

Visited Lakeview Milk Bar and it turned out to be a perfect dessert stop! We tried the sizzling brownie with vanilla ice cream, German Black Forest special, an ice cream cake, and waffles with ice cream — and honestly, everything tasted amazing.

The sizzling brownie was the highlight, warm, gooey, and paired perfectly with the melting vanilla ice cream. The German Black Forest special was rich and flavorful, and the waffles with ice cream were fresh, crispy, and super satisfying. Even the ice cream cake was delicious and creamy.

Definitely one of the best places to enjoy desserts in the city. Worth every penny and a must-visit if you have a sweet tooth!

Visited on 5th May and took a parcel home—ordered the chocolate-filled croissant, pain au chocolat, and double chocolate brownie for ₹650. Unfortunately, the experience wasn’t great.
Both the croissant and pain au chocolat had a strange soapy taste from the first bite, which was quite off-putting. The croissant filling also didn’t taste like chocolate—it felt more like an overly sweet caramel. I don't know why it tasted like soapy
Even our family members tasted it and felt the same.
The brownie was average in taste, but it was slightly burnt at the bottom, which affected the overall experience.
Overall, quite disappointing for the price.

Not worth the hype. The ice cream tasted velow average. They have lost their precipus quality. The ice cream scoop size was too small and the ice cream used in the peach melba that I ordered tasted like local ice cream. Totally not worth visiting.
Disappointed with the taste as it doesnt taste anything like before.
A gem of a place before, but has totally lost its charm.

name: O.G. Variar and Sons, Variar Bakery
review_texts: This bakery is truly fantastic! 🤩 I highly recommend their cream rolls, they are absolutely delicious. Every single item I've tried here has been incredibly fresh and bursting with flavor. A wonderful experience! ✨ Definitely a must-visit spot. 👍

The quality and taste have remained the same for years, which is why the place is always crowded. Prices are on the higher side, and the staff are usually busy because of the rush. Note that the bakery is closed on Tuesdays.

If you’re visiting for the first time, it’s best to try different items before buying in bulk. I’ve literally seen people bill bakery items worth ₹10,000 at a time here.

Must-try items: rusk, veg puff, milk biscuits, coconut biscuits, cashew biscuits, and their wide variety of cakes.

One of the oldest and most loved bakeries! O.G Variar & Sons never disappoints. The coconut biscuit, milk biscuit, cashew biscuit, Dil Pasand, and honey cake were all fresh and delicious. Classic taste, great quality, and full of nostalgia. A must-visit bakery!

On 25th I bought few items from here, I couldn't believe after opening the items it was so worst.. Dilpasand & puffs were pathetic.. Butter buiscuit was very hard...Need answer from the management..

Pls refer the bill & item photos..

Good gesture & prompt response..

I called up & informed the management about this issue, immediately they apologized for the bad prod/uct but they did not explain as to why it happend like this..

Good gesture part was that they did not arugue or asked for photos of bad products.. But they said they will send the good product without any extra money & they did deliver to our place..

Mistakes do happens but accepting & correcting is the part of good gesture, which doubles the confidence & trust of the customers...

The products were delicious & fresh...

Warrier Bakery is one of Bangalore's most iconic and oldest bakeries, and it's a place I never miss whenever I'm traveling back to my hometown. Their products have a unique, authentic taste that makes them perfect to carry home for family and friends.

My personal favorites are their crispy rusk, delicious biscuits, and wholesome wheat biscuits. The bread toast is another must-try, with the perfect crunch and flavor. Their puff is always fresh and tasty, and the cream bun is simply nostalgic and delightful.

If you're in Bangalore, Warrier Bakery is definitely worth a visit for its traditional bakery items and timeless flavors. And don't forget to carry your own bag while shopping!

name: Paakashala | Veg Restaurants in Rajarajeshwari Nagar | Party Hall
review_texts:
RELIABLE AND DEPENDABLE
Typical family restaurant is well maintained with lift access and serves freshly prepared meals and eatables. Easy on spices and served scrumptious meals with extra portions when requested. Service is good and there is a long gap between each table. On my second visit they had some kind of painting work happening and the paint odour was suffocating. Better to avoid if still not done. Check with them upfront. Rates are on the lower side. Atmosphere is calm & relaxed.

Paakashala serves really tasty food! I tried the Manchow Soup, Paneer Tikka, Baby Corn Manchurian, Mushroom Pepper Dry, and also the Butter Roti with Paneer Gravy—everything was delicious and well-prepared. The flavours were excellent across all dishes. Highly recommended for great vegetarian food!

Had a great experience at Paakshala, RR Nagar! The food was amazing and the flavors were truly authentic. The Kadhai Paneer was perfectly spiced and very flavorful, and the Cheese Naan was soft, buttery, and absolutely delicious. The combination of both was just perfect.

The service was good and the overall ambience made the dining experience even better. Definitely a great place to visit if you're craving tasty North Indian food. Highly recommended!

Paakashaala in RR Nagar is a fantastic spot for delicious, freshly prepared meals. The food is flavorful, well-portioned, and served with care. The staff is friendly and attentive, making the dining experience pleasant. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, perfect for casual meals with family or friends. Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty home-style food in a comfortable setting!

The dinner experience was good overall. The food tasted nice. The ambience was decent, though it was slightly crowded over the weekend. Service was polite and manageable. A good place to dine with family and friends.

We tried the tandoori platter and it was very good. For two people, it is more than enough to make you full.

The masala in all the dishes is mild, which we like. And it feels like our second kitchen — just like home food.

name: Big Pitcher Sarjapur
review_texts:
Had an absolutely amazing time at The Big Pitcher, Sarjapur! 🌟

From the moment we walked in, the place set the perfect mood. The ambience is vibrant yet comfortable, with beautifully designed interiors that create a great balance between a lively party vibe and a relaxed dining experience. The music and DJ were fantastic, keeping the energy high throughout the evening and making the entire atmosphere feel electric and fun.

What truly made the night memorable was the exceptional hospitality. A special thanks to Shakthi and Shane, who were incredibly humble, kind, and genuinely sweet. They took such great care of us from the very beginning until the end, making sure everything was smooth, comfortable, and perfectly taken care of. Their warmth and attentiveness really elevated the entire experience.

Also a big appreciation to Floor Manager Khakendra, who ensured that our food and dining experience was absolutely amazing. Everything was well managed, timely, and thoughtfully handled, which made our visit even more enjoyable.

Overall, it was a wonderful evening filled with great vibes, delicious food, amazing music, and outstanding service. Highly recommend visiting The Big Pitcher Sarjapur if you're looking for a place with great ambience, lively energy, and a team that truly cares about making your experience special. 🍻✨

Hello Google users,

I visited this place for their lunch buffet. It was an excellent experience with a great ambience and friendly staff.

They served a plate of crispy Nachos as the first dish. There were many starters which included Crispy Corn Salt & Pepper, Cheesy Mushroom Fingers, Crispy Veg in Hot Garlic Sauce, Peri Peri French Fries, Paneer Supreme Pizza, Vegetable Patty Burger and Vegetable Sandwich. All starters were fresh and tasty but the best starters were the Cheesy Mushroom Fingers and Crispy Veg in Hot Garlic Sauce.

For Grill options they served BBQ Grilled Paneer Tikka, BBQ Grilled Mushroom and BBQ Chatpata Pineapple. The BBQ Grilled Mushroom was the best as it was prepared to perfection and tasty delightful.

They had many options for Main dishes but we had only the Kashmir-e-Pulao with Raita. The Pulao was excellent as it had vegetables, cashew and raisins.

The dessert bar was stacked very well and they had 4 different ice cream flavours. There was a separate section for Gulab Jamun and Moong Dal Halwa. They had a lot of pastries and sweets and all of them were tasting good.

If you are in and around Sarjapur area in Bangalore then this place is a must visit for lunch or dinner with your family

Regards,
Deepak.

I recently visited Big Pitcher, Sarjapura . I had really memorable time with family. Padma did fantastic work in getting order swiftly.

Great food , Good Environment!

Great place to enjoy 😊.

This place has a great ambience. We went there on an early evening where it was mostly empty, however the food tasted very average that day. My colleagues had tried their food earlier and it was good but somehow that day was a miss. First we ordered nachos, to which the waiter heard we ordered 2 plates of nachos instead of 1. He didn’t confirm the count before placing the order and then we had to eat 2 plates of it. This was a good thing actually because the rest of the food was not good. Pepper paneer tasted just like marinated paneer and no cooking. Dahi kabab’s dahi tasted weird. Mushrooms were good but the cheese in the pizza was very bad. We also ordered prawns but they also felt like marinated and boiled not cooked. Drinks were also okay. We didn’t order any liquor. Maybe will have to give this another try because they apologised for the food and took detailed reviews of what didn’t work for us.

We had a wonderful anniversary dinner at Big Pitcher, Sarjapur, and a big part of the experience was thanks to Hemant. His hospitality was exceptional—he was warm, courteous, and attentive throughout our visit. He ensured that everything was served on time and checked in regularly to make sure we were comfortable. His friendly attitude and excellent service made our special evening even more memorable. Thank you, Hemant, for making our anniversary celebration so enjoyable. Keep up the great work!

name: The Watering Hole - RR Nagar
review_texts: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An absolute gem of a hangout spot!I recently visited The Watering Hole and was blown away by the experience. The ambiance is fantastic, featuring a gorgeous setup with fountains and lush greenery that instantly sets a relaxing mood. They offer both comfortable indoor seating with AC and great multi-level outdoor seating.The food menu is incredibly diverse, covering everything from North Indian to Continental and Chinese. Everything we ordered had a stylish presentation and tasted incredible. The tandoori stuffed mushrooms and the paneer tikka pizza are absolute must-tries! They also have a full bar with great cocktail options and legendary beer offers.The staff was polite, welcoming, and timed the dishes perfectly. On top of that, the prices are very reasonable for the quality and portions you get. Plus points for having a massive, hassle-free parking lot!Whether you are looking for a weekend live music vibe with friends, a big screen to watch a match, or a pleasant dinner with family, this place hits all the right notes. Will definitely visit again!

Atmosphere is awesome here. Very spacious and airy. We have ordered grilled fish, Malanda Chicken, lachcha parotha and ghee rice. All were equally delicious and fresh. Service was a little off. They forgot our order of rice though after reminding it was served promptly. Overall a good experience.

Good ambience overall, especially for brunch and lunch. The setup and vibe are definitely appealing.

However, the terrace seating is uncomfortable during summers. The fans are excessively large and powerful, they make the food cold very quickly, which completely affects the dining experience. The airflow is too aggressive, and the noise from the fans is quite irritating.

They need to focus on maintaining a comfortable cooling environment for customers instead of overdoing it and compromising the food quality.

Restrooms also require better maintenance.
