Summary: Great ambience, but poor temperature control and maintenance issues need fixing.

Had an amazing experience at The Watering Hole! The ambience is lively yet comfortable—perfect for chilling with friends. The food was delicious, and the drinks were well-crafted and reasonably priced. Service was quick and the staff were friendly and attentive throughout.
Definitely one of the best spots in RR Nagar for a great evening. Highly recommend for good vibes, great music, and a relaxing time! 🍻

Staff has no personal hygiene. Very bad experience. Touching the garlic bread with bear hands while serving by cleaner cum server. Writing this review sitting right here and experiencing. No hygiene maintained. Very unhygienic place. Spending 3k for 2ppl for a place like this is horrible experience one can have. There are flies sitting on the food you are eating. I dont know why ppl come here.

name: Glen's Bakehouse
review_texts:
The atmosphere is really good here.

Food is good too. The white sauce pasta was creamy and yum, peri peri baby corn was average and cupcakes were delicious.

The service is a bit slow and they did not provide us water at the beginning. But we saw them giving water to other tables. Midway through our meal we requested for water and only then they gave it to us. Apart from that everything was good.

Glen's Bakehouse is a fantastic place which has dine-in with a Cozy ambience, Great quality baked items and a Superb menu. Very popular with every age customers who enjoy their dining here. Young crowd is mostly seen enjoying thrift time.
Red Velvet cakes and cupcakes, Lasagna, Pastas, Salads and Hot Beverages are all favourites here. I completely enjoyed the time  spent here and also encourage others who have not visited this Lavelle Road Branch.
Its really a Go-to destination for those who want to enjoy delicious Bakery.

I recently visited Glen's Bakehouse and was thoroughly impressed. The taste of the items I tried was absolutely delicious, with fresh ingredients and perfect flavors. Furthermore, the hygiene standards appeared to be very high, which made the entire experience comfortable and enjoyable. I highly recommend it!"
This place serves Veg and non veg items but personally did not like the food because of taste. Ambiance is fine but not that great.

Cute cafe. We went on christmas day and the decor and vibes were great. The mini tarts were really good and so was the belgium thick choco shake. We also tried dark chocolate cake, hot mocha and cheese chicken puff.

Only disappointment was that there was no hot chocolate (come on) and plum cake which took too much time to be served that we had to cancel.

But overall great place

name: Olive Street Food Cafe - Btm Layout
review_texts:
A good place with nice vibes and a budget-friendly café experience. We tried a few dishes here — the Balle Balle Kothu Paratha was not that impressive, but the mango beverage is a must-try.

Overall, it was a good experience with a pleasant atmosphere and decent food options.

Atmosphere is nice, seating is available with handwash and washroom facility.
However, the food is average taste. I went there with much excitement, but was a bit disappointed.
Well, we loved the Mojito Mint 😍 it was chilled and refreshing.
We had 4 items ordered (attached pics) costing around 300-400.
I would suggest them to enhance the taste a bit, however the service was good.

Fantastic place... And budget friendly too . The place was somewhat clumsy but the food was worth the hype . My favourite is the jumbo king roll and i will definitely suggest to explore this place . You can find a huge variation of flavours so it's a must try place .  ✨

We recently dropped by Olive Street Food Cafe in BTM Layout and came away really happy with the experience. In a busy area like BTM, where quick, tasty, and pocket-friendly options are always in demand, this place hits the sweet spot for casual street-style eats. It’s part of a small chain that’s gaining popularity for its value-for-money offerings.

Ambience & Vibe
The cafe has a bright, colourful, and youthful vibe with decent seating space — perfect for a relaxed meal with friends or family. It feels lively and energetic without being overly noisy during regular hours. The setup is simple yet inviting, making it a comfortable spot for hanging out over food and drinks.

Food We Tried & Taste
We ordered a mix of burgers, sandwiches, shakes, and a dry fruit salad. Honestly, the taste was awesome across the board!
•  The burgers and sandwiches were flavour-packed, fresh, and satisfying — proper street food soul with the right spices and crunch.
•  The shakes were thick, creamy, and refreshing — a perfect companion on a warm Bangalore day.
•  The dry fruit salad felt light, healthy, and surprisingly well-balanced.
Everything tasted homemade and generous in portion size. Nothing felt overly greasy or bland — they clearly put care into the flavours. For street food lovers, this is the kind of place that delivers comfort and satisfaction without fancy pretensions.

Pricing – Truly Affordable
One of the biggest highlights is the very normal and affordable pricing. You can enjoy a fulfilling meal here without burning a hole in your pocket. Most items are budget-friendly (many options under ₹150), making it ideal for students, young professionals, or families looking for value. The quality you get for the price is genuinely impressive.

Crowd & Timing – A Practical Note
This place is very crowded on weekends, so expect some waiting time and a lively, packed atmosphere. If you prefer a more relaxed experience, weekdays are much better — comfortable seating and quicker service. Pro tip: Visit during non-peak hours (early evening or mid-week) to enjoy it fully.

Overall Experience
Olive Street Food Cafe delivers exactly what it promises — tasty, hearty street food favourites at reasonable rates in a casual setting. It’s not fine dining, but it excels at being a reliable, feel-good spot for quick bites or relaxed meals. The combination of awesome taste, generous portions, and affordability makes it a strong contender in BTM’s food scene.

Final Verdict: Recommended for Budget Foodies

If you’re in BTM Layout and craving burgers, sandwiches, shakes, rolls, or light snacks at honest prices, Olive Street Food Cafe is worth a visit. It’s especially great for students, office-goers, or anyone who wants delicious food without the premium markup. Just plan your timing around the weekend rush!
We’ll definitely go back for more — particularly on a calm weekday. Keep up the good work, team! Highly recommended for casual, tasty, and wallet-friendly outings. 🍔🥪.

Loved the ambience at Olive Cafe — calm, cozy, and perfect for a relaxed time. The food was fresh, flavourful, and nicely presented. Staff were polite and attentive. A great spot in Bangalore for a pleasant dining experience. Will definitely visit again!

name: Brahma Brews
review_texts:
My third visit to Brahma Brews and as always the place has lived up to the bar set back in 2022.

The in-house craft beer has a wide spectrum of offerings which cater to all tastes, personal recommendation, Mango Ale and Ananas if you like light, crisp, and fruity brews.

The accompanying finger food options are also a good mix of classics like Tangdi Kebab and Chicken Wings while also offering options eclectic local options like Kadalekayi Usli (boiled peanuts with desicated coconut) and Ghee Roast (go for for mutton if it's your meat of choice).

Special thanks to Kabir and Anil for their service for this trip. We will be back, hopefully, soon.

Brahma Brews has a really nice ambiance with a relaxed, chill vibe that's perfect for spending an evening with family or friends. The overall atmosphere, seating, and setup are definitely the highlights of the place and are the main reason for my 4-star rating.

That said, there were a few areas that could use improvement. The service was quite slow—we had to wait around 35–40 minutes for our second starter to arrive, which affected the overall experience.

We also tried the Ananas and Mango beers, but unfortunately, the expected fruit flavors were barely noticeable. They tasted quite similar to regular beer, and the unique flavors didn't really come through.

The food was average at best. One of the chicken dishes appeared partially cooked and was served cold. More concerning was that both my son and I experienced stomach discomfort the following morning after our visit. While it's difficult to say with certainty what caused it, the experience left us a bit concerned.

Overall, Brahma Brews is a great place for its ambiance and laid-back atmosphere, but the food quality, flavor consistency, and service speed need improvement to match the excellent setting.

Brahma Brews in JP Nagar is a solid spot if you're looking for good vibes and great beer. The place has a really welcoming feel to it — there's a fountain in the center that adds a nice touch to the overall atmosphere.
We went mainly for the drinks and weren't disappointed. Good beer selection, attentive staff, and the service was quick without feeling rushed. Didn't explore the food much this time, but the location is convenient with plenty of other options nearby.
Definitely worth adding to your Bangalore list for a chill evening out.

One of oldest & easily trusted restaurants and brewery around Jp nagar. Gourmet dimsum was on par with pan asian restaurants. Avacado bean salad was fantastic!! Aglio olio was not bad.

Well known for their seasonal beers. 👍🏻

Microsoft's a neighborhood spot with a huge space and different seating. We picked a covered spot with a fan and had some awesome lunch. They mostly have Indian food, but also great pan-Asian and continental options. The mango beer was amazing, and so was the cocktail with the appetizers. We had tons of dim sum and pasta for the main course with bacon. Loved the whole experience, and the food was great! They have valet parking, and it's best to book ahead on weekends.

name: Jetlag Bar and Grill
review_texts:
The staff at jetlag, were friendly and respectful. Loved the ambience. It’s a roof top bar. They have a variety of cocktails and drinks if one wants to consume alcohol. The atmosphere is good and cool as we get fresh air to breathe.
As for the food, we ordered - peri peri French fries, chipotle chicken pizza, and mango milkshake.
French fries were crispy and delicious with the garlicky dip. Pizza was tasty too.
Milkshake was not upto the mark as i felt it was not made of real mangoes.

But otherwise, just loved the place.
Recommended.

Visited this place after a long time and it was an okay experience.
The music was very average, the DJ was unable to sync any songs and randomly played songs.
We ate and drank the below items -
Corn sheek kebab - It was nice.
Kung Pao paneer - The paneer should have been better.
Fire roasted vegetable pizza - This was the tastiest of all the items.
Dal tadka & steam rice - It was nice.
Classic LIIT - It was well made.
Royal saffron punch - Gin based cocktail which was very well made.
Eden twist - Another Gin based clarified drink. A very different and nice drink.

All in all, it was a very average experience.

Jetlag Bar and Grill has awesome vibes and a great atmosphere. Loved the music, the food, and the drinks — everything came together really well. It’s a perfect place to hang out with friends, especially for a fun weekend night, and also works great for weekday outings with colleagues.

Overall, a solid spot to relax, unwind, and have a good time. Would definitely visit again!

This pub is just wow where me and my best friend kruthi enjoyed a lot. The food is very good and very tasty, very hygiene. Here is the best part is view where you can click good pictures loved the place. Must recommended place to chill and enjoy

If you’re scouting for a spot that looks like a million bucks on your Instagram feed, Jetlag in Rajajinagar is hard to beat. While the culinary side of things might not take off as smoothly as the name suggests, the atmosphere definitely reaches cruising altitude.

Here is the lowdown on why you should—and shouldn't—book a table here.

🌃 The View: A Total Showstopper
Let’s be honest: you come here for the skyline. Jetlag offers a spectacular view of the World Trade Center (WTC) and the Orion Mall area.
* The Vibe: When the sun goes down and the city lights flicker on, the place transforms. It is incredibly pretty at night and arguably one of the best spots in West Bangalore for a photoshoot.

* Photo Op: If you’re a fan of urban aesthetics, the backdrop of the illuminated WTC is worth the trip alone.

🤝 The Service: Top-Flight Staff
One area where Jetlag truly excels is the hospitality. The staff is great—attentive, professional, and they clearly do their best to manage the rooftop rush. In a city where service can sometimes be hit-or-miss, the team here keeps things grounded and friendly.

🍽️ The Food & Drinks: A Bit of Turbulence
This is where the experience becomes a bit "middle of the road."

* The Food: To put it simply, it was just okay. It’s standard pub/lounge fare that fills the stomach but doesn't necessarily leave you craving a second helping. It lacks that "wow" factor you might expect from such a high-end-looking venue.

* The Mocktails: For those of us sticking to the non-alcoholic side of the menu, be warned: they are incredibly sweet. It felt like the sugar levels were turned up to the max, which can be a bit much if you’re looking for a refreshing, balanced drink.

📍 The Verdict
Jetlag is a "view-first" destination. It’s the perfect place for a sundowner or a late-night hangout where the conversation and the scenery are the main events.
* Ambience: 4/5 (Great night views)
* Photography: 4/5 (Bring your best camera)
* Staff: 4/5 (Super helpful and welcoming)
* Food & Drink: 2.5/5 (Needs more balance and flavor atleast on the vegetarian side)

name: Fenny's Lounge & Kitchen
review_texts:
Nice cozy Goan style place in the midst of Koramangala … food was good, the drinks could be better but the smokey one we took was real good .. garlic bread was okish… the seats were not very comfortable for longer sitting so choose wisely, we chose the high sitting and guess that was not the ideal choice. The waiter, Anbu, was quite helpful and prompt…
Overall good place to hang out with friends and family.
Cool place!!! Gives you Goa vibes surely. Food was almost Goan style and very tasty! The Paprika soup was yummy. The eggplant rice was an amazing discovery for me! Loved the food!!!

This place is beautiful interior and good accomodation that can hold large groups too.
Personally loved their crispy mushroom starter.
The food is decent given the price and the buffet items are elaborate. Would recommend!

After 5 years i came today to explore fennys with my friend for lunch. The new drinks and the food was just amazing. The best one was the Tequila passion cocktail with perfect balanced and decorative garnish.
All the staff wore kind and polite, i would like to mention mr pukar for great service.

Everything we had here last night was delish and flavorful ,but the biggest hit was their Virgin Pinacolada for us ,oh my goodness! So well made and well balanced !
1)Crispy potatoe wedges ,unique flavoursome
2)Mushroom nest was too good
3)Alfredo pasta yumm
The only disappointing mocktail was Strawberry delight-high on strawberry syrup n sugar !
Posting this review as a Thankyou note bcz it deserves so ,especially bcz of food !

name: Imperial Restaurant
review_texts:
Imperial Restaurant in Bengaluru is a go-to place if you’re a fan of non-veg food, especially kebabs and biryani. It’s been around for decades and has a strong reputation for tasty, budget-friendly meals.
The biggest highlight is the food — dishes like chicken kabab, grilled chicken, and ghee rice are crowd favorites and known for good flavor. The menu is quite wide, covering North Indian, Mughlai, Chinese, and more, so there’s plenty to choose from.
The pricing is reasonable, making it popular among students and families looking for filling meals without spending too much.
On the downside, the ambience is pretty basic and can feel crowded, especially during peak hours. Service is usually quick but may feel rushed when it’s busy. Some outlets also vary in cleanliness and consistency.
👉 Verdict: Great place for tasty, affordable non-veg food — especially kebabs. Not ideal if you’re looking for a premium dining experience, but perfect for casual outings and late-night cravings.

If you know Shivaji Nagar, you know this place… 🔥

Imperial Restaurant is not just a hotel, it’s an emotion!
Serving since 1954, this legendary spot is always buzzing for a reason.

From juicy non-veg dishes to late-night cravings, the variety here is massive. Shawarma, grill chicken, kebabs… everything hits the spot. And the best part? Their tea, fresh juices, and milkshakes are equally solid—perfect combo after a heavy meal.

Crowded, fast-paced, and full of life… exactly how a real food joint should feel. Prices are reasonable, service is quick, and the taste stays consistent.

One of the most trusted and well-known food spots in Shivaji Nagar. Highly recommended!
Once you try it, you’ll keep coming back. 💯

I ordered lunch from
Imperial Restaurant
for my team members who were visiting from Mumbai, and unfortunately it turned into a very embarrassing and disturbing experience.
In the Butter Chicken Masala, we found a cockroach inside the curry. This is completely unacceptable and raises serious concerns about the hygiene and food safety standards of this restaurant.
When I contacted the restaurant to report this issue, instead of taking proper responsibility, they said they would only refund the butter chicken amount, not the entire order. When such a serious hygiene issue occurs, this kind of response is very disappointing.
I ordered food for guests visiting from another city, trusting the restaurant’s quality, but this incident was embarrassing and shocking in front of my team.
Restaurants must maintain basic cleanliness and proper kitchen hygiene to ensure food safety. I strongly hope the management takes this seriously and improves their standards so that no other customer faces such an experience.
Very disappointed.

The pricing is on the premium side, but the overall atmosphere doesn’t reflect that. As seen in the attached photo, the sofas are dirty, tiles are broken, laminates are peeling off, and the toilets are not well maintained.

That said, the food and service were good overall—except for the mutton, which was unfortunately undercooked.

Worst service ever received  please don't visit this restaurant if you have 1.5-2  hours time for waiting then visit to waste time in this restaurant otherwise I strongly not recommend to visit we have waited 1 hr for dinner and mainly they have given bill of  5 briyani which we have order only 2 this resturant is waste of time and money...!!

name: 1522 The Pub Malleshwara
review_texts: I"Had a wonderful experience at 1522 Bar & Kitchen. The ambiance is vibrant and perfect for spending quality time with friends and family. The food was delicious, well-presented, and served fresh. The service was excellent—staff were courteous, attentive, and ensured we had a comfortable experience throughout. Great selection of food and beverages, good music, and a lively atmosphere. Highly recommended for casual dining, celebrations, and evening outings. Looking forward to visiting again!"

I had a wonderful dining experience at 1522. The food was absolutely scrumptious, with an impressive variety on the menu. For starters, we tried the Paneer Manchurian, Dragon Baby Corn, Anjali Tava Fry, and the White Horse Special Chicken, all of which were flavorful and well-prepared.

For the main course, we ordered the Veg Dum Biryani and Chicken Donne Biryani. While the Veg Dum Biryani was initially slightly under-seasoned, it tasted excellent after adding salt, and the overall quality of the dish was very good. The Chicken Donne Biryani stood out with its authentic flavor.

We also enjoyed a selection of mocktails, including Spicy Chilli Guava, Pacific Blue, and Cinderella, which were refreshing and well-balanced.

The service was quick and efficient, and the cozy ambience added to the overall pleasant experience. Valet parking is available, which is convenient. Overall, it was a satisfying visit, and I would definitely like to dine here again.

Great atmosphere & vibes as they play old rock songs continuously. Food is great, prompt service, the 3rd floor has an open terrace and plays live music.     Rock music and live performances — music is a major part of the 1522 experience. Karaoke and special DJ nights on selected occasions.
Live sports screenings, making it a good choice for watching matches with friends.
Pub atmosphere rather than a fine-dining experience.
Food with a strong Mangalorean/coastal influence, alongside North Indian, Chinese, Continental

One of the most disappointing dining experiences I've had. The food is extremely overpriced for the quality, and the beverages were even worse. I ordered a watermelon mocktail, and it wasn't up to the mark. When I politely requested a replacement, the staff simply refused, saying, "It won't be replaced here," without offering any solution.

I also ordered a Magnum beer pitcher, but it tasted so diluted that it felt more like a premium soda than beer. For the prices they charge, the quality was completely unacceptable.

The customer service was poor, and there was no effort to ensure customer satisfaction. Overall, the experience was not worth the money. I would not recommend this place, as there are many better options that offer superior food, drinks, service, and value for money.
Amazing ambience..delicious food worth every penny. 3rd floor has live music performance and 2nd floor has a indoor smoking zone.

name: Drunken Daddy
review_texts: Friday night we visited Drunken Daddy. We started with food. We ordered fries, nachos, hung curd kabab, chilli chicken, jalapenoballs and paneer tikka. Every food and drinks tasted good and flavourful. Service was average. We entered the dance floor too. The music was fine and the place was pretty packed. Women got free shots as well. Overall a fine experience.

Drunken Daddy is a great place to chill out in Koramangala. The ambience is vibrant and energetic, with good lighting and music that creates a perfect party vibe. It’s an ideal spot to hang out with friends, especially on weekend nights.

The food is tasty and well-prepared. The starters go really well with the drinks. They also have a good variety of cocktails and mocktails to choose from.

The staff are friendly, and the service is quick. Overall, it’s a nice place for birthday celebrations, casual outings, or weekend parties.

Definitely worth visiting! 🍻

They charge ₹1000 per person as a cover fee and still refuse to waive the service charge. Stags aren’t allowed on the dance floor.

The service is terrible, and the staff have a rude, unprofessional attitude. The food ranges from poor to mediocre in taste, and the ambience of the place is equally disappointing.

It’s surprising that this place has 4+ rating with such be poor offerings.

The crowd is also cheap.

Amazing vibe at Drunken Daddy Pub🔥
The dance floor was packed and full of energy, and the food was surprisingly affordable and tasty. Had a fantastic time here—definitely a place to chill and enjoy

I had a pretty good experience overall. The place has a lively atmosphere with good music and a vibrant crowd, making it a nice spot to unwind with friends after a busy day. The food was well presented and tasted good, with a decent variety of options on the menu. The drinks were prepared nicely, and the service team was friendly and attentive throughout the visit. The seating and interiors create a comfortable environment, whether you're there for a casual outing or a weekend gathering. A few items took slightly longer than expected to arrive, which is why I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5. Overall, it's a well-maintained venue with a great vibe, good food, and an enjoyable experience. Would definitely consider visiting again and recommend it to others looking for a fun evening out.

name: Neemsi Restaurant | Basavanagudi
review_texts:
Neemsi in Basavanagudi is a fantastic find!
The Food: They offer a wide variety of unique and tasty options. We tried a combination of North Indian and Italian food, and every single dish was excellent and well-prepared.
The Ambience: Incredibly soothing and welcoming environment, perfect for a relaxed meal.
The Service: Exceptionally smooth and fast. The staff handles everything with great efficiency, and they have valet parking available, which makes visiting stress-free!
Important Tip: Prior table booking is a must! Otherwise, get ready to wait.

Had a wonderful dining experience at Neemsi and absolutely loved the philosophy behind the restaurant. One of the things that stood out is their commitment to purity—they source their spices directly from farmers, ensuring authentic flavours in every dish.
It's an all-vegetarian, no-alcohol restaurant that's redefining vegetarian dining with incredibly flavourful and thoughtfully crafted dishes.
We visited to try their newly launched Monsoon Edit, a seasonal menu that celebrates the flavours of the rainy season. Some of my favourites from the menu were the Chana Masala & Aloo Tikki Chaat, Mozzarella Veg Lollies served with Som Tam Salad, Mushroom Stroganoff Toast with Feta Cream, and the Teriyaki Vegetable Dimsums. For the mains, the Bhuna Sabz with Pyaaz & Nariyal Curry paired beautifully with the Basil Naan, while the Ravioli was another standout.
We ended the meal with Pisand Goreng and Neemsi's signature Mysore Pak Cheesecake, which was easily one of the highlights of the entire experience.
I also loved how Neemsi follows a seasonal menu concept called the Neemsi Edit, allowing guests to experience fresh, seasonal ingredients throughout the year. Thoughtfully curated dishes, beautiful presentation, and flavours that stay true to their philosophy make this a place worth visiting for a unique vegetarian dining experience.

Went to Neemsi, Basavangudi recently and honestly had such a nice experience ❤️

Tried their summer specials Mango Paneer Tikka, Mango Thai Curry with Jasmine Rice, Lychee Aam Panna, Broccoli Wonton and their Mysore Pak Cheesecake… everything was really good.
Also wanted to mention Prem, Bikek and John who attended us there.. they were super friendly, polite and very professional throughout. Even though the place was crowded, the management was smooth and there was no unnecessary rushing or irritation from the staff, which made the experience even better.
Good food, good people and overall a very comfortable place to dine.

Its a perfect place for fine dining experience. We ordered crunchy lotus stem which is a must try here. Palak patta chat is simply crunchy and delicious.
Raw papaya and Mango salad was simply yummy. We concluded our meal with pistachio cannoli and mysore pak cheese cake - both of them were delicious.
Each and every dish was very innovatively presented and service was quick.

We were guided and served well by Bishal, Safir and Arjun.

Overall a must visit with family and friends for a fine dining experience.

We were here for a special occasion- my niece's birthday. The staff quickly arranged a surprise for her which really made our dining even more special. Thanks a lot to the team of Neemsi for this special gesture.

I loved ambience, food and staff service. We ordered  broccoli cheese wonton, crunchy Lotus stem,Palak Patta chaat, mini Mexican tostada, raw papaya and mango salad, Pistachio Cannoli, Mysore pak cheese cake. All delicacies were tasty, innovatively presented. We were serviced by Bishal, Safir, Arjune. They were very polite and attentive. I visited here during my Birthday and got a surprise at last. They made it really special. Thanks a lot fir the experience. Surely would like to visit again.

name: The 13th Floor
review_texts:
Visited The 13th Floor after wanting to try it for a long time, and overall it was a good experience, mainly because of the food.

We started with the Tom Kha soup, which had a balanced coconut flavor and well-cooked vegetables. The Sushni paneer kebab was surprisingly good, with flavorful marination and well-cooked paneer and veggies.

For the main course, we had the veg Pad Thai, which was excellent with a nice peanut flavor, good crunch, and well-seasoned vegetables.

The only downside was the slow service. We were told the kitchen would stay open till 12, but after arriving around 10, we were informed it would close by 11 and had to order quickly, which was disappointing.

Overall, the food definitely lived up to expectations.

Overlooking MG road, this place has held the test of time. The food is good here and the service unobtrusive. The Malacca Vegetable curry and Guldasta platter were delicious. The crunchy masala lotus root was excellent! Espresso Martini was really good among the drinks.
We had reserved a table by the edge side balcony for the evening, but due to the sun we moved indoors. It is recommended to book a table in advance.

This restaurant is located on 13th floor and offers great view of Bangalore. The food is amazing here! The drinks are good. The service is a bit slow. Ambience is vibrant with good music. Price wise it is is comparable to other similar restaurants. Definitely visit this place for good food and view!

A suprise restaurant on the 13th floor (sic). It is a covered terrace deck that gives an unrestricted view of famous buildings in Bangalore.

I past part of a very large group for lunch, celebrating the baptism of twin sisters. First off, the staff is par excellence. All of them were attentive, courteous, patient and went out of their way to make all of us feel special. The restaurant's appetizers were original preparations and scrumptious.
Lunch was Thai cuisine, and the chef certainly knows Thai food. I enjoyed the noodle soup (Laksa-more Malay than Thai) and the chicken Kharpow especially. The flavors were authentic and satisfying. Desert servings of ice cream, coconut milk and sticky toffee were exceptional, and most us went for seconds. This venue is very well managed, and the host was constantly around ensuring everything was running smooth. The bar was well stocked and even a simple fresh lime soda was made to perfevtion. Overall, this is a must do place.

It's nice place ofcourse. Not very giant but warm. They have warm ambience and caring staff to take proper care of guests. But why all restaurants, pub, and cafe play english songs? I went on a solo candle light dinner but places like 13th Floor attracts couples. I don't think english songs are a must to bring a vibe, we have hell number of hindi ghazals and bollywood songs for love couples...so why not play them. It's my kind suggestion to the 13th floor management. However, I had a great time with myself.

name: Tamarind Restaurant
review_texts:
A good place to enjoy a quality time with your friend.
There is a plenty of space to enjoy food and drinks in indoor as well as on terrace. I went there with my friend and would like to go there again. Not crowded like other restro bars in Bangalore. Just book your table beforehand to avoid unnecessary waiting time.
At night, if you are with your friends on terrace enjoying drinks and food,nice pleasant winds make the atmosphere so memorable. The staff is polite and professional. Just go and chill !!

The place serves delicious food with good ambiance and rooftop views. Tried Kung Pao Chicken, Malai Kofta, Lucknowi Plurg Dum BiryAni, Burnt Garlic Chicken Fried noodles and kulcha. Every item was good except for the malai kofta which I felt was too much sweet. Though the gravy of the item was sweet it tasted good and had mild sweetness only. Staffs are well mannered. Open terrace dining is also available in the evening.
Good ambience and service but Food quality and quantity can improve. Pls serve dishes along with basic Salad.  They say it's fine restaurant not upto the mark...OKish.

I frequently visit this restaurant in Banaawadi road, the overview of this place is they have Multicusine restaurant and small party halls, good for a small gathering of less than 80to 100 people.
Food quality is excellent with good service levels, all staff are polite and customer friendly.
Limited parking avaliblle on the road side, best place for family dining..
Price for the quality and service is good and affordable.
Overall experience is good.

Nestled in the heart of Bengaluru for over two decades, Tamarind is a culinary gem that effortlessly blends traditional Indian flavors with a contemporary flair, creating an unforgettable dining experience. From the moment you step inside, the ambiance exudes elegance, offering a perfect balance of sophistication and warmth. Whether you're here for an intimate dinner or a celebration with friends, Tamarind ensures every detail is tailored to perfection.From the impeccable service to the extraordinary food, Tamarind offers a truly 5-star experience that’s sure to leave a lasting impression.

Tamarind’s aesthetics are perfect for that Instagram moment. The vibrant colors, artistic plating, and beautifully designed interiors create the ideal backdrop for your food photos. The intricate details and carefully curated presentations ensure you’ll have plenty of content for your feed.

name: Kapoor’s Cafe Jayanagar
review_texts:
Visited July 2026 for a friend's reunion. The food was excellent. Taste was nice and portions were healthy. We tried frird sweet corn, panneer Tikka for starters and then kaju Masala, Dal fry and bhindi sabji with pulkas. The bhindi was perhaps not ripe and hence the experience eating raw bhindi was not great but the other items were quite good. Mango Lassi was delicious.
There was ample seating space and service was quick.

Amazing north Indian food. All kinds of naans and rotis were amazing. Gravies were distinct and very delicious. Loved every bite. Specially lesuni paratha. All kinds of paneer were good. There are two seating options available, either sit on the cot or seat on table and chair/benches

Have been to multiple outlets of this but never had such a bad experience.
I ordered pyaaz pakora sweet lassi and a paneer veg thali.  It was 2 of us. He brought 2 thalis; upon asking He removed another plate very rudely.

We were done with the meal then we were handed over the token number to walk to the other side of the lobby to pay the bill at the counter. While we were on our way; then waiter brought pakoras (almost after 30-40 mins) . In the bill they added 2 thali cost.
The food was okayish..
Im the थाली sweet boondi allso comes. I asked the waiter to bring a little more because the quantity was very less; upon which he said we only serve this much. If you want you can place order separately (very rudely) I said I have been to multiple outlet pf yours and this is not the quantity that is served. To which his response was then you only tell how much they serve. Honestly I was done .
With the meal I asked for onion. Mistakenly I asked the table cleaner guy for onion... he could have went ahead and asked his colleague to serve the same ; rather I saw him putting onions with his bare hands in a bowl . The experience was horrible. Too much of hassle that too for a mediocre food with such rude waiters.
I will never visit this branch for sure.

I’ve visited Kapoor’s Café in Jayanagar a couple of times, and my first experience was excellent — the dal makhani, laccha paratha thali, lassi, and paan were amazing. That visit really set my expectations high.

However, this time I came with a group and the experience was more on the average side. The chole bhature were too oily, and the sarso da saag with makke di roti wasn’t available, which was disappointing. The lassi was still great though.

Hoping the consistency improves, because the place has the potential to be really good.

Found hair in our food, extremely unhygienic
We ordered paneer paratha from Kapoor Cafe and were shocked to find multiple small hairs mixed into the food. This is a serious food safety and hygiene violation. It's not a one-off crumb or minor issue — there were several strands, which points to a real lapse in kitchen cleanliness, staff hygiene practices (like not wearing hairnets/caps), or food handling standards.
For a place serving food to the public, this is unacceptable. We couldn't finish the meal and had to throw it away. I'd strongly advise the management to review their kitchen hygiene protocols — staff should be wearing proper caps/hairnets while cooking and packing food, and there should be a final quality check before food leaves the kitchen.
Very disappointed, and I won't be ordering from here again. Would not recommend to anyone who cares about food safety.

name: Anna Kuteera
review_texts: Used to be my go to spot for comforting meals. But over the years it has degraded so much. The cost has increased so much, Taste has gone bad, hygiene is not maintained properly and staff is least bothered. Recently went for South meals, such pathetic taste, couldn't even eat half. When complained, staff didn't even listen properly and simply said sorry we will serve better next time. Pathetic place. Won't ever come back here.

It's been years and finally I visited this restaurant.
Ordered Kulcha Curry and Jeera Rice
These tasted good.
Excellent, authentic-tasting paav bhajis! I wish I had the capacity to try out their chaats and  other dishes, but the paav bhaji was brilliant very filling.

I’ve ordered a couple of times but never had the chance to visit the place. But the recent visit to the place was quite interesting as the food o had ordered was veg noodles and I didn’t had much of an expectation but it was good and hence would recommend the place for Chinese as well. Further pls try their coffee I simply loved it. Cheers !

Had Naan Curry and Sweet Corn Soup.
Naan was paired with day's special Aloo Matar which was nice in taste, also daal was provided which was also good. Naan was freshly prepared and served hot. Quality and Quantity both were decent. Sweet corn soup was prepared instantly after order and served hot. No by two service is available for soup but on request they served by two.
Sweet corn soup was filled with veggies and corn was in right proportion. Soup consistency was perfect. Enjoyed having the soup as it has great taste without addition of Salt or Pepper. Prices are considerable as they are not too high.
Overall, i would recommend if you are looking for good quality South and North Indian food items in the surrounding.
Thank you...

name: SkyDeck by Sherlock's
review_texts: I enjoyed my team dinner here, as the food and service were truly outstanding! 🤩 The pizza, ghee roast prawns, andra chilli chicken, and donne biriyani were especially delightful. 🍕🍗 However, the lack of a designated smoking area meant smoke was present at tables. 🔥 Still, a fantastic experience overall! ✨ Highly recommend the place!
Went for a lunch, a group of four and our pet. The staff was really accomodating, even our pet had no struggles throughout the meal. Absolutely loved the experience and the food was amazing as well.

Skydeck by Sherlock's is a great rooftop pub on MG Road with a nice view of the nearby metro station and city surroundings. The open-air setting, good music, and lively ambience make it a perfect place to unwind and spend time with friends.

We tried their starters and pizza, and both were excellent. The service was quick and friendly, adding to the overall experience.  Overall, it is a fun and relaxed place to enjoy good food, drinks, and a great atmosphere with friends.

Visiting SkyDeck was a great experience as it serves good food and good cocktails. The Skyview,  night vibe is total worth.
Had a great time when we went for dinner.
On weekends, book table and visit as sometimes it might get crowded.

I love the vibe, they had pretty good set up for the cricket watch and the crowd was so entho. I am not a big fan of cricket but I enjoyed thoroughly due to the vibe and crowd. Little overpriced and during weekends they have cover charges set up so keep your pocket ready.

name: Biergarten Bellandur
review_texts: I recently visited Biergarten and had an absolutely phenomenal experience from start to finish. If you are looking for the perfect spot to unwind with great food, fantastic drinks, and an unmatched atmosphere, this is definitely the place to be.Right from the moment we walked in, the vibe of the place was incredible. It has the perfect balance of a lively, energetic ambiance and a comfortable, welcoming space to hang out with friends or family. The music, the seating layout, and the open-air design create a brilliant environment that immediately sets a positive tone for the evening.The culinary experience was equally impressive. Every dish we ordered was cooked to perfection, packed with flavor, and beautifully presented. The menu offers a fantastic variety, and the quality of the ingredients truly stands out. Pair the delicious food with their excellent selection of fresh brews and crafted cocktails, and you have a winning combination.What truly elevates Biergarten, however, is their exceptional hospitality. The entire staff was incredibly polite, attentive, and genuinely nice throughout our visit. A very special shout-out goes to Guddu, who took fantastic care of our table. Guddu was absolutely great, highly professional, quick with recommendations, and extremely attentive to our needs without being intrusive. That kind of personalized service is rare and made our dining experience even more memorable.Everything was perfect, and I cannot recommend Biergarten enough. I will definitely be returning very soon!

My visit here was a pleasant one! The service was excellent, with staff being attentive and friendly throughout. 🥳 The atmosphere was also great, very inviting and comfortable. 🌿 The food was okay; some dishes were enjoyable, while others didn't quite hit the mark. It's a decent spot overall. 🍻🍰
Ambience and reliance 10/10!
Very vibrant place.

We went with a group of 15 people as team dinner. The staff were very helpful in arranging the seats as per our team requirements. Special thanks to Rakhi and team for planning well and providing us proper seating arrangements. The team was very happy.  We ordered quite a lot of food starting from Fries, wedges, 5-6 mocktails, mushroom, pad thai noodles, fish and chips, nachos, palak paneer, rotis etc. all were good. Even asian food like cream cheese dumplings and water chestnut dumplings were good. Special thanks to Vishal who catered to all requests and customisation. Service was very fast and prompt. Very less waiting time. The place has a huge seating area but during summer there is no AC and it's in an open place. There is couple of parking lots available and rest is valet.

My Honest Review of Biergarten Bellandur

Ambience: The place has a pleasant open-seating setup with music, which adds to the overall vibe.

Starters: The starters were quite good overall.
Nachos – 3/5
Achari Paneer Tikka – 4/5
Crispy Fried Coriander Chilli Mushroom – 5/5

Main Course: The main course was average.
Assorted Indian Breads – 4/5
Steamed Rice – 4/5
Veg Biryani – 2/5
Dal Tadka – 5/5
Kadai Veg – 2/5

Dessert: Desserts were good.
Gajar Ka Halwa – 4/5

Soft Drink:
In the Summer Time – 3/5

Fantastic food. Great atmosphere.
We had angari paneer tikka, soya chaap, aglio olio pasta, lotus stem, spring rolls and desserts are great!
Won't recommend the pizza but everything else was great. The toppings are too loaded.
Our waiter Bishal provided great service as well. Will definitely revisit.
Oh! And definitely checkout the restrooms!

name: The Rasaganga
review_texts: Very bad experience with service, i asked for spicy panner fried rice , they gave me plain fried rice that to after multiple times after i asked to prepare spicy for order and ignored my i order to prepare even though first come. Give preference to special orders only. I  prefer not to visit again never nor suggest anyone to visit.

Extremely unhygienic place. We ordered a dosa and found a hair in it, which my 3-year-old had already started eating. We also ordered wheat parotta but were served naan instead. On top of that, the area where rotis were being prepared was extremely dirty. Very disappointing and unsafe, especially for families with kids.
I like the Ragi masala dosa over here and tea too so guys you can try here the breakfast items already mentioned I am the menu

It’s worth trying all the dishes here. Place looks cozy and food is authentic and affordable too.

They have ample parking space and service too

Hotel Rasganga is a great spot for authentic South Indian snacks. The place is clean and well-maintained, and the food is fresh and flavorful.

Samosas are perfectly crisp with a tasty filling.

Masala Vadas are crunchy, well-spiced, and not too oily.

Service is quick, and prices are reasonable for the quality offered. Highly recommended for a quick snack or evening tea break!

name: Smoke House Deli Indiranagar
review_texts:
Not as how I expected the food to be.
No doubt the presentation of the food looked good.. but still the taste could have been better.
Piña Colada was literally warm, the chicken was very chewy and not at all tender, Tiramisu could be better- had a weird aftertaste.. Mozzarella fritters were too bland and even the seasonings didn’t taste great.
The service of the staff was good. The place was clean with proper seating.
Overall, the place is not that great if the food isn’t tasty.

This is a too yummy hangover place with friends and family together. It has a European ambience and food. It also offers breakfast with pancakes, fruit juices and so on. I went for lunch and had tried a lot many varieties including appetizers, soup, starters, pasta, desserts, mocktail and beverages, and felt that they are awesome and have good options to have and were really tasty. This place also offers kids menu separately which is good to visit with family as well. There are also options to customize our food and I enjoyed a lot such that the food won't get wasted. I really enjoyed the food here.

Visited here for lunch with a friend on Friday afternoon. We ordered ras el hanout chicken along with cheese garlic bread along with iced mocha and diet coke. They took a lot of time to serve the diet coke considering it's a ready to serve item and doesn't need to be prepared. The ambience was nice.

We had a variety of drinks and appetisers. The ones that I remember were BBQ Chicken and Cheese Melt in Crispy Croissant sandwich- quite juicy and filling, Eggs Florentine with creamed garlic spinach - liked the taste and fluffiness, Elvis pancake - expected more bacon, Nachos with truffle cream - nothing special about these , Smoked house black pepper and balsamic chicken skewers- would recommend and chicken tenders - would not recommend since the crust separates and doesn't have a pleasant taste.
In the dessert, the creme brulee was particularly nice
In the drinks I had an orange juice which had a slight bitter aftertaste that you get in packaged juices and a kombucha.

I recently visited Smoke House Deli in Indiranagar with a friend, and it was a wonderful experience. The first thing that strikes you is the beautiful decor and the overall vibe of the place—it’s very well-designed and welcoming.

The Food & Drinks:
We started with a couple of drinks and an appetiser, followed by our main courses:
• Filet Mignon: This was the highlight. It was cooked exactly as requested, and we thoroughly enjoyed every bite.
• Grilled Chicken: Another great choice—perfectly prepared and very flavourful.
• Dessert: We finished with the cheesecake, which was lovely and very tasty. However, the chocolate ice cream was a bit of a letdown and didn't quite live up to the rest of the meal.

Service & Atmosphere:
The staff were incredibly attentive and friendly, making sure we had everything we needed throughout the evening. The combination of the great service and the lovely setting makes it a fantastic spot for a meal out.

name: Kapoor's Cafe - HSR Branch
review_texts:
Visited Kapoor's Cafe on a Sunday night around 9:30 PM, mainly because we had heard they serve good North Indian food.

Location & Setup:

The cafe is located on the 4th floor (with the kitchen on the 3rd). The seating area has a proper North Indian vibe—regular table-chair setups along with khat-style seating, which adds a nice rustic touch.

Crowd & Service:

The place was completely packed, easily accommodating around 70–90 people. We had to wait about 10 minutes, which is reasonable for a weekend. However, a major issue was understaffing—only around 3 servers managing the entire crowd, plus one person cleaning tables. This led to slow and inefficient service, which was noticeable throughout.

What we ordered:

Paneer Pakoda (₹340, 8 pieces)
Aloo Paratha (₹180)
Punjabi Chole Thali (₹340)
Lemonade / Lemon Soda
Chaach

Food Review:

Paneer Pakoda (2.5/5):
Quantity felt less for the price. The paneer didn’t taste fresh, which was disappointing. The chutney served alongside was good, but it couldn’t compensate for the average pakodas.

Aloo Paratha (1/5):

Looked promising initially—good size and decent stuffing quantity. But the taste was extremely bland. It felt like plain mashed potatoes stuffed inside, with no seasoning or flavor. Easily the most disappointing dish of the night.

Punjabi Chole Thali (2.5/5):

Chole: The only highlight—really well made.
Chapati: Good size, but didn’t feel fresh.
Rice: Too much ghee (subjective, but didn’t work for me).
Dal & Raita: Average.
Missing Salad: A basic salad wasn’t included, which is usually standard with thalis—felt like a miss, especially at this price point.

Lemon Soda (1/5):
Completely flat—no fizz at all. Didn’t feel like a proper soda.
Chaach (3/5):
Decent and as expected, nothing special.

Overall Verdict:

The ambience and seating concept are good, and the place has potential. But the food quality is disappointing across most items, especially considering the pricing. Service also suffers due to lack of staff.

Honestly, not a place I’d revisit or recommend. There are far better North Indian options in HSR Layout that offer better taste and value for money.

* Sarson Da Saag Thali - 4/10
* Lassi - 6/10

Absolutely underwheling especially for the price, 470. Only the bhindi fry was good. Really really good. Saag and Makki ki roti were sub par.

The Lassi was decent but found it to be quite pricey as well.

Charpai seating arrangement was interesting though difficult for 2 folks to comfortably eat on, especially with the Thali.

2 stars primarily because the taste of the dish did not justify the price (1395 for 2 people)

We've been here two times and both times some part or the other of the order was mixed up.
But the one, which does come correct is amazing and tasty (though feels a little overpriced compared to North India Dhabas). Go for the vibe and authentic taste of North India !

A popular pure-veg Punjabi/North Indian restaurant with mostly mixed reviews from diners across India — many places have similar patterns in ratings too. ambience as vibrant and family-friendly with cozy seating — great for casual meals and group dining.
Visit the restaurant for dinner. The sarso ka saag has a lot of salt . The kaju curry was just sweet and tasteless. Overall the food is very poor in taste .

name: Corner House icecreams
review_texts: Tried the ice creams here and absolutely loved the taste and quality! The flavors were rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced — especially with the chocolate topping and crunchy nuts. The presentation was also really good and the place had a nice vibe. Great spot to satisfy your dessert cravings. Would definitely visit again!

I recently visited this ice cream shop and tried the Fruit Jackpot priced at ₹210, and overall it was a satisfying experience. The dessert was definitely worth the money. The portion size was generous, and the combination of fresh fruits with ice cream was refreshing and enjoyable. The flavors were well balanced, and the quality of the ice cream was good.
One thing I really liked about this place is the wide range of ice cream options available. There are plenty of flavors and combinations to choose from, which makes it an exciting place for anyone who loves trying different desserts. The menu offers a good variety, so customers can explore multiple options depending on their preference.
However, one area where the store can improve is the air conditioning inside the outlet. During my visit, it felt quite warm inside, which slightly affected the overall comfort while enjoying the dessert. Maintaining proper air conditioning would make the experience much more pleasant for customers, especially considering that people usually spend some time inside while eating ice cream.
Overall, it’s a good place to enjoy desserts with friends or family. With a small improvement in the store ambience, the experience could become even better. Definitely worth visiting if you enjoy ice cream.

It's a good place for trying the best icecream in Bangalore.
The corner house chain is quite famous!
Loved the taste od the icecream..
Must try the apple crumble with cream!!
The truffle was good..
The ambience is not very aesthetic but good enough to enjoy your dessert!
🫶5 stars for the taste and service...☺️

After all the hype on the internet, we finally tried the Cake Fudge at Corner House and yes, it lives up to it. The taste is rich, indulgent, and genuinely memorable. Even now, the flavour still lingers. If you’re in Bangalore and skip this, that’s on you.
The service was quick, which is a big plus, especially during rush hours. That said, the space felt a bit untidy and cramped, which slightly takes away from the experience. Not terrible, but noticeable. And for that Cake Fudge alone it’s absolutely a must-try in Bangalore.

Polite staff members and super-fast service. It's been seven years since I first tasted DBC ice cream at Corner House in Bangalore. And it has become a ritual to eat every weekend. It's extraordinary – incredibly filling and satisfying.

name: SLV Coffee Bar
review_texts:
This is one of the best spots in south Bengaluru for authentic South Indian snacks! Very similar to Brahmin's Coffee Bar in Jayanagar, it's another excellent choice.

*Coffee, Idly and Dosa*
You absolutely *must* try their filter coffee – it's so authentic and delicious! The idli is super soft, and the chutney is simply yum. Just a note, they don't serve sambar, but honestly, you don't feel the need for it. Their masala dosa is also a must try! Chow chow baath was just average for me, though Kesari baath was good.

*Parking* can be a little tricky for four-wheelers, but you might find a spot on the parallel roads across the garden nearby.

*Ambience* the vibe here is typical south Bengaluru stand and eat, perfect for a quick snack and coffee grab! Be prepared for crowds and queues, especially on the weekends.

*Prices* are really reasonable considering the taste and quality of the food.

Must check out this food place when you're around Banashankari.

I’ve been eating at SLV coffee bar since the late 1990s and it’s still my go-to for quick, no-nonsense South Indian food.

*Idly + Chutney* is excellent - soft, fluffy idlys and that chutney hits the right spot every time. Fair warning though: they don’t serve sambar, only chutney, so if you’re a sambar person, plan accordingly.

*Coffee* is proper darshini-style - strong, frothy, and exactly what you want with your breakfast. *Service is super quick*, true to the darshini setup. You order, you get it, you’re out - perfect for mornings when you’re in a rush.

*Medu Vada* is very good - crisp outside, soft inside. *Khara Bath* and the other South Indian snacks are always served fresh and taste delicious.

Been coming here for 25+ years and the consistency hasn’t dropped. If you want authentic, fast, fuss-free South Indian breakfast, SLV still delivers.

Recently visited SLV for breakfast, and it was a wonderful experience. The idlis were incredibly soft, fresh, and melted in the mouth. The chutney was flavorful and paired perfectly with the breakfast. We also ordered Kara Bath and Vada, and both tasted really good. Everything was served hot and fresh, which made the meal even more enjoyable.

The prices are quite reasonable, making it a great place for a quick breakfast. The food quality and taste are definitely worth trying. The only suggestion I have is regarding the seating and crowd management. During weekends, the place gets extremely crowded, and it becomes difficult to find a place to sit. If they could arrange more seating or manage the crowd better, the overall experience would be much more comfortable. Apart from that, it's an excellent place for a tasty and satisfying South Indian breakfast. Highly recommended!

This is one of the legendary joints. I always intend to have my breakfast here whenever I am in this side of the city. Tried Idly-Vada ,masala Dosa and filter Coffee. All are served fresh and really tasty. Good value for money. I would recommend the masala Dosa and the Coffee.

Shri Lakshmi Venkateshwara Coffee Bar is not merely a place to eat; it is a living chapter of Bengaluru’s culinary heritage. One of the city’s oldest and most cherished establishments, this coffee bar has stood the test of time by doing one simple thing exceptionally well—serving honest, soulful South Indian food with unwavering consistency.

The idlis here deserve special mention. Soft, cloud-like, and perfectly steamed, they soak up flavours beautifully and set the tone for a truly satisfying meal. Paired with their legendary chutneys, every bite feels comforting and nostalgic. The masala dosa is another clear winner—golden, crisp on the outside, yet delicately soft within, generously filled and cooked to perfection. Their Golden Roast crispy dosa, in particular, is a showstopper: thin, evenly roasted, audibly crisp, and bursting with flavour, it reflects years of mastery over the art of dosa-making.

What truly elevates this place, however, is the chutney. The gatti chutney is rich, bold, and textured, while the neer chutney is light, fluid, and refreshingly balanced. Together, they create a harmonious contrast that complements every dish on the plate. The vade is crunchy on the outside, soft and airy inside, with just the right seasoning—exactly how a classic vada should be.

Beyond the staples, the menu offers comforting favourites like avalakki, flavourful palao, aromatic khara bath, and perfectly balanced kesari bath, each prepared with care and traditional finesse. To conclude the meal, their filter coffee is outstanding—strong, aromatic, and served piping hot, leaving a lingering, satisfying finish.

Shri Lakshmi Venkateshwara Coffee Bar is a timeless institution that continues to win hearts across generations. If you wish to experience authentic Bengaluru breakfast culture in its purest form, this place is an absolute must-visit.

name: The Terrace at Gilly's Redefined
review_texts: The service was not at all good. I agree it was too crowded but the staff were showing so much impatience . When we asked for the detailing of items like we wanted to know before ordering they were too frustrated . Also it took lot of time to get the food and even the bill. Then dance floor was nice and the bar counter staffs were also good . Its over rated i would say

Disappointing to mention here that, This guys post Kannada, Tamil, Telugu night in BMS under gillys brand. One you reach there they will route you to Silly Bar which is located in ground floor - Yes you heard it right the name if the bar it self is silly - As the name suggests here Ambience is silly, Menu is silly and coming to DJ it’s double silly with one centre speaker and 4 small speakers(they are calling it DJ) with some silly lights 😆😆 and coming to the service then comes the core of silly.
Had a terrible experience here, No point in visiting this silly bar in the name of Gilly’s(Never expected from you this Gilly’s)

Went here for T 20 screening.
Jeffrey was very attentive to all our requests gave our order pretty fast and even played our favourite music after the event.
He is really good and his assistance is commendable.

The terrace at Gilly's redefined is an exclusive rooftop bar and kitchen with huge open roof space for seating, events or dance floor and a +1 floor large seating space.
They serve amazing food and drinks and their presentation is just beautiful.
Loved the desserts as well.
Good service and good vibe.
Its quiet good place... As dance floor is at rooftop feels good... But sound not up to the mark... Space is also not enough... But it's not bad... We went Friday night still less crowd...

name: Coffee Confessions
review_texts:
If you're looking for a cozy café in Bangalore, Coffee Confessions in Doddathoguru is definitely worth a visit. The ambience is warm and inviting, making it a perfect place to relax, catch up with friends, or even work for a few hours. The coffee is rich and flavorful, and the food menu offers plenty of delicious options to choose from.

What really stands out is the friendly staff and quick service. The presentation of both drinks and food is impressive, and the overall atmosphere has a charming, welcoming vibe. Whether you're a coffee lover or simply searching for a comfortable hangout spot, Coffee Confessions delivers a great experience.

Highly recommended for anyone in and around Electronic City. A great place to unwind and enjoy good food, great coffee, and a wonderful atmosphere! ☕✨

The place had a great ambience with aesthetic vibes, tried both pasta varieties the red sauce was quite good, while the white sauce turned out to be very bland and not something to recommend. Overall, it’s a decent spot to relax, vibe, and have a good conversation.

Pros: Its a nice place with good ambience. The service was good, not crowded. Employees are courteous.

Cons:
1. The bathroom cleanliness was acceptable, but I would expect it to be maintained better.
2. The AC duct was leaking water, which left the floor wet and could be a safety concern.
3. It would be great if customers were served water in glass tumblers instead of plastic glasses.
4. Consider keeping pepper and salt in small dispensers/jars on each table rather than providing them in individual packets. This would improve the overall dining experience and reduce waste.

I visited for the first time watching reviews. But I felt its fake. Worst Food taste not even worth a penny. You can get better food in bakery or small cafes. Money is affordable but not even worth a penny. The guy who serve and bill, said me to wait for 5-10 mints as pan was over for pizza. We said ok, we will wait. But he made us to wait for 2hours I said him to cancel and give other food atleast as I was soo hungry. He gave mint mocktail completely sour and bitter could take it.. Oh god he gave worst service.. Later after 2 hrs he gave pizza which was burnt out and cheese is local cheese yaak. Felt to vomit dude.. Got vomiting.. Hot chocolate was like boost pathetic.
Affordable with cheap spoiled materials. Don't spoil your health guys… I won't recommend anyone here.
Nice ambience , good coffee and humble service. Manisha does provide very good service

name: Stories Bar & Kitchen - Rajajinagar
review_texts:
Recently visited Stories for lunch and had a good experience overall. We ordered the Homemade Chicken Nachos, Kerala Special Chicken, and Chicken Noodles. The funny part was that the “Kerala Special Chicken” turned out to be more like a chicken kebab—but it tasted really good, so no complaints! The chicken noodles were also tasty.

The washroom was clean and hygienic, and the overall place was well maintained. Since we visited in the afternoon, we couldn’t fully enjoy the ambience. I feel the place would look much more beautiful at night with all the colorful lighting.

A big plus was the valet parking, which made the visit convenient.

One suggestion to the management: the staff who took our order and served the food had difficulty communicating in both Kannada and English, which made ordering a little challenging. Also, the food was simply placed on the table without being served. Improving communication and service etiquette would make the overall dining experience even better.

Overall, the food was delicious, and I’d definitely love to visit again in the evening to enjoy the ambience. 🍽️✨

We visited this place on a Wednesday night for dinner, and it wasn’t very crowded, which made the experience quite comfortable. They have separate smoking and non-smoking areas, which is a great feature. The overall aesthetics of the place are really nice.
However, there were quite a few mosquitoes, possibly because of the indoor water features or plants (not entirely sure), which was a bit annoying.
Coming to the service, it was good, and the food was decent for the price.
We ordered Chicken Manchurian Soup, which was perfect in taste and had a generous quantity. Next, we tried the Bangalore-style Chicken Beloli Kebab, which was excellent and served with mint chutney that complemented it well. Finally, we had a Chicken Pizza, which was also really good.
Overall, I would rate this place 4 out of 5.

Stories Bar & Kitchen in Rajajinagar is a great place to unwind with friends after a long day. The ambience is stylish, with comfortable seating, good lighting, and music that creates a lively atmosphere without being too loud for conversations. The menu offers a good selection of food and drinks, and everything I tried was served fresh with appealing presentation. The staff were friendly, attentive, and happy to recommend items based on our preferences, which made the experience even better. Service was reasonably quick despite the crowd. Prices are on the higher side, but they feel justified considering the quality, location, and overall experience. I also clicked a few original camera photos of the interiors and beautifully presented dishes, and they turned out really nice. Overall, it's an excellent spot for casual meetups, weekend dinners, or celebrating special occasions in a vibrant setting.

I had a wonderful experience at Stories Bar & Kitchen, Rajajinagar. We ordered boiled peanuts, masala cashew crispy, kadai paneer, garlic butter naan, and lacha paratha. The boiled peanuts were a simple yet comforting start, while the masala cashew crispy really stood out – well coated with spices, perfectly crunchy, and addictive with every bite.

The kadai paneer was outstanding – the paneer was soft and fresh, cooked with cubes of onion and capsicum in a flavorful masala that had just the right balance of spice and richness. It paired beautifully with the breads. The garlic butter naan was aromatic, soft, and loaded with butter, while the lacha paratha was layered and flaky, adding a nice variety to the meal.

Overall, everything we tried was excellent, and the dining experience was truly enjoyable. A special mention to Diwakar and Sushant for their attentive and warm service – they really made the evening memorable with their professionalism and hospitality.

Very convenient location. Staffs were very friendly. They have separate smoking and non-smoking area. The food we ordered were very tasty and served hot. Wait time was also less than 15 minutes. The prices were reasonable and the quantity was also good. A must visit place with your loved ones to spend time. Wide variety of food and drinks. The chicken and the fish was fresh and juicy. They also gave us a complimentary red velvet cake. They take 10% service charge but if you want you can remove it..no questions asked. We also got a 50% off for pre booking through Swiggy Gold.

name: Hotel Dwarka
review_texts:
This 55 year old restaurant, undoubtedly, unquestionably, serves the best Khali dose in all of Bengaluru. At times even doctors recommend patients to have dose here. The texture is so Spongy and fluffy with a million pores in it. It's served with 2 dallops of butter & palya upon request & at an extra cost of ₹20, otherwise with just neer chutney. It's simply the best form of dose that you can get. The most surprising part of this is that, the doses are cooked & roasted without a single drop of oil or ghee or butter. It's simply amazing how a humble dose can be so overwhelming in taste.
I was recommended the vade in sambar dip, which was good but not excellent in taste, it's evident that they do not use adulterants to cook these items. Apart from that you get amazing pineapple Kesari bath, avarekaalu uppittu, poori sagu here. Sundays are famous for their carrot halwa. Also, Sundays are famous for the tomato dose that they prepare which apparently isn't available anywhere else across the city.
The perfect ending to this meal is a handsome glass of Filter Coffee. The flavor & temperature is so well achieved with perfection, it just tastes heavenly. This place is always crowded for the taste they provide, it's Bengaluru's pride & legacy on a plate surely!

It is a great place to enjoy classic South Indian breakfast. I tried the khali dosa and masala dosa — both were very tasty, crispy, and well-prepared.
However, on Sundays it gets extremely crowded, and it’s difficult to even find a place to sit. If you’re planning to visit, try going on a weekday or early in the morning to avoid the rush.

This hotel is run by Original Bhat family and needless to say they are experts in the game. It's mostly self service, there is some sitting section also..

You get all variants of the Khaali dosa here (Plain khali, Benne Khali, Khali Sagu,
Khali Palya, Single Khali 😆 etc.)
Can customise according to one's pallette for dosa...

Masala dosa looked yummy.

As usual, Tea is bad here.
Filter Coffee is much sought after..

I had a very disturbing and unacceptable experience with Dwarka Hotel. The food khaki dosa with aloo  palya  I received was contaminated, and I later discovered what appeared to be rat fecal matter in it. Unfortunately, I had already consumed part of the meal before noticing this.

Soon after, I developed immediate health issues and had to seek medical treatment from a doctor. This was not only physically distressing but also mentally very upsetting.

This incident clearly reflects a serious lapse in hygiene and food safety standards. Serving contaminated food is extremely dangerous and cannot be taken lightly. I strongly urge the management to take strict corrective measures and ensure such incidents are never repeated.

I would advise others to be cautious before ordering from here.
Food's tasty, traditional south Indian flavours. Dosa is too good. Plenty other options too. Also loved rava vada. Best sponge khali dosa with butter. Their running chutney was very tasty.

name: Nandhana Palace - Andhra Style Restaurant - Kammanahalli
review_texts:
Again bad experience after 6 months We had stopped visiting because of poor taste ..
In the recent visit, we tried special veg. The biryani which was overcooked and veg gravy was not at all good and even my friends visited from other places. They also did not like and we had to leave the food . Manager Anthony attended us. We informed him about the issue. Major issue was with the delay of beverages which were served after our meals were done and we had ordered ice cream, which didn’t even come till the end. So we cancelled it if you’re visiting visit in your own risk

Tried Nandhana palace after many years.
Got a takeaway of their Supreme chicken boneless biryani. Packing was nearly done.
The quantity of boneless chicken and biryani was good enough for 1 adult and a kid. Easily 1.5 portion of biryani.

I always expect better from reputed places. Unfortunately, my recent Zomato order from here (over ₹1,500) turned out to be one of the most disappointing experiences I've had in a long time.

I ordered Gobi Manchurian, Hyderabadi Veg Biryani, Chicken 65 (boneless), and Hyderabadi Boneless Chicken Biryani. What arrived was unacceptable on every level:

1. Chicken 65 (boneless): Nearly inedible. Almost 90% of the pieces were just skin and fat, hardly any real meat. The little meat that was there was rubbery, dry, and badly overcooked. This feels dishonest and completely unfair for the price paid.

2. Hyderabadi Boneless Chicken Biryani & Hyderabadi Veg Biryani: Both were shockingly poor. The rice was completely bland, tasteless, and had zero seasoning or aroma. There was no flavor whatsoever...it barely qualified as biryani. The texture was mushy and lifeless. Extremely disappointing.

3. Gobi Manchurian: This was the only item that was even remotely acceptable. Everything else was a total failure.

I have attached the bill for reference (total ₹1,521.98). For this amount, the quality fell far, far...FAR below any reasonable standard. I am deeply disappointed and frustrated with such substandard food from a place that carries a famous name.

I demand a full refund of the entire amount immediately. Please treat this seriously and confirm the refund without delay. If a full refund isn't possible, provide a clear explanation and a satisfactory compensatory solution right away.

I stay 5-6km away from the restaurant and the order was delivered within 50 min from the time of order, so distance cannot be a factor for food quality here.

This experience has left me utterly let down. I will not be ordering from here again.

Visited Nandhana Palace, Kammanahalli today. The food was good, and the ambience was pleasant. The taste and pricing were also good.

The only thing I felt could be improved was the service. The staff seemed to be in a hurry. They served the next dish before we had finished the previous one, and even brought the finger bowl before we were done eating, which felt a little rushed.

Overall, it was a good experience. Just a little more attention to the service would make it even better.
Great food and great service! Our servers were Chandra and Shatrugan and they did an incredible job of making us feel comfortable and at home!!

name: Sunrise Bar and Lounge
review_texts: Came here after a really long time. The food prices have increased a lot, but unfortunately the quantity and quality are not worth the price at all. The place was extremely crowded, and many people seemed to be there mainly for photos and the view rather than for the food. The food was served cold, almost saltless, and completely lacked freshness. We even called the waiter but no one came.... We had to order food but because of their  negligence we just felt and went to better place were you get good food.......Food needs attention here Overall, the experience was disappointing. People who like the food here probably haven’t experienced really good food.  Place is good....
Great atmosphere the food can be better with more options

Beautiful ambiance!!!!! Food and is too good.
People who love nature they will definitely love this place.

We visited for lunch.
Five stars for the ambiance.
Feels like dining inside a garden. Its vibrant, photogenic place.
Good seating arrangements on different floors.
Four for the food ( we tried mushroom chilli, Corn Cheese toast and more with cocktails) which tasted fine.
We spent around 2500 for three of us.
Service staff were attentive.
Valet parking service avaliable.

Captain Suresh and Team - fantastic experience for birthday celebrations and family sit out. Mushrooms are just try at the first floor.
Food is delicious and excellent.
Price is good and Oki for food server.

Much recommended.

Special thanks to Sanjay on the hospitality.
Very good service

name: La Casa Brewery + Kitchen
review_texts:
Good place for general dinner and outing. Ambiance is good but has dim light all over dining.
When we visited it was raining, and entire place had water all over near dining area. Tough they were cleaning it again and again, but not a comfortable place while you eat.
Food is good. Service is faster.
They do have valet parking available.

Extremely disappointed with my recent order of cashew curry leaf chicken gravy, chilli egg bhurji, butter naan, and roti. The cashew curry leaf gravy was particularly poor—it lacked flavor and was not palatable at all. Given the high price point, the quality was nowhere near acceptable. I won't be ordering from or dining at this restaurant again.

⭐⭐⭐☆☆

Visited La Casa recently and had a decent overall experience. The beer was definitely the highlight of the visit. The brews were fresh, well-crafted, and enjoyable. If you're someone who likes trying different beers, this place is worth considering.

That said, I felt the food could be improved. It wasn't bad by any means, but it didn't stand out either. When I compare it with places like Bier Library or Roxie, I would say those breweries currently have a stronger food menu and a more memorable dining experience. At La Casa, the food felt average and lacked the wow factor that I usually look for when spending on a brewery outing.

The ambiance is pleasant and comfortable, but the place itself is relatively small compared to many of the newer breweries that have opened in Bangalore over the last few years. Newer venues offer larger spaces, better seating options, and a more vibrant atmosphere for groups and weekend outings.

The pricing is another factor. Since La Casa is priced similarly to Bier Library, Roxie, and some of the other premium breweries in the area, it naturally invites comparison. At the same price point, I personally find myself preferring Bier Library or Roxie because of their stronger food offerings and overall experience.

Having said that, La Casa has one major advantage for me—it's close to home. For a casual evening beer, a quick meetup with friends, or when I don't want to travel far through Bangalore traffic, it's still a convenient option. Overall, it's a decent neighborhood brewery with good beer, but I feel there is room for improvement in the food and overall value proposition.

Went expecting a good food but was disappointed. The appetizers weren't hot, the main dish pasta I ordered was way too greasy and couldn't finish. The lasagne was a good one. The dessert brownie with sizzler icecream was a disappointment again, the brownie wasn't upto the mark and the chocolate syrup was just average.

Overall a disappointing experience.
Great place to hang out with your family and friends. Food varieties are not much but as per the price point worth it. Cozy ambience!

name: McDonald's
review_texts:
The food served here is so pathetic that they are serving only buns with patty n sause not even letues anymore

Worst service not worth visiting and spending such amount of money

The food was nice and hot! But the ladies staffs working in kitchen were extremely noisy and acting wierd, made it uncomfortable.
Only one lady staff was kind and professional. Who was serving the customers.

•	Nice McDonald’s outlet with fast service and friendly staff. The place is clean, and the food quality is always good. Recommended for a quick meal.
•	Good experience! Staff behaviour was polite, order was prepared fast, and the restaurant was well-maintained. I love the service.

Good place for an quick bite and an chit chat with friends. You can also celebrate birthdays with friends. Nice hangout place for friends and family.
