They have renovated this place and the ambience looks so cool with all new changes. They have added extra dishes as well. Parking space is also quite good. They have all 3 options which include dine in, take out and delivery. Just one thing they have compromised the quality of taste of the food which is quite disappointing.

Worst service in this store crispy chicken not boiled properly and service guy wasting french fries and
Other customer I refer Basaveshwara nagar store good service good atmosphere please visit
And don't visit again vijaynagar mc Donald's store guys

Thank you

name: Asha Food Camp Malleshwaram
review_texts:
Asha Food Camp has been a popular spot for simple, homely food, but the experience lately has been quite limited. Due to the ongoing LPG shortage, they are currently serving only a few items from their menu, so most of the usual options are unavailable. It may be better to avoid visiting for now if you are expecting their full menu.
During my visit, the staff also appeared a bit dull and low energy, which made the overall atmosphere feel less welcoming than usual.
If you still decide to visit, you could try their North Indian Thali, which was decent, and the Falooda, which was refreshing. Hopefully once the LPG situation improves, the restaurant will return to its normal variety and service.

The food here is quite good, really tasty! 😋 The service was also prompt and friendly. They also have a separate service hall, which is a nice addition. However, the atmosphere is just okay—nothing particularly special or bad, just a standard dining spot. 👍 It’s a decent place for a quick meal.

Best veg restaurant I have tried till date! All the dishes that we ordered was really good. We had ordered paneer kofta curry methi paratha butter roti plain roti manchow soup thia babycorn fry spring roll leafu fried rice (which we ordered twice because it was so good in taste) and finally finished off with gudbud ice cream😋.

Food is tasty but not very tasty.
Not fully satisfied.
Staff not cooperating.
Staff's way of talking is not good
Panipuri is not ok, pani of panipuri is tasteless.
Rooties r not soft

Top class vegetarian restaurant which serves tasty and delicious food. They have variety of items on menu that include South Indian, Chinese and North Indian dishes. All food items are served with top notch quality, supreme taste. Ambience is quiet  and good vibes inside which is perfect for a relaxing brunch or dinner.  Soup and Dal Kichdi are must try items! One of the hidden gem in Malleshwaram area, would highly recommend this place to everyone

name: Nandhana Palace -Andhra Style Restaurant - Rajajinagar
review_texts:
I had a fairly not bad experience overall with this restro bar.

I started with the Butter Chicken Masala, which was okayish and didn’t really stand out in terms of flavor.
Next, I tried the Andhra Style Chicken Masala. The taste was really good with nice spice and authentic flavor, but it was a bit disappointing in terms of quantity both the gravy and the number of chicken pieces were quite less.
For the main course, the Supreme Boneless Chicken Biryani was the highlight of the meal. It was flavorful, well-cooked, and very satisfying.
Lastly, I ordered the Nandhana Special 555 Biryani, which didn’t live up to expectations. It lacked flavor and felt underwhelming compared to the other dishes.

Overall, it was a decent restro bar experience with one standout dish, but some items could definitely be improved in terms of taste and portion size.

Visited Nandhana Palace – Andhra Style Restaurant, Rajajinagar and had a great experience. The service was very good and everything was well managed from the moment we walked in.

We tried the 555 Chicken Biryani, Special Boneless Biryani, and Andhra Chicken, and the taste was excellent. Among all the Nandhana Palace outlets I’ve visited in Bangalore, this one had the best taste so far.

I was also pleasantly surprised to see that they serve alcohol, which adds to the overall dining experience. The restaurant was clean and well maintained, and the staff handled everything smoothly.

The only small issue was that my Thumbs Up and Fanta were served at room temperature—I would have preferred them cold. Other than that, absolutely no complaints.

Overall, a wonderful meal and a great experience. Will definitely be coming back!

Nandana Palace is a well-known name for Andhra-style cuisine, and my recent visit was a fairly decent experience overall. The food remains the main highlight of this place. The menu offers a good variety of spicy and flavourful Andhra dishes, especially for those who enjoy bold masalas and traditional preparations. The biryani was aromatic and well-cooked, with tender pieces of meat and balanced spices. Starters were served hot and tasted fresh, making them enjoyable. Portion sizes are reasonable for the price, and the food quality is consistent, which is reassuring for repeat visits.

However, the ambiance is where Nandana Palace falls a bit short. While the restaurant is clean and functional, it lacks warmth and aesthetic appeal. The seating arrangement feels slightly cramped during peak hours, and the interiors are quite basic, offering nothing memorable or inviting. It feels more like a quick dining spot rather than a place to relax and enjoy a leisurely meal with family or friends. Noise levels can also rise when the restaurant gets busy, which affects the overall dining comfort.

Service was satisfactory, with staff being responsive and fairly quick to take orders and serve food, though nothing exceptional. Overall, Nandana Palace is a good option if you’re specifically craving authentic Andhra food and prioritise taste over ambiance. With some improvement in interiors and atmosphere, the dining experience could be significantly better. For now, it’s best suited for food-focused visits rather than special occasions or long, relaxed outings.

Last week we friends visited Nandhana Palace. They are famous for their Andhra-style biryani, and we tried three different types — all were super 👌. We also ordered a starter named Chicken Kshatriya, which tasted really good. The biryani quantity was generous — one portion is easily enough for two people. Service was okay, and the ambience was also fine. Overall, a nice place to enjoy authentic Andhra-style biryani with friends and family.

Recent visit to this place was truly very disappointing. Had seated in the 1st floor. The service is very very slow. Had ordered for few mutton starters and chicken starter with chicken soup and like soda. Each item they served had a delay off 15 mins. The fresh lime soda and coke came after we ate all the starters, after repeatedly asking for it. The most disappointing aspect was when he brought the mutton biryani and it was cold. It was totally unacceptable to eat cold mutton biryani. When you order home delivery you get more hot mutton biryani. Had to call the person who took the order and re sent it to make it hot. Never expected such callous service at this place. They either have no idea how to serve or they lack the basic training. Taste too is very disappointing. Soup was decent and apt. Mutton cheema balls too was good expect that it could have been served better hot. Chicken 65 served too was below standard and was small pieces like we left over chicken, with no proper chicken piece. Never expected this below par service, taste and quality from this resturant.  Hope the management rectify their standards.

name: Skyye
review_texts:
One of the oldest roof top pubs in Bengaluru. I've been going there since 2011 and it never gets old. The food is excellent, I loved the California rolls, grilled prawn and their burgers.

The view during sun set is spectacular and it's worth getting a seat near the edge, although, it gets freezing cold, it's highly recommended that you pack yourself to keep warm.

There is a cover charge on entry which is redeemable/minused on the total bill. For a couple on a Friday night we were charged Rs 2,500. The staff get very busy during peak hours and it could be pretty tough to get hold of them.

If you just go for the food, ambience and the experience it will be pretty light on your pocket. Purchasing of any alcoholic beverages will get increase your bill significantly.

The indoor lounge is calm and soft feels just like a regular place. Prior booking of table is a MUST! as tables are very difficult to get during the weekends. Paying through zomato or swiggy may reduce your total bill due to discounts sometimes, so its worth checking.

I recently visited Skyye and overall, it was a good experience, but not without its flaws.

The place definitely stands out for its aesthetics - the rooftop vibe, lighting, and overall ambience are beautiful. It felt quite peaceful, probably because we visited on a weekday, so it wasn’t too crowded. If you're going purely for the vibe and pictures, it does deliver.

Coming to the food, it was decent but not perfect. We had to switch our order twice, which was a bit frustrating. Eventually, we tried the chicken pasta, feta cheese dish, fruit melon bowl, and a salad. The taste was good, nothing exceptional, but satisfactory.

Where the place really fell short was the service. It wasn’t up to the mark for a place of this level. The delays and order issues made it feel a bit overhyped.

Honestly, Skyye feels more like a place you should visit during weekends or late evenings when the party vibe is on. That’s probably when the ambience truly shines. On a regular weekday, it feels a bit underwhelming.

Overall: good aesthetics, decent food, average service – more hype than substance unless you time your visit right.

Lovely place. Nice location. Plenty of parking in basements
Chicken ghee roast was excellent. Fish sticks were ok. Butter chicken was good too.
In the open air area, you get a lovely view. You can see Kingfisher tower.

Amazing Experience.

This place has all the green ticks as per my experience.

Ambience 5/5 - The best part is ambience. We loved the ambience of the place. Open space for dance, good musice, amazing Bengaluru weather is what you get here.. They have indoor space also if it rains for bigger groups.

Taste 4.5/5 - Starters were really good and tasty. Main course was okay.

Service 5/5 - They have really good staff who is flexible and supports with requests.

Overall I loved the experience of this place and would definitely revisit.

Prices are on a higher side for the overall package as well and I would recommend booking in advance if you are visiting on weekends.
Best place for a date. The view is amazing, and the food is really good.

name: Levels Pub & Kitchen
review_texts:
Levels Pub is a great place to catch up with friends. It has a really nice, cozy seating setup and a relaxed ambiance that makes it easy to spend a few hours here.

The food was tasty and reasonably priced, offering good value for money. Overall, it’s a pleasant spot with good food, a comfortable atmosphere, and one I’d definitely recommend visiting.

Anyone can love by seeing uploaded photos same also happened with me, but real story is when you visit here you can realise, i ordered crispy American corn, chicken tandoori, tandoori wings and Pomfret fish and some mocktails and some drinks. As per hypes i didn't find good taste with these food items and fish was very bad don't order Pomfret here there is no strong beer available only lager beer and there is no professional DJ and sound also not good at all you'll feel bored , if you want  only drink then fine . But in opinion you can find many other places compare to this price and you want spend quality talk with drinks then better you can choose other pubs or  you want to drink  then go for local bar you can find good food and MRP price also. Waste of money.

Definitely one of the best spot to hangout. 😊The food is definitely amazing & the service is great too. The staff is supportive & professional. The veg & non-veg was literally worth it. The dimsums, corn cheese balls, pizzas, chicken biryani & starters were the best in taste and quantity is reasonable too.
One should definitely pay a visit once and try.🙌🏼👌🏼
Went for a lunch. The Chicken ghee roast, chicken pepper fry, Kundapur chicken curry, Neer dosa, chicken kuruchan, tender coconut payasam were excellent. Service was good and atmosphere was great

Levels Pub & Kitchen in JP Nagar is a vibrant, multi-story destination that perfectly captures Bangalore’s energetic nightlife. Spanning several floors, it offers a versatile experience. Known for its extensive multi-cuisine menu. It is a top pick for large group celebrations, corporate outings, and sports enthusiasts looking for live screenings. While the atmosphere is electric and the service is generally efficient.

name: Skyline Pizzeria Bakery and Cafe
review_texts:
This is a wonderful place to relax and spend quality time with family and friends. The ambience is pleasant, comfortable, and perfect for casual gatherings or small celebrations.

I have visited this place twice already, mainly because of the great taste, reasonable prices, and excellent service. The food is delicious, and the menu offers good value for money. I highly recommend trying the Cheese & Corn Regular Pizza, which is incredibly tasty and available at an affordable price of just ₹119.

For beverages, the Blue Lagoon and Classic Mojito are must-tries. Both are refreshing, flavorful, and reasonably priced at just ₹99. They pair perfectly with the food and enhance the overall dining experience.

The restaurant also offers a variety of cakes, desserts, and other delicious items worth exploring. It's an ideal spot for celebrating birthdays and small gatherings, comfortably accommodating around 4 to 8 people.

Overall, this place stands out for its combination of great taste, affordable pricing, and inviting ambience. I will definitely be visiting again and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a good dining experience.

My visit here was really nice. The food was full of flavor and definitely worth it — every bite felt satisfying. 🍕 The ambiance was calm and pleasant, making it a comfortable place to sit and enjoy. The service was attentive and added to the overall good experience. 💖 Overall, it’s a place that balances good food and a relaxed vibe really well. ✨😋

I visited Skyline Pizzeria & Bakery and tried their pizza, fries and cold coffee. All the items were freshly prepared and tasted really good. The pizza had a perfect balance of cheese and toppings, the fries were crispy, and the cold coffee was refreshing. The place is budget-friendly, so you can enjoy good food without spending too much. The ambience is calm and comfortable for hanging out with friends or spending some time alone. Service was also quick and polite. Overall, a great spot for food lovers at an affordable price. Highly recommended! 🍕✨

1. Its value for money restaurant.
2. Korean veg pizza is awesome
3. Aloo Paneer Roll is also good
4. It has two wheeler parking
5. Sizzler ice cream and brownies are yum as well

I visited Skyline Pizzeria Bakery and Cafe quite some time ago and realized I never got around to posting a review. The food here is surprisingly good for the price, offering excellent value for money. The quality and taste easily exceed expectations considering how affordable the menu is.

One thing that stands out is how popular the place is. On 2–3 weekend visits, it was so crowded that I couldn't find a table and had to leave. However, on weekdays, the café is much less crowded, making it a far more comfortable experience.

Overall, if you're looking for delicious food at budget-friendly prices, this place is definitely worth trying. I'd recommend visiting on weekdays to avoid the rush and enjoy the experience better.

name: Barbeque Nation- Yelahanka
review_texts:
We recently visited Barbeque Nation on a Sunday. For 6 people (3 veg & 3 non-veg), the total bill came to around ₹4,500.

First thing—this place is definitely more suitable for non-veg lovers. Veg options felt quite limited for the price. Veg starters included paneer, mushroom, and sweet corn (crispy corn was actually very tasty), but most items were just variations of the same ingredients.

On the non-veg side, they served chicken, fish, prawns, and mutton.

Chicken was good 👍

Fish was average

Prawns were okay

Mutton pieces were very small and honestly tasted more like soya/milmaker than real mutton

Coming to the buffet (self-service):

Chicken biryani had almost no chicken

Chicken curry & fish curry were available

Egg fried rice was decent

Very limited egg-based dishes (they should add more)

Mutton kurma was there but nothing special

Veg gravies and fry items were quite limited

Desserts were basic:

Only vanilla & strawberry ice cream

2 types of cakes

Gulab jamun (good) + one more sweet

Pani puri was unlimited

Fruits, sprouts, curd rice, and salads were available

Major concern:
We found a ⚠️cockroach stuck to the kulfi stick, which was very disappointing and concerning. Hygiene needs serious attention. I strongly suggest checking food items properly before eating.

Service was fast and staff were polite. Soft drinks are charged separately. They offer a free cake for birthdays or special occasions.

Final Verdict:
Average experience overall. Not worth the price for veg customers, and hygiene issues make it worse. If you still want to visit, book early for discounts and be cautious with food.

After the completion of every tiring project, my partner and I have a set way to unwind and celebrate - visit any branch of ‘Barbeque Nation.’ Following the successful and high-profile conduction of ‘Wavelength 2026,’ the flagship media conclave of the ‘Department of Liberal Arts, Humanities and Social Science’ (DLHS) under the Bengaluru Campus of ‘Manipal Academy of Higher Education’ on the 5th and 6th of February 2026 (Thursday and Friday), we booked a slot at the Yelahanka Branch of ‘Barbeque Nation’ on February 7, 2026 (Saturday). We reached on time and ordered for the zero-spice barbeques – exactly what we have been doing at all branches of ‘Barbeque Nation’ over the years and across the country. While it took a bit of time in preparing our preferred variety of the barbeques, it arrived all right! As usual and more so, all the barbeques were super tasty. The iconic fried corn was excellent as usual. The main course was also lavish and quite varied. Particularly, the dessert items were better than many of the other branches that I have visited in Bengaluru. Overall, we got exactly what we were looking for - a good sound meal! Keep up the good work folks! You were, are, and will be then best when it comes to feeding your customers! Will we visit this outlet again? Hell no! There are many other unvisited branches of ‘Barbeque Nation’ throughout Bengaluru. Let us visit those first before coming here again!

We had such an amazing time at Barbeque Nation, Yelahanka, and it truly turned into one of our most memorable dining experiences! From the moment we entered, the atmosphere was warm, lively, and welcoming.
The food? Absolutely outstanding! 🔥
The chicken leg pieces were perfectly grilled — juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Every bite was delicious! But the real highlight for me was the chicken fried rice. They specially prepared it for us, and honestly, I still can’t forget that taste. It was perfectly seasoned, aromatic, and simply irresistible. I loved it!
And how can I not mention the desserts! 😍
The gulab jamuns were soft, warm, and melted in the mouth — easily one of the best I’ve ever had. The pastries were fresh, creamy, and beautifully presented. The dessert section was a dream!
A very special thanks to Mr. Jabbar Sir 🙏
He was extremely kind, polite, and attentive throughout our visit. He personally kept coming to our table, asking what we wanted, and made sure we were comfortable and happy. His service was exceptional and truly made our experience extra special.
All the staff members were very kind, friendly, and professional. Their hospitality made our day joyful and happier. ❤️
Highly recommended for anyone who loves good food and great service!
We will definitely visit again!

Had a very bad experience there, at first I used the district Zomato app in order to reserve table and to get discount of 25 percent. When we reached the place we found no one at the reception as the entrance was overcrowded so I had to go inside to ask the person to come upto reception furthermore they did not have any verification mechanisms to check whether u have reserved a table or not as they were writing our entry in a small notebook. This made the people who had already reserved a table to wait for a long long time. The staff who were serving  us were very polite but some food items such as noodles and fried rice were not good at alll as half of the items were not refilled there which also includes washed plates felt like they were understaffed because I used to see good number of washed plates in other outlets. After eating we had to wait for an hour to get the bill so I asked my parents to leave as I was waiting to pay the bill and the person shows with just an calculator in his hand randomnly calculating the bill. So it was 3350 when I insisted to pay through district Zomato which would have become 2500 eventually but they were like it’s not working at all insated they handed me a coke as a complementary when I asked for the discount. And at last the service said “u can visit us next time and I will make sure to get u the discount “ as if he would rember the face of the customers he get. As  i didn’t get the bill at all which is not professional

We decided to go for a family outing to Barbeque Nation as they had all come down to Bangalore for a break and that was the worst decision we took going the Yelahnka branch. It was so chaotic and overall the place was so filthy and unhygienic. They were severely understaffed and they were having so much difficulty to even provide the basis starters on the table. Infact we had to get our coal changed multiple times that we just finally gave up. Also they had shortage of cutlery as well as the main course. The food quality has dropped so drastically that I will never take a chance of visiting any branch. The staff also made excuses where they didn’t expect so many people to come in and they got so many reservations from multiple platforms. They definitely have a system in place to block bookings as when we tried to book at 8:30PM there were no available slots and we had to book for a 9:00PM slot. Unfortunately there is no option to give a negative rating.

name: Tipsy Bull- The Bar Exchange
review_texts: This is a really fun place.. absolutely loved their food and service.. and pricing is also so less really hard to believe

Spam be careful.

Have attached the photo. Came here through one dating app.

N Girl ordered 30 ml Royal solute drink which cost in the menu around 1999/- n I did not notice while she ordered n she ordered around 4 to 5 glass n I have ordered 1 cocktail n when bill came it was around 30k

I'm really suprised with bill. Later got to know through my friend it was spam. What to say to girl she was like child like perfecty trained what to talk.

Hate such experience and want to tell people if anyone of you got match through dating app and if girl wanted you to meet near ICICI bank n wanted to come neaby this location be careful.

If you see menu of restaurants it is not even matching with menu.

It was complete scam and how this restaurants is involved in such activities.

Will raise this to all new people coming to banglore n existing ones.

Be careful.

And restaurants owner will see u later in future but not now.

Tipsy Bull had such a fun and unique concept! The alcohol prices fluctuate like the stock market, so you can actually grab drinks at super affordable prices if you time it right. They also have small plates starting at just ₹129, which makes it a great spot for budget-friendly hangouts. Loved the vibe, music, and overall energy of the place — perfect for chilling with friends over good food and drinks.

Visited Typsy Restaurant recently and really enjoyed it. The ambience is vibrant and perfect for a chill evening. We tried a few dishes and everything tasted fresh and well-prepared. The staff were polite and attentive especially ( MR Santosh ) he helped a lot, which made the experience even better. Prices are reasonable for the quality. Would definitely recommend!
Tipsy Bull has great vibes, tasty food, and well-crafted drinks. Friendly service and a fun atmosphere make it a perfect spot to relax and hang out. Highly recommended!

name: TBC Sky Lounge - Kadubisanahalli- Marathahalli Outer Ring Road | Fabulous Terrace Lounge- Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
review_texts:
We had reserved rooftop searing and it was chill and good. Food was good as well. Service was also good.. but serving the food took extra time, but itvwas worth the wait. No complaints except for their washroom.. outside everything was fine and topnotch.. but their ladies room was of substandards.
It was conjested and one of them did not had handle as well. Everything else was good, but in then end the restroom broke my heart. If u can have just the food then i wud suggest you to go here, if u want to use washroom as well, then probably u can search a different restaurant. Because for premium food and premium ambience, the washroom quality did not match.

Very nice place, nice ambience, great food , in the heart of Marathahalli, have good offers on zomato and they suggest good choices. Biplob is great he helped with the order and served with patience and smile on face. All the staff is good and polite and helpful. Near and clean area and washroom. Great music also not too loud and too low. Little needed privacy is there. Good for family and friends gatherings. Safe area. Nice decorations and lights. Good for photos.

I visited TBC Sky Lounge for a Sunday noon lunch, and honestly, the experience fell far below expectations. The moment I walked in, the interiors felt outdated and in real need of a refresh. What put me off even more were the chairs — several of them had visible stains and didn’t feel clean, which really affects the overall comfort.
I ordered the Schezwan noodles, hoping for a flavourful meal, but the dish was overpowered by the strong aroma of star anise. It completely overshadowed the Schezwan taste and made it difficult to enjoy.
Overall, the visit was quite disappointing. With better maintenance, cleaner seating, and improved attention to flavour balance, the place could definitely do better — but for now, it didn’t work for me.

Food is really Good. Loved the music and ambience. Biplob has such a good service. Really enjoyed the vibe. The food was also good. I loved the Spanish ice-cream and we got chocolate ice-cream as complimentary. And even loved the pan tossed chicken in starter and pakka noddles was also tasty. Loved the pasta too. Such a good vibe.

They have the worse manager and staff, when I told one of dish’s chicken was smelling they took it without consent and given other item of their choice and the quantity reduces to 3 pieces of checkin as if we are bagger. We throw all food there paid 3200 for 2 people. This shows their mentality towards customer. Cheap people cheap mentality cheap food and atmosphere. I was with my wife but their behaviour was so irritating specially manager  I was so pissed of seeing their faces. When I already spent 3200 does it even make sense they taking my food without asking permission and replacing with other dish and giving 3 piece of chicken(less then half) saying I already ate 2 pieces from previous dish was the idiotic act and ill thinking never experienced such thing in last 25 years of my stay in Bangalore.

name: Oyster, Bar & Kitchen
review_texts:
I went here on a Saturday afternoon with my family. It was pretty jam packed with people and the staffs were quite busy. In the afternoon the ambiance felt okayish. Service was decent enough.

The food items were good. We ordered crispy corn, kalmi kebab, chicken momo, papdi chat, half n half pizza and a sundae. All of them were good, specially the pizza.

Overall it was a good experience for us.

Went for dinner on a saturday night.
To start with.. parking is a big issue even for bikes.
Would recommend to book a table and go. Its mostly crowded. Ambience is nice.. lots of plants all around the outlet.
Service is very slow. Staffs are very nice.
Food was good.. we ordered momo, chicken mallai kebab for starters which were good.. moctails were good.
For main course schezwan noodles and kumg pao rice was good but chicken manchurian was okok.. not that great.

Some restaurants simply serve food, while others create an experience—and Oyster Bar & Restaurant definitely belongs to the latter.

From the moment we walked in, the vibrant ambiance and warm hospitality made us feel comfortable. Being pet-friendly was a lovely surprise, making it a great spot for families and pet lovers alike.

The menu is a dream for food enthusiasts, offering everything from delicious duck preparations to an impressive selection of fresh seafood. Every dish we ordered had its own unique character. The Ghee Roast Duck was the highlight of the evening—succulent, flavorful, and perfectly coated with aromatic spices. The Butter Garlic Prawns were fresh, tender, and bursting with rich buttery goodness. The Crab Toast was crispy on the outside with a deliciously flavorful filling, while the Crispy Corn was light, crunchy, and impossible to stop munching on.

What made the experience even better was the attentive and friendly staff, who ensured everything was served perfectly and made us feel genuinely welcome.

If you're looking for a place that combines amazing food, fresh seafood, unique duck dishes, a relaxed atmosphere, and the bonus of being pet-friendly, Oyster Bar & Restaurant is a place you'll want to visit again and again. Every bite was memorable, and we left with happy hearts, full stomachs, and wonderful memories...

Went to this resto-pub with my colleagues for my farewell, and it honestly turned out to be the perfect send-off

The vibe was just right—good music, great ambience, and a place where you can actually talk and laugh without shouting over noise. The food didn’t disappoint either, and the drinks menu had enough options for everyone to enjoy.

What made it special though was how comfortable and easy everything felt. The staff were friendly, service was smooth, and we could just focus on spending quality time together.

Rooftop so you can escape the summer heat with some warm breeze along with your food. They say would can work as well here but I with the music being played I'm not too sure if that's going to work out. It's pet friendly and they offer food for them as well. The food is decent. They have a variety of cuisines. You can get ur sandwiches, bar bites, breakfast specials, etc... The chicken lollipop was drenched in too much sauce. The fried rice and noodles were good. Must say the quantity is pretty good. They really need to do something about the flies issue. It's just annoying especially when you are trying to eat and swat them away. The service is slow and waiters are friendly but awkward at times. It is an upscale place so pricewise on the higher side. I would visit this place during the evenings for that rooftop vibe.

name: Anand Sweets - Whitefield
review_texts:
Purani Dilli offers a satisfying overall experience with flavors that largely live up to expectations, though there are a couple of areas that could use some attention. The food, in general, is enjoyable and well-prepared, capturing the essence of North Indian street-style cuisine. The masala puri, while tasty, leans slightly on the heavier side in terms of spice and seasoning. For those who prefer a more balanced or lighter masala, it might feel a bit overwhelming after a few bites. That said, the quality of ingredients and freshness are evident, and the rest of the menu items we tried were well-executed and flavorful.

The ambiance and service inside the establishment were pleasant, contributing to a comfortable dining experience. However, the biggest drawback during our visit was related to parking management. The watchman seemed unaware of the actual parking availability, which led to confusion and miscommunication. Unfortunately, this resulted in an unpleasant interaction with another customer who believed we had taken up a spot incorrectly. This situation could have easily been avoided with better coordination and clarity regarding parking space allocation.

While such incidents may not reflect the overall quality of the restaurant itself, they do impact the customer experience significantly. A little more organization and communication from the staff handling parking would go a long way in ensuring a smoother visit for guests.

Overall, Purani Dilli delivers on taste and variety, making it a place worth visiting for its food. With some improvements in external management, especially parking coordination, the experience could become much more seamless and enjoyable.

Anand Sweets offers a wide variety of delicious sweets along with a comfortable dining experience. The shop features an extensive selection of  sweet varieties, beautifully packed gift hampers, and festive gift wraps perfect for every special occasion.
In addition to sweets, they also serve savory snacks and freshly prepared dishes in their dine-in area. Known for quality ingredients and rich flavors, Anand Sweets is a popular destination for celebrations, family gatherings, and corporate gifting.

Ordered noodles + chilli paneer combo. Duplicate paneer is being used. Not sure if this was only once or happens on daily basis was paneer was duplicate as I consume paneer twice-thrice a week and very well know the taste of orginal and duplica. In photo also you can see how it looks.

📍 Anand Sweets | Whitefield, Bangalore

For anyone craving authentic North Indian flavours in Bangalore, Anand Sweets in Whitefield continues to be a dependable and much-loved destination. It’s a place that delivers consistency, comfort, and familiarity—visit after visit.

🌶️ Food & Taste

We tried a good mix of their offerings, and everything lived up to expectations.
•	The winter special – makke ki roti and sarson ka saag was the clear highlight: rustic, flavourful, and wonderfully authentic, just the way it should be.
•	Their regular thali is equally impressive—well-balanced, satisfying, and a great representation of classic North Indian home-style food.
•	The chaat items were fresh and well assembled, and the jalebi was crisp on the outside, soft inside, and perfectly syrupy.

Across categories—meals, chaat, and sweets—the taste was consistent, comforting, and reliable.

🧼 Hygiene & Cleanliness

As expected from Anand Sweets, hygiene standards are top-notch. The outlet is clean, well organised, and inspires confidence, especially for dine-in and chaat items.

💰 Pricing & Value for Money

Prices are fair and justified for the quality, portion sizes, and overall experience. You get solid value for money, especially given the consistency in taste.

🧑‍🍳 Service & Speed

Service is efficient and professional, handling orders smoothly even during busy hours.

🌟 Overall Experience

Anand Sweets, Whitefield, stands out as a reliable go-to spot for North Indian food in Bangalore. Whether it’s seasonal specials, a wholesome thali, or quick chaat and sweets, this outlet delivers with reassuring consistency.

Final Verdict:
⭐ 4.5/5 – A highly dependable North Indian food destination in Whitefield. Comforting flavours, good hygiene, and consistent quality make it a repeat-visit place.

💡 Pro Tip:
Don’t miss the makke ki roti and sarson ka saag during winters, and always leave room for jalebi.

This is a very nice place to have vegetarian food and sweets in Whitefield. We have been here quite a few times, trying various food items like Corn Cheese Balls, French fries, Samosa chaat, Noodles, Aloo Paratha, Gobi Paratha, Pav Bhaaji, Jalebi, Lassi and others. The quality of the food is really great and the service is good too. Overall, it has been a nice experience here each time, and I would definitely recommend this place to everyone.

name: Gillys Restobar
review_texts: The restaurant is located at a busy area. It's located on three levels. We went to the topmost level which is not air-conditioned. The view from this level is breathtaking. There's greenery to be seen all around, however, the glass panes which form the outer wall are dusty which detracts from the beauty of the greenery all around. Food is good, service is fair, prices are reasonable. Furniture and settings are old and desperately need a makeover. Recommended for good food, reasonable price and the view.

One among the outlets of Gilly's chain. A good place in terms of the food and ambience but lacks service at par of other such outlets.
We visited here on a Sunday noon and got a good seating of our choice. It wasn't crowded when we visited but still it took time for our ordered items to be served. Felt like staff lacked the training yet were courteous to us. Should thank their staff named Guru who ensured quick service after initial hickups.
We ordered a variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian items and drinks as well. All of it tastes really good which makes me give 4 stars despite the slow service. Would certainly look forward in visiting their other outlets.
The location is easily accessible by public transport but parking might be a concern. A respite is that they have valet service.

Nice place to hang out with friends , a bit costly but the food and drinks are right on the mark in taste. Really worth it. Good staff as well and a nice tree canopy view from the pub makes it worth a visit. The place hasnt changed. Much as i noticed it during recent visit..so the 5 star rating stays. Lovely as i knew it

While the entrance and lift may feel a little on the shadier side, the place itself was quite okay. We sat on the top floor, it was windy, open & cool on a hot summer afternoon. We ordered their peri peri chicken wings which were perfect, crispy, slightly spicy, really well made. Their fried rice was the regular, good kind of fried rice with generous chunks of chicken & egg, the lemongrass chicken tikka didn't have any lemongrass flavour but was tender and delicious. The velvet touch mocktail was too sweet, the mango basil drink was better.

It's a spacious restaurant.
The view is amazing!
Food was very very bad.

We ordered :

Garlic naan : Too hard, couldn't tear it apart with two hands.

Kulcha : I dipped it in gravy, let it soak for a while and then could cut it.

Paneer Manchurian : Quantity of paneer was good, taste was excellent.

Nachos : Thicker than the normal crunchy ones, few of them weren't fully baked

Wine Sangria : Too much cranberry

Overall :

Food : 1/5
Ambiance : 4/5
Service : 5/5

name: Truffles - Kalyan Nagar
review_texts:
This is a continental fast food joint. Most items served here are finely made and tastes authentic. Flavor profiles used here are excellent and the dishes are cooked just right.

Seating is cramped and tables are small but acceptable because of the kind of joint it is. The place is always full and is sometimes crowded.

One toilet available but it's kept clean and usable.

No parking available nearby. The paid parking lot diagonally opposite to this place can be used.

Visited on a Sunday evening. There was minimal wait time but the table provided was in the corner and the air conditioning was poor. I was sweating due to this. Ordered Fish and Chips which was very oily. The regular size Chicken Rocky Road burger with brioche bun. The burger was very heavy and I couldn't finish it. Passion fruit juice had no real passion fruit and they used artificial sweetened syrup instead. Also there was only 1 small restroom for such a large crowd of more than 200 -250 people inside the restaurant. The service was decent but the server didn't know the name of the dishes properly. They need to be trained better. The prices were also high and it cost 2 people more than 1500 rupees. Overall a decent experience.

Visited Truffles today and really enjoyed the food. We ordered pinky pasta, pesto grilled chicken, chicken lasagna, chicken bao, French fries and french toast. Food was delicious and worth the hype. Only felt that the chicken bao could have been better.However, the restaurant felt quite crowded, and the seating space is limited, making it a bit uncomfortable during peak hours. Great taste overall, but better planning or expansion would improve the dining experience overall.

I’ve been to Tuffles twice, and I’ve ordered from here more times than I should probably admit. I genuinely love this place. The food, the vibe, the comfort level, it just feels easy and familiar.

If you’re visiting, ordering the cheeseburger is mandatory. This isn’t a suggestion. That’s what they do best, and they know it.

Recently, out of pure curiosity, I decided to try their mac and cheese. I wasn’t expecting much.
It’s easily the best mac and cheese I’ve ever had. Creamy, comforting, and done exactly how it should be. If you’re going there, add this to your order. No debate.

I’ve also ordered the mac and cheese for delivery, and honestly, it didn’t hit the same. It came a bit cold and dry, which kind of kills the whole experience. So if you actually want to enjoy it, eat it there.
If you’re in Bangalore, this place is a must-visit.

We tried them on a Sunday night and waited for 10-15 minutes to get in. Like all these other outlets, this one was also crowded. We tried few things from the menu and everything was top notch in taste.
Starting from Irish coffee, classic chicken steak, Bianca pasta, dutch truffle and what not. The items are too affordable and the ambience is good but the atmosphere is crowded. There is no cozy vibes at all. This is a must try for the food lovers without any doubt.

name: Cool Corner
review_texts: Wonderful joint. I absolutely love their masala puri, veg cheese sandwich & masala dose. Been visiting Cool Corner since I was a kid & it's great to see the consistency they've maintained. Jain options are also available..

A wonderful place to enjoy delicious food like dosa, sandwiches, chaats, and more.
My personal favorite is the paratha curry, which is a must-try. If you’re a dosa lover, this place is definitely for you!
Please note, sambar and idli items are not served here, but the variety and taste of other dishes make up for it.
The restaurant is clean, well-maintained, and hygienic, with quick service and a welcoming ambiance.
Prices are reasonable, making it a perfect spot for a casual meal with family or friends.

Cool Corner in V.V. Puram has been my go-to spot since childhood, and it continues to be one of the best places for South Indian food, especially their Masala Dosa, which, in my opinion, is the finest I’ve had. Served with two chutneys and a flavorful sagu, the dosa is consistently crispy and perfectly spiced, though the chutneys tend to range between spicy and extremely spicy. Apart from their exceptional dosas, they also offer a good variety of sandwiches and shakes, making it a great spot for both traditional and quick bites.

One of the standout aspects of this place is its very quick service, ensuring that you get your food fresh and hot in no time. However, during peak hours, especially in the evenings or weekends, you might have to wait for about 5-10 minutes due to the high demand. The ambiance is simple yet nostalgic, adding to its charm, and the pricing is quite reasonable for the quality they offer.

While almost everything here impresses, the only slight letdown is their coffee, which is quite average compared to the rest of their offerings. That being said, if you're in the area and craving a delicious Masala Dosa or a refreshing shake, Cool Corner is definitely worth a visit!

Had Masala Dose , Masala puri and Filter Coffee here !

Masala Dose :- Not bad , may be not my type it is too crispy outside 8/10

Masala Puri : One of the best I had in recent times, 9.5/10

Filter Coffee :- Just go for it !!! 10/10

Prices are affordable , good location , great service (QSR)

One of the best places for breakfast in the Basavangudi area. Large variety of food options available here. Food tastes really good. We tried Set Dosa and Masala Dosa. Both were nice. They gave two types of chutneys, red chutney and White chutney. Both are good. Also different types of ice-creams and desserts available here. Veg sandwiches are also available here. Place is really clean and hygienic. Food served in buffet system. No chairs available to sit and eat. During the peak hours the place is quite crowded.

name: Paakashala Malleshwara
review_texts:
One of the good eateries in malleswaram that serves variety of food, for a little costlier range(but the qaulity speaks for itself!🫶🏻)
The food is delicious, the staff's polite and the service is fast!
The dosa was beautiful in taste but the kesari did lack some authentic taste as it used to be, previously. Overall it was amazing!✨️
Definitely recommended for family outings!🙌🏻

Now that I have heard of this chain, I decided to give this a try inside the Bangalore city. While it is a great recommendation for a vegetarian restaurant, the city has other good options that result in greater competition when compared to a tier 3 city.
But as a standalone restaurant, it gets its basics right. The food was great and the service was quick. A good option to consider for people who do not like to experiment with options and just stick to the basics.
Horrible people with no manner nor basic commonsense to approach customers. You wanna waste your hard earned money.. never visit dis place

Very good tasty food. Service was very good. Especially server Basava Raju made good suggestions for us.

Staff were very friendly and we will visit again

I  ordered a ghee pudi masala for Rs180 ,a thick dosa which did not resemble a masala dosa was got which I returned back after quality issues.Mangaer told all are eating so there is no problem.They gave me a revenge dosa sought which was burnt and no ghee in it.Very sad.I frequently visit Paakashala.But I doubt now.Hope such incidents are taken care in a better way
Regards

name: Dose Camp
review_texts: We stopped by dose camp on a weekday evening and it was as crowded as it could get. We had to wait a bit to find a table. Parking can be difficult to find as you'll have to look for it in streets further away. Coming to the food , I personally LOVED the open butter masala dose . It had all the ingredients in the right amounts and I still can't get over it. The puliyogare was fantastic as well , and to end this meal with a filter coffee was the best thing ever. Highly recommend the food at this place, it's worth the crowd and the time .

Went for a quick dinner on a Saturday night. Though it was not much crowded the problem is dosa waiting is bit long. It's not very quick like other self service eateries. There is only one dosa master.
We tried the ghee dosa, the dosa was very good, definetley worth it. The chutneys could have been better. Price is okay not too expensive. There are no washroom facilities.

Weekend breakfast in jayanagar
We ordered one plate idli vada, thatte idli, corn dosa, capsicum dosa
All items were good in taste and worth the price.
Parking is available on the street, place was clean and well maintained, not very crowded over the weekend
Worth visiting!
I found the food to be absolutely delicious 😋, and the service was truly exceptional. However, the seating area could use some improvement, as it felt a bit cramped. Overall, a decent spot. 🌟🍽️😊

I have been looking at this place planning to try dosa and finally I tried. The Dosa options here are quite great ! The dosa tastes amazing the essence of Dosa with ghee and the chutney with which it’s served is like cherry on top. Recommended place for a quick stop for Dosa in case you are in a hurry and hungry.

name: Gufha Restaurant, Jayanagar
review_texts: Gufha Cafe is a truly unique dining experience with its cave-style interiors that instantly set a calm and cozy mood. The ambience is perfect for a relaxed meal with friends or family. The food is flavorful and well presented, with a good variety on the menu to suit different tastes. Service is courteous and attentive, making the overall experience smooth and enjoyable. Definitely a great place to visit if you’re looking for good food in a distinctive and memorable setting.

They have portrayed the theme perfectly. The food was good. We tried the crispy lamb and pepper chicken with kulcha; all of them were good except for the chicken dim sum. The dim sum was not it.

The service was good and the ambience was excellent.
Nicely done restaurant. Just could add a bit more light near the tables. Food is really good. And so is service.

Cave themed with dark background restaurant with amazing food quality and decent staff.
Drinking options available.
We tried their veg and non veg manchow soup, veg and non platter, pomfret fry, nachos with liquid cheese, and everything was too good to taste.

In desert, We tried sizzling brownie with ice cream which was mouth watering and tried their unique fried ice cream for the first time and it was not bad.

Overall very good dining experience.
I recently visit gufa restaurant and really shocked me to see restaurant theme it's look likes real cave and you visit restaurant so tried chicken biryani once

name: Chin Lung Resto Bar RESIDENCY ROAD
review_texts: Good ambiance and a great location with easy access from MG Road make this bar a convenient spot to visit. However, the food is just average and could be improved.                                       but the overall vibe makes it a decent place to hang out.

Most happening place to visit and the food here won't cost a fortune.
It's a super popular spot, and as soon as you walk in, you can feel the good vibes. The place looks cool and inviting, perfect for hanging out with friends.

The food is really tasty, and the prices are easy on your wallet. They have lots of different dishes, so you're sure to find something you like. The portions are suitable for small group too, so you definitely get your money's worth.

The people who work there are super friendly, which makes the whole experience even better. Basically, Chin Lung is a great place to go if you want a fun time, good food, and don't want to spend too much money. I totally recommend it!
This spot is great for hanging out with friends! The atmosphere is quite inviting, and the food options are generally good. Service was also pretty decent. Overall, a pleasant experience!
It was honestly cozy and everything went off so well without facing any hiccups 10/10
Had a fun time with my girls. Very much happy with the service. Prasanna sir was very nice and accommodating. Loved the vibe here

name: Roxie
review_texts:
The Pesto Burrata Pizza was delicious, especially if you’re a fan of pesto flavors. The Butter Garlic Prawns were decent, served with bread. The Paneer Chilli Mango was absolutely delicious! I’m usually not a paneer person, but I genuinely loved this dish. The tacos were fairly average. On the drinks side, all the mocktails were refreshing, flavorful, and complemented the food really well. Overall, a great place to try for good food and ambience !
And if you love getting pictures clicked then this is the place !

The food is amazing!!
We had their Korean cheese buns, Palak patta chaat, some mushroom starter, raw mango paneer chilli, pasta, noodles, pizza and some drinks.
All were amazing.
The service is good. The vibes are good.
Must try.

We had a wonderful time here for lunch. The menu is packed with amazing, delectable dishes. We kicked things off with the Korean garlic bun, which was an absolute standout. The Sherpa’s jhol momos and truffle edamame dumplings followed, both hitting the mark perfectly. We also loved the Banarasi litti chokha, which was scrumptious and authentically prepared. The veg biryani main course was decent, but the desserts were the real grand finale—both the pull-me-up tiramisu and the Vietnamese coffee tres leches were pure heaven.

To top it all off, the service was polite and cheerful. A special mention to Jeni, whose service was incredibly hospitable and great!

Visited thsi place  last week with a group of 6 including a kid. Love the ambience and a great vibe , though the music was a little loud inside.

The Korean Garlic Bread definitely lived up to the hype. Highly recommend to Malai Pepper Chicken Tikka for starter. For the mains, the Chateubriand Royale was outstanding and easily stars of our meals.

A special mention to the staff for serving curd rice for our kid at the right time without any delay. Also liked the bamboo straws, a nice touch.

Thanks to the Swiggy Dineout 15% offer.

Roxie is a beautifully designed restaurant with a really aesthetic décor and an amazing ambiance. The interiors are stylish and vibrant, making it a great place for both casual meals and special occasions.

The food was equally impressive. The bread with the cheese pull was delicious, the palak patta chaat was full of flavor, and the burrata pizza was absolutely amazing with fresh, creamy burrata and a perfectly baked crust. Overall, a fantastic dining experience that’s definitely worth a visit.

name: Madurai Pandi Mess - MPM®
review_texts:
To be honest, I'm not usually a big fan of parotta. However, MPM served one of the best Kothu Parottas I've ever had. The taste was absolutely fantastic and full of flavor.

While the biryani wasn't quite up to the mark, the Kothu Parotta more than made up for it. If you're a parotta lover, this place is definitely worth a visit.

I'd happily travel all the way from Whitefield to Kammanahalli again just for their parotta!

Hygiene - 0/5 - spotted at least 5 cockroaches, dirty washbasin, filthy floor and chairs. The food authorities should conduct an inspection of this place.

Service - the security guard who manages the waiting list gives preference to certain people irrespective of whether they come late. And when people confronted him, instead of being apologetic, he shrugged off saying not a big deal to wait another 10 minutes. In fact, a waiter called Rongzalu also tried to sneak in a family without their name itself in the list inspite of us waiting with a kid in the scorching sun for more than 40 minutes. Once you’re inside, the service is just decent.

Food - 4/5 based on taste.

Overall, no owner or manager were present and this place seems to be running only by waiters and the security guard. No maintenance at all. Avoid if you respect your time and love your body.

A no frills place. A very small place. You can see them making the fresh parotta in the back. The kitchen maybe somewhere else, but very helpful and friendly staff.

But the most important part is the food. You eat it the traditional way, on a banana leaf. Takes you back the real way it was without spoons and forks. Very flavorful,  not too spicy and tasty. Its truly a gem. In one word...Amazing....

Hands down, one of the best dining experiences I've had in a long time! Very welcoming.The food was an absolute showstopper. Every dish we tried was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. I highly recommend the biryani , fish curry meals mutton Nalli  n many dishes —the flavors were perfectly balanced,.The service was also impeccable. The person who manages the restaurant Mr Ramu was very kind , attentive, knowledgeable about the menu, and ensured we had everything we needed without being intrusive.
I would definitely suggest people to try here

Had dinner around 7:30 pm... decent place with good food... Tamilnadu style foods are available.. Bit costlier if you compare it to the ambience.. tried parotta, chettinad chicken, plain dosa and idlies which costed 581/-... approx 300 per head which seems costlier for the ambience... service is good... if you like Tamilnadu style food, you should try atleast once..

Cons : Ambience is not so great.. needs to be improved.. especially handwash area.. very congested and have only one basin for the sitting capacity of apprx 40 people..

name: Corner House - HSR Sector 2
review_texts:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Visited Corner House in HSR Layout on a weekend. Even though it was quite busy, the service was quick and the desserts were absolutely worth it.

The ice cream was fresh, rich, and delicious. Every bite tasted creamy and full of flavor. It's a perfect place to satisfy your dessert cravings with family or friends.

If you're in HSR Layout and looking for tasty, quality ice cream, Corner House is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!

I recently tried the famous Death by Chocolate (DBC) at Corner House, and I absolutely loved it. The dessert was rich, indulgent, and truly lived up to its reputation. They offer a wide variety of options on their menu, making it a perfect place for anyone with a sweet tooth.

Every time I visit, the place is always crowded, which clearly reflects the quality and taste of their desserts. Despite the rush, the service is quite efficient, and the overall experience is worth the wait. The ambiance is simple but lively, adding to the charm of the place.

I would highly recommend all dessert lovers to visit this spot at least once and experience their delicious offerings. It’s definitely a must-visit destination if you’re craving something sweet and satisfying.

Corner House Review 🍨✨

Death by Chocolate – 10/10
Absolutely love it! This is my go-to dessert in Bengaluru. I’ve tried almost all their ice creams, and they never disappoint. The taste is consistently amazing, and the whipped cream is super fresh which makes it even better 🤎

Overall: One of the best places for ice cream in Bengaluru—always a hit!

This must be one of the very few franchise outlets of corner house. They don't give out franchise anymore. Went on a Saturday night, buzzing crowd and has to que up to order. Tried the cake fudge, the underrated alternative to the overhyped Dbc! Do give it a go ! 😋

Corner House is famous for its death by chocolate and it’s well known for everything. Yesterday night we craved it and instead of going to the crowded Corner House, we ordered on Zomato. It was a top-notch experience with well-packed food. The taste was exactly as we would expect from the shop. This is one of our go-to places for dessert and they have more sundaes and other ice creams. Every dessert lover should visit Corner House. If you’re going there, you’re not alone; a huge crowd is waiting for you and this is not just hype, the items are actually the best.

name: Vishnu Garden Vegetarian Restaurant
review_texts: Vishnu Garden Veg Restaurant recently moved to RT Nagar, and I'm pleased with the change. The atmosphere is inviting, and the food is outstanding. The service is impressively fast, and both the quantity and quality of the dishes are excellent. Plus, it's very budget-friendly. Overall, it's a fantastic dining experience!

Did not have a good experience. Asked for bottled water but the waiter did not give the glasses. Food was alright but the service quality was not adequate. AC service hall was below average. Not tidy enough and there was a pile of tissues on one of the tables. Coffee was good but the badam milk was too sweet. Food items were limited mostly because of the LPG crisis. However, it is difficult to find a good veg restaurant around the place.

The Gobi Manchurian from Vishnu Garden was extremely disappointing. There was hardly any gobi in the dish, and what little was there was poorly cooked. The texture was off, the flavors were unbalanced, and it felt like no care had gone into preparing it. They seriously need to improve their cooking standards. Definitely not worth the money.
Vishnu Garden Review: A South Indian Delight! A go-to spot for delicious dosa, vada, and idli! The juice is refreshing too!

One of the worst services in the ac hall we asked the manager for cold water and he tells us that we don't serve cold water you can go and buy it from the near by shop he could have just said it's not available and he keeps on giving back answers. we had ordered mushroom fried rice and panner kulcha we told him to take away the mushroom friedrice and get panner first he took away the mushroom friedrice  and reheated the thing with so much oil and brought the same thing back when we complained to him about the oil he is giving back answers that you should specify the amount of oil to be put while cooking. Didn't expect such unprofessional behaviour in Vishnu garden really disappointed will never recommend it to anyone.

name: Eden Park Restaurant
review_texts:
If you’re looking for a relaxed dining spot in central Bangalore,  on Cunningham/Infantry Road Eden Park Restaurant is worth a visit. The restaurant has a calm, old-Bangalore charm with plenty of greenery and comfortable seating that works well for family dinners, casual outings, and small get-togethers.

The menu offers a good mix of Andhra, North Indian, Chinese, and seafood dishes,

We tried the Andhra Biryani, meals, Mutton Fry, and Chicken Kabab. The Andhra Biryani was fairly average and didn’t particularly stand out, but the meals were simple, comforting, and quite enjoyable in a homely way.
What truly sets the place apart is the ambience. The restaurant is surrounded by lush greenery, and the sounds of birds — even if played over speakers — create a calm, relaxing atmosphere that feels like a little oasis in the middle of Bangalore’s bustle. A good spot if you’re looking more for a peaceful dining experience than an extravagant meal.

This place is one of my TOP favourite. Food is EXCELLENT. Waiters are BEST. Atmosphere is PERFECT.

I have no words to say. This is rare when a place make me speechless to describe. The prices are reasonable. Iam satisfied with this place and would recommend it to everyone. You will definitely not regret coming here.

Note: I didn't like the mocktails i chosen here that much though. But iam sure other choices in the drinks menu could have been better.

An exquisitely designed restaurant enveloped in lush greenery, offering a serene and immersive ambiance, especially under the evening lights. The cuisine was commendable, with the bamboo biryani emerging as a visually captivating and exceptionally flavorful highlight. The service was equally impressive gracious, attentive, and genuinely warm. An ideal destination for a refined and memorable dining experience.You should must visit once.

🌳 *Eden Park Restaurant – Looks Better Than It Tastes*

*Ambience*: The greenery is good and the setup feels pleasant. Nice outdoor vibe if you’re just there for photos 🌿

*Service*: Very slow. We waited way too long, and the staff didn’t seem in a hurry to fix it. Not a happy experience.

*Food*: Quality was disappointing. Didn’t match the expectations at all — bland and below average.

*Verdict:*
❌ Slow service with no urgency
❌ Food quality didn’t deliver
✅ Greenery is the only real plus

*Final word:*
Overall not satisfied. The place has potential with the setting, but the food and service need serious work.

---

Skip this one unless you’re just going for the ambience and don’t mind waiting.

We came here for the first time, Service was nice, Food was nice, Ambience was nice. But the staff guy demanded the money for birthday celebration. Cleaning charges and he also added Service tax in the bill. Asking us to pay 500rs extra for cleaner. We made 4k bill including service tax.. even then he was asking for extra money of 500rs. Not worthy. Unprofessional behaviour.

We have celebrated birthdays in different restobars & cafes. No one demanded cash like this, to clean.. we didn’t make that dirty also, It was just party Poppers.

I wont recommend this place if you’re celebrating a birthday or any celebration….!!!

name: New Modern Hotel
review_texts:
The iconic New Modern Hotel (NMH) in VV Puram, Bangalore, is legendary for its authentic, traditional South Indian breakfast and snacks.
​Here is what makes their star dishes stand out:
​Khali Dose: Super soft, fluffy, and perfectly porous, served with a generous dollop of butter and their signature chutney.
​Masale Dose: Notably different from the typical Bengaluru Vidyarthi Bhavan style; it has a distinct, golden-brown crispness without being overly greasy, paired with a flavorful potato palya.
​Bread Dish (Bread Toast/Cutlet): A nostalgic, old-school favorite. Their bread toast features perfectly crisped bread slathered with butter and a unique spice mix, while the bread masala/cutlet options offer a perfect savory crunch.
​Idli Vade Sambar: The idlis are cloud-soft, the vada is incredibly crunchy on the outside, and it is all served with a traditional, slightly sweet, and highly aromatic Karnataka-style sambar.
Finally Filter coffee with moderate sugar is super.

brings back pure nostalgia. It is one of Bangalore's iconic old-school joints, and stepping inside feels like a trip down memory lane.
​The Khali Dose is a must-try—wonderfully soft, fluffy, and paired perfectly with their classic chutney and saagu. Their simple Bread Toast is another unexpected star, crisp and comforting in the best way possible. It is old-fashioned, fuss-free comfort food at its finest. If you love vintage Bangalore vibes and classic South Indian breakfast items, this legendary spot never fails to charm.

Today, I visited this place for breakfast with my family. We ordered Masala Dose, Idli Vada, Bread Toast, Pulav, Poori, Kesaribath, and Badam Halva. The food was decent and tasted good overall. The restaurant is quite simple, with no luxury or fancy ambiance, but it offers a comfortable and homely dining experience. The prices are very reasonable, making it a good option for a budget-friendly breakfast. The menu has a good variety of traditional South Indian dishes, and the portions were satisfactory. Overall, it's a decent place to enjoy a simple and affordable meal with family.

Was here 2 days ago only for Breakfast. It has a slightly yesteryear charm, not fancy like the current 'Cafes' of Bangalore... But the Food was yum, reminding one of yester years. Started with Coffee... much better than many places.. Then Idly and Vada.. the vada was real fresh and crisp and with true taste of Uddina Bele (Urad Dal), which is "rare" in todays eateries. The sambar was 5 star , hot, and one Bucket Sambar, Kept on each table, that was unique .
Masala dose was yum, crispy and generous helping of masala. Khara bath , was good , but should be called just plain uppitu. It was not khara bath. Poori and sagu was normal, nothing great, but good old style, pure atta poori (no traces of maida).  One last unique item was the "Toast" (homestyle, tava toasted with ghee) served with a unique combination of sagu n their own liquid jam. I liked it ...
Good place to get a yester year charm.

Limited Menu with Top Notch Quality of Food .
This spot is especially popular among locals for breakfast, and it’s easy to see .
Their Idli dip is lovely when served with a dollop of ghee and their unique aromatic sambar.
Their dosa is crisp and comforting, and the idli is soft, fresh, and served with  chutneys that hit the spot.
It’s the kind of place where you don’t come for variety — you come for authenticity.
One of the very few restaurants who have stuck to quality and south indian foods only inspite of the changing world !

name: Iyengars Oven Fresh - Bakery ,Cake Shop
review_texts:
Bad experience. Never going to buy any product from them. They sell old, rotten products with dubious expiry dates.

As the name says, you expect fresh bakery products to be sold by Iyengars. But it's not so.

I bought a box of Focaccia bread from them thinking that it'll be fresh. But the very next day I saw fungus growing on it. Which should not have happened, if the product was freshly made.

Due to this, I took the box back to the shop and requested for a refund.

To my surprise, the shop owners were so stubborn that instead of giving me a refund they started arguing and stating that we don't give refunds, you take another packet of the bread in place of this one.

Why? Because they have a policy that they don't refund money. Even when they sell rotten products.

Not just this, they also gave me reasons like if you buy a refrigerator, if there's a problem, it is replaced and no refund is given. Same way we are willing to replace not refund.

In which world, a bread (consumable product) can be compared to a refrigerator (kitchen appliance). This argument made me understand that the owners don't know what they are selling and what is the product category.

And if they don't know how food business works then obviously how will they cater to their customers.

Such bad customer service is a given, with brands like Iyengars.

And therefore I don't trust the food quality at all. More so when you say oven fresh but sell bakery items that are not fresh.

Visited this place for the first time yesterday 1 july 2026 bought a half kg death by chocolate, brownie and a bread...
Intresting part  there were so many expired bread so I searched for fresh white bread which expires on 6 th or 7 th of July I gave it for billing and today morning when I was open the bag it was surprising that the bread date was changed to 2 nd july, the person who was billing has changed the bread... Which is not acceptable.. and am never visiting again..

Picked up a few snacks from Iyengars Oven Fresh recently, and it was a nice experience. The bakery had a good variety of fresh items, from puffs and pastries to cakes and breads. Everything looked well-stocked and fresh, and the items I tried tasted just as good as they looked. The staff were polite, and service was quick even during a busy time. It’s one of those dependable neighborhood bakeries that’s great for a quick snack, a tea-time treat, or picking up a cake for a small celebration. 🥐🍰😊

One of the best honey cakes I’ve ever tasted! 🍯✨
Perfectly soft, rich in flavor, and just the right amount of sweetness. A must-try for all dessert lovers!

Tried their plain cake for the first time from the store- very disappointing. It had a bad smell and tasted stale, clearly not fresh. Even though the expiry date is 15th April, the product was already spoiled and inedible. Seems like poor storage or quality control. Not worth it and will not recommend.

name: Bistro Claytopia
review_texts: The ultimate creative hangout spot!I absolutely loved the vibe here. Painting pottery while enjoying a great hot latte and tasty snacks is such an amazing concept. The ambiance is beautifully designed, calm, and inspiring. It is a fantastic way to spend a few hours doing something hands-on and relaxing. Great food, excellent coffee, and top-notch hospitality. Highly recommend!

This was one of the most unique experiences I've ever had. For a restaurant the food was top notch and service was amazing. What made the overall experience memorable was the clay painting that we did while eating. Immersing ourselves into painting while having fantastic food on the table really let very little downsides. A special thanks to Wilson, who helped us out from the very beginning, with ordering and painting. Thank you very much!!!

It's a lovely place for people who want to relax and paint and take home a piece of their own art. Food is not that good.. i ordered prawns from starters in was deep fried covered with maida.. too much batter, and then a korean dish from main course which tasted like normal noodles. Drink was good. However the service Im not happy, the waiters were difficult to understand, there was a communication issue with my order, I placed the order with one man he was quite reluctant to wait so he left  and we could find him later, he seemed very unhappy while taking orders ..and  so we placed the order with another waiter. In the end both orders were placed.. one with and one without my consent and I ended up paying 780 extra for a dish.. even the clay they messed up the bill, adding items twice, which they later corrected... so i feel when it comes to billing, customers need to be careful and check thoroughly. There is a lot of confusion going on at the counter..They also added service charges after all this drama. So overall clay part was good.. the rest i would ask people to be careful and vigilant.

I visited this place with my friend. The food quality is decent, and the ambience is really good for art lovers. We bought different clay pots, and it was really fun to paint them. They have a wide variety of clay items ranging from INR 400 to 1,200.
However, they only offer three colours, and the quality isn't the best. Also, after glazing, the colour shades change completely. For example, purple turned into navy blue. So, although I loved my piece after painting it, I didn't like it as much after glazing.
If you're looking to spend quality time doing something creative and don't care too much about the final result, it's a good place to visit!

Loved the entire experience of being at Bistro!! From the entrance to the final touches of paint 🎨 it was an amazing time. The staff is extremely supportive and cordial. The food and the ambiace too was top notch! My friends and I had a great time bonding as we painted our pieces.

Kindly remember you will have to collect your pieces back after 20 days. And sometimes a few designs will be out of stock. That's it. Love Bistro!! Will surely visit many more times. ✨🌻✨

name: Bob's Bar - Koramangala
review_texts: Bob’s Bar is a great spot to hang out with friends, enjoy some good draught beer, and dig into classic comfort food. The roadside seating adds to the charm and sometimes even gives off relaxed Goa-like vibes. Overall, it’s a fantastic place with tasty food, a lively atmosphere, and great vibes.

best place to chill and hangout with family or friends or our loved once....
food 10/10
service 10/10
atmosphere 100/100
(if you are sitting outside(open area) make sure there is no birds in the tree, based on experience😅)

there is no other place like this in bengalore to hangout.
iam sure about this one...

Tried the Ghee Beef Roast and pork dishes from Bob’s Bar, and both were really good. The flavors were nice and went well with the overall pub vibe. Cocktails were just average, nothing too special.

Bob’s in Koramangala feels quite different from the Indiranagar branch. Even though the rates are affordable, I personally felt the cocktails in Indiranagar were far better.

The place has a very dark ambience, and it felt quite humid and crowded, especially during peak time. It’s more of a loud, busy hangout spot than a calm chill place.

Burgers, samosas, and good vibes! 🍔✨
Just had the chicken hamburger here—honestly so juicy, and the buns were buttery perfection. 🤤 Paired it with some cranberry juice and their amazing Chicken Samosa.
Such a chill place for students or after-work catch-ups, and the staff are super professional. Best part? It’s totally easy on the pocket. 💯

Worst experience - extremely disrespectful attitude
The bad experience started at valet parking. I was informed that management does not take responsibility for any car damage, which I understand. So I said I’ll park the car myself, which is a reasonable request.
Instead, the valet guy rudely responded,
“If you’re interested, come to our restaurant, otherwise find some other restaurant.”

He then said it is company policy that if you don’t use valet parking, you cannot enter the restaurant at all. This was shocking and highly disrespectful.
Even after entering, the experience inside was on another level of bad - poor service, careless staff, and zero hospitality. Customers are clearly not valued here.

To others: don’t just look at the prices and walk in.
Also look at your self-respect and dignity, because this place doesn’t care about either.
Not recommended. Plenty of better options in Koramangala.

name: Maize & Malt - Craft Brewery & Kitchen
review_texts:
Not every restaurant makes you go "Wow!" the moment you walk in. Some earn that feeling through their food, while some do it through their ambience. Maize & Malt is one of those rare places that manages to do both.

🍽 Food – ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)
This was honestly the highlight of the evening. Everything we ordered was served hot, tasted great, and reached our table without an unnecessarily long wait.
The Kerala Pork (recommended by the staff) and the Crispy Chicken were definitely my favourites. The Guava Chilli Mocktail was refreshing and paired really well with the food.
But the real showstoppers were the desserts. Mango Panna Cotta and Mango Pull Me Up completely blew my mind. The presentation, texture, and taste... everything was just spot on.
Another thing I really appreciated was their willingness to customize a dish to our preferred spice level. It's these small things that definitely earn them brownie points.

🏛️ Ambience –  (4/5)
The first thing that catches your attention is how massive this place is. Even on a packed Sunday evening, it never felt crowded or chaotic. The seating is spacious, comfortable, and there's enough breathing space to actually enjoy your time.
The warm lighting, beautiful architecture, greenery, and the balcony overlooking the ground floor all add to the experience. I can only imagine how beautiful this place would look around sunset.
The live music was enjoyable, although sitting close to the stage on the first floor can make conversations a little difficult. Everywhere else, the music volume was just right.
Clean washrooms and valet parking are definitely added brownie points.

🤝 Service – (4/5)
The staff was courteous, attentive, and knew the menu really well. In fact, the Kerala Pork recommendation came from them, and it turned out to be one of the best dishes we ordered.
Despite the restaurant being packed, there was always someone nearby whenever we needed assistance. We never had to wait long to place another order or ask for anything, which was quite impressive.

✅ Overall
If you're looking for a place that offers great food, beautiful ambience, and equally good service, Maize & Malt is definitely worth visiting. It's one of those places I'd happily visit again—not just for the food, but for the complete dining experience.

Visited Maize & Malt - Craft Brewery & Kitchen with my office team for lunch and had a good experience overall. The ambience is definitely the biggest highlight. The place is huge, spacious and very well designed, making it a nice option for team outings or casual get-togethers.

We opted for the buffet. The food was good, but the buffet spread felt a little limited. For vegetarians, the choices were even fewer compared to the non-vegetarian options, just something to keep in mind if you're visiting mainly for the buffet.

We visited on a sunny afternoon, but the indoor seating was comfortable and we had a relaxed time with the team. Service was smooth throughout.

Parking seemed to be mostly along the roadside, though we didn't face any major issues during our visit.

Overall, we enjoyed our time here. If you're looking for a place with a great ambience for team lunches or group gatherings around Whitefield and Mahadevapura, this is a good option.

I visited Maize & Malt with friends on a weekend evening. Management has Valet parking option so one can avail that benefit and two wheelers can be parked outside the main entry.
