It is a big, beautiful place. There are few small business stalls setup at the entry of the brewery.
We ordered a lot of veg, non veg options, dessert, beer, mocktails and everything was tasty. Gentry is also great. There is ample staff to help with the orders so we were able to take help from different person for a new order.
I really loved the place and also the prices are decent. I would definitely love to go again.

Visited here with a group of colleagues for a lunch buffet. The food itself was great, and the ambience was lovely, making for a pleasant atmosphere. However, the service was a major letdown. The starters were running out in seconds, and the staff was incredibly slow to refill them. It could have been an excellent team lunch if the service had been on point. Overall, it was a decent experience, but they definitely need to improve their management.

Went for lunch but ended up staying till evening — that kinda place 🫶🏻

Super huge space with giant screens all around, perfect for IPL scenes. Food was a solid 10/10 and the staff? sweetest & super humble 💯

They’ve got special IPL screenings, but trust me — sunset is the time to be here. Once the lights come on, the whole vibe turns dreamy ✨
Just imagine sitting under the open sky, match on a giant screen… unreal 🥹❤️

On my table:
Berry Bonanza 🍓
Deep Learning 🍹
Prawn Hargao Dimsums 🥟
Baklava Cheesecake 🍰 (so good!!)
Pesto Linguine with dried tomatoes & pine nuts 🍝
Smokey basil oil chicken pizza 🍕🔥

10/10 for vibe + food + IPL feels 💫

name: 1947 Restaurant
review_texts: Located in the 4th floor. There is parking in basement or on the road. Typically would recommend for buffet. Costs about 700. Like their spread. Good ambience. Great service and staff were always available when needed. Good and tasty food with a nice spread of delicacies.

Timeless Flavors, Elegant Vibes – A Pure Veg Delight! If you're looking for a place that blends heritage-inspired ambience with delicious vegetarian food, then 1947 Restaurant in Malleshwaram is a must-visit. It’s one of those restaurants that doesn’t just serve food—it tells a story. Perfect for family dinners, celebrations, or even a quiet date night.

They have both the options Buffet and Ala Carte
Serving Authentic North Indian food

Staff was polite, well-dressed, and attentive throughout. Food arrived on time, and they even helped us with suggestions based on our taste preferences. Really well-trained and professional team

The hospitality and service at the restaurant were excellent — the staff was very welcoming and attentive, which made the experience enjoyable. However, I felt that the portion sizes were quite small compared to the price paid. Improving the quantity would definitely make the overall dining experience much better.

We had a wonderful experience at the vegetarian buffet at 1947, Malleshwaram. The food was delicious, with a wide variety of dishes to choose from. The ambiance was pleasant, and the staff were courteous and attentive. Overall, it was a satisfying lunch  experience, and we would be happy to visit again. Thank you for your excellent hospitality.

If you're looking for a pure veg buffet that’s packed with flavour and variety, 1947 Malleshwaram is the place to be! The spread is huge – from comforting soups and delicious starters to rich mains and a great range of desserts. Everything was fresh, well-prepared, and served with a smile. The ambiance has a classic charm and the service is top-notch. Perfect for family outings or special get-togethers. Totally worth it!

name: South Thindis
review_texts:
South Thindis is a perfect example of Bengaluru’s beloved darshini-style breakfast culture—quick, comforting, and full of character. Located near Krishna Rao Park, the spot is instantly recognizable thanks to its eye-catching metallic installation at the entrance.

Revisiting this place brings a wave of nostalgia, especially for those who’ve been coming here since its early days. It’s the kind of place where you can stop by for a quick bite or linger a little longer with a cup of filter coffee, enjoying the relaxed, old-Bangalore vibe. The veranda-style setup adds to that charm, making it a great place to unwind or casually catch up with friends.

One of the highlights is the smooth and modern ordering system. The self-service kiosks make placing orders quick and hassle-free, even during busy hours. Despite the crowd, the service remains efficient, and the place is consistently clean and hygienic.

The menu is extensive, covering all the classic “thindi” favorites. Items like idli, vada, and khara bath are well-prepared and satisfying, even if you might find softer idlis elsewhere. The rava dosa stands out as a must-try—crispy, flavorful, and absolutely worth it. There are also plenty of interesting options like ragi rotti, akki rotti, neer dosa (available after noon), sabbasige dosa, Mangalore buns, and even Kerala parota, offering something for every craving.

In the evenings, the place comes alive with snacks like bonda and bajji, making it a great all-day destination. With reasonable pricing, quick turnaround, and a wide variety of dishes, it’s an ideal spot for a hearty breakfast or a casual snack break. Definitely worth checking out if you’re in the area.

I went for breakfast with friend!! It was really nice environment and food was really delicious 😋

We enjoyed a lot !!

Basanagudi!! That old bangalore charm was adding to the experience!!!

Decent resturant for a quick bite during early morning and the dishes are mild and soothing to the stomach! Rava idli was awesome and their vada is famous as well! Chow chow bath is also very tasty. Yet to try their dosa, which looks really yummy!

If you are on a run and would like to have a quick grab of south Indian food try this.
Food - 3/5
Atmosphere - 4/5 good for quick grabs and tea
Sitting space - no
Online cash payment- yes
Pricing affordable

Unfortunately the dosa was very oily

I recently visited South Thindis, and I have to say, the Masala Dosa was absolutely delightful. The dosa was perfectly crispy on the outside, with a balanced, golden-brown texture that stayed light—not oily. Inside, the masala filling of potato, onion, and fresh coriander had just the right balance of spice and flavor. The seasoning was subtle yet satisfying, and every bite felt enjoyable.

Overall, it’s a dosa made with care — crispy, flavorful, and beautifully balanced. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys authentic South Indian breakfast done right!

name: Anand Sweets - Commercial Street
review_texts:
I recently visited this place and the food was OK .out of a lot of things that we ordered what I did not like the most was the chaap. I am a big fan of chaap but the chaap that they served there is fried well but was too salty.
but the other Chaat items were really good. Pav bhaji was really good. I think with a lot of sales they are not able to take proper care of each dish which I think they should but other than that, it’s good. It’s OK.

One of the best places in Bangalore for authentic North Indian food and premium sweets. The moment you walk in, you’ll notice how well they maintain cleanliness and hygiene — the counters are spotless, staff are well-groomed, and the seating area is neat and organized.
The chole bhature here are absolutely amazing — truly Delhi-style! The bhature are fluffy and perfectly fried, and the chole are rich, spicy, and full of flavor.
Their North Indian thali is a must-try, especially with laccha paratha. The thali is wholesome, well-portioned, and gives a complete authentic experience.
To finish, don’t miss the ramalai with milk badam — soft, juicy, and perfectly sweet. It’s the perfect ending to a satisfying meal.
Highly recommended for food quality, taste, and hygiene standards.

The place is a must visit while shopping at commercial Street 😁. A perfect getaway for a quick grab .. be it sweet, snacks or you you want a tummy full 😍.
The taste, presentation of food, food gift 🎁 hampers, all are so creative and eye catching, you feel like having more.
In summer you can relish mango 🥭 sweets, lassi and in Bangalore cold weather hot hot jalebi, chaat, etc.
I just loved the food there. 🤩

Another great anand shop.

Very good sweets, but overpriced savories. Paneer pakoda was not that good. Only recieved one and it was reheated and sad.

However, the rest of the items are good and now they have added QR ticket ordering whic had made the queues much shorter and service much better. The savories can be improved. They lack consistency in terms of quality.

This outlet is a good one. Right on commercial Street. Watch out - there are two outlets.

Standard quality, consistent taste and flavour, good ingredients, Anand Sweets had been my go to destination in Bengaluru for 8 years now. This outlet in Commercial Street is also very decent but the only problem is that seating arear is accessible only through stairs. No passenger lift in the premises. But on a whole a very wholesome experience.

name: Al Zara Mandi Arabian Restaurant
review_texts:
Visited Al Zara Mandi in Frazer Town during a Ramzan night. The place has cozy seating and is good for a small group, we were around six people.

We tried the mutton mandi, which was decent. The salsa served with it was nice, though it would have been better with some salad on the side. We also had mutton haleem and chicken haleem, and the mutton haleem was definitely better.

Overall, a nice spot for a Arabian style dinner with friends.

The name says it all , they provide the best mandi in banglore , try Pepper Mutton raan mandi , the mutton was so tender and juicy and the chicken were also we'll cooked🤤, best place to have food with your family and friends and they provide many variety of sweets and try their mint jug.😋

The food here is really delicious and definitely worth trying. The Haleem and Mandi Biryani are especially very yummy and highly recommended. The ambiance is decent but not something extraordinary, so it may not fully meet expectations if you’re looking for a very fancy dining experience. However, the food makes up for it.

Parking is available, but most of the time you may need to park on the road. We visited during peak hours, so it was quite crowded and we had to wait for a table before getting seats.

Overall, it’s a great place for tasty food, but be prepared for a little waiting time during busy hours.

Al zara restraunt has multiple floors and multiple dining area for different sizes of groups of people.
The mandi was tasty, flavor and fulfilling with good amount of dry fruits enhancing the flavor. Chicken alfahm, although kinda small but flavorful and spicy.
Rice is not unlimited which was kinda disappointing but apart from that the food was tasty, so definitely worth checking out.
There are multiple varieties of mandi available, from mix to seafood mandi. Although slightly on the pricy side definitely worth a visit for their unique tasting mandi.

I've been a repeat customer here for the past 3.5 years and I've never been disappointed even once with respect to taste, quality or quantity! I ordered a chicken Mandi today with a side of chicken grill (half) and some drinks. The  taste was top notch as usual. The unique thing about this place is the flavour of the rice. It's well flavoured and fluffy. If you're in Bangalore and you're craving for a good Mandi, try this spot for sure! Highly recommended!!

name: Bombay Adda
review_texts: I was here for a private office party and I must agree that the vibe here is fantastic. By 2230, the DJ had managed to get the entire crowd in the lounge to dance to his beats. The wide dancing space, and the equally massive outdoor seating add to the charm. Drinks were strong, food was mediocre in my case.

Great food and an amazing atmosphere! The vibe here is top-notch and perfect for a night out. While the service could be a bit quicker, it was still a wonderful experience overall. Definitely worth a visit!
Food tastes amazing! Service is quick- we went on Thursday evening.
Food and ALC is quite expensive. Entry is strict and it gets crowded in there post 10pm. Its a great club though and amazing vibes and music.

Thank you the entire team for hosting a lovely party Loved the way things were arranged. It'll give you a different vibe as soon as you'll enter.
Food taste was amazing. Usually I see, places like these compromise heavily with the food quality and concentrate more towards the drinks. But this one, food was really good, even the presentation will take you heart.
The place is on the expensive side.
Staff was really nice as well.
I'd definitely suggest anyone to go, explore this place.

name: Milano Ice Cream - Jayanagar
review_texts:
No matter what mood I’m in or what kind of day I’ve had, a visit here always makes me happy.

The Dark Chocolate & Honeycomb combination is absolutely incredible. The dark chocolate is rich and indulgent, while the honeycomb adds the perfect crunch and subtle sweetness. The Honeycomb flavour is genuinely one of the best I’ve ever tasted.

This place has become my go-to comfort stop because it never fails to put a smile on my face. Please make the Honeycomb flavour available more often, it’s amazing!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great gelato and a guaranteed mood booster.

PS - the pictures attached are not of honeycomb.

The packaging for Milano ice cream deliveries through Zomato is extremely disappointing. Ice cream is a temperature-sensitive product, yet there seems to be no effort to ensure it reaches customers in good condition. My order arrived dully melted. If you can’t ensure proper delivery for ice creams then you should be available on food delivery apps.

Sugary and a bit Overrated!

Ordered Italian special menu I think cream cake &  blueberry cheesecake gelato with Vanilla. It was too sweet for us, the pricing is fine. If you like good amount of sweet this is for you!

Also it’s ironical that brand says gelato and names store as Ice cream.

The crowd as usual lacks civic sense & common sense with ppl talking insanely loud even at night times causing disturbance to others.

I had a delightful time at Milano Ice Cream - Jayanagar! 🍨 The flavors were truly enjoyable, and the service was quite friendly. I appreciate the variety of options available. Definitely a lovely spot for a sweet treat. 😊🍦😋

We have been going to Milano for several years now and believed that it served good quality ice creams and it was a hygenic place.
We were thoroughly let down when my son alerted my wife about the hair which was in the middle of the popsicle that she was eating.
We brought it to the attention of the staff who apologised and offered another ice cream which we preferred not to have. When I was about to take a photo, they were concerned about it and one of them asked me not to capture it…for obvious reasons.
I am sharing it here because I feel that it is important for people to pay attention while they are eating at Milano.
Ours may be “one-off” case, which for me is still not acceptable.
The trust on Milano’s quality built over so many years has fallen badly with this experience.
I hope the concerned stake holders take a note of the same and ensure that this does not repeat.

name: Eshanya Rooftop Cafe - Jayanagar 4th Block
review_texts:
Esanya Rooftop Restaurant offers a pleasant dining experience with a nice rooftop ambience. The soft naan was fresh and well cooked. The soup was good, flavorful, and served hot. The lime soda was refreshing and perfectly balanced.

To end the meal, I had a sizzling brownie with ice cream, and it was perfect — hot brownie with cold ice cream made a great combination and was the highlight of the visit.

Overall, the food quality was good and satisfying. A nice place to relax and enjoy a calm meal, especially in the evening. All items tasted good, and the experience was enjoyable. 👍

The ambience was excellent and well maintained, easily a 10/10. The food was pocket-friendly, flavorful, and freshly prepared. We spent under ₹300 for our meal and had a very pleasant experience overall.

The only minor inconvenience was that we wished to click a few pictures before placing our order, but the staff repeatedly asked when we would order, which made us shorten our time. Apart from this, everything else was outstanding.

We ordered the peri-peri paneer pizza, white sauce pasta, and cheesy nachos. The food was served hot and tasted really good. We left the place satisfied and happy with our experience.

A Hidden Gem for College Students!
This cozy little café with limited seating is a perfect spot for college-goers. With pocket-friendly prices and a surprisingly wide menu, it offers the best of both worlds — taste and value. Everything we tried was delicious, and the best part? It’s healthy and doesn’t burn a hole in your pocket.
Highly recommend trying their burgers — they’re not just tasty, they’re absolutely adorable too!

Pocket friendly Veg buffet. Panner is very soft and very good. Panner Tikka is amazing. Expected Biryani to be bit spicy but it was mild.

Only downside was only one flavour of ice cream will be served. And curd rice was not that good.

But I would suggest everyone to go just for Panner items.

The rooftop café in Jayanagar is excellent, offering great food at a very affordable price. The ambiance is nice, but it can feel a bit congested and the area tends to be noisy. Still, a great place to hang out on a budget!

name: Xero Degrees
review_texts:
Love the place!!
Have been visiting Xero Degrees quite often ever since my office shifted next to them.
Food is nice and I absolutely love their Nutella Waffle, the pizza pockets and peri peri fries are great too.
In beverages I like the Kitkat shake and the Hong Kong bubble milk tea.
The place is done up so well, lovely enteriors with well spaced and comfortable seating. Quite a few of the tables are next to charging points allowing one to charge their phones or laptops.
The staff is excellent and helpful and service is nice.
Two wheeler parking is available opposite the cafe and four wheeler parking is available in the nearby lanes.

Xero Degrees is a good spot if you’re in the mood for desserts, mocktais, and pizza, all under one roof. The place has a lively vibe, especially in the evenings, and works well for catching up with friends or just grabbing a quick bite.

The menu is quite varied, with options like loaded fries, burgers, pizzas, and their popular jar desserts. The food tastes good overall and definitely satisfying. The loaded fries stand out with generous toppings, and the burgers are filling enough for one person. Their desserts, especially the thick shakes and jar cakes, are worth trying if you have a sweet tooth.

Portion sizes are decent, so you feel like you’re getting your money’s worth. Pricing is reasonable.

The ambience is quirky and modern, with bright lighting and comfortable seating. It does its job well as a hangout spot. Service is fairly quick, even during busy hours, and the staff is polite.

Overall, Xero Degrees is a reliable option when you want something indulgent and easygoing. It is consistent, enjoyable, and a place you can revisit without overthinking.

Located in the heart of buzzing Koramangala.The ambience is really pleasant - clean, cozy, and relaxing with a very comfortable vibe, stylish setup that makes the place feel inviting.
Food was also great both in quality and taste wise.Loved chicken Crispers and Pizza .Pricing is also decent.
Would recommend for hangout with friends or family.
We ordered peri peri fries with sliders( friends). I must say it wasn’t disappointing. The burger was soft and the chicken was fried well with a crisper crunch. Overall had a good experience here.

Great place to hang out!
The food is usually excellent, with most dishes being definite hits. The ambience is really nice and makes it a comfortable spot to spend time. Earlier, they had seating across two floors, but it has now been reduced to one floor.

Service is good and staff are courteous. The only downside is the lack of parking nearby. Overall, a great café worth visiting.

name: The Local
review_texts:
The Local gave me major '80s and '90s pub vibes—warm, nostalgic, and full of character. The place had a lively crowd, events happening, great music, and an atmosphere that kept the energy up all evening. Service was prompt, friendly, and attentive throughout. As the name suggests, it's the kind of neighbourhood
pub where you can just relax, enjoy a few drinks, and have a great time. If you're in or around the area, The Local is definitely worth checking out. Highly recommended! 🍻 #thelocal #nammabengaluru #hrbr

Dropped by The Local after almost 6-7 yrs and had a great time. The Stout beer was smooth and perfectly chilled. Tried the nachos and pepper chicken — both flavorful, fresh, and well-made. We also ordered a mocktail, which was surprisingly refreshing and not too sweet. Nice ambience, good 90's music and quick service. A solid spot to chill and enjoy good food and drinks.

This is the best place to hang out with your friends. This is the go to place for me. Really good food, reasonable prices, great variety of food and drinks. I liked the place, it's small but ut has the vibe you need with friends,  where you can talk and chill, slow music low lights.

We visited The Local on a Friday evening around 7 PM as a group of five. The place was not very crowded initially, and although we hadn’t pre-booked a table, we were comfortably seated. By around 9 PM, the crowd gradually increased, which added to the lively atmosphere.

We ordered a variety of dishes and beverages during our visit. The Chicken Sausages with Veggies did not match our expectations, as the overall flavours didn’t come together well for us. The Peri Peri French Fries were enjoyable, and we liked them enough to order Plain Salty Fries, which were also good. The Fully Loaded Cheese Nachos (Veg) were decent.

The Barbecue Chicken Wings were not to our taste, and we felt they might not have been prepared to the level we expected. We also tried the Mexican Veg Pizza and the Smoked Chicken Pizza; while I personally found the chicken pizza acceptable, the group as a whole did not prefer the pizzas, and we were unable to finish them.

For drinks, most of us opted for bottled beer (Budweiser pint). Larger bottles were not available, and tap beer was the primary option. Some of us tried the Hefeweizen Pint and Banger Lager Pint, which felt a bit diluted. A couple of cocktails, including a flavoured mojito and a shot (possibly Brain Damage), didn’t quite suit our preferences. On the positive side, the whisky trio combo, featuring Red Label and Jack Daniel’s, was well received by the group.

We initially considered ordering more cocktails, including a LIIT, but after trying one and finding it not quite aligned with our taste, we decided not to continue further. Again, this is purely based on our individual preferences.

The ambience was pleasant, and we noticed posters about open-mic comedy events, which seemed interesting. Parking was convenient, and two-wheeler parking was available right outside.

While our overall experience with the food and drinks did not fully meet our expectations, we understand that taste is subjective, and what may not work for us could be appreciated by others. Our intention is not to criticize but to share honest feedback so the team can take it constructively. On a lighter note, we noticed a small typo (“Frise” instead of “Fries”) on the bill, just sharing with a smile 😊.

Wishing the team at The Local all the best, and we appreciate the service and hospitality extended to us during our visit. Cheers!

They just don’t accept Swiggy or Zomato Pay. They accept bookings via Swiggy/Zomato, but deny payments.

They tell this while you make the payment only and not before. You definitely missout on app offers.

name: Anand Sweets - Koramangala
review_texts: A top notch hygienic, exptic place for quick snack, brunch and lunch.  Self serve and QSR format. Service is super fast.  Four of us went for morning breakfast, loved Bedmi poori with Aloo Bhaji, sandwiches, punjabi lassi.  With that love at first sight, we made a repeat visit for a family lunch of 14 family members.  Even with 14 people, service was quick, cool, no confusion.  Quality and taste will challenge even bigger signature botique restuarants.  Must visit if you want tasty, high quality north Indian dishes in a well lit, well ventilated, spacious, airy, exotic interiors.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Absolutely loved the newly launched Delhi 6 Street Style Menu! The Chole Bhature was delicious with soft, fluffy bhature, the Pav Bhaji was rich and buttery, and the chaat had the perfect balance of sweet, spicy, and tangy flavours.

They also have a great selection of refreshing beverages and an amazing range of premium sweets to finish the meal.
The quality, taste, and overall experience were excellent. Definitely worth visiting if you’re craving authentic Delhi-style street food!

Recently my husband bought Baklava from this sweet shop—it's a delightful fusion of diverse sweets and savories. With an impressive array of about four varieties of dry fruit sweets. Very delicious 😋❤️👌🏻
If I visit will definitely will collect some other stuff too.

Anand Sweets in Koramangala is hands down one of the finest places for authentic Indian sweets and snacks! Every visit here feels special — from the warm hospitality to the elegant presentation, everything reflects quality and tradition. I’ve been a regular customer for years, and their consistency and attention to detail never fail to impress.

My absolute favorites are their Matka Rabdi, Kaaju Katli, and Motichoor Laddu — each one is pure perfection! The Matka Rabdi is rich, creamy, and has that perfect balance of sweetness and flavor, served beautifully in a traditional matka that enhances the experience. The Kaaju Katli melts in your mouth with its fine texture and pure cashew taste, while the Motichoor Laddu is soft, fragrant, and tastes just like something made with love at home.

I also absolutely love their Badamika Biscotti — it’s crunchy, nutty, and makes for the perfect snack with tea or coffee. It’s something I always make sure to pick up whenever I visit. Anand Sweets is also my go-to place for gifting, because their packaging is elegant and festive, and the quality is always top-notch — guests absolutely love receiving sweets from here!

The staff are polite, helpful, and always make you feel welcome. The store itself is clean, well-organized, and has a lovely aroma that instantly tempts you to try everything.

Overall, Anand Sweets in Koramangala is a true symbol of premium quality, taste, and Indian tradition. A well-deserved five-star experience every single time!

Went there to buy Mysore Pak to take them home as my friend's wants to taste it and Mr. Shashank helped me with the proper packaging so that I can take them properly to my hometown, gave me the sweets to taste..

Also had Dahi Papdi Chat and Aloo Tikki both were really good ♥️👌

Anand Sweets is definitely a great place to buy sweets and have some desi snacks.

name: Olive Beach
review_texts: On my anniversary visited Olive Beach in Bangalore, and it was an amazing fine-dining experience! 🤍✨ The ambience is elegant with beautiful Mediterranean-inspired décor, making it perfect for a date night or special celebration. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully plated, while the cocktails were equally impressive. The staff was courteous, attentive, and made the experience even better. Although it's on the pricier side, the quality, service, and overall atmosphere make it worth every visit. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Olive Beach never fails to impress! The beautiful, whitewashed villa and Mediterranean decor give off amazing Santorini vibes, making it the perfect romantic ambience for a date night. From the moment you pull up, the valet parking makes the experience stress-free right on a busy road. The service was top-notch—the staff were exceptionally warm, polite, and quick with excellent recommendations. As for the food, it was absolutely amazing. The veg mezze platter was incredibly fresh, and the wood-fired pizza and desserts were spectacular. Highly recommended if you want a classy, elevated dining experience in Bangalore!

Planning for a romantic date? or a family get-together?
Here's the perfect place for you.

This olive beach, the Mediterranean restaurant located in Ashok Nagar looks stunning with its beautiful interiors, the colorful drapes and art pieces against the white theme gives exotic vibes and the natural plants just enhance the beauty of the place.

It offers both indoors and outdoor seating arrangements, both of these come with their own benefits, the indoor looks more like a sophisticated cafe with easy chairs and controlled temperature, whereas the outdoor seating arrangement comes with beautiful drapes hanging from the ceilings, uncomfortably beautiful sofas with exceptionally small tables for 3 people and a live karaoke with lots of sweat because of the amazing whether of the bengaluru during peak summertime(Thanks to summer 2026).

We were almost the first to arrive on a sunday afternoon(12:00), my friend had booked a table for 3, they directed us to a table which is located at the outdoors despite we requested for an indoor table(Yes, we wanted to have a cool and breezy air of an AC), But the staff politely declined our request saying that, the indoor tables are only for 4 and more, since we were 3, we had to sit outside. Surprisingly the table which we sat later was also a 4 seater. The staff needs to be trained more on how to give better excuses.

While we sat on our table, We saw an inhouse photographer who was clicking photographs of random customers except us, In my defence we were well dressed and we were looking pretty.
It's okay,by looking at the way he was clicking the pictures, he didn't appear to be good at his own skills.

The best thing about the our afternoon was this beautiful girl Ms,Ranjani singing on a live katoke, Amazing voice, very graceful and very pretty, I wanted to send her a request to sing one of my favorite songs(They said they were open for requests), I asked multiple times to the waiters(I usually try to avid this word and I refer to them as staff, but the way they behaved I had to use it) but they ignored it.
Luckily I met this girl near the washroom(Btw the washroom looked great, I loved the interiors) and I requested her to sing "Rolling in the Deep". She acknowledged and sang it exceptionally well.

Oh I forgot about the food, who cares...!
Maybe next time, Let them work on their hospitality and skill development training for their staff.

The rating is 2.5 but grounding it to 2

A place that amazes you with all three aspects of an exquisite fine dining experience viz. Ambience, Taste and Service is extremely rare. Mostly you have ambience and service sorted but the taste of curated menu in such a fine place usually turns out to be okay but this is different, Olive Beach has all the aspects perfectly.

The ambiance is something I would repeatedly visit for. The food was great, except for one cold duck dish which I didn’t quite like other than that the drinks and the pizza and the chicken dish was really good. The service was amazing and the some free food which they provided in between was also great. Overall a great experience. The decor and the interior really has a great impact in the atmosphere, which makes you feel very calm and cozy. Slightly overpriced but recommended once in a while.

name: Uttam Sagar
review_texts: On my recent visit to Bengaluru, my friend suggested me to try breakfast from Uttam Sagar restaurant as I was craving for benne dosas. I can say that they serve one of the best dosas I ever tried in my life. They also have a variety of other dishes. I totally recommend that you try.

Unacceptable food quality. During my visit on 10 March 2026, I found a hard seed in the Masala Puri that could have caused choking or dental damage. This is not the first time I have noticed carelessness in food preparation here.

When customers are paying premium prices, basic food safety and quality control should not be compromised.

29th June 2026.

Extremely disappointing and unacceptable experience at Uttam Sagar, Banaswadi. I saw a live cockroach in the chaat counter while food was being served. This raises serious concerns about the restaurant’s hygiene standards and food safety practices.

A place serving food should maintain the highest level of cleanliness, and witnessing something like this completely destroyed my confidence in eating there. I hope the management takes immediate corrective action, improves pest control, and ensures such incidents never happen again.

Until then, I would advise customers to be cautious.

Great tasting food!

Recommended by our family who lives around the area and they come here very often for Masala dosa and I must say it definitely was a great one!

Tried also Dahi and Sev puri that were very good as well.

Near, clean, quick, popular standard self service South Indian restaurant which offers south indian, north indian n chinese cuisine primarily. I usually go here for beetroot halwa which is simply amazing. Their chole bhatoore, rice baat and dosas are also good which I have tried. Reasonably priced and easily accessible

We have been going here since many years for breakfast. Their menu has plenty of options to choose from. Prices are slightly on the higher side but the food is really good. Ground floor is self service. Sometimes the service experience is bad due to high demand especially on weekends. Parking is available in front of restaurant.

name: Milano Ice Cream
review_texts:
I recently tried the Hand Churned Rum & Raisin at Milano Ice Cream, and it was absolutely wonderful. The texture was very rich and creamy, and the flavor of rum with soft raisins was perfectly balanced. Every bite felt smooth and premium.

If you visit Milano Ice Cream, this flavor is definitely a must-try. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys classic, rich ice cream flavors. Great taste and a very satisfying experience! 🍨

This cozy place, set in a vintage-style house,

has a welcoming charm that makes it ideal for summer relaxation. Locals suggested I try their ice cream, and it lived up to the hype - natural taste, less sugary, and full of flavor. I chose mango and vanilla, both amazing in their own way.

Beyond ice cream, they have a variety of desserts and cookies that add to the attraction. The ambiance is laid-back, perfect for unwinding on warm days. Parking is a bit complicated, much like most areas in Bangalore, but the experience inside makes up for it. Overall, a delightful spot to enjoy authentic desserts in a cozy setting.

The gold standard for Gelato in Bangalore!

​If you’re looking for authentic Italian gelato, Milano is the place to be. The quality here is unmatched—every scoop is incredibly smooth, rich, and made with fresh ingredients.
This is My go to place and here are some of ​my Top Picks:
​Dark Chocolate: Intense, velvety, and not overly sweet.
​Fruit Sorbets: Tastes exactly like the real fruit—so refreshing!
​Nutella-filled Cones: A total game-changer; don't skip the waffle cone.
​The vibe is clean and bright, and the staff is always happy to let you sample a few flavors before you decide. Whether it’s the Indiranagar or New BEL Road branch, it’s a 10/10 dessert experience every single time.
​Tip: It gets crowded on weekends, but the service is quick!

Have been here couple of times, but for the first time for breakfast!

Typical english breakfast is available like mashed potatoes, brioche, eggs and breakfast pizza!

Mornings service is a bit slow and food was decent.

Fruit juices are good as they don’t add ice.

Chilled breakfast experience i would say.

A charming little gelato spot with a cozy, feel-good vibe. Set in a beautifully converted house on the main BEL Road, it offers plenty of seating, a lovely front yard, and views of the bustling street, all surrounded by greenery. It's the perfect place to catch up with friends over delicious pizza or gelato, with a great variety of flavors to choose from. Definitely worth a visit!

name: MASALA MANDI
review_texts:
⭐ Rating: ★★☆☆☆ (2/5)

I recently visited Masala Mandi, Sarjapur after watching a few videos online that made the place look really promising — vibrant ambience, great food variety, and a lively dining experience. While the ambience and service were indeed good, the overall food experience didn’t quite live up to the expectations set by the videos.

Starting with the positives — the restaurant has a pleasant and well-decorated setting that creates a nice dining atmosphere. The staff members were polite, attentive, and genuinely tried to make sure guests were comfortable, which I really appreciated. Service was quick and the team was courteous throughout.

However, when it comes to the food, I felt there’s significant room for improvement. Many of the dishes looked appealing but lacked authentic flavour. The taste didn’t quite match what was showcased online — it seemed that several items were made with a lot of soda or artificial ingredients, which left a heavy aftertaste and took away from the freshness one expects in Indian cuisine.

Another disappointing aspect was the drinks menu. Although the restaurant lists a good range of beverages, most of them were unavailable. It felt odd to be charged for drinks that weren’t even in stock or to have very limited options in what was supposed to be a full-fledged dining experience.

Overall, Masala Mandi has potential — the ambience and service are definitely its strengths. But if the restaurant wants to live up to its online reputation, it really needs to focus on improving the taste and authenticity of its dishes and maintaining consistency in what’s offered on the menu.

This restaurant is on the sarjapur road and 2 kms from bellandur. We went to this restaurant for team lunch. We booked prior from easy diner app for 12 people. They serve veg and non veg buffet. Veg buffet is ₹1050 and non veg is ₹1100. Coming to ambience its very nice feels like ancient art gallery type vibes. Food variety needs to be improved. And chats were good. Grill they served very less variety of starters. Live counter is not there except chat and dessert counter. Main course they have few varieties of salads, curries and rice items. They even gave bida pan which is rare these days in a buffet menu. In dessert they had 8 varieties. They have small parking infront of the restaurant itself. Overall it was okayish.

The atmosphere is good. we went there for Sunday lunch. Staffs are very well spoken and attentive. Service was good, nothing to complain about.
we tried mostly every item on the menu both beg and non-veg.
The starters and barbeque items are great.
The main course was okay okay.
Giving less stars, because the live counter options or the chat couter was only for the name shake. Coming to the dessert options - those are very very limited also the desserts were not at all tasting good, felt like they got the sweets from a cheap Sweet store.
So it was disappointing experience after paying for a buffet meal which costs more that 1100 bucks per pax

The food was awesome! 😋 Almost every dish was packed with flavor and masala, which we really enjoyed. The service was also excellent—staff were friendly and attentive. 👍

The only downside was the washroom area. There was just one hand-wash basin, and we had to wait nearly 10 minutes both before and after our meal to wash our hands. It was quite inconvenient. Hopefully, the management can improve this by adding more hand-wash facilities. Overall, a great food experience with room for improvement in customer convenience

I visited Masala Mandi on Sarjapur Road for a team lunch and tried their non-veg buffet. The experience was overall good. They started with a complimentary drink, which I personally didn’t like, but the starters that followed were quite good. The barbecue items were also good.

The main course was nice with a decent variety, and the desserts were enjoyable as well. The highlight for me was definitely the rasmalai, which I absolutely loved.

Overall, a good place for team outings, especially if you're planning to go for the buffet.

name: Cream Stone
review_texts: Scoop perfection! 😋 Loved the flavours, can't wait to come back. Friendly staff, delicious scoops! 👉 A must-visit for ice cream lovers

Recently visited this branch to try their Chitchat sundae and it was delightful experience. Their all three flavours of sundae were delicious. A perfect taste just melted in mouth. Amazing spacious ambiance. Must try their chitchat sundae at 89/- only .

It was ok ok, i felt there should much more to be good icecream. The quantity is less compared to price. Felt the little need for more options and improvements.
I felt the cold roll ones were better and DYI types are also cool to have.

We have tried the Mr.Alphonso mini. The mango icecream was really good with real mango taste and the waffle cone was also good but unfortunately, the mango pieces added as a topping have gone bad and tasted spoiled. Considering that there were only 5-6 mango pieces, we have removed the rest of them and just ate what's left of the icecream. Not worth it🙁

We visited Cream Stone and ordered the Banganapalli mango ice cream. After waiting for 20 minutes, we asked the worker about our order. He told us it was being prepared and would arrive in 2 minutes. We waited another 10 minutes, only for him to come back and say that the item was not available.

When I asked the person at the billing counter before leaving, he said there were no mangoes today. If the item wasn't available, why wasn't this communicated when we placed the order or at least when we first asked after waiting 20 minutes?

I don't know how dumb people can be. Wasted my 35 minutes. There is no option to give 0 rating, so giving a 1-star review. Won't come here again.

name: Kamat Bugle Rock
review_texts:
After almost 13 yrs my mouth was craving for some mouth 👄 watering 😋🤤 North Karnataka Meals!!

Never disappointed!!

Ordered the special meals..

Being a South Karnatakan, usually I don't like North Karnataka food much. But still the taste in this hotel was not bad. Unlimited roti available. Special dish costs ~340/- which is slightly high given the taste. No parking lot. Ambience is not great. Usually filled with oldies. No AC ! Overall okok

This place is truly incredible! The most authentic South Indian experience. The food is delicious! Holige, palya, jollad roti, sambhar rice,  ice cream and finish that all off with curd and butter milk and finally beeda.. the food is as I said lip smacking! The service is so humble and kind and sweet,

Quality of food was ok .. not great for the price . Visited this place earlier also it was much better . May be need some quality checks . So much of soda they used .. even after 4 hours if lunch feeling uneasy . Won’t recommend this place for sure
The serve very fast you can't eat peacefully. Unhigenic

name: Sri Raghavendra Stores
review_texts:
This 49 year old eatery, apparently serves one of the best Idli, neer chutney combinations in town & it's absolutely right. Although, I'm not a huge fan of Idli, the idli here is soft & chutney with a subtle spice, although a little salty for my taste. Apart from this, the Shavige bath & bisibelebath is a must try.

They've also opened up a dose camp across the street, where crispy doses are roasted, & during evenings, Indo-Chinese items like gobi manchurian, paneer chilli, babycorn manchurian are served here. The filter Coffee is simple & soulful; a perfect end to a perfect breakfast.

The reason for my 3 star raring is, the cleanliness. Absolute zero attention to hygiene. The place is always crowded, people come here for the taste, but the terrible hygiene is what made me change my mind about a second visit. The dose camp is comparatively cleaner & well maintained. I'd definitely return for the dose.

Raghavendra Stores is one of those cult-favorite Bangalore breakfast spots that keeps things simple and traditional. It’s not about ambience or comfort here it’s all about quick, authentic South Indian food at very affordable prices.

The food is straightforward but satisfying

* The idli is genuinely great for the price, soft, comforting, and easy to keep going back for.
* The shavige bath was also good, light and flavorful.
* The chutney had a nice pudina hint, which added a fresh touch without overpowering the dish.

That said, the place is almost always crowded, and there’s barely any seating available. Most people end up standing and eating, which is part of the experience at this point.

The biggest advantage is definitely the pricing, which is extremely reasonable and makes the place feel very worth it.

Went with family at around 1615hrs on Sunday. There was a mild rush in the evening. Its next to the Malleshwaram railway station. Its five decades old tiffin center.

Please note its not like a big fancy restaurant, its a small snacks point but with basic amenities like handwash & waterpoint for drinks. Would like to say the taste is really good.

The area is next to Malleshwaram Railway station. I loved the area's vibe. The rush got increased after 10 minutes.

One of the OG darshinis of Bangalore. It's next to the Malleshwaram railway station. A tiny shop serves softest idlies, crispy vada, shavige bhath, tea and coffee
I love the idly and vada.. On weekdays , there will be a lengthy queue. Definitely worth a visit

One of Malleshwaram’s iconic breakfast spots. Crispy vada, soft idli, tasty shavige bath, and amazing chutney with authentic old Bengaluru vibes. Simple place with huge crowds and limited seating, but definitely worth trying for classic South Indian breakfast!

name: Brik Oven - Woodfired Pizzas (Church Street)
review_texts:
OMG it was the best pizza I've ever had. We had ordered Bacon and caramelized onion pizza it was just so so good. We also ordered Cheesy stuffed chicken garlic bread which was so delicious. The presentation was so beautiful.

For drinks we had ordered Raspberry Lemonade and Dirty Coke, the Lemonade was beautiful it was so sparkling too. The Coke felt a bit watered down in flavour but still amazing. I wanted to try the coffee but unfortunately it was not available.

Ambience was beautiful and we got a seat fairly fast. Would love to visit again.

The Brik oven outlet at MG road is a bit small. Online reservation won't be useful here as they have their own system of serving the line outside.
Apart from that the food was affordable and the pizza were amazing. Not disappointing.
Also has options in size like mini, medium and large.. so can order for solo as well as family size.
Walkable distance from MG road metro station

The restaurant was smaller than expected.

The bread is the attraction here but everything else doesn't feel as good. The pizza crust was thick and the rest is thin - Neapolitan style. The Garlic bread was great 👍

Not a fan of the size of the shop nor the overall hygiene. Would do great in better settings.

Space is bit small. So better reserve in advance just like we did, else you will end up waiting in queues upto hour. Liked there stuffed garlic bread. Both pizza and garlic bread were preapared using sour dough. Good budget friendly place to hang out with friends.
Best pizza place ever. Must try mushroom and chicken pizza. Do not try cold brew latte and lemon ricotta cake.

name: XOOX Brewmill
review_texts:
Decent place. With nice music and vibe. Good ambience for date night as well!

We ordered

Asian green saucy dim sum and vegetable burger. All tasted nice. We’re cooperative enough to accommodate our no cheese request in burgers.

Bill - ~750 for 2 people for above food

Went for lunch last weekend. The place was ok , I think in night it's look more charming. The food we ordered was good in taste ,although Nachos were little overcooked one and the quantity of main course ( thai curry with rice) was very less..not worth the price. Craft beer was good .
Overall ok experience

Food was very mediocre with paltry quantity. The Japanese Ale Beer I’m sure they got it wrong coz it tasted anything unlike the description. It tasted totally watered down, completely tasteless. The ambience was loud, with the annoying commentary of IPL live

Visited on a Monday (bonus: no crowd, no waiting!) and loved the chill vibe. Tried Dal Makhni, Chicken Makhni & Paneer Butter Masala — all tasted great and freshly made they provided jeera rice as complimentary . The ambience is bright, with one full glass wall and eye-catching red maple tree replicas adding to the lively decor. Comfortable sofas, ample seating, and valet parking available. It’s right on the main road, easy to spot. Perfect for a relaxed lunch or casual evening hangout.

Food: Not too good but not bad at all. Far better than any brewery where the food is usually average.
Tried few of their items mentioned below
Crispy vegetables dimsum: average in taste, looks and presentation
Stuffed crunchy paneer kebab: this is one of their best dish, a very unique and tasty dish
Lotus stem chip: another unique dish to must try
Serradura: a very average and expensive desert

Service: This is something which this place can improve. You have to ask again and again for the basic cutlery since they will just keep the spoon and fork in front of you and once you get the table cleaned you will have to ask it again. Moreover they have mandatory service charge though its low but still irrespective of their bad service you have to pay for it in the name of their policies.

Atmosphere: One of the best thing was the ambience and songs which were being played alongwith the interior. This is something which is pretty cool. Nothing overdone or underdone, it’s just perfect.

Overall the place can be visited once but not again for sure

name: High Ultra Lounge
review_texts: Food is exceptional. Must try : Pork chops. Cocktails are also good. The seating outside is a bit uncomfortable. Spacious. But maintainance is average. Last but not least, the view. You have to visit it once just for the amazing view.

Had an amazing Friday night at High Ultra Lounge! The ambience, food, and overall vibe made for a fantastic dining experience. A special thanks to Antonio, whose service was exceptional. He understood exactly what we were looking for and made sure everything was perfect throughout the evening.

It was an absolute banger of a dinner, and we had a wonderful time. Highly recommend this place for great food, stunning views, and outstanding hospitality!

High Ultra Lounge is one of those places I kept going back to, mostly for the food.

Food: Really good. The dragon spring roll is one of my favorite appetizers I used to go there for that. The mushroom pizza was also really good and the cocktails are solid too.

Ambience: Inside has a pretty decent vibe. Outside is really blue and cozy at night, but it can get too windy sometimes. Also noticed that if you sit outside, the staff don’t pay a lot of attention. You can get amazing clips of the sky during sunset.

Service: Staff are a bit moody. I used to frequent this place so I’ve felt they have different attitudes at different times.

•The downside: Biggest disappointment was the IPL screening. The TV is really small and the DJ keeps playing loud music even after asking them to reduce it. Kind of defeats the purpose.

Food costs 2000 to 2200 per person without district 50% off so i would recommend pre booking on district Or swiggy.

I had such a pleasant experience here! ✨ The atmosphere is truly top-notch, really setting a lovely mood. I do wish the lift still had its cool glass floor, but the service was still great. If you plan to visit, definitely check dining apps for discounts, as menu prices are a bit high.

I visited this place for lunch, and it turned out to be a truly delightful experience. The buffet offered a wide variety of dishes, giving plenty of options to choose from and catering to different tastes. Everything I tried was flavorful and well prepared, making the meal thoroughly enjoyable. One of the highlights was the interactive stomping setup, which added a fun and unique touch to the experience, along with the live counters that brought freshness and excitement to the dining atmosphere. There was also live singing that created a pleasant and lively ambience without being overwhelming. The staff were extremely friendly, polite, and attentive, ensuring guests felt comfortable throughout their visit. Adding to it all was the top-notch view, which made the lunch even more enjoyable and memorable.

name: Proxy Restobar - Kundanahalli
review_texts: Proxy Restobar has a great ambience with good food, refreshing drinks, and excellent music that makes it a fun place to hang out. However, the service needs significant improvement. The servers seemed to lack motivation and attentiveness. Empty plates and glasses were left on the table for a long time, and even after repeatedly asking, tissues and spoons were not refilled promptly. The overall experience was enjoyable because of the food and atmosphere, but better service would make it much more enjoyable.

Hosted my husband’s birthday party here. The veg and non-veg menu was impressive, and the food overall was good. The tres leches was a standout, and drinks were decent.

The ambience is nice, though the indoor seating felt quite dark even during the daytime.

Had an amazing evening at Proxy! The rooftop ambience is absolutely stunning, especially as the sun goes down. We loved the Butter Chicken Sliders and the Paneer Ghee Roast—the flavors were spot on. The cocktails were the highlight, expertly mixed and very refreshing. Definitely a trendy spot worth visiting if you're looking for great food and a vibrant vibe!"

Proxy in Kundalahalli is a nice spot with a Bollywood-themed vibe that stands out from the usual places. The decor and music add a fun touch, and the ambience is lively—great for a casual hangout.
Food was good overall. The nachos are a must-try, well-loaded and flavourful, and the Thai curry was really good too.
Service was smooth, and the overall experience was enjoyable. Worth checking out if you’re in the area.

“Had a great experience at Proxy Restro Bar. Both veg and non-veg food tasted really good with great quality and flavor. The ambience was pleasant, the manager was very friendly and welcoming, and the service was excellent throughout the visit. Overall, a wonderful place to enjoy food and spend quality time with friends and family.”
-LG SOFT INDIA

name: Nandas
review_texts:
If you also think Nagarjuna meal is overhyped and definetely overpriced, this place is your respite.
Had a meal- served in traditional banana leaf, great variety, unlimited ofcourse and lip-smacking taste. Just wow. Typical Andra meal with items rotating in the menu over the week.
The daal, semiya and curry are to die for. Service is amazing and they will be prepared with what you need next beforehand. The meal goes really well with goli soda. At the end, the bill leaves you with a smile. Approx 250 per person per meal, thats it. A definite recommendation

Taste - 10/10
Location -10/10
Service -10/10
Variety-10/10
Value for money-10/10

I recently visited Nandas and had a really nice dining experience. The restaurant has a pleasant and comfortable ambiance with a clean and welcoming atmosphere. It feels like a true Andhra-style place where you can enjoy homely, flavorful food. I tried their thali and mutton biryani, and both were absolutely delicious. The thali had a great mix of dishes with rich flavors and perfect spice levels. Every item on the plate tasted fresh and authentic.

The mutton biryani was outstanding. The rice was cooked perfectly, the mutton pieces were soft and juicy, and the flavors were rich and satisfying. You can really taste the effort and quality in their cooking. The staff were very friendly, polite, and attentive. They made sure we were comfortable and served everything on time.

The overall experience was completely satisfying. The food quality, the Andhra-style taste, and the service all stood out. I actually forgot to take photos this time, but I will definitely update them on my next visit because this place truly deserves it. Nandas is a must-try for anyone who loves authentic Andhra meals and biryani that’s full of flavor and tradition.

Worst Food Experience at Nandas's HSR Layout. Ordered Chicken Biryani Large, Firstly I was cheated with quantity i was served small and second and most importantly the peices were only bones hardly any meat complained to senior guy there he was arguing bone peices will have bones !! what a discovery he made, should award him Bharat Ratna for it. None of us knew it😂.

No meat in peices (pics attached), Served Small instead of Large which i ordered. Tasteless, seemed microwaved left over previous night absolutely blunt taste. Staff were not honest. Bad Experience. Check pics below for idea what I am talking. Price not justified for the kind Food they serve, deprived quality and dishonest quantity and Staff feedback.

I recently visited Nandas in HSR Layout, and it turned out to be an excellent dining experience that I would wholeheartedly recommend. From the moment you step in, the calm and soothing ambience sets the tone for a relaxed meal. The interiors are well-kept, neat, and designed to make you feel comfortable, whether you’re dining with family, friends, or colleagues.

The highlight, of course, is the food. Every dish we tried was flavorful, freshly prepared, and served at the right temperature. The vegetarian options are outstanding, with the paneer dishes and South Indian thalis being especially memorable. The non-vegetarian selections are equally impressive – well-cooked, tender, and rich in authentic taste. What I really appreciated was the balance of spices: nothing felt too oily or overpowering, yet every bite was full of flavor. Portion sizes are generous, making it great value for money.

Equally commendable is the service. The staff is courteous, attentive, and quick to respond, ensuring that everything you need is taken care of without delay. It really enhances the overall dining experience when the team makes you feel welcome and looked after.

Whether you’re in the mood for a hearty family meal, a quiet dinner, or even a casual outing, Nandas in HSR is the perfect spot. With its delicious food, excellent service, and peaceful ambience, it truly stands out as one of the best dining destinations in the area. I’ll definitely be visiting again!

Visited Nanda’s Restaurant in HSR today and had an amazing experience! The Andhra-style dishes were packed with authentic flavors, and the Pepper Juicy Chicken was absolutely delicious – tender, spicy, and full of taste. A must-visit for anyone craving real Andhra food in HSR!

name: Ambrosia
review_texts:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Ambrosia! The ambience is beautiful, spacious, and perfect for a relaxed meal with family and friends.

We tried Dahi Ke Kebab, Cheesy Jalapeño Poppers, Cauliflower Popcorn, Don Pizza, Julia Roberts Pizza, customized Alfredo Penne Pasta, Hakka Noodles, Origin Mojito, and the sizzling Brownie. Every dish was freshly prepared, packed with flavor, and presented beautifully. The food quality is truly top-notch, and you can tell great care goes into every item on the menu.

One of the biggest advantages is the ample free parking available for both cars and bikes, making the visit completely hassle-free. The restaurant is also very kid-friendly and senior citizen-friendly, with a comfortable layout and welcoming atmosphere for all age groups.

The service was courteous, prompt, and attentive throughout our visit. Overall, Ambrosia is an excellent place for family dinners, celebrations, or casual outings. Highly recommended, and we look forward to visiting again!

Ambrosia in RR Nagar is an Italian and mexican restaurant that offers a pleasant setting, making it suitable for family dining and special occasions. The ambience is comfortable, and the blackcurrant punch stood out as a refreshing and well-made drink. We ordered the Maharaja Tandoor Platter and baby potatoes with hummus, both of which were good in taste and enjoyable.
However, the service needs improvement, as two of the starters were served late and arrived cold, which affected the overall experience. The dim sums were well prepared and tasty, but the pasta felt average and lacked enough cheese. The dessert nutella and cream cheese clouds was also just okay and did not really stand out. Overall, Ambrosia has potential and works well as a family dining spot, but faster service and better consistency in food would make the experience much better.
Very calm ambience with tasty Italian food. It’s great vegetarian restaurant in this area. Service was good and lot of options.

Ambrosia is an amazing place — truly one of the first vegetarian restaurants I’ve been fully impressed with. The space is clean, well-designed, and has the vibe of a sports bar with huge screens. It’s spacious, serves liquor, and the prices are very reasonable. We ordered a variety of dishes and everything tasted great — flavourful food without the “filler” soda effect that many restaurants rely on.

Even after eating a lot, our bill came to only ₹3.5K for five people, which is excellent compared to similar large restaurants. The option of both open and indoor seating is a big plus as well.

The only drawback was that several items listed online — like thalis and chaat — weren’t available when we visited. Since many customers choose restaurants based on menu items they see online, this can be a bit disappointing.

That said, I still highly recommend Ambrosia for its great food, service, ambience, and overall value. A must-visit for vegetarians.

One of the best places in Bangalore for  vegetarian Italian food. The ambiance is amazing , I would recommend for a pre booking there is always waiting. The only thing that can be improved is their service which is quite slow .

name: GOD Celebrations Cafe and Private Theatre - Rajajinagar
review_texts:
We recently attended a birthday celebration at God Celebrations, Bangalore, and it was a truly delightful experience. The venue was beautifully decorated with a warm and festive vibe, making the occasion extra special. The staff were extremely courteous and attentive, ensuring everything ran smoothly throughout the event.
The arrangements — from seating to lighting — were well thought out, and the attention to detail really stood out. The food was another highlight: fresh, tasty, and served on time, keeping all the guests happy. Children had plenty of space to enjoy themselves, while the adults could relax and enjoy the celebration without any stress.
Overall, it was a memorable experience and a perfect place to host birthdays or special occasions. I’d highly recommend God Celebrations to anyone looking for a well-organized and joyful event venue in Bangalore.

Trusted the reviews and expected it to be good. It's not worth . Studios are average,  neither the ac , projectors control nor the lights will be working properly ! I don't know why its so top rated !

We booked the private theatre and the experience was extremely good. The ambience was comfortable, sound and picture quality were nice, and it was perfect for a small group to enjoy together. The best part is that the price is very reasonable and budget-friendly. Overall, great value for money — we were fully satisfied. Thank you for the wonderful service!
A Beautiful Place to celebrate! The staff are very friendly, cooperative and Professional🎊 Had a great time celebrating my Mother’s BIRTHDAY with 10 people ❤️

When you look at the outer space of the cafe, it just looks like an ordinary building, but as you go inside, you get to understand that the cafe has multi celebration floors. The top floor is where the food is prepared, the washroom space holds to be very compact.
But the rooms which you can get on a timely basis for the celebration are excellent and space is well managed.
As our request and according to our needs, the walls will be decorated, which u will love for sure and right away open your cellphone to click a few selfies like I did.
On coming to food, If you ask me or my group of 10+ friends, we all liked it.
The veg starters and the cool drinks are pretty much tasty, satisfying and craws you for more:)

name: Corner House - Jayanagar 9th Block
review_texts:
Tried Corner House recently and it was so good!

The Cake Fudge was rich and chocolatey with soft cake and ice cream super satisfying. I also had a caramel pudding dessert (forgot the name 😅) and it was amazing soft, sweet, and full of caramel flavor with butterscotch icecream.

Definitely worth it if you love desserts!

Tried their dbc after seeing it as one of the world's best ice cream under 100th rank. Went with so much expectations. I didn't find anything special in it also too much sweet. Literally your tounge feels more sugar presence than chocolate. Overall we can try once. Also staff wont allow you to eat peacefully. They will dust under your legs while having ice cream. Definitely they need to mention some strict timing slot for cleaning so that it wont disturb customers.

Tried the Death By Chocolate. Came to ₹263 including GST and comfortably served two people. Rich chocolate-heavy dessert with layers of cake, vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, peanuts, cream, and cherries. The texture balance is good and the portion size justifies the price.

The outlet itself is compact, with seating for roughly 17 people across 5 tables, so it can feel crowded during peak hours. Ambience is functional rather than premium, but service was quick and the dessert quality holds up to the brand’s reputation.

Overall: 4/5. Good value, generous portions, and still one of the better quick dessert stops for classic chocolate sundaes.

We had a couple of Death by Chocolate, plus mango and vanilla ice cream. Overall, taste was good and we liked it.

But it felt a bit pricey for what you get. Also, I personally didn’t like the peanut with the brownie + ice cream combo — cashews would’ve worked way better. Something they should consider changing.

The place was really crowded and service was slow. We even had to call staff twice just to clear our table.

Good desserts, but service and pricing need work.

I tried the Death by Chocolate, and it was horrible.. tasted just like the cheap ₹15 softy ice cream you get outside a D-Mart. The amount of hot chocolate they drown it in would make anyone "die," especially at this sky-high price for such low quality. Avoid if your kids are under 10, and if you have borderline diabetes and are tired of living, give it a shot - it lives up to the name!

name: Hamza Hotel
review_texts:
Hamza Hotel is an excellent place for delicious food at very reasonable prices. Every dish is fresh, flavorful, and served in generous portions. The quality is outstanding, and the value for money is hard to beat.

The staff are friendly, the service is quick, and the atmosphere is welcoming. If you're looking for tasty food without spending too much, Hamza Hotel is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended—I’ll definitely be coming back!

Had a great experience at Hamza Restaurant. The food was tasty, fresh, and served on time. The staff were polite and helpful, and the overall service was very good. The place was clean and comfortable, making it a nice spot to visit with family or friends. Definitely recommended!

Visited Hamza Hotel in Shivajinagar tonight with high expectations because of its reputation, but the experience was extremely disappointing.

First of all, the waiter was not polite at all, and the service overall was far below expectations. The prices are extremely high, so naturally we expected the taste and hospitality to justify the cost — unfortunately, neither did.

The dal served was nothing close to proper dal; it was just like yellow-colored water with no taste or quality. Even the gravy served with the paratha was very poor and completely unsatisfactory.

For the amount being charged, this level of food quality and service is simply unacceptable. Definitely not the experience we expected from such a well-known place.

I would first say instead going to this better plan Empire or any other restaurants....bcz don't expect too hygienic here and other taste tho I seriously didn't like ...ordered mutton punjabi gravy...it was like tomato chutney....kabab was very much average i would say...i highly recommend not to visit and waste money...we 3 friends came out with upset mind bcz of taste..
This is not my first visit...same I have experienced many times but this time I decided next will never visit.....

Had mutton biriyani here.
Delicious taste, close to authentic shadi ki biriyani AKA Bangalore boroyani. The quantity was okay, a decent sized eater would possibly find it less. Meat was tender and cooked. Biriyani was served with surplus dal, baigan ka bharta and raita(chutney). Overall good biriyani.
Ambience is also okay.

name: CHAPTER ONE Bar|Maiin
review_texts: Went out for corporate lunch. Service was very slow . Drinks were too sweet. Highlight was the fish and prawns along with the crispy chicken and nachos. The desert was also a delight, the coconut panna cotta was really smooth and light.

Place is setup on a busy road but is well maintained. The ambience is good and peaceful. It should be really good during the night time with all the lights. I was there in noon. The food is good but not upto the mark i.e. all dishes except for egg were pretty cold. The service is good but gets confusing as the waiters are too many and handled by only one manager. However except for the beer, everything else was served immediately.

One of the best bars I have been to in North bangalore. Exemplary service. We visited during lunch time and the environment+ambience was so balanced in terms of perfection! I The food here was also good. Portions are small for the price but the presentation kind of justifies it! There is like 3 floors of seating area and all the floors are worth visiting.

Coming to drinks we ordered Broken angel, Muse, Bulls on parade & Like a stone. All four were so different and unique !

Wish you all who is reading this, have as much as a good time as I had

We were looking for a place near to our home to spend the valentine's day and landed on this.. The ambience of the place was okay-ish (nothing to write home about), i think better up keep is important.

The staffs were while friendly, the service was on the slower side.

Finally, the food however was on point. We went with classic indian foods (hariyali kebabs, naan, kadai chicken, keral parotta with mutton pepper fry etc along with drinks and dessert) and they were delicious, reasonably priced and well portioned.

If they can improve upon their ambience, upkeep of the place and service, i think they would definitely attack lot more crowd!

We  recently visited Chapter  and had an amazing experience! We were thrilled to enjoy their half-off menu offer — such great value for delicious food. Every dish we tried was fresh, tasty, and beautifully served.

The staff was really polite, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our meal. It’s always nice to see such good hospitality.

We left completely satisfied and happy — both with the food and the service. Definitely looking forward to coming back again soon. Highly recommend Chapter if you’re looking for good food, great deals, and warm vibes! 🍽️✨

name: Amma's Pastries
review_texts: I'm a regular customer of Amma's pastries.I ordered a Spanish Delight cake from the Kalyan nagar store. I wrote the message as 'Celebrating Us❤️'. Instead of this they wrote 'Celebrating Usd'. When I called the customer care and checked with them for a refund or an exchange of cake they said all they can accommodate is take the cake back and change the top part or a discount for next time. On what trust I can order the cake next time if they can't even write the message properly. Pathetic customer service from Amma's pastries and cheap response from their team. Never going to order and suggest to anyone.

Baked blueberry cheesecake had a plain vanilla sponge cake in between!!!! Need I say more. Disappointed in the size which is made much smaller & felt cheated by a vanilla sponge cake in between a cheesecake

Seriously, what a terrible experience! We bought a red velvet cake, and guess what? There was a mosquito in it! And we bought it for a little one. Luckily, we didn't give it to him. A lot of people really trust Ammas Pastry and just buy their cakes without thinking twice. You guys really need to get your kitchen clean and keep things hygienic.

I found this place to be just ok. The place is average. Food was tasteless and service was too slow. It took more than 30 mins to get our order on table. Vegetarian options are tasteless. One should only go for non-vegetarian food. There is only one person who takes your order thus takes time to place a order also if the person is busy with other tables. Overall not a nice experience. Prices are also average. Can be visited just once.

One of the most ridiculous customer service experiences I’ve had.

I bought cake for takeaway and asked for a spoon and tissues — the most basic items required to actually eat what I paid for. The staff refused as if this was some unreasonable demand. It honestly felt like customer convenience means nothing here.

Selling takeaway food without providing the basic ability to consume it is poor planning and worse service. Instead of being helpful, the staff attitude made it feel like customers are a burden.

Plenty of better options like Glen’s Bakehouse and Truffles where service actually matches the price you pay.

Definitely not worth it. Would not recommend.

name: Olive Street Food Cafe - Kammanahalli
review_texts: I ordered chicken jumbo roll from here and it was really good, they had two types of chicken, egg and a lot of veggies but the only problem is it's not spicy at alll, the only seasoning or sauce there was mayo, I feel like it would be nice if they had an option to opt in for a more spicer version. Overall I really liked it and it was very filling
Loved this place for its variety of food options for veg and non veg. Prices are reasonable and tasty. A very busy place to visit during evenings/holidays.

I ordered online through Swiggy, and the food was extremely disappointing. The sandwich pieces were barely 2 inches in size and weren’t even made with proper sandwich bread, just regular bread.

And the “paratha”? I honestly don’t know why it was called a paratha. It was even worse than the sandwich.

I’ve added photos here so people can see for themselves. I couldn’t upload them on Swiggy, but the quality and portion size speak for themselves. I will never order from here again and wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.
Amazing budget-friendly cafe with delicious food....One of Bangalore's best value-for-money spots! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The food was absolutely delicious.chicken and egg yolk cooked well..it was loaded with sauce and cheese. The portions were generous, and the presentation was pretty impressive. Crowded… great place to chill out evenings

name: The Bier Library Brewery & Kitchen, Sarjapur Road
review_texts: atmosphere and the ambience are quite good here. food was decent, there are a lot of varieties and you will enjoy it. service was good, especially the wait time was very less. I visited on a Saturday evening it was very crowded. DJ was good and I could see a lot of people enjoying the music and ambience. vallet parking is available, washrooms are well maintained. like any other similar places it is noisy, don't go here for serious talks as you may already know. just go here for food, drinks and fun and enjoy.

Bier Library, Sarjapur Road is easily one of my favourite chill breweries in Bangalore. The place has a massive dining area, making it comfortable even during peak hours without feeling cramped. It works really well for both lunch and dinner, whether you’re coming with friends or family.
The pizzas here are a must-try and pair perfectly with their brews. On top of that, the aesthetics of the place are beautiful — open, well-designed, and great for a laid-back outing. What really stands out is the staff; they’re extremely polite, attentive, and make the overall experience even better.
Definitely a spot I keep coming back to for good food, good beer, and a relaxed vibe. 🍕🍺✨

The place had serene ambience and a nice vibe. The food was delicious. The two pizza options we tried were amazing and all the appetizers we tried were yummy. The Korean fried chicken with cheese was a perfect snack. The grilled salmon was scrumptious too. Everything was fresh and served quite fast and so it tasted much better than typical bar food. The staff were friendly and helpful. They had ample parking and were kid friendly. We had a great time here and will be happy to spend more time in the future.

Totally loved the vibe of the place! Rahul was very kind and made sure we had everything we needed while serving the dishes. Since it was a Saturday night, there was a slight delay in service, but that was completely fine. We sat in the open-air seating and really enjoyed the music, atmosphere, and overall experience.

A complete vibe! Perfect for friends, family, and great food.
Whether you're catching up with friends or having a relaxed lunch with family, this place delivers it all. The atmosphere is fantastic, the music is spot-on, and the service is impressively fast despite the rush. The absolute highlight is the soothing pond right in the center - it adds such a relaxing, peaceful touch to the dining experience.
​I'm a regular here and highly recommend it. Must-try items: The Jhol Momo, Pizza, chocolate ganache cake, beat the heat (mushroom) and the falafel pita wrap. Also, their hummus is incredibly smooth, flavorful, and absolutely top-notch! 🌟

name: Flyover Drinkery
review_texts: Overall ambience was good . They played good bollywood Kollywood even Tollywood music too.. Dj was good.. We tried on Tuesday and environment is nice..not crowded but nice one..

One of my favourite places for dinner dates/new year parties or some casual disco nights with friends. This place has got it all. Larger seating, rooftop seating and good food and music. I have been here on multiple occassions and each time i had good fun. Recommeded. 100%
Very nice place to come with friends and family. Good food and also good quantity. Good music and can have a great time.
Vibe of the place was great and the food was  good as well. However the service was too slow when we visited on valentines day. Good place to chill though!

The food is excellent, with standout sauces accompanying the finger rolls and all items tasting delicious.
•	Alcoholic beverages and mocktails are both impressive, making it a great spot for drinks.
•	The ambience is lively and inviting, with a well-curated song selection that adds to the dining experience.
•	However, the cost is on the higher side, which might be a consideration for some.
•	Service was generally good, though there were a few instances where the waiter forgot parts of the order. Still, the quality of the food made up for these minor lapses.
