•	Overall, Flyover Drinkery is highly recommended for its great food, superb drinks, and energetic vibe-even if you might pay a bit more and face occasional service hiccups.

name: Siddiq kabab center
review_texts: Tried the famous seekh kebab after being in the queue for about 10-15 mins. The pieces were fine. However, hygiene of the place was very mid. Hope they improve the experience. A solid 7/10.

Best seekh kababs in bangalore hands down, everywhere else you'll get kababs that have very less meat and more binders like besan flour etc they taste like those artificial chicken "sausages" you get in supermarkets. Personally I felt they were a little under seasoned for my liking also the place doesn't feel very hygienic.

Street food for non veg lovers.
Try their seekh kebab, veal kebab, kalmi kebab.
The place is quite decent, less space to sit inside . However road side tools are their. Parking is ample but better to go on a 2 wheeler. Might have to stand in queue as well.
Taste is good, service is good.

Siddiq Kabab Centre near Johnson Market is truly an OG place when it comes to seekh kababs and Beef kalmi kaba. If you are a beef lover, this spot is an absolute must-visit in Bangalore.

Their seekh kabab, seekh kabab roll, and beef kalmi kabab are simply amazing. The taste is rich, juicy, and packed with flavor - easily one of the best seekh kababs you will eat in Bangalore. Every bite is mouth-watering and worth the wait.

Speaking of wait, be prepared- there is usually a long queue. It’s a self-service setup where you need to take a token and then wait for your order. Even late at night around 11:00 PM, the place is heavily crowded.

There isn’t a proper dine-in area. They’ve arranged a few stools and benches along the footpath, so you’ll likely be sitting outside while enjoying your food. Despite the limited seating and heavy crowd, people keep coming back purely for the taste.

Overall, if you’re in Bangalore and love beef dishes, make sure you visit this place at least once for their seekh kabab and beef kalmi kabab. The setup may be basic, but the flavor is outstanding.

Went out shopping with my wife near Johnson Market, and she was craving kebabs—so we stopped by Siddiq Kabab Center.

And honestly, it didn’t disappoint.

We tried their seekh kebab, beef kalmi kebab, and a seekh roll—all of them were juicy, packed with flavor, and cooked perfectly. The kind of food where you take one bite and just look at each other like “yeah, this was the right call.” Easily one of the best seekh kebabs I’ve had in Bangalore.

The place itself is very basic—no fancy dine-in, just a few stools and benches outside. It’s self-service, and there’s usually a queue (we had to wait a bit too), but once you get your food, it makes sense why people keep coming back.

Parking can be a bit of a hassle, and it does get crowded, especially in the evening. But if you’re here for the taste, none of that really matters.

Overall, a proper no-frills, high-flavor spot. Perfect for a quick stop after shopping or when those kebab cravings hit hard.

name: Maharaja Vaibhava- Vijaynagar
review_texts:
Extremely disappointing experience. I visited this restaurant expecting good food and decent service, but it turned out to be one of the worst dining experiences I've had.I ordered the North Indian meal based on the cashier's recommendation. Unfortunately, it was nowhere near worth the high price I paid. The meal was incomplete—they forgot to serve the salad and papad, and I had to remind them before they brought them. This basic lack of attention to customers is unacceptable.
The food quality was very poor. The curries were bland, lacked proper seasoning, and tasted stale rather than freshly prepared. The overall meal had no authentic North Indian flavor and was far below expectations. For the price they charge, customers deserve fresh, flavorful food, not something that feels like it has been sitting for hours.The restaurant's hygiene standards also need serious improvement. Although the place is relatively new, it already appears poorly maintained. The dining area was not clean enough, and the overall atmosphere did not inspire confidence. There was no proper RO drinking water facility; instead, they were serving water from a bubble-top can. This made me question whether they even use purified water for cooking.The seating arrangement was also uncomfortable and not well maintained, making the dining experience even less enjoyable.Overall, this restaurant is charging premium prices without delivering the quality, hygiene, or service that customers expect. I regret choosing this place based on the recommendation given at the counter. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and improves the food quality, cleanliness, and service. Until then, I cannot recommend this restaurant to anyone.

Absolutely terrible experience. The restaurant had very less customers and almost empty, yet it took nearly one hour for our order to arrive. There was no valid explanation or even a sincere apology for the delay. Waiting that long when there are barely any customers is simply unacceptable.
To make matters worse, the food was disappointing. The taste was average at best and definitely not worth the long wait. The overall experience was frustrating and left us regretting our visit.
Poor service, poor time management, and underwhelming food. I would not recommend this restaurant and certainly won't be returning.

Worst food..
Check how the machow soup is prepared. Taste like hot water with some masala.

Pricing is on higher side compared to the worst quality of the food.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a great experience at Maharaja Hotel. The Vada Pav was really delicious—crispy, fresh, and full of flavor. Service was good, and the food was worth the price. Will definitely visit again

Very disappointing experience. We found a cockroach in the Baby Corn Manchurian we ordered. The service was also extremely slow. Poor hygiene and poor service. I don't want to give even a single star. ❌🪳

name: Amma's Pastries
review_texts: Quality is degraded to a worst level in btm layout .. thought quality is maintained and spent 4.5k for a cake here and to our surprise it is not even average. Cake is hard like a bread and dry.  It happened before as well but thought it is one time mistake. Many competitors offering in less price like cakewala.. etc in btm with good quality.. don’t waste your money and spoil the precious occasions.

Great spot if you looking for pastries 🥐 & cakes 🍰.
Brought some vegetarian cookies.
Little bit costly for pastries & cakes.
Customer friendly but ambience & atmosphere of interior is not that good.
Have a sustainable option ♻️ of providing a waste bin 🚮.

Wheelchair accessible ♿❌
LGBTQ+ 🏳️‍🌈 Friendly ✅
Kid Friendliness ✅

Had an Heart shaped cake ordered and they made it freshly within 30mins and tasted so good.
I’ve been tasting Amma’s pastries for years now but in different branches.
This branch as well gave the same taste.
Pastry was good without unnecessary sugar and dalda. Have managed to retain the OG pastry quality. Less flavor options and questionable seating area. Good for takeaway.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting this fantastic ammas pastries bakery that offers a wide range of pastries, cakes, and other delicious baked items. The highlight of my experience was undoubtedly the chocolate and white forest cake, which was nothing short of amazing. The cake was beautifully presented and had a delightful texture that melted in my mouth.

I would wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone who considers themselves a cake lover.

If you're looking for a place to satisfy your cake cravings, look no further. Trust me, you won't be disappointed.

name: Nandhini Deluxe - Andhra Restaurant - RT Nagar
review_texts:
Welcome back, Nandhini!

This is specific to RT Nagar branch.

Having enjoyed this cuisine for over 20 years, I genuinely felt that the charm and flavors of the early Nandhini days are back. The quality and taste of the food were excellent, bringing back fond memories of what made the restaurant so popular in the first place.
The ambience and service have also improved significantly, making the overall dining experience even better. The only challenge is parking, especially for four-wheelers, which can be a bit difficult during busy hours.
Overall, a very enjoyable experience, and it's great to see Nandhini back to its best.

Had a wonderful dining experience at Nandini delux. Food is   fresh, flavorful, and served continuously, with plenty of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options to choose from.

The ambience was lively, clean, and perfect for family gatherings or celebrations. The staff were courteous, attentive, and ensured we were well taken care of throughout the meal.
Overall,  offers great value for money with tasty food, excellent service, and a memorable dining experience. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a premium food in Bangalore, and I'll surely be visiting again!

Must try : South Indian Andhra style meals

Fantastic Andhra food. It's a new place and we just loved it. Can rate it on par with Bhimas meals. We didn't try the biriyani. But the meals and Kababs were just fantastic. Ram laxman was a very good person who served us.  Thank you

I had a great Experience At Nandini! The food is splendid! And the first reason why i choose to come here, is the customer Service! I met a really good staff! Rina aktar who treated us very well and never kept us waiting, very polite too..my first preference is Nandini, first for it's customer care and second for it's food and hygiene

Restaurant has good ambience and service is great too. The food however was very disappointing .We ordered 2 meals and a non veg starter. Asked for their spiciest non veg starter and they got us chicken kshatriya . And its boiled drumsticks with chicken stock mixed with cornflour and capsicum . Absolutely bland! No taste whatsover. We asked for their spiciest starter and they got us this bland semi gravy thing. Thoroughly disappointed.
Meals were also just ok.
Not too great.
All that for a bill of 1250/-
Definitely not worth it.

name: CHIN LUNG RESTO-BAR, KORAMANGALA
review_texts:
This is a spacious and comfortable pub with a lively ambiance and fresh been on tap.

At lunch time, it wasn't very crowded and the service was prompt. The staff is very professional and efficient. I suspect that it would be harder to communicate with them when the music gets louder.

I tried their fried rice, a chicken appetizer, and some draught Tintin Toit. The food is disappointing for a bar which is spun off from a Chinese restaurant. The beer is fresh.

Really had a great time here. Atmosphere was great . Music 🎵 was going on with great vibe selection. Nice place to hangout with friends and have a great dishes together with lots of options around veg and non veg. There also have a great menu options for non drinker people. We also had a great vibe around the table. This place also have a great guest all have fun around them self, everyone chills on there own .
Service Is also at its best . Waiter service was dot on time and order also
At last , had a great time in here .
Thank you 👍 for giving us a great time Chin Lung Resto-Bar .
Thank you for

Chin Lung Resto Bar is one of the best budget-friendly spots in Koramangala. The prices are reasonable, the portions are generous, and the food is worth the money. The lively atmosphere, quick service, and friendly staff make it a great place to hang out with friends without spending too much. Definitely a go-to spot for affordable food and good vibes.
Just ok nothing great,  but value for money go for bottle beer food is good, ok for get together.

I would have rated this restaurant 4 but rating it 5 mainly because of the behaviour by the service staff. We had a made a reservation here. But as soon as we entered the waiter hospitality was very bad. His tone was rude. He kept constantly asking is to show reservation and insisted is to sit on a particular table. I didn't like this behaviour and I asked the staff change. The other guy who served us was good. He suggested us some dishes to try. What I would say is hospitality matters when we go out. If we are not treated right will never get back to you.remeber we are paying you. Your food is not free for us.

name: Once Upon A Rooftop Restobar
review_texts:
Roof top was so good, felt refreshing to be there. Good service. Maintained good plants on the roof, good ventilation, clean washrooms with no light inside😄
Food was average, ordered few starters, mushroom Manchurian, corn, and cheese, pineapple and cherry was just okayish.
This is a great place to hang - no doubt. The food is great, they have some excellent signature items. Very helpful staff. The rooftop ambiance makes everything even better

I recently visited Once in a Rooftop in Bangalore, and it was an absolute delight! The ambience is stunning, with a breathtaking rooftop view that adds to the charm of the place. The dim lighting, cozy seating, and lively music create the perfect setting for a relaxing evening. Whether you're catching up with friends or on a date, the vibe here is just right. The service was prompt, and the staff was courteous, making sure we had a great experience.

Coming to the food, the menu offers a mix of global and Indian flavors, and everything we tried was spot on. The Peri Peri Chicken Wings were a highlight—crispy, spicy, and full of flavor. The Pasta Alfredo was creamy and well-balanced, and the signature cocktails were refreshing, especially the Mango Chili Martini. The pricing is reasonable for the quality and experience, making it worth a visit. If you're looking for a rooftop spot in Bangalore with great food and a fantastic vibe, this place should be on your list!

Great food at affordable prices! All starters under ₹149, small plates from ₹49 – perfect for students & budget foodies. Loved the Fish Fingers, Brownie with Ice Cream, and the Pizza – unlike any I’ve had before! 🍕🤤

The rooftop ambience is perfect for chilling. Definitely a must-visit in Jayanagar!
Cute place of you're okay with cigarette smoke around you. Very good food although a bit on the pricier end. Had a lovely evening here!

name: Matteo Coffea
review_texts:
I've been going to the MG Road metro station for about ten years, but until today, I never had the opportunity to go to this cafe, which is directly in front of the station.

The cafe has got very cool vibes and hosts both indoor and outdoor seating arrangements. We decided to have a table inside for obvious reasons.
The steats were very comfortable and tables were spaced properly with a good amount of space between two tables so that we wouldn't hear the conversation form the next table.

We ordered an espresso shot, a cold coffee(for me) and some water based tea for my friend. The cold coffee was really amazing with a perfect blend of coffee and cold milk. My friends said their drinks were good but mine was the best (they did taste the cold coffee from my cup).

The interesting part about the washroom, it's made of steel and looks like a giant refrigerator, its really high time they should change the mirror and interiors of the men's washroom(cutting down a star for this).

Had a great time here. Great place if you are planning to hangout with your friends. Not recommended for remote work because they dont have a WiFi facility  in 2026. Can you believe it?

If you are a food lover. This place is LIT🔥🔥.
One of the best burgers and shakes I have tried and the fires…. So perfect in texture and crispness. We ordered 2 burgers a wrap(without mayo, cheese , oil) and a cappuccino. The service was okay ish and the seating also the same. But the food just blows a persons mind away..

Good place to have a coffee and chill for some time while you are exploring busy alleys of brigade road/church street/mg road.

The sandwiches, burgers and pasta are worth try. Place is descent and affordable for all age groups.

Offers plush, comfort indoor seating with sober interiors and ample space for people to enjoy conversation over a cup of coffee, even on their wooden chairs outdoors. Decent cold beverages & desserts, but minimal options for warm beverages.

A fairly quiet joint on a rather noisy street. Had a cool and relaxing weekend with a friend over some pasta and coffee. Also met another friend, a writer who also likes this ambience. Great indeed to unwind and look back upon some inspiring moments of life. The staff were courteous and helpful. Spent about an hour and a half hour and enjoyed thoroughly. Complimented the management while leaving. Would certainly like to return for another cool weekend.

name: Skygarden Best Rooftop Bar & Kitchen Restaurant
review_texts:
The staff behavior was very nice, and Deepika attended to us very well. The place was pleasant, and the food was good. The soup was especially excellent, while the prawns were okay. Overall, the staff behavior was awesome and made the experience even better.

They added a service charge to the bill, and when we asked to remove it, they accept. Also, they do not accept Swiggy Dineout payments directly; instead, they provide the Swiggy discount directly in the bill.

I visited Sky Garden recently. The place is good and not too crowded. The DJ was good, the ambiance was nice, and the staff were polite and helpful.

I would like to specially mention Divya — she was very courteous and supportive.

The only downside is the beer options, as there were very limited choices available. Also, the pricing felt very expensive compared to what I expected.

Overall, I felt good about the experience apart from the high pricing and limited beer options. ⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a great time at Sky Garden, Whitefield this weekend!

We tried Loaded Cheesy Fries BBQ Chilli Paneer, Chilli Mushroom Pizza, Chicken Fusilli Smoked Tomato & Chilli, and Veg Aglio Olio, and honestly every dish was delicious. The food was flavorful and perfectly prepared.

The drinks were awesome, especially the Pina Colada and Pretty Bird — very refreshing.

The ambience is really good, making it a perfect place to relax and spend time with friends. Also, the staff were very polite and attentive, which made the experience even better.

Overall, it’s a great spot for a weekend chill.
Thanks to the team for the wonderful experience!

By far the best buffet I had been too. Hands down a clear winner. Recently had been to skygarden with my girl squads and trust me it was all worth it. Would highly recommend this place, we had been here on a weekday and the food was to the point. Most of the dishes were too good. Don't miss out these, the crispy fish, corn, potatoes on the starters. Mains had this delicious red thai fish curry, burnt garlic noodles and pasta that you would love. Brownies and tiramisu scores here well. Staff Manav was very respectful and polite, they served us the buffet. Give it a try.

Visited Skygarden and really liked the rooftop ambience — it has a great vibe and is perfect for a relaxed evening. The food was good and the overall setting feels premium.

However, the experience had a few downsides. Most of the beers on the menu were out of stock, and the beer I ordered was not the one that was served, which was disappointing. Considering the pricing, this could have been handled better.

Overall, a decent place mainly for the ambience, but service needs improvement.

name: MAYURA 1989 Bar & Kitchen
review_texts: Visited MAYURA 1989 Bar & Kitchen and the overall experience was very good. The food taste was excellent, well prepared, and satisfying. Ambience is pleasant and comfortable, making it a good place to relax and enjoy a meal. Service was smooth and timely. Fully happy with the visit. Highly recommended.
A great place to hang out with a fantastic rooftop ambiance. The service was good, and while the vegetarian options were a bit limited, the overall experience was enjoyable.

Service: Subpar (disappointing at times)
Food: Most of the items were good.
Overall experience: Average

Our family of five visited this restaurant hoping to enjoy a good meal and spend some quality time together. Unfortunately, the entire experience was ruined because of the poor service.

The main issue was with the person taking our order, Jeevan. We requested a lassi as soon as possible because my uncle was experiencing acid reflux and had a coughing fit. Instead of acknowledging the urgency or giving us an update, there was no response. Even after waiting nearly 15 minutes, every time we asked about it, we were either ignored or simply asked what else we wanted to order.

When we finally expressed our concern and asked when we could expect the lassi, his exact response was, "If you want, I can cancel the order," said in a very dismissive and arrogant manner. That level of customer service is unacceptable.

What made the experience even more uncomfortable was how he treated the rest of the staff. The employees serving the food were polite and trying their best, but he kept interrupting them, correcting them constantly, and creating confusion. At one point, he even yelled at another employee in front of us and other customers, warning him that it was "the last time" he was being warned. Watching an employee being publicly reprimanded like that was unprofessional and unpleasant. The staff appeared visibly anxious around him throughout our visit.

To make matters worse, the restaurant charged separately for the cover to carry the takeaway box, even though it was branded with the restaurant's own name. They also added a 5% service charge to the bill, marked as "voluntary," without asking whether we wanted to include it. None of these are legally okay. That practice felt misleading and unethical.

The food may have been decent, but the service completely overshadowed it. What should have been a pleasant family gathering turned into a frustrating experience. Sadly, we've lost interest in visiting this place again.

Went here on a weekend afternoon.
2nd floor is very hot environment, even with Ac being on.
Chicken starters and Tandoor items were good.

Masala papad was too spicy with green chilly sprinkled generously 🔥

They levy 5% service charge here.
Very nice food and Mr Pradeep also served very good food thanks for services..

name: Wildcraft
review_texts: Situated on the first floor of gopalan mall. They do have backpacks,laptop bags,hiking bags, travel bag,outdoor clothing. Price is similar to international brands. Quality is excellent. You won't find much of wearing. But you do get shoes rain coats . Discounts are offered only during major festivals. Staffs are good and professional with having certain knowledge on products they sell. Collection are also good.
One of very good entertainment place in Bangalore,but all entertainment entry fees little bit high.

Exquisite exterior of the mall brings royalty.
Inside is just for normal shopping,(Shopper Stop, Lifestyle, Spar, Reliance Trends, Reliance Digital) Dining( Mac Donald’s, KFC, Pizza Hut) For Movie Gopalan Cinemas.😊

This mall looks like a palace from outside. There are lot of shops here like shoppers stop, Reliance trends, spar, max store etc. Mall is not well maintained. Toilets are not clean. Less parking place.

A shopping experience par excellence thanks to the store keeper who not only has a helping nature but is excellent with follow through and in resolving issues and product complaints. Kudos to him for me to keep faith in the brand and their commitment. A place where customer satisfaction scores over profit.

name: Amintiri - Cafe | Patisserie | Gifting
review_texts:
Absolutely worth the hype.

The Avocado Cheese Sandwich is a must-try. The Butter Croissant paired with their Hot Chocolate was a fantastic combination, and the Pull-Up Stretches Lotus Biscoff Cake was both delicious and indulgent. We also tried the Caramel Macchiato, which was smooth, flavorful, and perfectly made.

If you’re a coffee lover or simply enjoy good café food, this place is definitely worth a visit. Great food, great coffee, and an overall wonderful experience.

Pulled by this cafè for a quick lunch on a Sunday. The ambience and service were sublime and I didn't have to wait for being assigned a table. In a nutshell, you get what you pay and there doesn't exist any compromise on the quality of food which is served here. It is a sort of a cafè worth being hopped on to once in a blue moon and it certainly does live up to the hype.
It is undoubtedly a patisserie lover's paradise.
I ordered their smoked grilled chicken filled croissant sandwich and their burnt basque cheesecake. They both were above par and I was more than satisfied. Thank you for the good food & warm service :)

This is an edit and is after my second visit. The place had already set a solid impression on my first visit and they needn't had to do anything to prove themselves. Jackie was my very calm, gentle. generous server for the day. Thank you for catering to me well. I had ordered 3 of their desserts, them being yet again their Burnt Basque Cheesecake, Tiramisu and Belgian Dark Chocolate Truffle Cake. All 3 were bangers. The Tiramisu wasn't the best I've had in Bengaluru, but was just above average (if you don't have high expectations) but their Belgian Dark Chocolate Truffle Cake is going to be a straight-up paradise for dark chocolate lovers. Absolutely sensational. Thank you for having me over guys.....until next time :)

Amintiri is a standout destination for brunch enthusiasts, offering a refined yet cozy atmosphere that pairs perfectly with its artisanal menu. The cafe is widely praised for its consistent quality and sophisticated presentation, making it a favorite for both leisurely weekend breakfasts and quick, upscale coffee breaks.
* **Eggs Benedict:** A highlight of the breakfast menu, the eggs are poached to perfection with a velvety hollandaise sauce that is rich without being overpowering.
* **Vanilla Cold Coffee:** This drink is a refreshing balance of smooth, premium coffee notes and a subtle, creamy vanilla finish, making it an ideal companion to their savory dishes.
* **Avo Toast:** Served on high-quality bread, the avocado toast is generously topped with fresh, seasoned mash and vibrant garnishes that provide a delightful crunch and tang.
* **Atmosphere:** Beyond the food, the cafe’s stylish interior and attentive service create a welcoming environment that feels like a true escape in the heart of the city.

Absolutely loved my order at Amintiri! The Masala Cheese Omelette was perfectly cooked, loaded with flavor, and the cheese made it extra delicious. The Mini Mango Pull Up was the highlight—refreshing, creamy, and packed with rich mango goodness. Every bite felt worth it. Great taste, quality ingredients, and a wonderful experience overall. Can’t wait to visit again! 🍳🥭✨

It is such a cozy and warm place to hang out. The food was amazing  every dish we tried was top-notch. Their pull-up cake and Nutella strawberry entremet definitely deserves a special mention it was delicious and not overly sweet, which made it even better. The staff were very attentive and polite adding to the overall pleasant experience. Since it’s a small café, it can get quite crowded on weekends, so you might have to wait a bit. But honestly the food and vibe make it totally worth it.

name: Sangam Mess
review_texts:
Visited this restaurant through a friend recommendation. Was worth the try.

From Vegetarian meals to Egg burji & Neymeen Fry was yummy.

Egg Burji is a must try.

Service is fast and friendly staff.

Parking is very difficult to find on the main road which is already narrow. A 100 Meters walk to the restaurant inside a small lane at the dead end.

The fish curry was a standout dish, rich in flavor and perfectly balanced with spices. The gravy had a deep, aromatic profile with a pleasant tanginess that complemented the freshness of the fish. Each bite felt comforting, with the fish cooked just right—soft, juicy, and absorbing all the flavors of the curry beautifully.

The fish fry, on the other hand, offered a delightful contrast. Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, it was seasoned well with a blend of spices that enhanced the natural taste of the fish without overpowering it. The golden crust added a satisfying crunch, making it an excellent accompaniment to the curry or even enjoyable on its own.

Together, the fish curry and fish fry made for a complete and satisfying meal. The combination of bold, spicy gravy and crispy fried fish created a perfect harmony of textures and flavors, leaving a lasting impression.

Good place to try non-vegetarian kerala cuisine with your family and friends.. service also good... affordable price... quality is good but quantity is decent.. had dinner with my wife...didn't expect the bill is very affordable... my suggestion to the management is the place is bit congested... very less space for aisle.. try to rearrange the tables to accommodate as well as some space between the tables... Highly recommended to visit if you visit Kammanahalli area.

We finally made it for a Saturday lunch at this much-talked-about little eatery in Kammanahalli. Got there right at noon to be safe — a few tables still open, but the place was already humming with people settling into an early weekend meal.
The first thing that struck me was how unpretentious it all felt. Simple, neat, nothing overdone. The owner at the desk greeted us with a genuine smile — the kind that sets the tone before the food even arrives. The staff followed suit — warm, easy, and more than willing to guide us through the menu.
The food did take its time coming, which did catch us off guard for a place that clearly runs a full house most days. The famed Kerala meals weren’t available — apparently a cooking gas issue — which, oddly enough, just made us appreciate that we got anything at all without much fuss.
Now, the highlight — the seer fish mango curry. Quite honestly, the best I’ve had. And that includes some very reputed places back in Kerala. Beautifully balanced, sharp where it needed to be, and just... complete.
The crab fry and prawn masala, however, didn’t quite keep up. Both were decent, but hovered around the average mark — a bit of a surprise given how strong the meal had started.
The tender coconut pudding brought things right back on track. Light, just the right sweetness, with that gentle coconut finish — exactly what you want at the end of a meal like this.
Parotas were good. Ghee rice worked well too — no complaints there.
All in all, a solid 8 out of 10. And we’re not done here yet — feels like there’s more on that menu worth going back for.

We were here for lunch a few days ago and we had one of our best lunches ever here. Simple, fast moving place. We ordered their kerala meals with anchovy fry, meen polichattu and kallumukkaya fry. The mussels fry was incredible, so delicious. The meals were delicious. We got their prawns biryani and clams fry packed, both 5/5!  Their passion fruit mojito was excellent too. Great service and don't miss out on their tender coconut pudding.

name: Stonny Brook
review_texts:
One of finest and Unique place I ever have been till date. Budget friendly, the quantity is actually alot for normal appetite people.
The place is very cozy for family, friend's and a date night.
Contact them in advance for anniversary or date night celebration 🎉.
Mr. Chetan was very kind and helpful to help us with the menu and food.
Really liked the place alot... Must go place for multiple times.
Cost for our food was ₹1000/- as we ordered soup, starter, juice and main course... Which we had to take parcel because of the quantity😂

Service is slow and pathetic , chicken tikka was undercooked, fries were good, ordered noodles and Naga chilli wings, and even after 1 hour food was not delivered. Tired and hungry we left the place. No one was even there to take bill, we had to chase captains to pay the bill. Not recommended but if want to go fir Ambience, that is beautiful. Fish spa is also good

I visited with my family expecting a fine dining experience based on the excellent reviews, but it was very disappointing.
When we arrived, the restaurant was almost empty. The tables weren't properly set, there was no water served, and the overall atmosphere didn't feel welcoming. The staff seemed surprised that customers had actually walked in, and there was no warm hospitality.
We waited around 30 minutes for the food despite there being hardly any guests. The chicken barbecue was undercooked, and the masala tasted raw, making it unpleasant to eat. The bill, however, was surprisingly high for the quality of food and service we received.
We paid the bill and ended up going to another restaurant for dinner. Unfortunately, this was not the family dining experience we had hoped for.

Really enjoyed the atmosphere great place, okish food and service is quite good, really recommend to visit more often.

I recommend to visit before 7PM if you are visiting with family.
So much delay in service but the foods taste and quality makes us forget the delay.. should improvise the kitchen team. Otherwise all good. Had a great time

name: Roots Restaurant
review_texts:
Visited Roots recently, and the experience truly lived up to its name. The ambience beautifully reflects nature - earthy, soothing, and effortlessly calming. It creates the perfect backdrop for a relaxed meal.

The food was delicious across the board. The garlic cheese naan with paneer lababdar was a combination made in heaven; rich, flavourful, and perfectly balanced. The garlic noodles were also incredibly tasty, adding a delightful twist to the meal.

Overall, it was a satisfying dining experience with great flavours and a refreshing atmosphere.
Would definitely recommend Roots for anyone looking to enjoy good food in a nature-inspired setting! 🌿✨

We went for a late lunch around 5pm. The ambience is pretty neat and calming. The tandoor items were not available, hence we couldn't try any of their starters. We ended up ordering the main course directly. We tried the chicken ghee roast. This is not even ghee roast, though there was ghee it was made using tomatoes that too had a raw tomato flavour (who even uses tomato in ghee roast?)
Then we had phulka and basmati rice with murgh rara. The gravy was flavourful and good.
The mains issue is with their service. Since basmati rice was extra we asked to pack it. I was surprised to see in the bill packing charges ₹5 and carry bag ₹10! They conveniently added service charges though there is a clear Govt ditective to not bill a  service charge. When asked the waiter said anyways you are paying through district and getting 25% off right ? What kind of nonsense is this ? Though after arguments he accepted if u told before paying i could have removed it. Hope they improve on their service. Came here after positive reviews about the starters they serve, unfortunately couldn't try any of it.

Visited this place for dinner with friends.
The ambience was cozy and pleasant, creating a nice vibe. All the dishes we ordered tasted perfect.
The fish fingers and garlic chicken were the highlights, while the chicken soup was also quite good.

Valet parking is available.

Food quality and taste is commendable. Visited on a weekday for lunch and was very satisfied. The menu is spread across veg and non-veg. Both the options were enjoyable. The atmosphere is very pleasing and the restaurant is maintained well. Definitely a good restaurant to try.

The hygiene levels are pits to say the least. There are roaches running on the table. When we asked for a change of table, they did oblige but were casual about the hygiene part. As for the food part it was tasty and spice levels were as requested. Not sure how hygienic the kitchen would be?

name: Fire Station - Bar & Kitchen
review_texts:
Food was average and not as spicy as expected. The non-veg options were more compared to veg, and the taste was better in non-veg dishes as well. The ambience was good and truly gives a fire-station vibe, just as the name suggests.

However, the service was very slow and not well-managed. Mocktails and main food arrived first, while the soup—which should have come first but about to come in the middle of the meal—was delayed so much that we eventually had to cancel it.

The prices are on the higher side considering the quality and quantity of food served. Overall, the experience was average.

Fire Station is one of the best places to hang out with a group of friends, especially on weekends. The DJ is amazing and plays all kinds of songs, keeping the energy high throughout the night and creating an incredible atmosphere. The food is also really good, making it a great spot for music, food, and fun. Highly recommended for a weekend outing!

One thing you will notice is that there are many reviews with only star ratings and no written feedback, and the restaurant has replied to most of them. These are reviews submitted while customers are dining at the restaurant. They are not trustworthy.

Now coming to the restaurant and the food.

I have visited this place a few times. The ambiance is nice, and the rooftop seating feels good.

The music can be quite loud, so you may need to raise your voice while talking. This is fine for resto-bars and may not bother everyone.

The service has generally been fine. On some visits it was fast, while on one occasion it took longer.

As for the food, I feel the quality has changed a bit compared to my earlier visits. It used to be very good, but during my recent visit I found it decent rather than great. M not saying the food is bad, but I would rate it somewhere between average and good.

If you're new to the area, you can visit here once and make your own opinion.

Aaleena has excellent behavior and is very friendly. She handled our team in a very polite and professional manner. The service was outstanding, and Fire Station is truly a family-friendly restaurant with very welcoming staff. Aaleena is one of the best staff members at Fire Station Restaurant. Her hospitality and customer service made our experience memorable. Thank you, Aaleena!"**

This place is such a vibe. The music was reminding of our childhood time with friends. The food and drinks we had were so  good. Me and my friends had really a good time there with the food and drinks with the music and vibe in their rooftop. I don’t have much photos from there but yeah good place and I recommend people to try and check out the place. I am not able to recall this drink’s name but something with Rum, I had a very bad throat situation and having this in the night cured my throat pain and cough too and this was so good to have.

name: Tipsy Bull - The Bar Exchange - JP Nagar
review_texts:
I would not recommend this place to anyone. The service was extremely disappointing. I had to call the waiter three times, but no one bothered to come to our table or even ask for our order.

Even after we finished eating, no one cleared the used plates from our table. The staff seemed completely inattentive, and no one came to serve us throughout our visit.

To make matters worse, there were no spoons or tissues on the table, and I had to get them myself from another table. If you’re looking for a self-service restaurant, then this place might suit you—but don’t expect any hospitality.

The food wasn’t that great either, which made the overall experience even more disappointing. I hope the management improves both the service and the quality of the food.

This place looks great vibe in morning but if you are with friends wants to watch IPL night time vibe is excellent 👌

We took veg and non veg starters with baby corn and paneer tikka and Gobi it was great

And their non veg starters was excellent also their ambience turns out to be good

If you are in and around Jp nagar this place you cannot miss it

This is a no-frills bar- food and drinks at pocket friendly prices. Staff is extremely courteous and professional.

As far as desserts are concerned, I would NOT recommend the Gulab Jamun. It was nothing like the standard jamun, the pulp seemed spongy and tasted strange.

This incident happened to us last Sunday during RCB match and we had booked through district app and reserved the table in advance also. On reaching there around 7:30pm the staff denied us entry and demanded 1.5k per person and disregarded our booking and said table is full. This was a very disappointing experience for us and didn’t expect this from Tipsy Bull JP Nagar staff.
If they were fully booked, they ought to let us know in advance rather than sending us back after we reached there. Very unprofessional behaviour from the staff.

Temva was bad at service. He doesn’t respond at all. No hospitalality. He wouldn’t help me with anything. I have no interest with paying the 7.5% service charges. He think he is the owner. I really would appreciate if tipsy bull could hire waiters having a hotel management degree

name: Ginger Greens
review_texts: A really good place to hang out, whether you're going alone or with friends. Some sections are quiet, so you can sit and relax, while other areas are great for a fun time. Prices are reasonable, not too expensive, and the food tastes really good. Service is okay, but the atmosphere stands out — lots of trees around give it a unique and refreshing vibe. Definitely recommended!
Good food.. good service.. but the washrooms could be improved.

Got Buffet at Rs 250. Food was nice and ambience was also totally natural. It feels like In between nature we’re having the delicious meal. If you are going with more than 5 people, just a give a call to ginger greens contact number, they’ll prepare everything according to the quantity. We had tandoori roti, naan, gobi chilly, veg curry, chicken curry, plain rice, chicken biryani, curd rice, raita, ice cream, sprite, water.
The perfect destination for a family dinner or a hangout with friends. The menu offers a great variety, the food is top-notch, and the bill won't break the bank. Great ambiance, even better prices.

A group of my college friends regularly meet at Ginger greens. It had become our favourite meeting spot. Food is good where we regularly order Harabara kabab, egg pakoda and chicken items. All the items are fresh with good taste. Service is friendly

name: 1522 The Pub JP Nagar
review_texts: Huge would be an understatement for this place. Name it and they have the item on the menu. Ample seating place and super good food. We had been on a Monday morning so the place was deserted but I could feel how it would be when it’s a weekend!  All of The vegetarian items we tried were pretty tasty and cooked to good perfection. The mocktails were also very good.

We visited on 16/04/26 to watch the IPL match with friends. The overall experience was good. We ordered multiple items, and both the service and food taste were satisfying. The 1522 Special Starter is a must-try item. Food prices were also reasonable compared to the quality and quantity.
However, the disappointing part was the water bottle pricing. The MRP on the Kinley water bottle was ₹18, but they charged ₹50 per bottle in the bill. Initially, we assumed they would charge the printed MRP, but after the meal we noticed the higher amount. When we questioned the staff, they did not give a proper explanation and were not ready to remove or adjust the extra charge.
This is not the correct way to earn money
It was disappointing to see the same bottle on every table being charged this way. Apart from this issue, food and service were good, but management should be transparent and fair with pricing.

They have an amazing cocktail menu, all must try!!
Deserts were good too and the place vibe is off charts! Must visit place with good match screenings also!!
Also the top jam sessions were also good, great songs.

Never order French chicken from here totally waste of my money fully oily not cooked properly no taste at all.
Nandini is far more better for French chicken.

The ambiance at 1522 was quite good, with a lively crowd and a nice vibe overall. It was a good place to hang out with friends. We ordered a tower and pitcher of beer (Magnum), along with chicken fingers, chips, and watermelon. The service was decent, and the total bill came to ₹7,000 for four people.

While the experience was nice, the pricing felt a bit on the higher side. Still, it's a good spot for a night out if you enjoy a lively atmosphere.

name: Siddique Kabab Centre
review_texts:
Visited Siddique, Coles Park after seeing mixed reviews. Honestly, my experience was good and pocket-friendly. Food quality and taste are much better than the low ratings suggest.

Tried multiple items - most were delicious. Only issue was with grill chicken: masala was too much and it wasn’t well cooked. Rest of the items were great.

I visited Siddique Kabab Center for lunch on Sunday. We ordered biryani, but the person taking our order was quite rude. He spoke in a way that made us feel unwelcome, almost as if we shouldn’t be dining there and should go somewhere else.

However, the Nepali staff member who served the food was very quick and efficient. He brought the food to our table promptly and had a warm, friendly smile throughout.

Note to management: Please train or replace the person taking orders so that customers are treated politely and with a smile. I don’t know his name, but he is short and thin. Dirty toilet not clear i had to wait for 15mins and 2 more wait after my using...

Siddique kabab center near Coles park tried their Achari chicken,Angara chicken,butter nun n Hyderabadi chicken gravy.Quantity is good but taste they should improve specially hyderabadi chicken gravy and biryani .
Other than that kabab and butter nun was tasty.
Ambience is good but service is not that good.

Best Tandoori Chicken in Bangalore. Hands down. Everything else is good too.
Very affordable if that isn't enough. 10/10 would recommend with my eyes closed. Have been coming here since 2011

Tried a few items at Siddique, Coles Park, and overall it was a good pocket-friendly experience. The brosted chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy inside, well seasoned and enjoyable. The Chicken Angara BBQ had a distinct smoky flavor with good spice levels, making it stand out from regular BBQ items.

The Nizam roll and chicken masala roll were both tasty and filling. The stuffing was flavorful, and the taste was different from the usual rolls you get elsewhere, which was a nice change.

To complement the food, the pineapple mojito was refreshing and balanced—not too sweet, perfect as a cooler.

Overall, the food was affordable, portions were decent, and the taste was different and satisfying. A good spot for budget-friendly non-veg snacks around Coles Park.

name: SOMRAS BAR & KITCHEN
review_texts:
Visited Somras Bar & Kitchen, Sector 1, HSR Layout, and had a wonderful experience. The place has a lively ambience, comfortable seating, and a great vibe for spending quality time with friends and family.

The lower level is full of energy— vibrant and lively, crowded, filled with music, fun and masti. It's the perfect place to enjoy with friends and soak in the vibrant atmosphere. The upper level on roof top  offers a more relaxed and comfortable ambience, making it an excellent choice for families and those who prefer a quieter experience.

The snacks and food was delicious, well presented, and the service was courteous and prompt. The place strikes a nice balance between a vibrant resto-bar and a comfortable restaurant, making it suitable for different kinds of outings.

The ambience, food, service and overall experience is great. Whether you're planning a fun evening with friends or a relaxed dinner with family, Somras Bar & Kitchen is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!

Great service by Mohammad quick orders. Really loved the Basha fish — very tasty and fresh. The veg, chicken, and prawns starters were also good. Mocktails and juices were refreshing. Nice dim-light ambience with open-air seating, which adds to the experience. Only downside is parking — even two-wheelers can be difficult to park on the opposite side when it gets crowded.

If you’re looking for a budget-friendly yet happening place in HSR Layout, Somaras Bar and Kitchen is definitely worth checking out. This place is quite popular among youngsters and working professionals, and it gets heavily crowded during peak hours, especially on weekends. So, if you want a good seat or a relaxed experience, making a reservation in advance is highly recommended.

The ambiance is one of the biggest highlights here—lively, energetic, and perfect for a fun evening with friends. We visited this place a few times with our group, and the vibe always felt fun and happening. Whether you’re planning a casual outing, a birthday celebration, or just a chill night out, the atmosphere fits all moods perfectly. The staff is well-trained, attentive, and manages the crowd efficiently, which is impressive considering how busy the place gets.

Coming to the food, it offers great value for money. The taste is satisfying across most dishes, and their bar snacks pair really well with the drinks. The menu also has a good variety of beers and cocktails, giving plenty of options to explore. One major advantage is the pricing—it is comparatively cheaper than many other bars and kitchens in HSR Layout, which makes it attractive for regular hangouts.

However, one concern we personally faced during multiple visits was related to hygiene and food quality consistency. A few times after dining here, some of us experienced stomach pain and health discomfort. We regularly visit many other places as well and did not face similar issues elsewhere. Because of this, we feel the management should pay more attention to maintaining hygiene standards and product quality. Affordable pricing is great, but quality and cleanliness should never be compromised.

Overall, Somaras Bar and Kitchen has an energetic crowd, good ambiance, and pocket-friendly pricing, but improving hygiene standards would make the experience much better and more reliable for customers.

Visited Somras Bar & Kitchen over the weekend. The place was extremely crowded, and while the vibe wasn’t particularly great, it was still manageable.
I was already aware from previous reviews that they charge a service charge despite the rule stating it’s not mandatory. Continuing to add it to the bill feels unfair. We chose not to argue about it, as many reviewers have mentioned facing resistance and attitude when questioning it, and ultimately being compelled to pay.
Coming to the food — prices are comparatively low, which is a positive. We tried the Peri Peri Chicken Wings, which were disappointing; the chicken was very hard and didn’t taste good. The Peri Peri Chicken Tikka, however, was very good and something I genuinely enjoyed. Banjara Chicken Tikka was also yum. The Chicken Nachos were average.
Service was okay considering the crowd. Overall, it’s an average place. The main highlight is the affordable pricing, but there’s definitely room for improvement in food consistency and customer approach regarding the service charge.

I recently visited Somras Bar & Kitchen in HSR Layout, and it turned out to be a pretty good spot for a relaxed evening with friends. The ambience is lively but not too loud — perfect for catching up over drinks without having to shout across the table.
The starters were the highlight for me — especially the tandoori items and bar snacks. They paired really well with the cocktails, which were nicely balanced and not overly sweet. The menu has a good mix of Indian, Chinese, and continental options, so there’s something for everyone in a group.
Service was decent overall, though it can get a little slow during peak hours. Pricing is mid-range for HSR, and portions are fair for what you pay.
Overall, it’s a nice casual place for weekend hangouts, team outings, or a chill dinner with drinks. Not ultra-luxury, but definitely a reliable and fun spot in the area.

name: South Kitchen
review_texts: Seems like a very popular place among the locals. The vada is very crispy but a little too soft inside, but sure a nice snack. Great filter coffee.

I’m absolutely loving the food here! The Navane bath, Shavige bath, and Idlis were all packed with authentic flavor. A huge shoutout for the special Vada and that incredible sweet chutney—a perfect combination. The Khara bath was a highlight; it literally melts in your mouth. To top it off, the service was impressively quick. Highly recommended! It is rare to find such flavorful food prepared entirely without onion and garlic. The taste is so incredible it actually lingers long after the meal. It proves that you don't need those ingredients when the preparation is this good
Good taste, very affordable. Flavourful food. The people will enjoy the food. Limited menu Sunday is a holiday
Lip smaking tiffen. Idli, vada, kara bath and Bisi Bele Bath is worth a try and to end with tea or ☕...

South Kitchen is one of those places that lives up to its reputation without trying too hard. The first thing you notice is the quick service—orders are prepared and served fast, and the self-service setup keeps everything moving smoothly even during busy hours.

The food is where it really stands out. The taste is consistently great, with that comforting, homely South Indian flavour that’s hard to get right everywhere. A big plus is that the menu is made without onion and garlic, which makes it a great option for Brahmins or anyone looking for sattvic-style food without compromising on taste.

The vibe adds to the experience. There’s a strong old Bengaluru charm here—the kind where people from all age groups come together, standing or sitting around, enjoying their food while conversations flow in the background. The constant chitter-chatter, the quick movement, and the no-frills setup all make it feel lively and authentic.

It’s not about fancy ambience or long, relaxed dining. It’s about good food, quick bites, and that familiar city feel that many places have lost over time. Despite the crowd, the system works efficiently, and you don’t feel overwhelmed.

Overall, South Kitchen is definitely worth the hype. It delivers on taste, speed, and simplicity, while also offering something unique with its no onion-garlic approach. A place you’ll keep going back to when you want something satisfying and fuss-free.

name: Indian Biere House
review_texts:
So, i visited this place very recently with my family as we were celebrating something very special. 🍻

The place felt extremely spacious the way it was designed despite the amount of people on the weekend , the decor consisted of Portugese tiles with indo western setup and a few paintings. The restaurant has subtle hints of nature all of the place🎍

This restaurant stood out with how well the staff was trained and the dish suggested by him was yummy too. Thanks to Mr Suman for making it extra special through these small guestures. 👏

The craft beer was really good although I expected a few more different ones from you.

The food was just amazing, we ordered many dishes all the way from nachos to fried tempura sushi to ground lamb pizza.
Every dish had a professional touch to it.
The head chef killed it with the Ottoman chicken just yummm 🤤.

Thank you for making the visit a memorable one🥂

Visited Indian Biere House in JP Nagar with friends recently. Overall, it was a decent experience, though a bit mixed.

We tried the dumplings, sushi, veg pizza, and paneer bao buns. The dumplings and sushi were the highlights both tasted good, although the portions felt quite limited for the price (5 dumplings and 8 sushi pieces). The Mediterranean veg pizza was average and a bit too bready for my liking. I personally wouldn’t recommend the paneer bao buns as the sweet, spicy, and tangy combination didn’t work well for me.

We also tried their Kalajamun beer, sangria, and mimosa, but unfortunately none of the drinks really stood out.

Service was decent, and the ambience was pleasant enough, but considering the pricing, I do feel the portion sizes could be better. Overall, worth trying once for the dumplings and sushi, but there’s room for improvement in both quantity and consistency.

Indian Bier House is a great place to visit, especially if you're looking for a vibrant dining experience with good food and an energetic crowd. The restaurant is extremely popular and tends to get packed during weekends, so be prepared for a bustling atmosphere. Despite the heavy footfall, the seating arrangement is well planned, allowing the space to feel organized even when it's full.

One aspect that stood out was the service. The staff were polite, attentive, and impressively efficient. Even during peak hours, they were quick to take orders and were accommodating when it came to food modifications or special requests. Their professionalism definitely enhanced the overall experience.

The ambience is lively and energetic, which many people may enjoy. However, it can get quite noisy, especially during busy hours. If you're planning to have a long conversation or a quiet catch-up with friends, you may find yourself raising your voice frequently just to be heard across the table.

Coming to the food, we tried the Veg OG Farmhouse Inspired Napoli-Style Pizza, which turned out to be quite enjoyable. The pizza had a flavorful combination of toppings and a well-made crust that complemented the ingredients nicely. It was satisfying without feeling overly heavy.

The Peri Peri Fries were easily one of the highlights of the meal. Crispy, generously seasoned, and packed with flavor, they were addictive and probably the standout dish we ordered.

We also tried the Veg Crystal Dimsums. While they were decent and well-presented, they didn't leave a lasting impression and felt average compared to the other dishes on the table.

The ambience was excellent and easily one of the best parts of the experience. The dim sums were very good, and the pizza was enjoyable as well. Overall, the food was good, but considering the pricing, I felt the quality could have been better. It's a place that leaves you with mixed feelings—great atmosphere and some standout dishes, but the food doesn't fully justify the premium price. Nevertheless, it was a pleasant experience overall.

Packed especially in IPL season. We went with friends, the place was packed due to RCB match. Ambience is good.
Food needs a bit of improvement. Sheek Kababs served were cold and dry. Our server went a long way to serve us drinks and food. Staff is polite and amicable.
Facilities are clean and well maintained.

name: Shift Lounge - HSR Layout
review_texts: Had a great time at Shift Lounge - HSR Layout. The rooftop ambience, music, and overall vibe were really good. Food and cocktails were tasty, and the place is perfect for hanging out with friends on weekends. Service was decent even during busy hours. Definitely a good spot in HSR Layout for chill evenings . But music was bit noisy.

Average tasting food with small portions at expensive prices. The top floor is just for sitting, the floor below that has a dance floor and loud music. Dance floor is very small, people start dancing after 9 PM and the DJ hits bad music, no beats, just too loud music, bad selection of songs, no vibes for dancing. Nothing good about this place, might be considered as a last option. There is no place for parking too, have to park on road.

I have mixed feelings about my visit to Shift Lounge. There are some definite highlights, but the drink quality and service left a lot to be desired.

The Highlights: Food & Vibes
If you are coming here strictly for the food, you won't be disappointed.

Must-Try: The Fish Fingers are top-notch and easily the best thing on the menu.

Ambience: The overall vibe and decor are great, making it a visually pleasant spot to hang out.

The Lowlights: Drinks & Service
This is where the experience falls short.

The Bar: If you’re looking for quality drinks, this isn't the place. The alcohol felt very low quality; both the beer and the whiskey seemed diluted. Considering the high prices, the drink quality is a major letdown.

Service: The service is quite slow and feels a bit old-fashioned. You have to manually check the menu and flag down a waiter to get anything done.

Comfort: I wasn't a fan of the seating arrangements, and the air conditioning/ventilation could definitely use an upgrade.

Entertainment: The DJ was a miss for me. The track selection didn't really fit the mood or get the crowd grooving.

Summary: Go for the Fish Fingers and the atmosphere, but stick to bottled water or soda if you don't want to overpay for subpar drinks.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟From the moment I walked in, I knew this restaurant was something special. The ambiance strikes the perfect balance between cozy and elegant, making it ideal for both casual dinners and special occasions.The service was impeccable — attentive without being intrusive. Every staff member seemed genuinely passionate about ensuring guests had a memorable experience.The food, though, is the true star. Each dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. The ingredients tasted fresh and thoughtfully paired, showing real creativity in the kitchen. The chef clearly has a gift for elevating classic dishes with modern flair.Highlights included the melt-in-your-mouth starter, the perfectly cooked main course, and a dessert that was nothing short of heavenly. Every bite felt like a celebration of taste.Overall, this restaurant delivers excellence in every aspect — atmosphere, service, and cuisine. It’s the kind of place you’ll want to return to again and again, and one you’ll recommend wholeheartedly to friends and family.

Great food. Ambience feels a little congested. Extremely quick service of food. Valet Parking is available.
I recommend:
Sambal Chicken
Spinach Corn Mushroom & Cheese Pizza
Crispy Corn
Veg Penne Pasta

Not recommended:
Malai Tikka

name: BigBite -Veg Food & Chaat Restaurants in Vijayanagar
review_texts:
The only place in Vijaynagar where people from small age to very aged persons you will be able to having chats and juices. This place serving almost all types of chats at very very affordable price, and maintaining authenticity from very long time. Saw people who were once visiting this place when they were in school and now bringing their children to have it.

Mainly I recommend chats platter where you have all types of chats in it, Korean buns, tawa pulav, tandoori paneer, cheese cake and mocktails.

Guys definitely you will 100% definitely like for sure with no doubt, only thing is it’s very crowd in the evening so plz do visit with friends and family at the afternoon or 3-5pm between or after 8:30pm that is after peak time.

This bakery is 11/10 , it has all types of desserts , you get berliners,cheescakes,tiramisu,lotus Biscoff Tub and pizzas pastas much more. It's always crowded especially on Sundays it's a must try for all desserts lovers! I tried their Korean Bun , farmhouse Pizza, Lotus Biscoff Tub which is a must must try here. It's the best lotus Biscoff Tub ever eaten . Loved it ,loved the place. Only thing is it's not much spacious place to sit and have dishes,the place had to be bigger so that all people could sit and have the food.

This QSR offers huge spread, limited seating capacity. Tasted here cheese sev puri, special papdi pizza, Babycorn stick, Kolhapuri Bhel, Pani Puri, Veg Momo Tikka, Sizzling Brownie and Big Bite special Icecream. All of them tasted great with right spice levels and flavors. Tough to get the seat, parking for 4 wheeler. Affordable prices, quick service and wide range of varieties to try. Definitely visit another time to try out other dishes.

The Taste Of Veg Burgers 🍔 was Worth and Flavor full with The Bun's were Fresh 4.5/5. Dahii Aloo Puri and Dahii sev puri was Average Not worth* The Big Bite Roll was 🌯 gud in taste. Itz Quite Expensive Some Off Them were Not worth I only Recommend The Veg Burger 🍔 and  Wrap 🌯 to try it*
It a very good place to have snacks. All the food I ate tasted really good. The place is always packed in the evenings. The service can be a bit quick, but other than that it is a really good place.

name: Udupi Sri Krishna Bhavan
review_texts:
Udupi Krishna Bhavan is a lovely place for a traditional South Indian breakfast. The dosa was truly excellent — crisp, flavorful, and very satisfying. The idly was soft and fresh, and the pongal was delicious and comforting. The food quality and taste are definitely the highlights.

However, the service could have been better. It felt a bit slow and less attentive at times. Improving the service would make the overall dining experience even more pleasant.

Overall, a great spot for tasty and authentic food.

Went there with my family to have lunch. The lunch was almost over, we did not get the special Thali (the best I think the restaurant is famous for). We were 8 person and asked to club two desks together, but they denied and hence we have to be splitted in two groups.  We were quite hungry so just did not want to explore nearby.

Besides, crowd is little heavy so you may need to stand on the queue for your turn.

Beside coffee was probably priced at 25 Rs which I felt too high given we generally get 15-18 Rs in such Udupi branches.

We got here around 1pm on a Saturday afternoon and got seated immediately. We got the regular meals, which had pooris, holige, sambhar, same, curd rice etc. while the food was okay, it was quite underwhelming. Cold, very mildly delicious, muddled flavours, not bad but definitely not great. Very very mid. Okay for a one time try, but that's pretty much it.

I had a wonderful breakfast experience at Udupi Sri Krishna Bhavan! 😋 The food was absolutely delicious and the service was top-notch. I was pleasantly surprised by how affordable it was, definitely a great value for money! ✨ I highly recommend this place for a delightful meal. 👍

Went here for breakfast on a Sunday morning . We had to wait for about 20-25 mins to get a table.  One section of the restaurant was kept closed . Had they opened it , there wouldn’t have been any waiting . Not sure why they don’t open it during breakfast . Coming to the food , the idli and vada were very nice . Piping hot tasty sambar and a nice spicy chutney . The masala dosa was good too, however they could have gone a little easy on the tuppa. Coffee was amazing . Overall a very nice place to have breakfast but definitely needs better crowd management.

name: Corner House - Jayanagar 5th Block
review_texts:
Excellent ice cream experience!

Today we visited Karnaroos, 5th Block, Jayanagar, and it was a wonderful experience. The ice creams were absolutely delicious with rich taste and excellent quality. They have a wide variety of flavors to choose from—something for everyone—and each one we tried was really good.

The ambience is pleasant and comfortable, making it a nice place to relax and enjoy dessert. The staff were very polite, friendly, and helpful, which made our visit even better.

Overall, everything was perfect—from taste and variety to service and atmosphere. Highly recommended for all ice-cream lovers! 🍨😊

Visited this spot after TasteAtlas ranked their DBC among 100 most iconic ice creams in the world, but it was way too sugary / sweet.. This might be more popular due to nostalgia for many than the taste.

Love all the outlets of Corner House as such. This one located in Jayanagar gives retro vibes with the interiors dotted with old pics of Bangalore and the history of the city

Space is decent inside and the service is super quick here. Love the death by chocolate and other brownie based icecreams here

Will keep visiting

Good place for ice creams, it's a very old non place to serve death by chocolate. Ice creams are tasty but there are other icecream outlets doing a better job these days. Good to try, some people are fans for this place, wonder if they haven't tried other places or could have become a cool thing to visit Corner house.

When it comes to ice creams, Corner House has always been my most fav in Bengaluru, visited this store of corner House over a weekend and as always the brand stands out ! Yum ice creams indeed !  Not much crowd when we went there, parking is tricky though!

name: Kapoor's Cafe - Yelahanka
review_texts: ​If you are looking for a place that captures the true essence of a Punjabi dhaba while offering the comfort of a modern dining space, kapoors cafe is an absolute must-visit. From the moment you walk in, the rich aromas of roasting spices and clarified butter (ghee) let you know you’re in for an authentic feast. Our host Nikil served the food ordered really quick and the food was really delicious 😋

Good food, good ambiance, good service. Portion size is big, so order accordingly.

I liked the regular lassi than the dry fruit one, gobi pakora was good, less oily (did not give the deep fried feeling), green chutney given along with it was yummy.

French fries Punjabi style we tried, they specify  it’s spicy but spice level was good to me

The food did not taste good. I ordered a veg pulao for 380, but the quantity was very less and the taste was just average, not satisfying. 🙂
I recently tried the mushroom masala combo at this restaurant. The overall taste was just average and did not meet my expectations. Based on my experience, I would not recommend visiting this restaurant.
Waste of money.!

Here for a weekend lunch. It's on the rooftop and has a non-ac and AC seating and a party hall. We wanted to sit inside but they said AC was not working so we managed outside which seemed better. Nice seating arrangement just like all of the outlets with vibrant colors. We tried a few a Thali's , paneer pakoda and veg seekh kebab. The starters were food and so were the lassi and buttermilk. In the Thali , we found uncooked potatoes in Aloo sabzis. Chole, dal and paneer were all great. Service was ok, had to call the staff a couple of times. Service charge was added to the bill, when I requested them to remove it considering its optional and the saga with the AC, they refused saying it's automated billing and they can't exclude it which was just an excuse. There is also paan available for purchase and we opted for banarasi paan they gave us paan leaves that were almost grey as if they had dried or were not fresh, when we questioned them they said that's how banaras paan looks, considering I've been to banaras a few times and eaten banarasi paan a number of times, I can tell that was not true. Overall a one time visit.

The food and ambience of the place was just too good. I went with a group of friends, which was really fun. I would suggest people to go in a group of 4-5 to have the best experience of this place. They have seats which are typically found in dhabas, and they have a separate AC section too. The food was tasty, but we felt it was a bit pricey ( especially the lassi which was priced at 120 for a glass). And yea the paan was mid, I wouldn’t suggest it. The overall experience of the place was great, would definitely recommend. 👌

name: Brew Meister Craft Beer and Kitchen
review_texts: Brew Meister is a fine place to hangout. I went to the terrace but found the setup to be a bit congested; guess they want to accommodate as many customers as possible. Smoking was allowed though there was a warning written. This place brews beer and a couple options were available (look at the menu picture). I went for IPA and it was fine. The food was good, well cooked and tasteful. But the service was late, at around 3pm, when just 3 to 4 tables were occupied. Spent about 2ish hours here and it was quite fine.
Food was below average, not too bad. Chicken loaded nachos was not fresh. Mushroom Cigar was good, beer was good. Place is very much under maintained …
Thought bit run down but you get beer😁nice and airy though .. needs some cleaning I guess

Brew Meister offers a great dining experience with delicious food, a warm ambiance, and excellent service. The staff were kind, attentive, and made the visit even more enjoyable. A perfect spot to relax and unwind!

Good place for an afternoon beer and some finger foods. Tried all the beers.. each one tastes good. Pricing is also reasonable. Pale ale and pilsner was really good and very light aswell. Overall a good place in hustle bustle area 👌

name: The Palms Brew and Kitchen
review_texts:
We visited The Palms Brew & Kitchen for a team dinner, and it turned out to be a fantastic experience from start to finish.

The ambience is one of the biggest highlights—spacious, vibrant, and beautifully designed with plenty of seating options spread across two floors. There’s ample parking, which is a huge plus, especially for larger groups, and the large screens make it a great place to catch live sports while enjoying your meal.

The staff were warm, humble, and attentive throughout our visit. They patiently helped us with recommendations, making it easy to choose from the extensive menu.

We tried quite a few dishes, including Mutton Pepper, Dragon Chicken, Dumplings, Butter Garlic Prawns, Pizza, and Pasta, and every single dish was delicious. The portions were generous, the ingredients tasted fresh, and the flavours were perfectly balanced. Among the drinks, the Tongue Twister (non-alcoholic) was my personal favourite—refreshing and definitely worth trying.

Whether you’re planning a team outing, a family dinner, or a casual evening with friends, this place has something for everyone. The menu offers plenty of variety, the atmosphere is lively yet comfortable, and the overall experience is top-notch. I’d recommend reserving a table in advance if you’re visiting with a large group.

Overall, The Palms Brew & Kitchen delivers on every aspect—great ambience, delicious food, refreshing drinks, excellent service, and a wonderful vibe. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be visiting again!

Had a wonderful lunch at The Palms today with family and friends. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and packed with flavor. The Dilli 6 Chicken Kebab, Kali Mirch Chicken Tikka, Tandoori Jheenga, Murgh Patiyala, and Railway Mutton Curry were absolute standouts. The Mango Tres Leches and Kunafa Pistachio Warm Chocolate dessert made for a perfect ending.
The cocktails and mocktails were refreshing, and the overall ambiance was warm, vibrant, and ideal for a relaxed weekend lunch. Service was courteous and attentive throughout, making the experience even more enjoyable.
The only reason it's not a full 5 stars is that a few dishes took a little longer to arrive. Other than that, everything was excellent. Looking forward to visiting again!

Good Ambience
Good Food
Good Service

Went here on a Thursday noon for a lunch and a quick drink. The place is tastefully done with a huge parking.
The service is pretty good and the food is delectable. The keema puff was specially notable, the soft puff with a mildly spiced puff complemented each other really well.
The ambience is beautiful done. A beautiful place to visit.

The place looks nice with bamboo and alot of greenery. The waiter Amar was friendly,  patient and offered good service. The hostesses at the entrance could be more friendly and not fake. The pepper baby corn, and tandoori paneer were really tasty. The cocktail nirvana was good. But I feel the prices are a bit high ..there are so many other places with a good ambience offering value for money food and drinks..so why can't this place as  well.

Had a wonderful experience here! The ambience is warm, cozy, and perfect for a relaxed meal. We tried the veg thukpa momo soup, mushroom pizza, and mushroom tandoori starter, and every dish was absolutely delicious and full of flavor. A special mention to Debashis for the excellent service. He was attentive, courteous, and made sure we had a great dining experience. Would definitely recommend this place and look forward to visiting again!

name: Polar Bear Ice Cream Sundaes - Rajarajeshwari Nagar
review_texts:
Visited Polar Bear at RR Nagar, Bengaluru, and it was an extremely disappointing experience. We placed our order at around 1:55 PM for just three sandwiches, yet it took nearly 35 minutes to prepare. Such a long wait for a simple order is completely unacceptable and reflects very poor service.

To make matters worse, the food quality was terrible. We ordered the Peri Peri Paneer Sandwich, but it barely had any paneer in it. Calling it a paneer sandwich is misleading when the main ingredient is practically missing. The sandwich was poorly made and nowhere close to what was advertised.

Pathetic service, substandard food quality, and a complete waste of time and money. I won’t be visiting again and definitely wouldn’t recommend this outlet.

Polar Bear Ice Cream is a lovely spot with one of the best ambiences I’ve found—quiet, peaceful, and perfect for relaxing. The Strawberry Mastani was very good—fresh and flavorful—while the Blueberry Bliss was also enjoyable. I ordered the Hot Chocolate Fudge, which quickly became my favorite: rich, indulgent, and perfectly balanced. The Coffee Brazilila ice cream was just okay, not bad but not standout, and my DBC Sundae was good as well. Overall a great place for a calm treat.
Great place, amazing taste, even better people. Staff is super cooperative + friendly. Worth the trip!
Cozy warm and a good hangout place to give yourself dessert treat all the staffs are pretty good and very much down to earth especially Nimrita ...way to go polar bear
Good vibes and good ice creams.. great place to hang out with friends.

name: Starbucks - Chruch Street
review_texts:
Had a wonderful experience! The Americano was perfectly brewed – bold, smooth, and balanced with a rich aroma. Exactly how a classic Americano should taste.
The service was equally impressive – quick, courteous, and very attentive. The team ensured everything was served fresh and hot. Truly a great place for coffee lovers. Highly recommended!

Visited Starbucks Church Street recently mainly for the Hogwarts theme, but the experience didn’t live up to expectations.
I ordered the Hogwarts Golden Vanilla Latte, and the drink itself wasn’t good flavor felt off and not something I’d order again. Also, the presentation and decoration didn’t match the themed vibe at all, which was honestly disappointing since that’s the main attraction.
If you’re looking for better quality coffee, Third Wave Coffee right next to it does a much better job. And if you prefer Starbucks, the outlet near UB City offers a far better experience.
Thank you! Great place to grab a nice cold coffee, some hot food, and get your work done here. The staff were very helpful, and customized the order for me.

I had a truly wonderful experience at this Starbucks today. The coffee was perfectly brewed, rich, and consistent. The staff were incredibly friendly and efficient, getting my order just right, even during a busy rush. The atmosphere was clean, warm, and welcoming—making it the perfect spot to catch up on work or just relax. I'll definitely be returning!"

Invoice Date: May 31, 2026
Cashier: S036
Invoice #: S03627T110007466
Having been to Starbucks locations all around the world, I was disappointed by the service here. First of all, I was never asked whether my order was for takeaway or dine-in. It was just served in a takeaway cup by default. I noticed this isn't just an isolated incident; many people in this cafe are being given takeaway cups by default.
