It seems to be a common practice here to just hand them out without asking, for which there is really no justification. My 10-year-old daughter always loves the presentation in the glass cups, so she completely missed out on that experience for her Tall Belgium Chocolate.
To make matters worse, because the chocolate was so thick and yummy, she couldn't easily sip it with a straw. When she went down to ask for a spoon, a staff member told her she should just use a straw and sent her away. When we adults went down to ask for a spoon ourselves, the employee actually responded by asking us "Why?". I have no clue if he even understands why a spoon is used, but we actually had to explain it to him before he finally changed his mind and gave us one. Is the staff just trying to avoid washing dishes, or is this an official Starbucks policy now?
Additionally, we also took a Starbucks reusable cup. The staff claimed they could not generate a bill for it due to a "technical issue," but they still collected ₹400 in cash from us without providing any receipt. This is highly unprofessional

name: Corner House Banashankari
review_texts:
This Corner House  branch is comparatively more spacious than some of the older outlets, which makes the experience more comfortable.

The place is clean, well maintained, and has a simple self-service setup. Even when it gets crowded, things are managed smoothly. The ambience is casual and perfect for a quick dessert outing with friends or family.

Coming to the desserts, the highlight is obviously the Death by Chocolate (DBC), which remains unbeatable. Rich, indulgent, and full of chocolate layers — it’s a must-try every time. The hot chocolate fudge and cake fudge are also excellent options, especially if you want something similar at a slightly lower price. Flavours like rum & raisin, cashew fudge, almond fudge, and fruit-based sundaes are also very good, with a nice balance of taste and texture.

One thing I like is the consistency — the taste and quality remain the same across visits. Portions are satisfying, and the freshness is noticeable.

Prices are reasonable for the quality, though it can add up if you order multiple items.

Overall, one of the best places in Bangalore for ice cream and desserts. Simple, reliable, and always satisfying.

Food: 5/5
Service: 4/5
Atmosphere: 4/5
Value for Money: 4/5

Moved to better place. Nice ambience and lot of place to sit and park vehicle...

As usual all icreams is worth eating. quantity and price is justified

One of the nicest spots to gather, especially for sweet lovers. My friend and I tried the DBC and a sundae — both were excellent! The flavors were rich and satisfying, but after a while the sweetness really hit us hard, leaving us with a “sweet trauma” for the whole day. Perfect for those with a strong sweet tooth, but maybe pace yourself if you’re not used to such indulgence.

Its a good place to hang out with friends with tasty deserts.
As usual all time favourite DBC😋
And can even try think shakes here they are also very tasty for this hot summer.😜

I tried the Rum & Raisin ice cream and it was simply amazing – rich, smooth and packed with flavor. The Death by Chocolate was equally irresistible, a true chocolate lover’s dream with its deep, indulgent taste. Both were incredibly satisfying and definitely worth coming back for. Highly recommend for anyone with a sweet tooth! 🍨✨

name: Corner House - Basavanagudi
review_texts:
Corner House Ice Cream is not just an ice cream parlour — it’s a piece of my childhood and honestly, a whole emotion.

I’ve been coming here since I was little, and no matter how much Bangalore evolves, this place remains the OG dessert spot. They’re famous for their iconic sundaes, especially their signature ones — and rightfully so!

And that hot chocolate sauce? Absolutely to die for. Warm, rich, and poured so generously — it’s what makes every bite unforgettable.

My go-to order will always be the Cake Fudge (mini version of DBC) — because I don’t like sharing my ice cream 😌. It’s the perfect amount of indulgence, loaded with everything you need for a chocolate fix.

Honestly, no matter what mood I’m in — sad, happy, angry, or celebrating — there’s only one solution:
Corner House’s Cake Fudge.

Some places serve desserts, but this one serves comfort, nostalgia, and happiness in every bite 🤍✨

This is one of the ideal place to have icecream near Basavanagudi. Have tried the DBC on multiple occasions. It’s excellent & taste is good. Ideal to be shared for better experience as it’s quite a sugar overload for one person.
The ambience is decent with limited seating capacity. It’s usually busy on weekends during the evening hrs. The pricing is expensive & premium must be said. Not like the earlier days. Service too is fast. They did not have cone 🍦 during my last visit not sure if that’s the case most of the time. Chocolate too appears very thick & juicy. Restroom facility is available with hand wash too available.
The customers need to park their vehicles on the road in front of the shop or near by as it may get difficult during the busy hrs. Overall a decent space to try the iconic corner house DBC.

The ice creams are creamy and tasty, while being expensive for the quantity. Parking spaces for two-wheelers are readily available, but it can be difficult to get a location for a four-wheeler. In Basavanagudi, Corner House is renowned for its excellence and diversity. Although we strongly suggest the chocolate sundaes, the apple crumble with vanilla ice cream is a fantastic choice if you're looking for something different. All things considered, it is a trustworthy place to savor excellent desserts.

This is one of the best place to have authentic ice reams around Basavanagudi. All the ice reams are good and carries a unique taste profile to it. We had DBC and must say it was excellent in taste and more than sufficient for 1 person.

The ambience is above average if not fancy. But it carries a good vibe to enjoy the ice cream. It can accommodate 25 people at one shot and usually crowded during evenings.

There is no dedicated parking area instead customers need to park their vehicles on the public parking and it is not difficult to find a parking beside the road as the road is wide and spacious.

Great ice cream shop! My nieces absolutely love the ice creams here. There are plenty of delicious flavors to choose from. Their Death by Chocolate, Almond Fudge, and Café Mocha are the best across all their outlets.

name: Al-Bek Restaurant
review_texts:
I have been a regular customer at Albek , RT Nagar, for the last 5–6 years, but my recent experiences have been extremely disappointing.

About two weeks ago, I ordered tandoori chicken and found multiple chicken feathers in it. When I brought it to the staff’s attention, they initially said it was “common” and suggested I simply remove the feathers and continue eating. Only after I insisted on speaking to the manager did they apologize.

The person at the billing counter explained that all the food is prepared at their main kitchen in Rajajinagar and that the RT Nagar outlet only cooks and serves it. He assured me that he would escalate my complaint to the main Rajajinagar team and apologized for the experience. Since I had been a loyal customer for years, I decided to let it go, assuming it was a one-time issue and that the problem would be addressed.

Unfortunately, when I visited again yesterday for dinner, I experienced the exact same issue. I found a chicken feather in my chicken biryani. We also ordered the Andhra Kebab, which was equally disappointing and nowhere close to the quality the restaurant was once known for.

This time, I didn’t even bother complaining because I had already raised the issue during my previous visit and was assured it would be taken seriously. I simply paid my bill and left. When the staff asked why I was leaving disappointed, I told them that the same hygiene issue had happened again.

While I was leaving, I also noticed two other customers returning their food to the staff because they were unhappy with it. I don’t know the exact reason for their complaints, but it reinforced my impression that the overall quality has declined.

It is very disappointing that despite assuring me the complaint had been escalated to the main kitchen in Rajajinagar, nothing seems to have changed. Finding chicken feathers in food once is unacceptable. Finding them repeatedly over multiple visits points to a serious lack of hygiene and quality control.

As someone who has been visiting AlBek for over five years, it’s sad to see such a decline in standards over the past few months. I can no longer recommend this place. If hygiene and food quality are important to you, I would advise avoiding this restaurant until these issues are properly addressed.

Tried Hyderabadi chicken dum biriyani, bangalore mutton biriyani and special kebab.

Chicken biriyani was good and it was more than enough for 1 person.

Mutton biriyani was also good and the rice flavor was so so good.

Special kebab was a disappointment.  Contained 6 pieces of grilled chicken. It lacked flavor and we couldn't finish it.
The food taste and variety were good. The restaurant was clean and hygienic. However, the service could be a little faster. 🤜

Worst experience ever.
We ordered Dum Biryani Special and found a long hair inside the food. Completely unacceptable.
I immediately returned the dish and walked out of the restaurant. What made it worse was the front-desk manager’s attitude—he seemed totally unconcerned, busy counting cash and taking orders, with zero care for hygiene or customer safety.
This was a pathetic and disturbing experience.
Not recommended at all.
People ordering takeaway or home delivery should be extremely careful, as you won’t even know what’s inside until it’s too late.

Extremely disappointing experience.
I ordered their special dum biryani and discovered a strand of long hair mixed in the food. This is a serious hygiene failure.
I handed the dish back and left the place immediately. What was shocking was the response at the counter—the person in charge showed no concern whatsoever, staying occupied with billing and orders as if nothing had happened.
This shows a lack of basic cleanliness and accountability.
I would strongly advise against dining here.
Those placing online or takeaway orders should be extra cautious, since issues like this may go unnoticed until the food is opened.

name: Animal Bar
review_texts:
This restaurant offers great ambience. It is spread in big area and it has AC with no smoking zone and NON- AC with smoking zone with large space to accommodate big parties. Washroom were pretty clean which is mostly not so in many places. Talking about food and drink both were amazing and budget friendly. We were there for around 4 hours and enjoyed it.
Additional point is you can ask for inhouse offers.

Overall we had great evening and we loved it. We wanted to try out new restaurant and the experience here was great.

Ambience - 4/5
Food - 4/5
Drinks - 4/5

This was my first time at Hammered and I had gone there to catch-up with my friends. We ordered a few drinks and the Veg and Non veg platter along with Fried Rice,Dal Tadka and Chicken Biriyani. Overall the food was tasty. The service was fast as there was only one couple in the restaurant with us, given that it was a Thursday evening.
The atmosphere could have been better...The place looked extremely shady and the restrooms could do an overhaul.

Very good location. Parking space is good. Two wheeler parking is outside and car parking in basement.
Good place for hookah lovers.  Ambience is very nice. Great interiors and neatly maintained. They have two floor. Ground floor is non smoking zone. And first floor is for smokers. Food taste is good.
Masala French fries is best. They play music in the evening.

Just a right spot for weekend parties.  Ambience, food, service, interiors, all are top notch. There are several elements just nicely placed around the place. Food is good and you can feel the freshness, fries are just best and presentation wise they are masters of food. The only problem is drinks, a big no no for cocktails and mocktails.... otherwise Kudos guys!

I had a disappointing experience. The servers completely ignored us, even though I didn't notice them treating other customers the same way. The table we were given was dirty, which wasn't a great start. Later, a staff member came over and told us we weren't supposed to be sitting there, even though we had been seated there in the first place.

As for the food, it was just average and definitely not worth the price. Overall, the service and experience didn't match the cost, and I wouldn't recommend this place based on my visit.
